tei:div.tei:p: stodzodang rnalar/sa zhusku ga las rku zhu

(a)ra༅༅//rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mdzad pa po dpal rgyas dbang po/zhu sgrig pa mkhan bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin/na00

ra༅༅/ /oṃ susnyi/ de yang 'dir rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pa'i mkhas dbang / lung rigs kyi lus stobs lhag par rgyas shing phus rgol glang po'i spobs pa 'phrog pa la mchog tu dpa' ba'i gdong lnga pa/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i zab dbang thugs rgyud la smin pas gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon sum du gzigs pa'i grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po 'jam mgon sangs rgyas rdo rje mchog dang / thams cad mkhyen gzigs dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde zung gi zhal slob tu gyur pa/ dus zhabs pa dpal rgyas dbang po mchog gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i/ rgyal dbang 'brug pa ska phreng lnga pa skyabasamagoni dpag bsam dbang po mchog gi rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dgazha ba'i zlos gar zhes bya ba/ rdor gling dpal 'brug sgar dpe mdzod nas rtsis 'phrul nang btsud gnang pa de bzhin

ma dpe 'gazha zhig la gzhi bcol te slar yang zhu dag dang bcas/ bla ma phrin las rnam rgyal mchog gi thugs bskyed med du byung tshorin po che'i nye 'dabs shrī gau tapa buddha wi ha ra'i gsung rab rgyun spel khang du/ tshe dbang lha mo nas rtsis 'phrul nang dpe gzugs thudape tshogs lte gnas khang dang / dpal ldan mkhas dbang jin mi mitha mchog gi lam ston dang rogs skyor 'og /rgyal sa kyāsku'i ring bsrel gsar bskan skabs/ rnam dkar gyi 'du byed po mkhan bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin pas/ rnam 'dren bzhi pa rgyal bam̐kyi nags su/ bden bzhi'o chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen khyad par yo gyi i/(3010 zla bske7 pa'i tshes ska)par skrun lha

pa dbang po'i rnam thar skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bya ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so// 'phrul phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khrangs rabs dang por smos pa 01sa bzhin du slar yang sprul pa'i zlos gar za hor gyi rgyal rigs mtshungs pa med par bstan pa 455 bya mtha' dag la spyan ras kyi gzigs pa stsal ba dbyen grangs 72rtsi phan bde'i dbyed du bzhes pa dbyen grangs 103

/) rab byed lnga pa shes bya rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son nas bsnyen par rdzogs te dge slong gi dngos por byon pa dbyin grangs /34e) rab byed drug pa nges 'byung gi glang po dben pa'i nags la phyogs pa /62she) rab byed bdun pa lo gsum phyogs kyi rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa bsam gtan lhur len mdzad rjes 'phrin las kyi sgo dang por phye ba /89ce) rab byed brgyad pa gnas chen du rten 'brel gyi legs tshogs mtha' dag 'grags te rgyal ba gar gyi dbang po dang mjal ba 2/6she) rab byed dgu pa bstan 'gro'i dpal du ngur smig 'dzin pa'i grwa sde btsugs pa 140

tabye) rab byed bcu pa sprul pa'i skyes mchog nyi zla lta bu sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed du bkod pa 2641she) rab byed bcu gcig pa phul du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin skye 'gro'i mchod sdong dam par lhun gyis grub pa 2941she) rab byed bcu gnyis pa yongs 'dzin mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chos kyi 'khor los sgyur bar dbang bskur ba 327dkubo/ rab byed bcu gsum pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rgya mtshos sprul pa'i skyes mchog sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par rjes su bzung ba 36514na/ rab byed bcu bzhi pa 'dod pa'i dngos grub brnyes te 'phrin las kyi zhags pas kun gsal gyi pha mtha' bcings pa 396

1/) rab byed bco lnga pa mtha'i dmag dpung thugs rje'i zer gyis bzlog par mdzad de bod yul gyi skye 'gro phan bde'i dpal la bkod pa 4251bu) rab byed bcu drug pa phul du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin rnam par dkar bas ma dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig rjes bzung ba 4581gyi) rab byed bcu bdun pa dad ldan gyi dge legs gong du spel ba'i phyir rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal rin po che las bzhengs pa 4761/) rab byed bco brgyad pa thun mong ma yin pa'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas yongs su gang ba sgrub brgyad rgya mtsho'i dpal du spel ba 5011spyi) rab byed bcu dgu pa thog mar dge ba ༄ 522

smubyed rab byed nyi shu pa bar du dge ba 5472she) rab byed nyer gcig pa mtha' maradage ba 5672she) rnam thar gyi mjug sbyang 596'an/ rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod phul byung dad pa'i 'jug ngogs/ chos smra ba ngag gi dbang pos mdzad pa 603———615bcas bzhugs pa lags sku1// //sarba maṅga lam̐//

ra༅༅/ thamagasuraratnadzanajisarbadzñābaskradzramuniḥsana'i ranātal /senasabamokusubhagananda/ṭanāmabaharatasma/ /ra༅༅/ /dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams to mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rtsam par thar pa skal bzang kun 6 dga' ba'i blos gar zhes bya ba ba'ags so//

ra༅༅//traya:kasarbaka9bashyi//lokezhanirmakhamarā0kaḥ shrīsabomeghasārarsānind+raḥsarbazhuthagurugamasnya/ /ra༅༅/ /dus gsum kun la gzigs patsho thugs rje can/ /'jag rten dbang phyug sgya 'phrul zlas pa'i gar/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dbang po dpal 'brug pa/ /kun mkhyen bla ma 'gro ba'o mgon por 'dud/ /

go༅༅/ /dzamālhagacinaswarupasnikuḥhastepa75cha'ilaṅgāre/ /tra:tsherasmadhamirādza:nywachelhamisadagosgyudzo/ /go༅༅//rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs bcom ldan 'das/ /phyag na padmo dge slong tshul 'dzin pa'/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'brug pa//slob mar bcas pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /

sgrib bral ye shes me long nang du shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi gzugs/ /rdzogs par shar ba'i blo gros snang bas ma rig mun pa'i dpung bcom nas/ /kun mkhyen mchog gi go sar bkri la gzhan dring mi 'jog lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam dgrangs smra ba'i nyi mar 'dud do bdag blo'i padmo rtag skyongs shig /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las legs 'khrangs gang sku'i lhun po rin chen mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /grub pa'i ring lugs legs pa'i lam stoni gang gsung gzhom med yan lag drug cu'i dkyil 'bor ldarno/ /mtshan mar spyod pa'i chu 'dzin nyer zhi gang thugs lha lam dngos kun go 'byed pha mtha' bral/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i mgon po kun gyis gang gi thugs rjer sgran min dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /dpag yas srid pa'i gdung ba skyob mkhas 'phrin las grib bsil bla na med/ /bsam pa'i yul min mos pa'i rjes 'gro

si༅༅/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /dbang por bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi mgon po yongs grub dpal 'brag pa/ /thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde zhes grags pa'i me tog mchog tu dkar/ /gang gi rtogs brjod mi zad chu gter ngo mtshar rba rlabs mkhar 'byud pa/ kā/ ba dang rgya che'i gting mtha' mi mngon mtha' gnyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i/ /dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas che las skal ldan yid kyi gdung sel du/ /dad pas snyim pa'i chu thigs tsam zhig rang blo'i mos ngor dgod par bya/ /'on kyang dam pa'i spyod tshul nam mkha'i khyon/ /mkhas dbang 'dab bzang gis kyang rtogs min na/ /bdag lta rnam dgrod ma smin byis pa'i blo/ /sbrang bu'i gshog rlabs bskyod pas ga la zhig /de lta na yang rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /lan brgyar bsngags pa bas kyang bla ma yi/ /ba snga'i khung bu gcig

bstod legs byas rdzi /phung po mtho bar gsungs pas bdag yid spro/ /lhag bsam skal ldan shing rta'i snying stobs kyi/ /kun mkhyen tshangs pa dgyes pa'i zhal lung las/ /rjes gnang gco phab pas lam gsum rgyud/ /mngon par mtho dang nges legs dpal la spyod/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel ba'i/ /rnam thar 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /legs (shad dngul dkar yol go yis/ /da1da ldan yongs la bstabs pa gang / /ya rabs dam pa'i rna rgyan du 'os yon tan 'od 'bar nor bu'i 'phreng / /log lta'i mun pa kun nas 'phrog byed ngo mtshar ri mo rnam par bkra/ /gang zhig mthong ba'i mig dang yid la bdud rtsi'i dga' ston ci yang spel/ /mi phyed dad pa'i srad bu la brgyus rtogs brjod do shal 'di longs shig /bsod nams byas pa dag la mi zad gter/ /gzur gnas thugs kyi bum bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /log

ra༅༅/ /rtog mun pa'i rab rib kun 'joms pa'i/ /snang ba dam pa'i dpal du 'bar ba can// //'di ltar rjes su thos te/ bdag nyid chen po rnams ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon du mdzad kyang / mtha' klas pa'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir zhing khams rgya mtshor sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sgyu 'phral gyi bkod pa cig car du ston pa nyid rdo zhes grags/ de yang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs dang /gling dang /dpung gnyen bslu ba med pa/ dzurmi gsum du gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i spyi gzugs/gsang ba chen po'i dkyil gsor ma lus pa'i 'char gzhi/ stobs bcu'i stobs kyis bdud sde rtsa lag dang bcas pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye

shes kyi snang ba chen pos 'jig rten gyi sgroni ma dam par gyur pa/ brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang po thams cad kyi 'khor 'ordzos bsgyur ba chen po/ 'dren pa zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa la de nyid gnyis pa lta bu/ mthong thos dran reg gis gdul bya don yod pa'i 'bras bur sbyor ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang / bum pa bzang po dang rdzogs ldan gyi sprin lta bur 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba/ yid can nyam nga ba'i dba' rlabs 'khrag cing sprug bsngal gyi rlabs phreng gnyer ba'i 'khor ba chu srin gyi 'byung gnas las thar mchog rin chen gling du sgrol ba'i ded dpon/ mtha' 'khob kyi rgyud mun gling lta༄ bu thugs rje'i 'od kyis snang bar byed pa'i smon lam gyi mthu yongs su gyub pa/ 'phags pa phyag na padmo ngur smig 'dzin pa'i dge slong gi tshul du byon pa'i yongs 'dzin chen po/ chos kyi rgyal po

go༅༅/ /dpal 'brag pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde/ zhes snyan grags kyi durdzu je'i sgra dbyangs khams gsum du grabags pa de'i rnam par thar pa mtha' dag ni ngag la dbang ba'i blo chen po dag gis kyang brjod par mi nus na/ bdag lta'i skye bo gti mug gi ra bar rmongs pa'i mun pa 'thibs pas tshur mthong dman ngor snang ba'i mdzad pa tsam zhig kyang gsal bar brjod nus pa'i go skabs ga la zhig /de yang / mkhyen rtogs zung ldan/ bzang sdings chos rjes 'bad pa chen po'i sgrig rtsom gyi zin bris mdzad 'phror lus par brten/ rgyal ba mchog nas/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ kho bo'i rnam thar rtse dgazhi 'khri shing zhes snyan tshig phul du phyin pas smras pa zhig mdzad 'dug pa 'di'i 'byungs rabs bcu gcig pa yan chad ni legs pa'i rtser soni

pa zhig 'dug na'ang / kho bo'i spyod tshul gyi skabs su zur za ring mo 'dra zhig 'dug pa nas/ rang cag dman pa'i rjes zhugs kyi blo dang / khyed kyi bsam pa'i babs gcig par snang bas zin bris btab chog ces bka'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i mthus/ gdul bya thun mong las kyang thun mong la snang ba'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bdag cag la nges pa can mang du mchis na'ang / rnam thar gyi sa bon ji bzhin du sgro skur spangs te/ ji ltar/ rgya mtsho las ku sha'i rtse mos drangs pa'i chu thigs tsam zhig spro bar bya ste/ de yang / bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngoni rol du/ 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i bskal pa la gling bzhi la dbang byed pa'i gser gyi gsor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud ces bya ba bu stong / rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong / 'dun na 'don bram ze rgya mtsho'i rngul zhes bya ba yod pa zhig byung / 'dun na 'don de la sras

/brgyad cu dang slob ma bram ze stong yod pa'i sras che ba bram ze rgya mtsho'i snying po mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin 5 grags par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis/ rgyal po chen po/ mir gyur pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten tu 'byang ba'ang / dam pa'i chos nyan pa'ang rnyed par dalakha yis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs skyed cig /ces sogs bskul bas/ 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rjozlo kyi zhing na bskyed do zhes khas blangs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas rin chen snying pos me long bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sgoms par zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi smu pa la rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing 'ordzo bdun du 'dam bcug pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing

bzung zhing sems bskyed pas/ rgyal po chen po bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du sangs rgyas tshe dpag med du lung bstan to/ /bu stong gi thu bo mig mi 'dzum ni tshe dpag med mya ngan las 'das nas sretred la chos nub pa'i tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan 'edi zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po zhes bya bar lung bstan/ de'i tshe mig mi 'dzum pas/ sems can gyi khams thams cad la rnam par bltas pas/ sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa mthong ste de dag thams cad skyob pa'i phyir/ bdag gi ming byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /bdag gi ming gang gis thos pa la ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / mi khom par mi ltung ba dang / bde ba can du skye bar gyur cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i smon lam rgya chen po btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa des/ de la/ legs so legs so/ /de de bzhin te/ khyod kyis

go༅༅/ /sems can gyi khams thams cad la rnam par bltas pa'i phyir/ khyod kyi ming yang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag ces bya'o/ /zhes bsha' stsal pa nas mtshan de ltar grags la/ des sems can gyi khams tshad med pa lan mang du bsgral yang de dag nyung bar ma gyur nas dam bcas pa sgrub pa la sgyid lug pas/ dbu bcu gcig tu gas pa snang ba mtha' yas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du byon te zhal bcu gcig tu byin gyis brlabs/ gang gi spyan chab kyis chu skyes bskrun pa'i sdong po las sgrol ma gnyis dang / don gyis na 'phags pa nyid kyi bstod tshig tu/ phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / /gang la gang 'dul de la der stoni pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong yang

mgon po 'di nyid kyi smyu ma chen po'i rol rtsed do// //de lta bu'i 'phags pa de'i sgyu 'phral gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ mi mjed zhing gi dzam gling dbus ma'i dum bu la yul drug tu phye ba'i nang tshan byang phyogs shambha la ste bde 'byung gi gling / rmotha' gangs ris kun nas zlum por ba〈snar ba'i dbus na sa gzhi padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbyibs/ 'dab ma re re la yul chen po bcu gnyis bcu gnyis/ de re re la sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po re re/ yul re re la'ang yul gsor brgya phrag re re yod pa / yul 'khor re yang grong 'bum phrag re la byed pas yul chen po rer grong bye ba re tshang ba/ de'i lte ba gangs ris mu khyud lta bur bskor ba'i nang na lhas brtsigs pa'i pho brang ka lā pa tshangs pa'i drang sretreng dag gnas pas thub pa mchog gi grong khyer zhes grags pa mi khyim bye ba phrag bcu gnyis mardzod pa de'i chu zheng dpag tshad bcu gnyis

mā la ya'i skyed mos kyi tshal dang / tshal de'i g.yas g.yon na nye ba'i yid kyi mtsho dang padma dkar po'i mtsho gsum se tshal na chos kyi rgyal po zla ba bzang pos bzhengs pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos bslang rin po che sna lnga las shar sgo'i khyams na nor bu rin po che'i seng ge'i khri la chos kyi rgyal po rnams rim par byon nas rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa lha'i dbang ldan dang / de'i lha mo sna tshogs yum gyi mngal du 'jam pa'i smu pa'i ska rgyal po'i rigs chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug tu skyes pa rin po che'i cod pan chen po bcings pa grong bye ba bye ba'i

bdag po rnams kyis zhabs kyi padmo la phyag byas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab kyi sku rgyal po chen po grags pa rigs bzhi gcig tu mdzad pas/ rigs ldan gyi dbang po dang por grub pa gang ni yab dang / de'i yum lha mo sgrol ma'i sras su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid bsam bzhin du srid pa bzung ba ni rigs ldan gyi dbang po gnyis pa padma dkar po'am/ sems dpa' phyag na padmo can te/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa ltar dpal ldan rgyad la rgyas 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba shlau ka khri nyis stong yod pa dang don dam bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ seng ge'i khri la lo brgyar chos bstan pa'i 'phrin las kyi snang bas 'jig rten gsal bar mdzad cing rigs ldan rigs kyi thig le gsum pa khro bo gshin rje mthar byed kyi sngal pa'i ska chos rgyal bzang po rgyal sar bton te spral pa'i bkod pa

༄༅༅/ /bsdu bar mdzad do// //de nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las hi ma la ya'am bod ces yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya bar bgrangs shing / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ lha ldan gyi yul zhes bsngags pa'i kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di 'phags pa gang gi thugs rjes yongs su bzung ba'i zhing khams te/ ji skad du/ bdag gis gang la 'dul thabs rgya mtsho yis/ /sems can de kun smin cing grol byas nas/ /mtha' 'khob de ni rin chen gling lta bur/ /dam pa'i chos kyis kun nas 'gror bar shog /ces sogs spyod lam rgya cher bskrun te rang gi zhing du bzung bas so/ /de yang / 'phags pa 'di dang 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin las bod kyi mi dag mched cing / shwakya litstsha bi'i rigs las byung ba'i skyes bu mtshan ldan zhig de dag gi rgyal por dbang bskar ba la rje gnya' khri btsan po zhes grags/ de nas

rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug 'das tshe 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan zhes pa byon te dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs bzhi pa gnam ri srong btsan dang / btsun mo tshe spong bza'am/ 'bri bza' thod dkar du grags pa'i sras su 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid a mi de ba rigs kyi cod pan bcings pa'i rgyal bu dbu bcu gcig pa zhig tu 'khrungs/ mtshan khri lde srong btsan du btags/ dbu lhag ma dar le brgan gyis dkris/ dgung lo bcu gsum la rgyal sar byon nas mtha'i rgyal phran thams cad dbang du bsdus/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgral pa blon po mgar stong btsan gyis bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i sras mo sgrol ma khro gnyer yo gyi sngal pa dang / rgya nag stong khun rgyal po thang tha'i dzung gi sras mo lha lcag yong jo sgrol ma sngon mo'i sngal pa gnyis btsun mor bsus/ lha shākya rnam gnyis sogs

si༅༅/ /rten byin rlabs can mang po spyan drangs/ sku rgyu spungs pa la rang byon bcu gcig zhal byung / de'i tshe bod la yi ge med pas 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa thon mi saspyo zhes rgya gar du byon/ slob dpon lha rig pa'i seng ge dang yig mkhan li byin la sgra dang yi ge legs par bslabs/ sod kyi skad dang bstun nas gsal byed sum cu/ dbyangs gag kyed bzhir bsdas/ dbyebs kha che'i yi ge dang bstan nas lha sa'i sku mkhar ma rur bcos/ sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad/ rgyal pos kyang sgra dang yi ge bslab pa'i tshul bstan/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas pa dam pas rgyal po'i mtshan srong btsan sgam por grags/ bod spyi srin mo gan rkyal du skyel ba 'dra ba'i sa dgrad gnon par mtha' 'dul dang yang 'dul la sogs pa'i lha khang dang mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad sngal pa bkye nas bzhengs/ srin mo'i snying khrag 'o thang gi

mtsho la/ ras sa skyal bzo khyad las 'phral lta bur snang bas ra sa 'phral snang zhes grags pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhings/ rgya gar dang rgya nag gi yul nas dam pa'i chos la mkhas pa'i slob dasgo mang po spyan snyungs/ lo tsā ba pho mi dang sda'i slob bu dharma ko ṣa sogs kyis byas/ gsung rab kyi skad bcos/ mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa sogs bsgyur/ yer par sgom grwa btsugs/ lo drug cu rtsa dgur chos kyi rgyal srid brnying ste brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa la yab yum gsum rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kur sprul pa bsdus te/ bod yul 'dir dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa'i srol legs par gtod pas skye dgu rnams la bka' drin gzhal du med par gyur to//// de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa khri lde gtsug brtan gyi sras su 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam sngal chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs/ de'i tshe bod

si༅༅/ /yul gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ za hor gyi bhikṣu chen po pa/ yul kha sa ra 6ra 'khrangs pa dharsā shāsti sgo dzi 'jig rten na ā tsārla bo ji sa twa zhes grags pa gsung rab thams cad la mkhas shing tshul khrims dang shes rab ldan pa mi 'phrog pa'i brtson 'grus rmi zhugs pa/ dbu ma rang rgyud du smra ba thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu shānta rakṣi ta zhes grags pa de dang / lho nub rnga yab gling gi tshur rol/ o rgyan yul gyi pha rol/ chu bo wo po siddhi rgya mtshor 'bab pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog tsho pho brang gnas pa dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du padma'i sdong po phun sum tshogs pa'i ge sar gyi rtser khye'u lo brgyad pa'i na tshod mtshano dpes spras pa zhig tu rdzus te 'byungs pa/ dzasa'i gling na che ba'i rigs sngags 'chang padma 'byung gnas gnyis su'ang sngal te/ bod du byon nas

'dre srin gdug pa can thams cad btul/ chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed pa bzhin 'phags yul 61 tanta pū ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs te/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i garto la dang / gzhi yod smra'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su sad mi mi bdun rab tu byang ba sogs bod khams mun pa'i gling sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i sgron mes yongs su gsal bar mdzad/ sba ye shes dbang po rgyal tshab tu bskos/ sad mi drodun la ka ba dpal brtsegs sogs lo tsā ba che ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyis blo sbyangs/ de dag la slob ma cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs lo tsā ba stong rtsa brgyad byung zhing / gzhan yang khams yan chad du chos kyi grwa sde chen po bcu gnyis btsugs/ paṇḍi ta dang rig 'dzin mang po spyan drangs/ theg pa che chung gi sde snod mtha' yas pa bskyar bshad gtan la phab pa serdzogs byang phyogs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi

ra༅༅/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ mthar ma 'ongs 'byang 'gyur lung du bstan te/ mgyogs 'gro'i phras bskul te zhi bar gshegs/ nyid kyi slob ma padma'i ngang tshul gyis chos log tshar bcad de skal ba dang ldan pa rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkod do// //gzhan yang bsam gtan dang mthun pa'i gnas mal mchog tu rgyal bas lung bstan pa gzhir ste kha che'i yul/ sngon dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis klu las blangs te sgyu ma sprul pa'i zhing khams grong khyer dpe med ces mi khyim 'bum phrag so bdun yod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal 'byor lha yul gyi 'gran zlar 'os pa der/ bram ze rgyal po byed pa'i ming nā ro ta pa zhes bya ba'i rigs yab rgyal po dge ba'i go cha dang yum dpal gyi blo gros ma'i sras su 'khrungs pa'i mtshan kun tu bzang po/ cher skyes nas bram ze'i las drug la sogs pa phyi rol

pa'i rig gnas thams cad khong du chud/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pas bdud rtsi'abyung ba'i gtsug lag khang du mkhan po dzi na mi tra las rab tu byang ba'i mtshan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sde snod gsum par gyur/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob/ blo gros kyi nor btsun pa dbyig gnyen la bdo bas gnas brtan bstan pa 'jin par grags/ yul dbus nā landa'i mkhan po mdzad pas rgyal sras nā landa pa dang / der mu stegs mang po rtsod pas pham par mdzad pas smra ba'i seng ge rtsod med du gleng / tsi lu paṇḍi ta'am dus 'khor zhabs chen po bsten/ dbang mdor bstan pa'i 'grel pa/ dgyes rdor/ 'dus pa rgyud phyi ma la sogs pa'i 'grel bshad mdzad de dus zhabs chung ba dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇḍi ta ya shwa bha dra ste snyan grags bzang po zhes 'jig rten du grags/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan ltar yang dag pa'i gdams

ra༅༅/ /pa 'tshol bar bzhed nas/ kha che bde ldan bya bar 'khor lo sdom pa'i rig pa 'bum phrag gcig song ba'i tho rangs/ sa g.yo ba dang / sgra dang / 'od dang bcas te lung bstan pa brnyes nas rgya gar shar phyogs go ḍa ba'i yul du byon/ dka' phran bcu gnyis spyad pa'i mthar/ skyes tanta pū ri zhes dpal bsam yas kyi ma phyi bhaṅga la'i yul na yod pa der bla ma tilli pa dang mjal/ lus srog phye mar 'thag pa'i dka' chen bcu gnyis spyad pa'i mthar theg chen gyi mthong lam thob/ phyir phebs kha che'i yul gur kum gyi ljongs shing kun skyes pa'i ri bor puṣṭha ha ri zhes dpal me tog mdangs 'phrog gi gtsug lag khang btab/ dbus 'gyur shar phyogs bi kra ma la shī la'i byang sgo skyong ba chen por mnga' gsol/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 'joms pa'i smra ba'i seng ger dbang bskor/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i

mtha' la zhugs pa'i mkhas grub gang gis kyang 'gran par mi nus pas/ dpal 'jigs med grags pa'am paṇa chen nā ro ta pa zhes srid pa gsum du grags so// //de nas snying rje chen po padma dkar po'i mdor/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud du dge slong 'tsho byed ces rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po byed par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis lung bstan pa dang / gzhan yang maho rnying nge 'dzin rgyal po dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs bod du 'gyur ba'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam las lung bstan par grags shing / khyad par bod kha ba can pa la bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i slob dponi padma sambha bas gter chos mtha' dag las snying po'i bstan pa spel bar lung bstan pa'i skyes chen/ sngon gyi sems dpa' me tog zla mdzes/ thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa/ khyim na gnas pa'i tshe rgya bal bod kyi sman pa mkhas pa

go༅༅/ /mang po la gtugs/ che'i rig byed mkhas pa'i mthar so3/ nges par 'byang ba'i bsam pa brtan pos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byang ste bga' gdams kyi gzhung man ngag kun la sbyangs/ phyis rje btsun mi la'i snyan pas thugs phyogs rto zhabs kyi padmo bsten/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje rnal 'gror zlo'i dbang dang byin rlabs kyis smin par mdzad/ rgyud dang 'brel ba thabs lam gyi gdams ngag dang / byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa mtha' dag spar khrid du gsan/ bla ma'i lung bstan ltar gnyal se ba lung du phyag chen gyi gnas lugs gzigs/ rim gyis 'ol khar mthar phyin/ de nas dwags lha sgam por byon te lo bcu gnyis sgrab pa dang 'gro don stabs su mdzad/ ska dngos kyi rgyal tshab rje sgom tshul/ gzhan dus gsum mkhyen pa dang / bde gshegs phag grus gtsos pa'i sgam po'i

grub thob bco brgyad la sogs pa skal ldan gyi gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ dpal dwags po'i dkar brgyud ces yongs su grags pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed chen por gyur to// //de nas/ nyi 'og gtsang gi yul gru/ gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po'i lha zhol 'brog khu le gnam gyi mthil sum rtsen gyi ljongs sa la 'phos pa ji lta ba'i 'dzin ma'i gzhir/ rgya'i rigs kyi thig ler 'khrangs pa chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po ye shes rdo rje/ yul dang gdung dang na bza' las mtshan du gsol ba gtsang pa rgya ras pa de nyid/ dgung lo bcu gnyis la rab tu byungarā 'i mtshan shes rab bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo btags/ tshad ma sde bdun dang mngon pa gong 'og sogs mtshan nyid kyi gzhung lugs dang / smya 'phrul sesgogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur la sbyangs pa mthar phyin/ nyer gsum la grub thob chen po gling dang mjal/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang

go༅༅/ /bskur thob/ phyis lho brag mkhar chur me tog gzhu can gyi dpung las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon bsgreng pa'i sgrab tshugs kyis chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon sum du gzigs shing / 'byung ba ro sgoms kyi man ngag gter nas phyangs/ tsa ri trar zhing skyong ba'i dbang mos spyod pa'i grogos mdzad de rtsa rlung thig le sgrib bral du gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pas bskal pa bzang po'i sajirmi rgyas mos par lung bstan/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ bstan pa bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad khyab par dbugs phyung / byang chub kyi shing kha ṭaṃ ga lta bu'i drung du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyis gzengs bstod/ zhang bde ba'i rdo rje dang / grub chen gling gis nā ro pa chen por bsngags/ mchog gi dingos grub thob pa'i slob 'khor bgrang ba las 'das pa 'jig rten khyab par lan gsum bzhe rigs kyi dbon chos

kyi sras su gyur pa dbon ras dar ma seng ge rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ gzhan stodi 'brag gnam gyi skar ma/ smad 'brag sa'i dreg pa/ bar du 'gro ba'i don g.yel med du mdzod pa'i bu chen nyis stong brgyad brgya la chos kyi dzol srid spel bar gdams/ nyamathar sku tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcigashe la spyan ras gzigs nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs sku gdung lha sku dang ring bsrel gyi phung por bstan te ngo mtshar ba'i dga' ston ci yang 'gyed par mdzad do// //gzhan yang mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas shar gyi phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji snyed 'das pa na/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams zhes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'brags pa 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston pa'i gnas yod de/ sa gzhi thams cad gser gyi mdangs can mnan na rnem cing bteg na 'phar ba/ mi mnyam pa med cing rjog na bde ba byang chub kyi shing rin po che sna

ra༅༅/ /bdun gyi rang bzhin las chos kyi sgra 'byang ba/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rdzing bu khras kyi 'bab stegs dang rin po che'i them skas can/ sted mos tshal dgos 'dod 'byang ba'i 'khri shing dang yid rdzu 'ong ba'i me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ rin po tstsha sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs par rin po che'i khri dang dar zlob kyi stan bshams pa/ bzlom pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du stsol ba'i dpag bsam gyi ljon shing me tog dang 'bras bus mdzes pa/ sprul pa'i bya dang ri dwags sna tshogs pas yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byin pa/ skabs gsum pa'i mdzes sngag la co 'dri ba'i skyes pa dang bud med rnams phan tshun lta ba'i rtse dgas tshim pa/ mdor na phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos po thams cad legs par tshogs pa'i zhing mchogo der/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa rigs can gsum gyi 'khor la

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gang du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snang ba rdul bral zhes bya bar gyur te/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dpag yas spyod pa'i tshul bstan to// //de nas/ chos rje 'brag pa nyid snying po'i bstan pa spel ba'i phyir slar gdung rabs su byon pa/mtshungs med rgyal ba'i dbang po kun dga' dpal 'gyor/ mdo sngags rig gnas thams sdud la mkhas pa'i rtse mor phyin/ 'khral zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi drin las gdod ma'i gnas lugs gzigs/ rgya gar shar phyogs grong khyer dam pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen las rlogs bshad kyi bdud rtsi ci yang gsol/ rngog ston bdun pa bo ji shrīs nā ro par bzung nas dbang rgyad bshad kyi bsha' babs gtad/ 'thung spyod kyi grong khyer sogs gdod nas grub pa'i yul rnams su

ra༅༅/ /rdo rje'i spyod pa mthar phyin/shāsti rgyal ba'i pho brang du bcom ldan 'das bsod nams rin chen gyi gdan seng ge'i khri nas chos gsungs/mtha' dmag gi 'jigs pa skyob phyir/bu chu gsang ba chen po'i nags tshal bde chen ha har bzhad pa'i gnas kyi sgo phye ste sgrub pa'i grwa btsugs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa ce yang bstan nas/ mthar mkha' lding gi rigs su sprul pa'i snang brnyan 'thi par lung bstan/rje btsun mar pa'i rnam sprul dgo rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po rgyal tshab tu bskos naX skyu yal lo// //de nas/mi 'gyangs par lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams chos bzhin du skyong ba'i lha/bya khri dpon dpal bkra shis dar rgyas legs pa'i rgyal pa' sras su 'khrungs pa 'jam pa'i dgrangs chos kyi grags pa ste/pho brang chen po chos rgyal lhan por rgyal dbang rje'i zhal slob cog bu pa brgyad brgya

tsam gyis lo gcig gi ring rab tu 'byung bar gsol ba 'debs pa la bsdad/ 'brag pa rin po che phebs/ phyogs bral gyi bla mar gsol ba btab kyang yab yum gyis ma gnang ba'i grol la brten/ lho rgyad kyi gdul bya rnams la brtse ba'i rgyus thabs la rākhas pa'i gzigs pas chos srid gnyis ka dang du bzhes/ dus zhabs pa shwakya dbang phyug las rgyud tha snyad/ dge slong rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'gro mgone chos skyabs pa sogs las rgyud sgrub bapokha man ngag mtha' dag smar khrid du gsan/ rgyal dbang rkadze pa chos grags rgya mtshos kun ting go shrī'i las kha dang / 'jig rten dang mthun par rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun byin te gsor los bsgyur bar dbang bskur/ lhag par rje btsun ras chung pa kun gyis mthong bar ras pa gzhon nu'i tshul du byon te/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog snyan rgyad kyi gdams pa khyad par can

༄༅༅/ /stsal/ dwangs ma'i sku brnyes pas gor ma'i me long la phyag zhabs pablo'i snang brnyan gsal bar bkod/ rdo rje dril bu bar snang la 'jog pa sogs grub pa'i rtags kyi rol rtsed ci yang mdzad cing / mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su byon nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrags pa dngos la de nyid 'khor los bsgyur bar bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha so bdun ma yo ga dang rjes su mthun pa'i dbang lung ros/ gu ru drag po dmar chen gyi zhas gzigs te bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal/ dpal bkra shis mthong smon gyi rtser sgrub pa'i sde'i sa dras pa'i tshe/ rgya gar gyi grub thob pho mo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston la 'dus/ drung 'khor rnams kyis bya rgod brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gral la bsgrigs nas tshogs la longs sprod pa mthong bas ri de la bya rgod phung por grags/ chos rgyal gling du dus kyi 'khor

lo'i dbang thog ma stsal ba'i tshe byin 'bebs dus/ kun spangs rje la khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs dngos su phebs nas rdzu bka' babs/ rdo rje gling pa mthu stobs zhabs sam yoni tan ye shes dang / bya paṇḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal gnyis la/ ‘ 'phral kun spangs sgyu ma'i gar mkhan dang / rgyal ba lo'i sprul pa smar ḍa ki ras chen gnyis la gtad de gzugs sku'i sbrito/༄/ //de nas/ gyad yul ku sha'i grong khyer lta bu dpa' rtsal gyi /byung khungs shar kong po'i ljongs/ nor 'dzin zurtsi'i dga' ston la bung ba mgron du 'bod pa'i me tog sna tshogs kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ dri bzang po'i ljon shing gi nags

༄༅༅/ /ya'i yul lta bu/ chu bo chen po lū hi ta dal gyis 'bab pa'i byang rgyad/ spus ri sgra gcan gyi lte ba/ gtsang shod dgon zhes bya bar/ gnubs kyi rig sngags 'chang jo sras klu'i dbang po dang / chos skyong sgrol ma'i sras su 'khrangarmi pa ni/ nā ro ta pa'i rgyal tshab 'gyur med ngag dbang nor bu dbang po'i sde'am/ ngag dbang kun dga' rnam rgyal nor bu dpal bzang po zhes sam/ mi pham padma dkar po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha zhes grags pa'i kun mkhyen chen po ste/ sku bltams pa'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang / 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa dang / me tog gi char babs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan du ma dang lhan cig 'khrungs ma thag /choso nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags kyi rang sgra gsal bar bsgrags shing / 'khrungs nas zhag nyi shu tsam song ba'i tshe/ dwags po la dbar gyi phyag na rdo

rje rang byon bskor mi mang po'i dbus su/ phyag na pablo'i snying po yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags shin tu gsal bar lan gsum bgrangs pas/ khrom pa kun ya mtshan du gyur te a 'o ma ṇi ba zhes btags/ gzhan gyis bgrod par mi nus pa'i shing dang g.yang sa khang pa serdzogs la thogs pa med par 'bab 'dzeg mdzad pa serdzogs sgyu rtsal la snyad pa'i rdzu 'phral dang / mngon mkhyen thogs med du lung ston pa sogs dam pa'i kun spyod 'ba' zhig gis/ thams cad kyis 'di ni skyes chen dam pa zhig go zhes kha tshon bcas/ ngo mtshar gyi pho nyas rim par mtshams sbyar te/ rje gong ma'i sprul par nges nas chos rgyal bya pas spyan drangs/ thog mar byar skyid phug tu rje bkra shis rnam rgyal mjal ba sogs gnas dus thams cad du sngerdzon gnas rjes dran gyi ngang tshul ci dgar gsal bar mdzad pas/ thams cad yid ches kyi dad pa ya mtshan gyi 'phreng ba dang

go༅༅/ lhan cig spel/ de nas ldo phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi sa'i lte ba/ dpal bkra shis mthong smon 'phral gyi gtsug lag khang chen yor/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug gis bsten pa'i sngar gyi gdan seng ge'i khrir phebs pa'i tshe ltas khyad par can mang du byung / bya rigs rmis kyi rgyal po'i rgyal srid kyi dpal 'gror phun sum tshogs pa sri zhu'i yon du sbyar/ 'brag chen ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po rgyal tshab dam pa/ bya paṇḍi ta/ kun spangs rje/ rje mthu stobs zhabs sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las zab rgyas kyi chos tshul ci yarjo bzhes/ sbyangs stobs kyi ngal ba la ma ltos par mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum la sa steng na 'gran zla med pa'i paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ lhan skyes gnyug ma'i rang zhal gzigs pas snang grags thams cad chos ska'i rol pa 'ba' zhig tu 'byams klas/ bla ma lha dang ḍā kis

bskul ba las/ rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa glegs bam bcu phrag tsam bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed du mdzad/ gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bshad sgrub nyams su len pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa du ma skye dgu'i legs byas spel ba'i zhing du ༷skrun/ gsol ba rags pa spangs shing zag bcas snyigs ma'i khams sgrib bral du dag ste sku'i grib ma mi mngon/ bod gangs can du chen por grags pa'i mkhan slab sogs sde snod 'dzin pa rnams dang / sa la spyod pa'i dbang po rang rang gi mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bus zhabs kyi padmo la btud/ byang phyogs 'gro ba'i rtsa lag thugs rje chen po rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi ska yo ba bsrangs pas spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du yid ches/ mthong thos dran reg gi gdul bya mtha' dag smin grol la

si༅༅/ /bkod/ khyad par rje btsun yongs 'dzin dam pa lha rtse ba chen po dang / sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal bzang po sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bgrang ba las 'das pa bstan 'gro'i dpal du spel/ mdor na thog de la thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bya ba las kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i mdzad pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la 'gran zla thams cad kyis dben pa zhig go/ /mthar chos rje dbon chen la/ byar rjes phu'i nags khrod dben pa der gzim spyil dwangs spro ba zhig bzos shig ces zhal bkod gnang / dbus nas lho rgyud du phebs lam 'grong rgyas nas mi dbang stobs kyi rgyal po sku mched kyis spyan drangs/ bka' las/ ngos kyis 'grong rgyas su da lam the ba'i lan bcu gnyis yong / da lam thams cad la 'brel ba 'jog pas shog zer tshad la 'gro gsungs/ spyan

'dren zhus pa thams cad du phebs/ srong btsan gyi rtsig ming la phyag nas zhus dus 'dir nged kyi gzims chung bkod pa bde ba zhig mdzad par zhu/ da yang dbus pa zhig byed pas mgyogs par slob 'ong gsungs/ yang de dus bka' las/ nged 'grong rgyas pa 'di mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang jo so rje'i dbon rgyud ma nyams pa yin zhes rang bzhin pa'i zol gyis gdung rabs la bsngags pa che bar mdzad/ smar ston lung bstan rdo rje la/ mahā dzin gyi yul gru las byung ba'i yol go 'thag spyad gsol zho bzhes 'phro dang bcas pa bskur ba gnang nas/ nged kyis 'di la zho btung ba'i snod du byas nas lo mang rab song bas/ dad rten du dpon sa bdag mo la phul cig gsungs nas 'bul du byon pas/ dpon sa thugs dam ma grol zer yug cig sgag dgos byung ba/ rin po che bas zid kyi ma 'grongs par/ zhabs drung mi'i dbang po'i phyag tu phul

ra༅༅/ /bar snang / khra 'brag gi gnas gzigs la phebs/ chos skyong la/ nged 'grong rgyas phyogs su skye ba len pas bar chad mi 'byang ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs shig gsungs bka' bsgos/ dres bzhin zla ba'i tshes bdun la gsang gling du phebs/ bde mchog gi sbyin sreg ma gtogs phyag dpe thams byed b.lakha tham gyis mnan/ nged mtshams zhag bdun byed/ de thog nas dbye ba phyed yong gsungs bkra shis lhas stengs su phyags phab/ da lam rten 'brel gyi dbang yis khams mi 'tsho skye ba myur du 'ong / srung ma'i lung bstan bzhin bzung / dpe dang dbang rdzas ma 'khyar bar/ bshad sgrub kyi sde la 'dzin skyong gyis gsung ba'i bsha' chems phyag bris ma zhig phyis phyag dpe 'phral dgos khrod nas rnyed/ bco lnga'i gang ba rdzogs pa'i mthar zil chen po zhig 'ong ste ma 'jigs shig ces gzims dpon la gdams

nas/ smyu 'phral gzugs sku'i bkod pa mngon byang 'od gsal gyi mkha' klong du snyoms par zhugs par gyur to// //thugs rje'i spyan ras gzigs pa lhang bas rigs dang lershas ldan blo gros padma dkar po'i tshal/ /chos kyi rgyal thabs nyi 'od kyis phye srid zhi'i rgya mtsho mdzes byed snyan grags bzang po'i glu/ /bsod nams rin chen bung bas lhur len ye shes rdo rjer chags pa'i snang ba rdul bral bar/ /kun dga'i dpal 'gror mtshungs pa med pa'i zil dngar rab rgyas chos kyi grags pa'i dri bsung spros/ /rgyal kun ngo bo mkha' dang dbyer med du/ /bzhugs pa'i mtshan nyid bzung du med kyang slar/ /'gro mang 'dul la rnam sprul sgyu ma'i gar/ /ci yang bsgrur ba'i skyes rabs mu tig 'phreng / /legs pa'i yoni tan kun nas rab 'bar yid bzhin nor bu cha brgyad pas/ /legs byas yal 'dab mchog tu dgod pa'i sa hor rgyal

go༅༅/ /rigs sā la'i tshal/ /legs par brgyan phyir phun tshogs dpal yon yongs su 'du ba'i shing mchog tu/ /legs 'khrungs de ni sa gsum 'gro ba'i phan bde'i snying po gzugs can bzhin/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyag gi sgyu 'phrul phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khrungs rabs dang por smos pa'i rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o// //de nas/ dzambu'i gling gi yul dbus rgya gar gyi rgyal khazlos yul 'khor chen po bcu drug gi nang tshan shar phyogs za hor gyi yul bhaṅga la grong shing thags can du rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i sras mya ngan med byon/ de sras rgyal po dza dang ind+ra bo dhi/sha kra/gtsug lag 'dzin rnams rim par byung ba las

pho brang gser gyi dzol mtshan can zhes pa der/ rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi sras dharma rā dza zhes bya ba/ dpa' ba dang brtul phod pas pha rol rnam par gnon pa zhig byung la / de'i gcung rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pa/ mkhan po bo dhi sa ta'am mtshan gzhan shānta rakṣi tar grags pa/ sngoni gyi smon lam gyi mthus bskul te/ btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis sod yul du spyan drangs/ dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs/ de sogs chos 'khor skyong ba'i srang ma zhig hor yul nas spyan 'dren pa la/ dharma rā ḍū sras gsum gyi dang po dharma pā la 'os par dgongs/ srang ma spyan drangs nas bod du 'byon dgos pa'i pho nya rmongags/ des kyang de ltar mdzad de chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la srung ma phul/ dharma pā las rig pa'i gnas sgru la mkhas par sngangs/ phyis dpal chu bo rir theg

༄༅༅/ /pa bla na med pa'i sgrub pa la bzhugs/ rgyal pos kyang bla mar bkur/ pho yong bza' khab tu bzhes pa la sras dpal gyi rdo rje dang rin chen rdo rje gnyis byung / gcung rgya gar du byon nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad/ gcen gyis pa tshab ma khab tu bzhes pa la badzra kirti/ ratna kirti/ dharma kirti ste sras gsum byung / gcung gnyis rab tu byung / gcen gyis sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gro zhig mu drar bston pas/ sras zla ba grags pa 'khrungs/ de la rig pa'i seṅge/ de'i sras shākya blo gros/ yon tan blo gros/ grags pa ye shes te gsum pos g.yo ru sa'i lte ba yar klangs su phebs/ gcen gyis khra 'brug dang nye ba/ g.yu sring smon mkhar du bzhugs/ gcung chu glang pakṣa'i byang baiḍūr bye ma dang nye ba'i yul ljongs su

bzhugs/ 'bring ba yon to blo gros/ bod kyi btsan po gnam lde 'od srung gi bla mar gyur/ mkhar thog btab/ yon ṭha blo gros la sras rdo rje gsal ba dang / rdo rje rin chen gnyis/ de'i dus su 'bangs rgya dang sha rags/ bya dang rngog /khu dang puṣkar sogs byang zhing / rdo rje gsal ba la sras ye shes rdo rje/ de'i sras g.yu drung rnam mkha'/ rdo rje rin chen la/ mnga' bdag dpal gsor btsan gyis bkur sdi phu dud du bsgrubyes/ de la sras rdo rje grags pa dang rdo rje 'bar ba gnyis/ yab sras gsum gyis hor bshar phyags phab/ sgang kha spel zhes pa'i sku mkhar brtsigs te/ sras che ba 'og pas hor khang phyi pa dang / chung ba lcang 'dur du phog pas hor lcang 'dur bar grags/ de nas rdo rje rin chen dang sras rdo rje 'bar bas/ g.yu srid kun dga' ra ba/ sa padma 'dab brgyad du 'dug pa/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub

go༅༅/ /pa der phyags phab/ yab kyis dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan dge slong rdo rje rgyal por btags/ bstan bcos kyang du ma mdzad/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i sras hor dra dar zhes grags pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin zab mo la dbang 'gror ba grub pa'i khyu mchog tu gyur kyang phyi rol tu drag shul gyi spyod pa mdzad/ gong ma se chen rgyal pos spyan 'dren gser yig pa snga phyir btang yang ma byon par/ gangs can 'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i sras/ hor bkra shis 'bum dang / gcung po ni gzhon nu nas rab tu byang / mtshan tshul khrims dar por grags/ bcu gnyis rnying ma ba rin chen rdo rje'i zhabs la gtugs/ dkar brgyud rin po che'i zab chos ji snyed pa thugs nyams su /zhes/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug brnyes te/ gdan sa chen po thel gyi mkhan po mdzad/ spyan snga grags

pa shes rab pa dang / tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi dbu skra yang bcad/ de las byung ba'i mkhan bus ni/ bod chol kha gsum yongs su gang bas rgyal bstan wo mor mdzad do/ /mkhan chen tshul dar ba'i dag po/ drung gawo nu bzang po dang / dgo bkras bsam gnyis ka hor bkra shis 'bum pa'i sras yin la/ drung 'a tā'i si tu nas gong ma na rim gli chos srid gtsug lag snyas ldan gyibaka'e tho po kun dga' ra ba'i zhal ngo na rim gyis mdzad/ lhag par gzhon nu bzang po'i thog /gzhan sde rnam par gnon pa'i brtul phod kyis/ bod yul khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag lan gsum du phab par mdzad/ lha gzigs chos kyi rgyal po'i chab srid dbyar mtsho ltar gong du spel/ tā mi byang rgyal gyi bka' blon dwangs ma mdzad/ dpal gyi chos grwa chen po rtses thang sogs dge 'dun gyi sde mang po gsar du bstun/ gcung

ra༅༅/ /bkras bsam pa'i sras/ hor gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ hor kun dga' dpal bzang / slob dpon nam mkha' rin chen/ dpon dbang rin pa ste/ sku mched de bzhis kyang / spyan snga ches bzhi pa dang / drung chen rin po che gnyis kyi zhabs pad spyi bos blangs te/ phyi'i so kha bsrung ba/ nang gi 'khos sgoms pa/skabs su babs pa'i 'dzin skyong sogs skye dgu thams cad kyi smon pa'i gnas grub par mdzad/ hor kun dpal ba'i sras/ drung chen dpal 'gror bzang po bas spyan snga grags pa byang chub pa'i zhabs la gcigs/ bdag po bsod grags pa'i gsol ja ba mdzad/ phyis dmag dpon du mnga' gsol nas/ shin tu brtul phod pas dgra sha drod ma yal bar len pa sogs drag po'i 'phrin las mthar phyin pa de'i gcung drung bsod nams dpal ldan pa/ drung sangs rgyas skyabs pa/ dkon rin pa rnams yin

la / sku mched de rnams kyis/ spyan snga bsod grags pa dang / gong ma grags rgyal ba'i zhabs la gtugs te/ lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa phul du byung bar bskyangs/ dkon mchog rin chen pas/ mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i thugs kyisras mdzad de/ rab brtan gling dang / 'phyeng dbar stag rtse'i ri la 'chi med kyi grong khyer dang mtshungs pa'i pho brang bsgrubs/ sras kyi thu bo rdo rje tshe brtan rnam rgyal sogs rigs kyi dpag bsam legs par bskrun/ lhag par bstan 'gro'i don du stag rtse'i ri bor/ gtsug lag khang rten gsum dge 'dun gyisde dang bcas pa bzhengs/ rdo rje tshe brtan mched kyi sras/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang rin chen rgyal mchog /phyi ma'i sras bsod nams mgoni po/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ rin chen tshe brtan rnams la/ bya bkra shis dar rgyas kyi sras mo 33 yod sgrol ma khab tu bzhes par/ hor

go༅༅/ /bsod nams dar rgyas dang don grub rdo rje gnyis byang / phyi ma rab tu byang / gcen dang dga' ldan bkra shis rab brtan gyi lcam sring tshe dbang rgyal mor/ hor bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po/ tshe dbang bsod nams༄ bstan 'dzin/ karnga cangag dbang grags pa gsum byang ba'i che ba lugs gnyis kyi gtsug lag rgozhan las phul du phyin pas/ dpal gyi rir theg pa mchog gi 'dus sde 'debs pa dang / sher phyin sum brgya pa/ padma'i b.le'u thang rnams par du bskrun/ kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu la sogs dam pa kun gyi zhabs pad gtsug tu len cing / ri bo bde chen nyams pa gso ba sogs yongs rdzogs kyi bstan par sri zhu rlabs chen mdzad do/ /de ltar za hor gyi ༄la rigs mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i brgyad du/ chos kyi ska dbyings dang ye shes dbyer mi phyed pa'i mngon par byang chub pa las g.yo ba mi mnga'

yang / thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba mtha' dag la gzigs nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku nyid byon zhing / gang du bltams pa'i yul ni/ mi mjed kyi zhing dam pa gling bzhi'i bye brag dzambu'i gling dbus ma/ 'phags yul ma ga ddha rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi snying po las byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya lhag tsam bgrod pa/ rab dkar kai la sha'i 'phreng bas kun nas bskor bas bode gangs can zhes grags pa'i yul mchog /dpag tshad brgya phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi lhag pa'i bcu drug dang / rgyang grags drug dang / gzhu 'dom stong dang so gsum lhag pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phral las grub pa'i zhing khams chen po'i dbus 'gyur 'chang / dge bcu'i dpal phun sum tshogs pas bkra shis shing g.yang chags par byas pa/ rig sngags 'chang padma ka ra'i bka' rtags thod du 'ching ba srid pa'i lha chen

legs par skyong ba/ yar mo klungs zhes pa'i sa'i cha/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba rim par stan chags ring ba/ mtho ris kyi grong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i dga' tshal yid du mchis par/ yab bsod nams chen po'i byin dang cho btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo bud med kyi yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan par sgya 'phral bzung ba/ mtsho rgyal dpon mo chos thongs pa la byams/ rgyal ba'i yum mchog tu 13 lam grub pa gang gi sras sras/ ñdzi ltar dam pa tog dkar dga' ldan nas 'phrul chen mo'i lcams su zhugs pa ji bzhin/ skyes bu chen po 'di nyid kyang / ind+ra nī la'i 'od ltar dwangs pa'i ska mdog

mthing kha gtsug tor gyis mdzes pa/ bla gos ngur smig gsol ba'i lha bu'i rnam pa zhig tu mdzad de lhums su zhugs par snang la/ de'i tshe yum gyi ming lam du/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i skyes pa dang bud med rgyan gos can mang pos bskor zhing 'dud pa dang / lhag par bud med rgyan can mdzes ma gnyis kyis dus rgyun du bsrung ba'i mel tshe dang rim gro byed pa rtag par byung / kun da'i phung po ltar mchog tu dkar ba'i 'o ma'i rgyun 'dod pa'i myos bum las ci yang phab pas/ khang bzang gi steng 'og bar gsum dkar por song ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas snang mang du byung bar gsal la/ gzhan yang yul phyogs der dgun gyi grang reg gis rtsub pa'i dus kyang me tog padma mang po shar ba dang / stag rtse'i pho brang gi rtse mor 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan thal byung du zug pa nyin mang por byung / yongs 'dzin dam pa lha rtse rjes/ rin chen gling du/

ra༅༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi lha mo la gtor ma rgyas par phul nas/ sprul pa'i sku gang du 'byor pa'i lung bstan zhu ba gnang tshe/ mtshan lam du/ sa yul 'grong rgyas rang yin pa la sngar bas skyid nyams che ba zhig na/ thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs pa yin zhes mi mang po bsgor ba byed/ gnyis kyis ma ṇi bskul ba sogs dang / yang / nub gcig bris thang zhig la/ sku mdog mthing kha lha'i bu 'dra ba la gtsug tor yod pa/ bla gos ngur sprig gsol ba zhig byung bas/ snang tshul de 'dra ba zhig gis phebs pa 'dra bsam pa shar zhes gsungs/ kong po'i bu mo 'dra ba zhig gis bu chung zhig pang du thogs nas/ 'di la ming zhig thogs dang zer ba la chos rgyal bkra shis gyis gsungs par/ phyi de na bu mo mang po 'dug pa de rnams kyis/ bu chung de la dpag bsam dbang po zhes 'bod kyi 'dug pa rmis gsungs/ lhag

par/ dbus gtsang gi cha shas nyams dga' ba/ /chu chen yo pakṣu 'bab pa'i lho/ /ri glang chen 'gying 'dra'i mdun ngos kyi/ /dus 'gyangs med 'byon pa'i mtshan ma mthong / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad sprul sku 'byon tshul yid kyi ngal gso yi ger ngadus/ sus mdzad mi rig pa'i ched du zab khog nas rtogs ldan ādma de war zhal bkod gnang nas gzims spyil gyi sgo logs ‘cher gyis mdzad pa po rig nas/ ral gri gnam skyar 'di rang mdzad byed chung zer/ gzhan dag phal cher ni sprul sku myur du 'byonagatam gleng ngo / /de dang mtshungs par sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal bzang por/ chos rje dbon chen drung gis mchog gi spre

ra༅༅/ /brtag pa mdzad dgos zhus pa ltar/ gserdzol ba btab nas thugs 'dun btang bas/ zhag lnga tsam skurdzong ba na/ lung pa'i nub cig nas chibs rags mang po 'byon gyi 'dug pa'i sngun la/ mgron gnyer dpal sdings pa rta zhon/ stan dmar phrag la bshal nas sleb byung mtshams/ klu khang dang yur ba 'dra zhig yod pa'i gzhogs su stan dmar bting song / de'i 'khris na bud med gzhon nu sgab rtsa ring nge ba zhig gi gos kyi sbubs nas bu chung zhig bstan byung ba dang / de nas dkar phibs thibs se ba zhig tu slebs/ de na cog grwa'i rten gtso thub pa zangs thang ma de khro khri yin no snyam pa zhig gi nang na 'gyel stabs su bzhugs 'dug /gzhogs na chos rje khyams stod nas 'dug pa la/ ci drag 'di chud zos su song yod dam byas pas/ khong nas/ chud zos med ska rgya na 'dze ba zhig 'dug zer/ yar

gsungs/ de ltar bla ma rnam gnyis sogs zag med kyi mngon shes sgrib bral du mnga' ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ming lam gyi zol kho bar dam bcas pa'i srung ma drag rtsal can rnams kyis kyang de mtshungs su bsngags par byed do/ /de nas zla ba bcur lhums kyi gzhal (rgyan par/ chos dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi mthu chen pos/ srog chags khrag khrig mtha' yas pa smin par mdzad dro ga rten gyi 'dren par byon nas lo grangs nyis stong lnga brgya zhe dgu 'das pa/ shambha la'i chos kyi rgyal po'i gdan rabs nyer drug pa khro bo'i la pa/ rigs ldan gyi dbang po rnam gnon seng ge'i khrir phebs nas lo drug cu rtsa dgu song ba/ rnam rgyal te chu mo sngal lo rgya skar snron

༄༅༅/ /gyis nya ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gang ba la/ res gza' zla ba dang / skar ma lag 'grogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i skya rengs dang po'i dus la gnod pa dang snyun mi mnga' bar bde bar sku bltams/ de'i tshe/ lha'i rol mo'i sgra dang lhan cig spos kyi dri zhim pos phyogs kun tu khyab/ me tog gi char dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ci yang zhig dadzin phyogs la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod sprin du sprul/ de'i dgrar lung pa'i phu nas shā 'od gnam la mchong ba lta bu 'jigs su rung ba byung bas khang khyim rnams 'jig par mngon du phyogs tshe/ steng thog tu spyan drangs nas 'od pa la gzigs pa'i mod de tan chu 'ol kha bskyar ba bzhin song nas gnod pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan to/ /de skabs/ rje lha rtseb pho brang gong danan gyi gzims chung sgo|da na ska mtshams la bzhugs

dus/ sde srid rin po che yin snyam pa dbu skra hrog hrog yod pa khro rngams can zhig gis/ mkhas grub khyung pos spyan drangs pa'i garto la de bsnams nas/ 'di la skyon /e 'dug ltos dang gsungs/ gzigs pas sgo gdong de na nag tal tsam zhig 'dug par ras zhig gis phyis pas sangs song / 'di'i nang na mahā bo dhi bzhugs trīgazigs pas na bza' dmar po dang bcas sku g.yoni la yo tsam byas bzhugs 'dug /gser chab cig sgroni rgyu byung na snyam pa rmis gsungs/ sang zhogs sde srid rizu che'i bku' thor/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul pa'i ska 'grong rgyas pa'i zur sras zhig tu 'khrangs pa 'dra yang gleng / 'ga' zhig ni bde chen chos 'khor du snyupa'i skye sgo 'di yin nam yang zer/ thugs dam brtag pa 'dra stsa 'dra byung zhu bar/ rmi lam bzang rbe zhig ni byung / da lta zhu skabs ma mchis zhes gnang 'dug /swā

༄༅༅/ /dgun 'grong rgyas stag rtser byon skabs mi'i dbang po'i gsung las/ rgas bu yin pas zhu mtsher tsam 'dug na'ang / grong gas ra du ngos kyi zur bu zhig byung ba/ snga sor thams cad mkhyen pa chen po de nyid kyi bsha' bzhes thog tu 'gyol pa 'dra/ thugs dam brtag pa bzhin ci 'dra byung gsung bar/ re zhig zab khog nas/ brtag pa rang 'di gsal ma byung / 'on kyang gsung 'byon mi mkhyen ring su dang yang mjal ma 'jug /yod pa'i 'phros kyang mi gnang ba zhu gsungs/ bla ma gong ma'i shangs mtshal gyis bris pa'i mgon po dang lha mo'i srog 'khor gyi mgal bsrung / rdo rje'i re khā can gyi stan dkar/ dmod bor spyan btsums te rten dar mang po'i gseb nas gcig bzhes pas/ dri mas ma gos pa'i bkra shis kha btags che ba 'brug 'khor brgya lhag gi ri mo gsal bar dod pa zhig phyag tu byung bas rten 'brel

bzang dgongs pa shar/ de rnams sde pa rang gi phyag tu phul nas 'di tsho 'bul ba zhu gsungs/ de dus nang so dpon bkras pas/ nged kyi a che lags la bu chung zhig skyes yod pa gtser gtser 'dra yong 'dug pas ming 'dogs rogs dang phyag mdud cig gnang ba zhu zer bar/ ming chos rgyal bkra shis mdzod ces sngags mdud dang bcas gnang / gtser gtser la gzhan thabs e yong zhu bar/ lha mo bu rdzi ma'i mdos btsugs na legs po 'ong / zhal 'dris che ba'i mdos 'thags pa 'dra e yod gsungs pas/ khu mi slob dponi du byas pa'i mdos 'thags mkhas shing nged tsho'i skag bsnyor mkhan zhig yod zhu bas/ 'o na mdos 'di ltar tshugs mdzod ces bslab ston gnang / de mtshams/ thob rgyal lha rtser/ hor mi dbang bstan 'dzin gyi ska'i rim gror zhag 'ga' bcad rgya mdzad/ grol nas yar lam/ dang po thams cad

go༅༅/ /mkhyen pa gar bzhugs kyi gnas de gzigs ma khyad phyag 'bul ma chag pa mdzad pa zhig yod na'ang / da lam phyag mdzad na gsang sgo sgordzor dogs/ 'ju grong gsar gzigs gdong sku khams seng ba'i zol gyis chibs sgordzol/ zhabs 'gros rgyang tsam mdzad/ de dus nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing rdul shin tu 'jam pa la/ dpangs thog so bzhi la zheng khang pa ka bzhi ma tsam byas pa'i rlung kham nag cig khyil khyil grong gsar gyi nang nas 'thon te/ dpon slob phyogs su mda' rgyang tsam gyi gdong thad du zil chen po dang bcas byung ba la/ rlung 'di'i dkyil na ye shes kyi lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bzhugs so snyam mos pa chen po 'khrungs pa'i mod la bstod pa blo ka lnga yod pa/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje las 'khrungs thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po'i sde/ /'gro mang don du yangs pa'i sa

'dir lo brgyar 'tsho gzhes 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhes serdzogs kyi 'dod gserdzol dang bcas pa mdzad mtshams/ rlung de grong gsar du slar 'ordzog pa zhabs 'bring ba kun gyis mthong / rje rang gis dpal ye shes kyi lha mo dud sol ma'i zhal dngos su gzigs par snang ngo / /de dus/ gtsang stod lhun po rtse nas/ sa la spyod pa'i dbang po rpā grub rdo rjes/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'grong rgyas kyi de ka yin min gyi brtag dpyad gzigs rtog dbu che bgres ka rnams kyis mdzod gsung ba byung / gsung rtsom grwa tshang pa'i slob dpon rin po che mang thos pad dashar bar gdan sa zhabs drung yab sras kyi snyan du/ rje kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor buX sprul pa'i sku 'grong rgyas kyi 'di ka yin nges su 'dug kyang / nged rnams kyis thag chod zhu rtsis med/ de kha rang sngar rgyan gyi thugs dam brtag pa ngos 'dzin bdag rkyen sags gnang ba zhu zer ba'i gnas tshul

ra༅༅/ /zab brgyud du phul bas/ de skabs dbon rin po che dur khrod blo mos rgyal na sku mtshams lo gsum gyi bcad rgya la bzhugs dus/ gdan sa nas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang nor bu'i sprul pa'i sku 'phyong rgyas na phebs yod 'dug zhu ba'i gnas tshul 'di lta bu byung ba ngos 'dzin brtag pa sogs ji ltar sregs sam gsung ba'i bka' bgrerdzos gtam snyan gyi char rgyun bka' sgo(ga stsal ba snyan du lhung ma thag /gtsug phud can gyis 'brag sgra thos pa ltar mchog tu mnyes te/ sku mtshams har 'don gnang nas gdan sar phebs/ sprul pa'i sku 'di la brtag pa byed mi dgos/ rje de nyid nged rang la daspongs pa lhag par gtad pa zhig yod pas/ ngos 'dzin la nged rang 'phral du 'gro ba yin gsungs/ gdan sa'i dbu che rnams la bgazha bgros skosnar tsam yang ma gnang bar shar rgyag tu phebs par thugs

dgongs gtad pa la/ zhabs drung mi pham chos kyi dzol po'i bsha' las/ sprul pa'i sku 'di la 'chug pa med kyang / sngar rgyun gyi brtag pa dang gdan sa'i dbu che rnams la yang gros skor tsam bgyis pa'i thams cad mthun grub pa zhig byas te/ thog ma'i ngos 'dzin 'di la mi rgan rang phyin na brling zhing brtan par slebs che ba zhig yod pa yin te/ bu chung mi gsan par 'byon na/ rje gong ma de nyid rtogs ldan gyi cha lugs ral pa can la shin tu mi dgyes pa zhig yod pas/ dbu ral 'di bzhar/ rab byang gi cha lugs mdzad nas phebs pa legs gsungs pa la/ 'ordzo gsum gyi mtshams skra bla ma'i sprul sku la 'bul ba yin gsungs ma gsan par 'phral rang du phebs rtsos mdzad/ bar der/ rje rdo rje 'chang lha rtse ba/ sems dpa' chen po dpal gyi seng ge/ rdor chan kun dga' snying po/ smar ston lung bstan rdo rje/ khyams stod chos

go༅༅/ /rje/ rdzong kha nas skru gzhon pa/ rje dbon 'phags mchog pa/ drung gnas nam dbang pa/ 'phyong rgyas kyi mi sna sku rdzi tshe dbang don grub dang bcas/ dgung lo gsum gyi ngor phebs pa myas byed de shing mo lug lo/ tha skar zla ba'i 'grub sbyor bzang po zhig la grong gsar du phebs/ mdun gyi klu khang der gsol ja dgyes sprodang bcas yud cig bzhugs skabs/ bla ma rin po che dpal gyi seng ge la/ sngar mtshan lam la byung ba'i gnas de 'di ka yin pa 'dug lags sam zhu ba mdzad pas/ ngo bo 'di ka yin pa la rmi lam gyi de 'di bas cung yangs pa 'dra zhig 'dug gsungs/ thog ma nas phyag 'bul ci 'dra 'gab kyi bka' gros spel bar/ rdo rje'i stsophab dpon yin pas phyag 'bul ma byas na rten 'brel 'chug pas/ bkra shis kha btags re'i phyag rten dang bcas phyag 'bul ba 'thad ces thams cad zhal

dan/ gzims khang ma'i skar phibs der bzhugs stan gyi bca' gzhi lam tsam 'dug par byin phebs mtshams yum gyis gdan drangs byung bas/ thams cad la gzigs nas zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad/ chos rje cog grwa ba gsung ngo mkhyen pa dang / na bza' dkar po 'gan sbyar bgro zhig zhus 'dug par/ 'di 'dra min chos gos gon gsungs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gsung 'ba' zhig byon pas nyi ma song ba'ang ma tshor/ thams cad mos gus kyis ba spu g.yo ba dang / kun rtog rags pa 'gags pas shugs 'byung du bka' stsal ba ma gtogs brtag dpyad kyi dri ba ka dpe ma zhu rgyu ma byung / de skabs gzhis ka nas sde srid phag mo gru pa'i mi snar sde pa mdo pa dang / lhan rtse nas o lo chos mdzad 'gror par/ mi sna gnyis rang gzigs rtog la byon gsungs/ khong gnyis kyang zhal mjal ba tsam gyis rtog pukka kyi snang ba rang

ra༅༅/ /sar dag /lhun rtse nas/ brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad cig bla ma rnams la zhus shog gsungs par/ lha rtseb chen pos/ snying po'i bstan pa dbyar skyes rnga bo che/ /sogs blo ka gcig dang / phyis/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje ni/ /zhes sogs kyi rnam thar gsol 'debs shig kyang mdzad/ bla ma rin po che dpal gyi seng ges/ chos kyi sku la g.yo ba mi mnga' zhing / /zhes pa rnams thog mar mdzad do/ /rje gong ma'i gzims dpon chen mo 'jam dbyangs pad dkar zhabs phyir byon/ shin tu thugs la bzhugs par snang / de ka nas sku gzhogs su bcar bzhugs mdzad do// //dpal 'gror rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i klong du legs spyad chu klang kun 'du zhing / /dge legs nor bu'i 'byung gnas bhaṅga la zhes grags pa'i yul 'khor che'i/ /snying por grub pa rin chen rang bzhin rigs rus cho 'brang mngon

'chi med rnam 'dren du ma brten/ /skye dgu'i nyer 'tshor yongs grub srid pa'i mig /sgrib byed log rtog chu 'dzin mthar rambha'i/ /ming lam zol gyis kun gsal khyab par gdal/ taphags yul lumbi nī tshal ji lta ba'i/ /mtho ris grong khyer jib brjid dpag bsam shing / /'gro 'di'i dpung gnyen mchog tu 'khrungs par gyur/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che ni bang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gan las/ mkha' khyab smu pa'i zlos gar za hor gyi rgyal rigs mtshungs pa med par bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o// //gdong ngan

༄༅༅/ /te me pho spre'u lo gsar/ gzhis ka gong daspyan nas/ sku ber/ dbu sgom sogs rgyas pa/ zhu yig sku bzos rje gong ma la ji lta ba'i bkur snyi dang bcas 'bul bar mi snar nang so rgyal nang pa 'gror/ de mtshungs lhun rtse nas/ zhal dkar nyin mo bde legs mas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen/ 'grong rgyas su ja zhus dang bcas pa'i mi sna drung yig lhun grub pa dang 'brang khud pa nor bu 'byor skabs/ gza' tshes dge ba la/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dpon slob stag rtser spyan drangs/ de'i tshe bsu ba'i bkod pa ches khyad par du 'phags pa rnams kyis mdun bdar/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i dad 'dus kyi khrom shin tu che ba 'tshogs pa rnams kyis a la la'i sgra dang mchod pa'i slad du 'byu'i me tog pus nub tsam gtor/ pho brang du phebs pa dang 'phags sde 'du khang pa'i mang ja'i tshogs dung darkan po rgyang

grags kyi sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa dus mnyam byung ba sogs rten 'brel bzang / gzims chung rnam sras pho brang du mdzad/ der yang sngoni gnas rjes dran gyi lde mig gis yid ches 'phrul/ gyi sgo glegs mang po zhig 'byed par mdzad pas/ mi dbang sku mched btsun mor bcas pa mi 'phrog pa'i dad stobs lhag par 'phel lo/ /de skabs su gdan sa chen po ra lung thel nas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po bstan pa'i nyi ma dang grub thob rin po che dpon slob kyang phebs/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i thugs dgongs su thog ma'i ngos 'dzin la rje mi pham chos rgyal phebs par bzhed pa la/ dbon rin po che phebs/ sku'i cha lugs la ma dgyes pa'i tshul tsam byung zhing / rje bstan pa'i nyi ma yang thugs gtum pas/ thog ma'i rten 'brel cung zad ma 'grigs kyang / slar gzims chung 'gol sar dpon slob nyung bsngas kyis mjal/ dbu'i gtsug phud

ra༅༅/ /bzhes/ mtshan ngag dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal khams gsum 'brug grags dpal bzang po'i sde zhes gsol ba dang / sku tshe'i rten 'brel du grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang zhig gnang / sprul pa'i skur mnga' gsol ba sogs dgongs pa gcig par gyur cing phyis kyang mjal 'dzom kha re byung / 'on kyang gdan sar snyan 'bul la nged tshos thag gcod zhu rtsis med zhus kyang / zhabs drung khu dgo nas thog ma'i dngos 'dzin la ma phebs ring dbu che grwa yon rnams kyi zid ma 'khyongs par gdan 'dren thag gcod byas rkyen gyis gdan sa dang cung zhig rten 'brel 'chug pa'i rgyur song ba yin zer ba yang gdan sa'i dbu che bgres mgo rgyus can khungs btsun rnams gleng na'ang / gdul bya las nyon can gyi ngor snang ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan du de lta bu'i tshul tsam yang ga la zhig ste/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ dper na sangs

rgyas sprul pa sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed/ /byed pa de la dregs pa cung zad skye mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin shes rab spyodad mkhas byang chub sems dpa' yang /bzhin du bya ba thams cad ston/ /zhes pa ltar/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las kyang / de ni cig car la lar sgo mang brgya nas chos kyi 'khor lo ngaskye ba mi snang la lar skye ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs dang / /la lar byang chub thams cad la lar de ni mya ngan 'das ston kyang / /de ni gnas de las kyang rna mnga' la thams cad mdzad/ /ces gsungs pas/ bstan 'gro'i don du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zhing rnams su/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i smyu 'phraskus/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdul bya smin par mdzad pa zhig yin la/ zhing 'dir yang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 'phrul gzugs bshad ༵

bye/da cig yod par grags shing grub pa dang / lhag par rje 'di nyid kyis mtshon pa'i bstan pa'i srog rma med par 'dzin na du/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /gang la mos pa ji ltar der 'gyur nas/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i sa la /bang por gsol ba 'debs/ /zhas gsungs pas so/ /des na/ phyogs 'dzin gyi chang gis myos pa'i rang gzhan /ra ba la snying po ci zhig yod/ 'o na/ tha snyad du dus snga phyi dang / bla ma slob ma'i rnam par rtsen pa sogs la ji ltar ri pa yin gyi rang rgyad min/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen pos/ e ma skad cig re re la/ /rnam pa snatshogs

las bgyid mkhan/ /snying rje'i gzugs 'di'i ngang tshul gang / /rgyas pa kun gyi blor mi 'chun/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa de'o/ /pho brang de las rgyang grags tsam bgrod pa na/ bde skyid gling zhes pa'i skyed mos tshal/ mya ngan med pa'i ljon shing gi 'phreng bas kun nas bskor zhing rba rlabs kyi 'dzum 'od spro ba dang lhan cig /lhung lhung gi sgra snyan 'byin pa'i 'bab ldan gyi rgyun khrus kyi rdzing bur 'khyil ba la ngang ngur sogs chu bya'i tshogs dga' zhing bag phebs pa'i mgrin rnga bsnying ba/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'dab mas mdzes shing zil dngar gyi dri bsung zhim po phyogs kyi dga' ston du 'gyed pa'i pad tshal du rkang drug rnams rtsedags rol ba/ de' dbus su/ thog 'phar mas bteg pa'i gzhal med khang gi rtser kra ma shirṣa'i mda' yab rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyis mdzes pa/ gzhan yang khang pa dang khang phran bsil

ra༅༅/ /khang dang ra bas phyogs kun tu bskor ba bde ba can gyi zhing khams lta bu der/ zla ba drug tu nye ba tsam stan chags/ sde srid rin po che phag mo gru pa khu dbon gyis/ spyan 'dren gyi gser yig pa snga phyi lan du mar mngags pa ltar/ dgung lo lnga'i khar phebs pa gser 'phyang ste me mo bya lo'i sos/ sgar grwa'i dbu che/ drung 'khor las tshan sogs zhabs 'bring ba mang po dang bcas/ 'grong rgyas nas chibs kha bsgyur/ thog mar grwa dge ba 'byung ba'i yul gru'i sgrub sde don grub mthong smon du/ bla ma rin po che dpal gyi seng ges spyan drangs/ bsu ba ser sbrengs sogs bkur sti chan pos mdun bsus/ der chos rje rgya ras kyi sku tshogs bdun pa la byon pa'i rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi spyan sngar/ mig sman gyi mtsho las gsar du phyung ba lta bu'i dbu ska lcang lo bcad de ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ rim pas

yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang rgyal chen gling / dol mda' sogs skabs su babs pa de dang der sri zhu bla na med pas mchod/ lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa gzhis ka gong dkar zhes lha gzigs kyi pho brang gnyis pa nas/ zhabs drung mi'i dbang po dpal ngag gi dbang phyug dkar brgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i lha nyid rgyal phran/ drung gsor/ rta pa'i tshogs kyis bskor te lugs smad lcang gsar du thab bsu la phebs/ ser sbrengs las tshan skya rags shin tu rgyas par bsgrigs pa sogs bkur sdi sngar rje gong ma la ji ltar zhu ba bzhin mdzad/ phar yang mi chos sogs rje gong ma ji lta ba ltar zhu ma dgos par gnang bas kun ya mtshan du gyur/ rnyed bkur phul phyin mdzad/ lo gcig tsam stan chags/ rje bla mas mngal sgrib spyong phyir rnam 'joms kyi byab khrus mang du phul/ skabs shig /ska gzhogs na yod pa'i dung chos chung ngu

ra༅༅/ /zhig 3 rags kyis 'ur rdo'i tshul du 'phangs pa rdo chal mthil du babs/de zhabs drung mi'i dbang po'i phyag tu 'gror ba la ye shes khyung khra'i sku rang byon gsal bar phebs pa yad cing /lar de dus phyag tu byung tshad sku rtsed tshul gyi rgyang du 'phang ba rang zhig yod pa la/rje rdo rje 'chang gi bka' las/'phrin las che ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs so//mkhas dbang 'jam dpal grags pa gnas kyislob dpon du mnga' gsol/thog mar yig gzugs zan la bcos nas sku rtsed brda ston tsam du phul bas tshags med par mkhyen/rgya rol/skyes rabs brgya pa/mdzangs blun sogs sbyar klog dang /sdud pa/brgyad stong pa sogs bsdus nas ljags klogaganang /de yang /rgya che rol pa dang brgyad stong pa sbyor klog gis nyin re la 'khril ba sogs phal gyis sprod yul du ma gyur pa'i ljags klog gi 'phrul chen

po'ing bstan/ de'i tshe dkar brgyud kyi shing rta chen po dpal stag lung thang pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes pa'i bdag nyid chen pos/ rtag brtan rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum gyi phul/ /zhes sogs dam pa 'di'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la bstod pa'i tshigs su sad pa blo ka lnga pa dang / gzhan yang / grub pa'i dbang phyug brag stod pa chos sku lha dbang grags pa sogs skyes chen mang pos/ brtan bzhugs kyitshigs bcad/ legs so'i 'bul lam rgyas pa ༅ 'gror/ de nas/ bod yul lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams chos bzhin du skyong ba bya khri da' gong ma mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug mched dang dbu che grwa ris mi sde dang bcas pas spyan 'dren lan du mar byung ba ltar phebs pa'i sgo dod/ lum pa rdzong du rgyang tsam stan chags/ lce bde bas skabs gsum pa'i 'gror pa la

ra༅༅/ /'gran ba'i dpal 'gror gyi bkur snyi bgyis/ rnam 'phyang ste sa pho khyi lo/ rje nyid dgung lo drug tu phebs pa'i tshe/ lto rgyud du chibs kha basbyar ba'i bzhugs sgar zhabs phyir cog grwa rnying pa dang bcas/ 'grong rgyas/ gri gu brgyud/ byar phu 'bog tu dgra sde 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po dmag dpon stag ldo rje dpon g.yog thab bsu la phebs/ zhag stag rtser dpon sa sku mched kyis spyan drangs/ mos gas kyis ri mor bgyis/ gro bzhin zla ba'i yar ngo'i gza' tshes dge ba la / dpal lhas bstan gyi ri bo gsang sngags chos gling du phebs/ de dus zhabs 'bring la/ sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal bzang / rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dgazha snying po/ dbon chen phyag mdzod mi pham bla ma/ rin po che bstan 'dzin chos grags/ phyag mdzod bkra shis/ sngags cog slob dpon las thog pa gnyis/ stagartse ska sme

bsod nams dpal bzang / chos rje thugs rje grags pa sogs dang / mkhas dbang 'jam dpal grags pa/ gzims dpon 'jam dbyangs pad dkar/ gsol dpon sde pa sbri nas/ mgron gnyer bla ma dpal chen mo/ drung yig bstan 'dzin pad gta sogs rje gong ma'i ska gnogs pa'ang shin tu mang ba yod/ thog mar gzims chung du phebastu ma thag /sku gong ma'i phyag rnga zhig yod pa shugs bskyed nas brdung ba gnang bas snyan grags kyi ston 'brel legs par 'grigs/ bug sgo gsar pa zhig 'dug pa de la/ 'di na bug sgo zhes 'gazha res glengs bas/ 'di la nga'i dkar stegs shong ba med/ nga'i bug sgo 'di na yod gsungs/ gzims chung sgo'agyog gi bug sgo ston pa gnang / phyag mdzod pa la lde mig khyer shog gsungs/ dpe dbang rdzas sogs sngar phyag tham gyis mnan pa rnams dbye/ phyag dpe/ dbang rdzas/ rten

ra༅༅/ /mchod sogs thams cad re re nas phyag tu bzhes te/ 'di yin gyi ngos 'dzin sogs thogs rdugs med par stsal bas/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi ngo mtshar la thams cad yid ches shing dad pa'i spu long rang dbang med par g.yos pas spyan mtsho las bdud rtsi babs pa'ang byung ngo / /de'i tshe sde pa tshe dbang bkra shis/ rtse le sku skye/ tshigs smad sku skye rnams kyi gtsug phud bzhes/ skra bcad gnang ba'i thog ma yin/ snga mas yang rtsedang / rgya mtsho grwa tshang gi mkhan po/ phyis tsa ri yo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i khri bzung / rtse le sku skye 'phrin las shin tu che bas bstan pa la phan par byung zhing / tshigs smad ska skyes kyang tsa ri'i 'gro mgon byas so/ /der zla ba phyed gnyis tsam dgyes par bzhugs/ de nas/ gser gyi lhan po gur kum gyi chu bos lan brgyar bkrus pa lta bu'i mi pham rgyal ba'i ska brnyan phan bde'i dbyed du

bzhugs shing / lung rigs kyi sgra dbyangs khor mor sgrogs pa'i ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i 'dus sdes kun tu gang ba'i 'dun sa/ byams chen chos kyigling du phebs/ khyi phag byi lo gsum gtso bor byams chen rang du bzhugs/ bstan pa spyi bye brag gi chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams dang / rgyud sde gong 'og gi dkyir chog phyag len dang bcas pa la thugs byang bar mdzad cing / khyad par ji skad du/ de ltar sgrub cing sun 'byin gyi/ /rig pa'i gzhung lugs gang gis shes/ /mkhas pa de ni rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa 'dzin/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ tshad ma gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo phyogs po ti rnams la gsan sbyong smar bar mdzad/ de dus/ rang byon rdo rje sems dpa'i bzhugs gnas/ 'chi med kyi dga' tshal lta bur yid du 'ong zhing / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu rgyan khrus kyi rdzing bur 'byil bas ma dag pa'i dri

ra༅༅/ /ma 'byin pa la mthu che ba'i gnas rdo rje gling zhes pa der/ chos kyi rje yon ༅ brgya 'phel ba'i phyi rten rab gnas la spyan drangs/ bde mchog mngor lo'i las rim rgyas pa'i sgo nas lhag gnas brtan bzhugs shis brjod kyis dge legs stsal bas byin rlabs mtshungs pa med pa'i gzi 'od 'bar bar gyur to/ /de skabs dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab grub pa'i steng na phar phebs pa la/ rin po che 'jam dpal grags pas de 'dra ma mdzad 'gom yugs yong zhus pas/ sku gzhon nu des/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ka bla ma yin mod gsungs pas cang zhu ma spobs/ 'di nyid rten la rab gnas gnang ba'i thog ma yin/ de dus mnga' ris mang yul nas rgya sa jo bo dang nyo ma dge slong sogs stod 'gyul ba stobs che ba 'gror/ gser/ gur kum/ ka shi dzi'i ras sogs 'bul ba rgya chen po bsgrabs/ rgyal byed

sngags grwa'i bla mar/ rje gong mas rgyud sde la sbyangs pa sad par bsngags pa'i bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang blo gros kyi sku skye la bsko 'ja' grwa tshang la phogs thebs dang bcas stsal te brdzangs/ 'phar ba ste lcags mo glang lo/ dgung lo dgu pa la shas cher gsang sngags chos gling du bzhugs/ de skabs mkhas pa'i dbang po ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje lhun rtsebadud 'dul grwa tshang gi bla mar bsko 'ja' gya nom pa dang bcas shis brjod kyi 'phreng ba spel/ gsang gling gi ka ga ni bzhings pa'i rab gnas nyin zhag bzhi'i bar du mdzad/ dge byed de chu pho stag lo/ snga gong khams rgyal ston du bla mar rdzong bdar gnang ba'i chos rje rgyal ston pa dbang phyug rgyal po zhes mkhas btsun bzang po'i dper 'os pa de phyag 'bul du 'gror/ dre'u bcu drug steng khal dang bcas pa sogs 'bul ba stobs che/ g.yas ru byang nas khri lcam kun dga'

si༅༅/ /dpal sgron dang /lhun rtse nas sde srid bka' bgros/chu dbar spro bder ri pa mgo yod dang bcas pa gnang dgos tshul zhu glang bu mdzo bzang pa chos rje byams pa bde legs pa dang sgrub pa ba rnams rje bla ma'i kṣiṃ gzhogs nas rdzong dgos tshul gnang ba bzhin brdzangs pas/sbribar byung /de lo rje yongs 'dzin dam pa'i thugs dam mtshan ltas su sku tsha la dog cha char 'byung bar gzigs/'jam mgon grub pa padma dashar po'i sdebartan bzhugs tshigs bcad dang rjes 'brel 'gyur ba med pa'i re khās mtshan pa'i bzhugs stan bkra shis pa'i rtags kyis 'khyud pa sogs 'bul ba dngasngar myur bar rdzong bdar stsal bas rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/de nas bzung mi lo bzhi bcu'i bar ska tsha'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs te/zhing 'a

dpal du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa yin/ de lo phyag mdzod bkra shis pa grongs/ gshegs 'gyed rgya chen po gnang / slar lo gcig gi ring phyag mdzod chos rje dbon chen rang gis mdzad do/ /mdzes byed de chu mo yos lo dgung lo bcu gcig tu phebs tshe/ skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba rgyal ston dbang phyug rgyal por/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi brda' sprod pa'i bstan bcos ka lā pa'i phyag ris/ zhwa lu lo chen gyi ṭī ma'i steng nas yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i yon lag tu/ byings mdo/ u ṇa di'i mdo/ nyer bsgyur/ si sogs ti sogs kyi mtha' dpyad dang bcas pa gsan/ gzhan yang / snyan ngag /mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar sogs rig shinas thun mong ba phal cher la ye shes kyi gzigs pa'ang stsal/ yang rtser/ rdor 'dzin kun dgazha snying po gshegs pa'i 'dad kyi gral dbur spyan drangs/ 'bul ba rgya cher snang ba rdzogs

ra༅༅/ /byang du bsngos/ khong gi zhal chems la/ gsang gling gi spel ser por zhal ngos do dam mdzad/ sos 'di spyil po rgyag rgyu yin pas nga rang sdod du yong gsung ba mdzad 'dug pa ltar/ mi 'gyang bar sku skye bya gong ma rin po che'i sras su 'khrungs/ de dus zhabs drung grub thob rin po che sku gzhogs su 'gror ba / mchod yon ba/'a bgros nas yang rtse dang sgrub sde padma dkar po'i mkhan por bsko 'ja' stsal/ de nas/ dzambu gling gi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nang tshan/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las/ nye ba'i tshan do hi ma la ya ste/ bod skad du/ kha ba can nam gangs can/ bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ bod kyi yul dang de bzhin du/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i bod yul/ de yang / dag pa shel ri gtso bor byas nas gangs can dang / zhing skyong gnas pa'i sa gco bor byas nas 'od du gsungs

te/ don gcig la ming gi khyad par ro/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ nye ba'i 'thung spyod tsa ri tra/ zhes bshad pa ltar/ sgra sgrur mar pa'i zhal snga nas/ tsa ri tra ni lto phyogs thag nye ba 'di na/ rdo rje phag mo sha dang chang gis mchod pa'i gnas zhes bya ba yod de/ ces gsungs shing / rgyal dbang rjes/ spyod pa la yi ge bsnan pa'i bshad pas/ tsā rend+ra ste mkha' spyod dbang po zhes gdags par mdzad cing / sems dpa' rang byung rdo rjes/ tsa ri zhes pa bzhi yin te/ /tra ya skyob par brjod par bya/ /khams ni rnam pa bzhi po la/ /bde ba chen pos skyob pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs rgya cher bshad pa'i gnas mchog /sngon drag po 'jigs byed khyo shug 'khor dang bcas pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis ri rab kyi rtser sngal bshad mdzad pa'i dkyil gsor chen po'i lho phyogs kyi dur khrod/ dpal he ru ku'i pho brang gsang ba mchog

ra༅༅/ /gi gnas der phebs par bzhed/ zhabs phyir dbu che las tshan nyung bsdus gnang / gsang stabs kyis phebs/ khyim du bzung yang mi chags pa'i/ /ngang pa mtsho la bskrad kyang 'khor/ /zhes pa ltar/ dad ldan gyi tshogs chen po gar phebs su 'dus/ lhag par/ yul chen po mi 'gyur ba'i mtshan mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs las bshad pa rang byung gi skye gnas sam 'od rdo mtshan can du/ sde pa bang rim pa/ 6rdzor pa/ rgyal mthong smon pa sogs kyi 'bul zhabs dang / rdor 'dzin ri pa jo bzang rnams kyis phebs bsu rgyas pa dang bcas rtsa gong ngam rtsa mchog gi gnas cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs su phebs/ spam chen las tshan so sos zhabs nas bteg /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams la rdzogs kyi martsed pa rgya chen po dang / las tshan so sor gnang cha mchod thebs sogs rgyas pa

bstabs/ der rkyen pa rgyal po/ bla g.yel ba sogs yoni bdag rnams dang / kong phyogs kyi dgoni so so nas kyang mjal mi mang bas/ gnas nang du 'tshogs pa la mang zer ba tsam 'dus pa thams cad zhal mjal byin rlabs chos sbyin gyis skal ba bzang po la bkod/ de nas tsa ri'i gnas sgo 'byed mkhan shar phyogs lwa ba pa mkha' spyod du byon pa'i gnas lwa ba phug tu zhag gnyis bzhugs/ phu skor gnang / de dus dag pa'i gzigs snang ci yang zhig thol byang du gsungs tshe/ rin po che 'jam dpal grags pas/ da lta gsung gsung mang ba rang mi 'gab ces zhus par brten phal cher bka' stsal du ma gnang / lha rmetsho sgang dang stag ma sgang du bzhugs zhag re gnang / rim pas g.yu mtshor phebs pa'i lam thams cad du'ang / nam mkha' dbang sngoni gyi me long phyis pa ltar dwangs pa la/ dbang po'i tshon ris dra bar sbrel zhing me

si༅༅/ /togagi char 'bab pa dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sku'i da65 'khor la 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i gur phugapa/ spos kyi bsung zhim 'thul ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas ci yang zhig ni zhabs phyi na yod pa kun la'ang mngon sum du gyur/ der mngal sgrib kyi bag chags phra mo byang ba dang khams drug sgrib bral du dwangs pa la sa gsang ba mchog gi pho brang chen po'i sprul pa'i lha zhal gzigs/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ dmar nag nyin khugs su mdzad nas stag tshang du bzhugs/ rtsesgor mdzad de ka la dung mtsho nas slar cig car du phebs/ de nas gsang gling du bzhugs thog /rta sdings nas bla ma thugs rje grongs pa'i rten bzhengs phyag mdzod nas thugs khur bzhes/ legs par grub nas rab tu gnas te kong por gnang / dbon chen drung sku bgres pas phyag mdzod grol cha zhus/ byar smad kyi me

rtog bzhes te byams chen du phebs/ de'i tshe/ 'bras spungs thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i snal pa'i sku yoni to rgya mtsho sog yul nas phebs par rje gong ma rnam gnyis nas thugs kha nye ba'i gzhis/ legs ja rgyas pa 'bul du sngags grwa slob dpon rnam rgyal bkrab zhis dang mgroni gnyer bla ma dpal sdings pa rdzong bda' mdzad pas rten 'brel legs tshogs che bar byung / khro mo ste shing pho 'brag gi lo/ lhun rtse nas sde srid ma chen gyis/ sde pa bkra shis rdzong kha ba la phyag mdzod kyi bsko bzhag 'os pa'i snyan 'bul byung ba ltar bsko bzhag gnang / pad dkar grwa 〉nga gi slob dpon rin po che bstan 'dzin chos grags par/ ber sogs gnang cha stsal te chen po'i go sar spar/ chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes dgu la byams gling nas lto brag la chibs kha bsgrar/ yar lam chos rgyal gling du bya gong ma yab yum gyis bkur sti phun sum

ra༅༅/ /tshogs pa 'dug /sngags grwa slob dpon rigs sngags 'chang rnam rgyal bkra shis par chen po'i bsko 'ja' dgos tshul gong ma rin po che brgyud nas byung bar/ thub pa'i sku/ ber sogs gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas te phyag nas gnang / sngags grwa ba bkra shis dpal/ sgro g.yang ri dgon gyi bla ma dang / chos rje rnam rgyal dbang po rdo rje gdan gyi slob daphro du bskos par gnang cha/ spyi sor tshogs khro che ba sogs mang 'gyed rgyas par stsal/ rtse mo rir dmag da' stag rdo rjes spyan drangs 'bul zhabs rgya cher zhus/ de bzhin yang dag ri dang rdzong chen kyang zhabs kyis bcags/ shel mkhar du/ bya gong ma rin po che dang mchod yon lhan rgyas su zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ chibs kha bslar gdong / rdo rje rnal 'gror ma'i ska brnyan li ma/ hor gos kyi ber khyad thon sogs gnang ste/ lho rgyad kyi dgon grwa ris dang
