bcas pa bzhugs sgar ma phebs bar bcol dam mdzad/ chos 'khor stong du bla ma bgres pos gtsug lag khang phal cher grub pa la phyag nas kyang gnang / se khun gyi skya ser rnams kyis 'bul zhabs kyang dpangs bstode 'dug /de'i tshe/ gdan sa ra lung du rje mi pham chos kyi dzol po sku khams mnyel babs lci ba zhig byung dus/ sgar pa phebs kyi yod 'dug zer ba gsan pas/ sprul pa'i sku da lam gdan sar phebs thub na bstan pa'i la rgya 'di la slebs ci dang mi 'dra ba zhig yong ba 'dug /des na gdan sar spyan 'dren zhus pa'i mi rgan dang mjal ba zhig cis kyang dgos 'dug cing / ding sang phebs na/ lam zab dang bde mchog gi dbang sogs dbang chos gal che ba 'ga' ya nga 'bul thub pa 'dug gsungs gdan 'dren pa gnang rtsis mdzad/ rje 'brug pa rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar phebs thub na rten 'brel legs par 'grig

go༅༅/ /rgyur/dpon slob rnams ldo brag la shar rgyag phebs song zhu mkhan byang bas/bka' las/bu chung gis nga'i kha la ma gsan par sgos kyi rten 'brel rnams 'chug pas lan par 'dug/da sprul pa'i sku dang mjal ba zhig mi yong gsungardzu/de nas mi 'gyang bar gzhan don la dgongs so/ /dgu bsdus gzhung brgyud/gtam shul/bsam grub dgon gsar/gung rgyal/btsan gro/byar gzhongs sogs gar phebs kyi yul gru so sor/skyes bu chen po'i zhal gyi dkyil gsor blta ba'i phyir skye tsho tshogs mang du lhags/so so'i legs byas spel ba'i bkur sti'ang rgya cher bgyis pa rpā yod par mdzad de/rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas nye ba'i gnas chen de wī ko ṭi zhes spyod pa/de la snyas yod pa'i mig g.yon pa dang sbyor rgya/he ru ka rang byung gi pho brang zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i 'dun sa/slob daphro

chen po padma dang / gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ sba ye shes dbang po sogs bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su byon pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi sgrub gnas/ 'ja' tshon gyi sku can ras chung rdo rje grags pas zhabs kyis bcags shing zab mo'i gdams pa gter du sbas pa/ chos kyi rje 'gro ba'i mgoni po gtsang pa rgya ras pas chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs shing zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams ngag ro sgoms gter nas spyan drangs pa/ gzhan yang / grub pa mang pos byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas/ phal gyi lho brag mkhar chu zhes bod pa der phebs/ cog grwa gsar pa ba gtso bor gyur pa'i ri bzhugs rnams kyis rgyal ba mnyes par 'os pa'i bkod pa chen pos bsus/ thog mar rgyal dbang rje'i bzhugs khri 'ja' tshon mar phebs/ gsol ja kha yar gyi ring bzhugs tshe dbu'i thad kyi nam mkha' la gdugs phubs pa bzhin/ 'ja' 'od sna tshogs

go༅༅/ /pas khebs pa dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa dngos su mthong ba byung bas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu mar 'dug gsungs/ der 'dus thams cad dad pa'i sa bon je 'phel du gyur/ rje gong ma'i gzims spyil nor bu spungs par bzhugs/ rje mi pham chos rgyal gyi dgongs rdzogs 'bul ba'ang 'gror/ rin ngo che shes rab chos 'phags pa sku mched la/ sgrol ma'i sku li ma/ khyad dkar sogs kyi gnang cha/ de bzhin lha khang dang sgrub sde pa la'ang stsal/ cog grwa pa dang / lha khang pa sgrub sde ba sogs kyi brgya 'bul bzhes/ rin po che spyan mi gsal bas grwa tshang gi thugs khur dgongs grole zhus nas sgrub pa kho na la gzhol/ gdan sar dge slong sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'os par dgongs nas bsko 'ja' gnang / gnas der rgyang tsam stan chags/ lho moni gyi smya ser mang po nyin re bzhin 'tshogs che ba la

mtho ris dang thar pa'i sa bon rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par bskrun to// //kun khyab bde chen dbyengs las g.yo min yan lag bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /zhing 'dir sna tshogs sprul pa'i zlos gar rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las can/ /gzhon nur gyur kyang dam pa'i spyod tshul ma smad snyan grags dgrar skyes rnga/ /thos pas rab dga' mi dbang gtsug phud 'dzin pa'i tshogs kyi sri zhus mchod/ shes bya kun mkhyen go 'phang brnyes kyang slar/ /tshur mthong 'gro ba kun dang mthun 'jug slad/ /yi ge phyi mo las brtsams rig pa'i gnas/ /mtha' dag rnam dasad mags gyi bum par chags/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'thung spyod tsa ri trar/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /pra phab mig la dwangs pa'i shel bzhin du/ /sgrib bral ye shes spyan gyis gzigs mor che/ /slar yang nye ba'i gnas mchog lha mo

༄༅༅/ /mkhar/ /rab dkar shel gyi sa 'dzin maspo po'i rtses/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i lto ba dral dogs te/ /rngul thig bdud rtsir 'dzag der gar brgyas rtsen/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ gzhon nu rol rtsed dang lhan cig shes bya mtha' dag la spyan ras kyi gzigs pa stsal ba'i rab tu byed pa ste gsum pa'o// //de rjes/ dbus phyogs nas gong 'grong sogs sde dpon rnams kyi spyan 'dren gser yig pa dang / lhag par cog grwa rnying pa'i slob da' pa rin po che thun mong nas kyang gdan 'dren du 'byor bas chibs kha bskyar/ lha khang brgyad sgo chu gzhis rkan sgrab sde bas bkur snyi phun sum tshogs pa zhus shing / der khra spel chung ba sogs lho brag gi

sde dpon phal cher mjal ba la byung / chos dang zang zing gi 'du 'god bsam gyis mi khyab pa nas/ gri gu pa'i thab 'dzin chibs bsu rgyas pa dang bcas gzhis kur phebs/ mi 'phrog dad pa'i nor can dpon sa sku gzhen pas/ rje btsun ma'i sku li dkar/ gser srang du ma/ na bza' skor sogs dang / dpon sa rje btsun mas gser zho brgya phrag /gos phyi nang sogs 'bul bar/ dbang chos kyang ci rigs stsal nas tshogs gnyis kyi gang ba yar ngo ltar spel/ de'i tshe/ sbyin bdag che phran so so dang / dbu che bgres kha ska gzhogs su rgyun bzhugs sgar rang gi phyag mdzod sogs las sna rags rim dang bcas pa thams cad bka' bgros/ rang cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa mchog gi sngal pa'e ska 'di nyid/ ska'i sha tshugs gzherni nur snang ba tsam ma gtogs mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las gang

ra༅༅/ khi rjes su dpag kyang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po de nyid dngos byon rang du 'dug pas/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye dang skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /zhes thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin/ skye ba nas skyebar dbang thob la ma nyams pas gsang sngags kyi sdom pa thugs rgyud smu bar ma chad du gnas nges shing / thog ma med pa'i dus nas rin chen byang chub sems kyi sa bon bskyed pa'ang de bzhin du gnas phyin/ skyes bu gzhan las dam pa'i chos kyi sman gsar du bzhes ci zhig dgos/ 'on kyang byis pa'i skye bo blo gros chung ngu kun rtog gi dra bas dkrigs pa dag gi blo'i 'jug pa dang rjes su mthun zhing klan ma'i gnas spang ba'i slad du/ theg pa chen po las gsungs pa'i sdom pa gnyis gsos 'debs pa dang / 'phags pa nyan thos pa'i lugs kyi so so thar pa'i sdom pa slar nod

pa'i tshul tsam zhig med mi rung du 'dug /des na bla ma rin po che lha rtse nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bston par rigs so zhes mgrin gcig tu byung ba bzhin/ spyan 'dren gyi pho nya bas yang yang bskal ba las/ rje yongs 'dzin dam pa dpon slob kyang bzhugs sgar du phebs/ der mchog sprul chen po nyid dgung la bzhugs/ sku 'khor gyi bla ma slob dpon phyag mdzod sogs las 'dzin drag kha thams cad zhal 'dzom par/ bdag la chos 'bul ba'i spobs pa tsam med pas 'bul mi nus/ gal te 'bul ba shar tshe/ ras chung zhabs kyis ras pa chen por skyes su phul ba bzhin/ chos maṇḍal gyi tshul du 'bul bas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis kho bo la bla ma'i mthong bkur mi mdzad pa zhu zhes dman sa bzung ba'i zhu mchid ci yang gsol/ de nas 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shwakya seng ge dzas gling pa'i mchod yul du lha las babs pa'i dus khyad

༄༅༅/ /par can gyi zla ba tha skar gyis nya ba'i yar tshes gsum gyi gza' skar dge ba la/ rten gandho la'i spyan sngar mchod sprin gyi 'phreng ba bstar/ chos 'dul ba las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin tshigs snga ma dge bsnyen dang / bar ma dge tshul gyi dngos por yang dag par nod rjes/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga lugs gnyis dang / bstan 'gro'i dpal du sku tshe'i rten 'brel sgrig pa'i sgor/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa rta mgrin gyi sham bu can/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang / dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i rjes su gnang ba gsan te/ 'brug skor gyis gtsos pa'i dbang lung man ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pa'i dbu 'di nas tshugs so/ /dar rgyas rab brtan du phebs/ 'grong rgyas zhabs drung ska mched rta pa'i tshogs bcas kyis chibs bsu'i rgyan bkod

dang / ri bo bde chen/ 'phags sde/ spyan g.yas/ dpal ri/ thang po che sogs chos sde che phra so so'i dge 'dun grangs mang pos rol mo'i bye brag gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs kha na ma tho ba'i mchod rdzas ci yang thogs pa'i ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te/ 'phyong rgyas stag rtser phebs/ zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs ring rje yongs 'dzin chen por/ rdo rje btsun mos rjes su bzung ba'i grub pa'i slob dpon chen po a rbha yā kā ra gupta ste 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyi khyad chos/ dbang bskur rdo rje 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad du lhag ma bcu bdun yang 'du bar bshad pa paṇḍi ta re lend+ra dang chag lo'i bzhed pa ji lta ba mngon dkyil kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa ltar dang / sgrab thabs rgya mtsho lha nyis brgya dang nyer lnga'i rjes gnang / de dag gi rgya gzhung gi lung / gzhan yang rje padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i rjes gnang nyer

༄༅༅/ /gnyis ma sogs gsan/ sde pa zhal ngor chos dang zang zing gnyis sha'i gnang skyes dang / dgon sde so sor mang 'gyed stsal/ de dus mtshan nyed kyi gsan sbyong gtso bor bzhes skabs nas sku gzhogs su rigs lung dang 'bel gtam shin tu smar/ bde yangs su dpon 'bangs skya ser thams cad kyis brgya 'bul stobs che ba bzhes/ khrom chen po la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig stsal/ yar stod smad e sogs nas dad ldan mang du 'dus/ smar ston zangs 'tsho ba/ chos rje dung la ba sogs 'brag rigs kyi dbu che rnams kyi 'bul ba dang lhag par rje bla mas/ rje rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu sgom gyis gcos pa'i 'bul lam/ rtse nas lo rgermir tshes bcu sogs kyi gar 'cham gzigs 'bul yang mdzad/ sne'u sdong rtser/ gdung brgyad rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan

dpal bzang po khri thog tu phebs par/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyag gi sku li dkar las grub pa sogs kyi legs ja rgyas pa 'bul bar phyag mdzod pa rdzong bdar gnang ngo / /sna tshogs dbyeg ste shing mo sbul lo/ gong ma chen pozlo sne'u sdong rtse nas spyan 'dren pa drung gnas nam dbang pa 'byor/ zhal gyis 'ches kyang / byang stag lung du zhabs drung kun dga' bkra shis zhing khams gzhan du thegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs tshogs dbur gdan 'dren du/ nang so sum 'phrang pa dang mgron gnyer khang gsar pa 'gror ba ltar/ spyan g.yas brgyad/ zhabs drung sku mched de tshun chibs skyel la byon/ de nas sgrab sde don grub mthong smon du bla ma rin po ches spyan drangs/ kun tu bzang po'i sri zhus mchod 〉nga / shar gangs skyon med rgya shubs bod shubs bcas pa lnga/ ska zer legs pa nang ldan bzhi/ sman rtse'i yol ba sngas

༅༅/ /gtsang bzhi/ chibs ming can drug /gos phyi nang yug mang pos gtsos pa'i dgu tshan bcu gsum gyi 'bul chen dngos gtsang ba mdzad/ yar lcag gra phyi nang sogs kyi dgon so sos kyang 'bul zhabs legs par phul/ phebs lam gyi sa tshigs so sor/ yar rgyab/ skyid shod pa sogs sde da' rnams kyis bas 'degs dang bcas sum 'phrang du phebs/ stag lung nas thab bsu dang ja zhus rgyas pa'ang der slebs/ la skyed du ban dpon gyis gtsos pa'i rta pa'i tshogs mang dang / thang du gling grwa tshang gi ser sbrengs rgyas pas bsus/ bzhugs yul grog khar gnang / yang dgon du/ rgyal ba'i sras po po to ba rin chen gsal gyi rnam smu mkhas btsun grub pa'i dper 'os dboni rin po che ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba dang mjal tshe/ mjal dar gnang res/ bzhugs gdan gung bzhibs la bzhis byes

kyi bkur sti'i bab 'brel las rgyal ba nyid kyi bzhugs khri khad gsar cung mtho ba/ gsol dpon mnyam rgyug dam pa'i chos kyi 'bel ba'i bka' mchid gnang res sogs dashar brgyud gong ma'i mdzad pa phyag len du bstar/ de nyin dbon rin po cher brtan bzhugs 'bul ba/ gser zho bcu drug na bza' skor sogs kyi thog ma'i bkra shis kha btags phyag tu bstar tshe/ dbon rin po ches gdan khar phebs nas bzhes/ sku bgres gzhon gyi babs 'brel du thog mar dbon rin po cher tshe bapokha dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i lung thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba gsan dus/ dbon rin po che rgyun gyi bzhugs khri'i steng du bzhugs/ sku mdun du rgyal ba nyid la kha gang ma'i steng du stan dmar dang bzhugs gding tsam mdzad/ slar dbon rin po ches rgyal ba nyid la/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs rta mgrin gyi sham bu can

ra༅༅/ /dang / lam zab snying por dril ba gsan dus bzhugs gdan gong las zlog pa mdzad pa sogs skyes bu dam pa phan tshun du dag pa'i snang ba 'grams klas pa'i dkar brgyud rin poche'i rnam thar med du byung ba'i rgyus sku rdzi khu dbon/ dbon rin chen blo gros/ dpon mgon po/ khams tshan spyi pa/ ka drug pa gling grwa tshang sogs so so nas dad pas bsnyen cing bkur/ phar yang gdung 'bul mang 'gyed rgya che ba dang gtsug lag khang rten gsum rnams zhib mor gzigs dus snyan dar sogs mchod sprin spros/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i nyin/ bkra shis kha btags kyis byang drangs rgya gar nub phyogs kyi lha thub pa grong khyer ma sogs rten gsum/ khyad nor gyi rigs mang po/ gzhan yang ja gos dar/ rta dre'u/ mdzo g.yag /go khrab sogs brgya 'bul gsum lhagatsam 'bul ba mdzad/ yas gtapa

mchod 'bul gyi bsngo ba yon bshad dang bcas rgyas par stsal bas kun yi rangs par gyur/ stag lung nas phyir phebs dus dbon rin po ches gzims chung 'bul ba'ang rgya cher gnang / chag la'i nang khugs su thab skyel dang ban dponi sogs rta pa'i chibs skyel zhus/ 'phan yul brgyud/ glang thang chos sder rje mthu chen gyi sprul pa'i sku bla ma zhabs drung gis spyan drangs/ 'bul zhabs dang 'bel gtam shin tu smar bar mdzad/ de'u gong du skyid sgo da sde pa g.yul rgyal bar/ dbang chos bzhed pa bzhin stsal/ gling ma gzhis shar stag lung nas dpon sa rje btsun mas zhabs tog phun sum tshogs/ pa zhus/ de nas bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan chos 'khor lha sar phebs/ bzhugs yul dga' ldan khang gsar du mdzad/ jo shāka yid bzhin gyi nor bu gtso bor gyur pa'i rten mjal zhib mor gnang / zhal gser dang / lha rdzas kyi

/ tshogs pa du mas snyan shal mdzes par byas/ khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba sogs mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis legs naser ston sogs gnang cha rgya cher stsal/ dkyil 'khor sdings su mchod yon lhan cig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' rten yang zhib tu gzigs/ sku 'khor na dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du mchis pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab la rnam par pa bdag pho mo so sor 'dod sbyar gyi bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims dang / thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung sogs la pa'i ska yon tan rgya mchos/ gos chen gyi na bza' skor sogs rgyas pa dang bcas 'bul bar mgron gnyer bgres po

byang / gong dkar nas spyan 'dren pa nang sesgo grwa lnga 'byor/ mgon po gdong du drag sngags kyi srang ma beng la snyan dar rten rdzas rgyas pa bshams te 'phrin las rgosol/ lum pa rdzong du phebs dus bya yul nas chos rje dbon chen sku na smin pa dang bcas mi 'tsho badro 'dug zhu bas/ drung yig chen mo dang / gzims dpon gri gu ba gnyis la zhal bkod gnang / lho rgyad kyi bla ma slob dpon so sor bsngo rten/ sde grwa tshang rnams la mang 'gyed rnam gzhag lung ston sogs dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i dngos po stobs che ba gnang ngo / /rjo bla mas/ 'brug byang chub sdings su zhabs tog zhus/ gong dkar nas zhabs drung mi'i dbang po dpon blon brgya byin dpung tshogs bskyod pa lta bu'i chibs rags bcas srin po ri'i mdun du spyan 'dren la phebs/ ra ba smad pa dang / rje bla mas gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i grwa tshang gnyis kyi ser sbrengs

༄ṣṭha༅/ /rgyas pas bsus te pho brang chen por zhabs kyi padmo bkod/ de'i tshe/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen por rnam 'joms mthing kha khro bo bco lnga ma dang / tshe dpag med zhi ba lha mangs kyi dbang / bkra shis tshe ring ma'i rjes gnang sogs dbang rjes gnang mang po dang / gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud sde rin po che bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung gsan pa'i dbu tshugs/ der rgyal ba nyid kyis kyang mi'i dbang po khu dbon la dgongs sbyar gyi dbang rjes gnang 'ga' dang / chos rje gnas chung ba sogs don gnyer gyi tshogs la tshe dpag med lha mangs kyi dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste stsal/ rgyud 'bum gyi lung gsan bzhin pa'i mu nas slar lum par phebs/ chos rje mang thos pad dkar/ tsa ri tra'i rdor 'dzin du ber sogs gnang cha dang bcas te bskos/ de dus spral pa'i ska bla ma zhabs drung yang phebs/ zhabs

phyir rgyud 'bum 'khril ba'i bar bzhugs/ dge slong 'bri khung pa yig rigs la shin tu mkhas pas lañdza dang / wartu sogs yig rigs mang po la byang bar mdzad/ der yongs 'dzin dam par mgon po rigs bzhi'i skor rnams gsan/ slar rgyal khab chen por phebs thog lhun rtse dang 'grong rtse'i spyan 'dren pa 'gror/ de dus rje rdo rje 'chang gis phag gru'i ba/'a 'bum sogs dkar brgyud rin po che'i zab chos ji snyed pa dang / 'jigs byed sogs dkyil 'khor mang po'i dbang lung / lhag par dpal ye shes kyi mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba lha mangs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa chen po dang 'brel ba'i dbang bzhi mchod yon lhan rgyas su phul/ de dang rjes 'brel khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid kyis/ ji srid bskal pa rgya mtshor ska tshe'i rgyal mtshan g.yo ba med pa'i rten 'brel du/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil

༄༄/ takhor thags grub ma'i bla re/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bkod pa sna tshogs kyi mos ngor 'char ba'i rten 'brel du/ hor dus kyi se hu pas grub pa de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbyangs kyi chos tshul du ma sgrogs pa'i rten 'brel du/ hor dril dngul mgo ma rtse lnga shubs bcas/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho la dbang 'gror ba'i rten 'brel du/ rdo rje gri gug dang / ka pā la dum bu gcig pa bdud rtsis gang ba kha gcod stegs dang bcas pa/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i yoni tan gyi stobs gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du/ rdo rje'i kha ṭaṃ ga hor dus kyi dngul tshags skyon gyis ma reg pa/ 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che

'gog pa med pa'i rten 'brel du/ mgon mangs kyi tsaka li cha tshang / rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan 'bur dod/ bka' 'bum rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i pusta ka bcu phrag sogs 'bul ba mdzad de dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen por mnga' gsol/ sde srid nas kyang 'bul lam shin tu rgyas pa byung / tshe b.lakha serdzogs dbang rjes gnang dgongs bzhed bzhin stsal/ de nas gtsang phyogs pa rnams kyi spyan 'dren mang bas phebs par phyogs/ zhabs drung dponi gaskusnag gis rin chen gling tshun chibs skyel mdzad/ dpal de/ sna dkar rtse sogs su zhabs tog mkhos su phebs/ rje btsun u rgyan mtsho mo'i ja zhus kyang slebs/ grub pa mang pos byang chub brnyes pa'i rdo rje gdan/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i dpal bcu gsum gyis shis par byas pa'i gdan sa chen po ra lung thel nas/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i

ra༅༅/ /mgon po mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma dpon slob kyis/ bsu ba ser sbrengs kyi bkod pa rgyas par bstar te spyan drangs/ gtsug lag khang so so'i rten gsum rnams zhib mjal gnang / sku 'bag khams gsum zil gnon sogs rten khyad par can de rnams kyi spyan sngar snyan dar sogs mchod pa'i rdzas kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyi phung po bzhin spro bar mdzad cing / spos skya sgrub sde ba dang / shwa rags pa rnam/sa la mang 'gyed kyang rgyas pa gnang / de nas shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen spyan yangs pa sprul pa'i sku mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug bdud 'joms rdo rjes rgyal rtser bkur sti chen pos mchod/ rin sdings grwa tshang pas kyang gdan drangs 'bul zhabs phul phyin zhus/ tshogs khro sogs mang 'gyed stsal/ bsod nams chen po'i dpal la spyod pa'i sa'i dbang phyug kun bzang rab brtan dpon blon chos

sde'i mkhan slob dang bcas rta pa'i tshogs kyis chibs bsu dang / chos sde chen po'i dge 'dun rnams kyis yon gnas la ri mor 'os pa'i ser sbrengs kyis zagagadong nas bsus/ mtho ris kyi dpal yon du mas gang ba rtse chen du phebs/ sri zhu bsngags par 'os pas dgyes pa bskyed/ dpon sa rje btsun mas gang ser du'ang spyan drangs/ chos sder mang 'gyed rpā gnyer so so la'ang chos kyi sbyin pa yid bzhin du stsal/ dad pa dang gtong ba'i nor gyis phyug cing dpa' zhing brtul phod pa 'brong rtse ba tshe dbang don grub yab sras kyis bsu ba thab 'dzin dang / 'brong rtse chos sde/ rgyal byed sngags bshad sogs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbrengs/ sog gar gyi gzigs mo dang bcas spyan drangs/ bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa dang / gza' tshes dge ba'i nyin mdun gyi zhing mo cher seng ge'i gdan khri bshams pa la yon

ra༅༅/ /gnas ci dam pa 'khor dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bskor ba gdan drangs/ sde pa yab sras nas skye ba du mar skyes bu dam pa la sri zhu bgyis pa'i rnam dkar gyi dad shugs mi dman pas/ rten gsum/ gser dngul/ shel spyad/ ja gos dar/ go khyab/ rta dre'u sogs kyi 'gror pa lhab lhub tu bdal bas bre tab rnams kyi snying lkog mar 'tshangs pa lta bu'i brgya 'bul spyi sger nas mdzad pa dang rjes 'brel/ drung 'khor dpon rigs/ khyim bdag 'byor ldan so sos kyang 'bul ba dpangs bstod 'dug pa'i dge tshogs byang chub kyi bar du mi nyams la 'phel zhing yangs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ba dang / rin po che'i sku rgyan bzhes nas khrom chen po la tshe bka' gnang ba ma rdzogs ring me tog gi char ngo mtshar ba babs pa kun gyi spyod yul du gyur/ lung rigs smra ba'i 'dun sa chos grwa chen po rgyal byed tshal du

phebs/ rje gong ma kun mkhyen chen po padma dkar po'i bsha' 'bum rin po che'i lung gsan par tshugs/ mgon khang zhal dbye mdzad/ rten gtor dang spyan gzigs ci yang bshams/ 'grong rtsepa sogs yon bdag rnams kyis kyang spyan gzigs la dmigs pa'i go dkar ldem sogs phul/ chos skyong gi bskang gzhag mang po sbrel nas gnang / mkhas grub rgyal ston chos rje dbang phyug rgyal po dang / sngags bshad so sos kyang 'bul zhabs legs par phul/ 'di dus sku'i snang tshul tsam ston par gsol ba ragasapa mi gzha1la ba/ mnal bar mi mdzad pa/ nyin gang rje bla mar dbang lung gsan pa dang / phyogs kyi dang 'dus shin tu mang ba la zhal mjal byin rlabs gsung chos gnang bas dus 'da'/ mtshan mo sge 'bol 'cha' ba dang ska mnye ba sogs gtan nas mi gnang / na bza' be phrug re'am 'jam ras re las mi

ra༅༅/ /gsol/ mar me'i mdangs la phyag dpe gzigs pa'am/ dad rten du gnang rgya'i chos skyong srung ma'i sku thang phyag bris ma mang po gnang / bla ma lha khang mjal bar phebs skabs 'gro ba'i mgon po'i sku 'bag yid bzhin nor bu'i snyan g.yon༄ pa'i rtse nas ring bsrel yungs mar che ba tsam zhig phyag tu phebs/ mgon khang du thog ma phebs skabs/ rje sdo rje 'chang gis 'di dpal ldan lha mo'i rtag gtor yin pa 'dug lags zhu ba gnang 'phral/ de ma'i thad kyi spyan gzigs khrod nas bkra shis kha btags dri mas ma gos pa zhis sku'i mdun du babs pa dang / las mgon gyi 'bur sku'i gri gag las zhag dngos su 'dzag pa byung / rgyun du'ang chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams zhal gzigs pa dang / de dag gis 'phrin las skyab tshul gyi gsung gleng shugs 'byung gis phebs/ sngar gtor ma la byi bas gnod

par 'dug ste/ phebs bzhugs thogam 'di nas bzung gtor gzhi 'dzugs pa gnang ba thams cad bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa skyone med du brtan pa dang / de skabs zla ba bcu gcig pa'i dgu gtor gyi gung gseng la/ pa snam gyi dgoni sde lnga drug gi brgya 'bul rdo gcal mthil gyi bzhugs khri chen mor phebs nas bzhes skabs/ bla ma'i rnal 'gror ches rgyas pa zhig gnang ring me tog gi char chen po kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'dab ma can babs pa khrom pa kun gyis mthong / gzhan yang cho 'phral gyi tshes bco lnga'i nyin snga phyed tsam la yab sras lhan du sgo mangs su bzhugs skabs/ nyi 'od cher 'bar ba la nyi thog gsum rim bkra ba phug pa'i bar tham/ cad 'khor lo dang / dpal be'u sogs bkra shis pa'i ri mo'i rnam pa'i 'ja' sprin mtshar bas khebs pa las manda ra ba'i char rgyun dal bur 'bab pa sogs dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams

ra༅༅/ /kyis mchod pa'i mtshan ma tshur rol mthong ba'i 'dren byed la babs pa'ang mang po byung / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor phyag bris ma la brten nas bde mchog nā ro bcu gsum ma'i dbang / tshe dpag med zhi ba lha mang / rnam 'joms khro bo lha bco lnga ma/ gsang sgrab khro bo lha mang rnams dang / rjes gnang gi rim pa'ang mang bar gnang ngo / /g.yabs khrar sku mtshams gnang / de dus dgung lo bcu gsum gyi dgung skeg thog skye rshabs pa dang / dam grib zhig gis rkyen byas sku khams shin tu mnyel ba'i tshul bstan/ rgyun du gasku1la ba rags pa mi bzhes pa'i khar/ de skabs chab 〉sgol grang phran bu ma gtogs gang yang ma bzhes par zhag grangs mang po song zhing / ska'i 'phrod bsten ci phul yang dwangs skyed med par shin tu nyen par byung dus kyang bzhugs khri'i khar nyin mtshan med par ska khrong nger bzhugs/ der

dbu che 'tsho byed thams cad bka' bgros/ da ni gso dpyad kyi 'phrod bston sku rim sogs 'di las gnang rgyu mi 'dug /skyes bu dam pa bsam bzhin du 'gro ba'i don la byon pa yin pas so so'i skye bo'i blos dpag par ni dga'/ phal pa yin na phyi nang gi ltas thams cad shar 'dug pa dang bcas zhag bdun las mi bzhugs thag chod du snang bas/ sde pa lhun rtse nas thugs dad che bas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba zhig ma byung na thugs 'dod mi rdzogs shing nged rang rnams la thugs 'phog kyang yong / ma 'ongs pa byung tshe bsha' gros zhu sa yang yong bas/ gdan 'dren pa btang ba 'gab gsungs spyan 'dren pa btang / dgongs cig dpon tshang tsha rong nas kyis bzhugs khri la dbu btud/ da thabs gzhan ni ma rnyed/ nam zhig ci 'dra zhig thos yong dgongs yod pa la/ skabs shig gsung shugs chen pos bla ma rin po che/ bla ma rin po

ra༅༅/ /che/ gis nyis btung gsungs byung ba la/ bla ma rin po ches gsung lan phul te/ thugs bden thugs bden/ zhes zhu ba gnang song bar/ de dgong ni rgyu mtshan ci yang zhu ma nus/ nang par mdang srod la dpon slob gsung gleng ba de ci lags zhus pas/ bla ma rin po che nas/ mdang dgong nga'i kun rtog gi bsam pa zhig la/ bstan 'gro'i don du sku'i sprul pa zhig phebs ni phebs/ nga rang sprul pa 'di bsdus nas gzhan zhig phebs par brtsams na thugs mi sun pa 'dra bsam pa zhig skyes pa de dgongs par 'dug /thurges rgyal bzhengs pa'i gsung shugs mdzad lugs kyis zhing khams gzhan du phebs pa'i dgongs pa gtad pa med 'dug pas/ da rang / nged rang tsho blo skyog mi dgos par 'dug gsungs/ lhan rtse nas sde srid kyang nyin mtshan bshar nas phebs/ snyan du gsol bas mchod yon

thugs nang gtsang bas shar rgyag tu btang chog gsungs/ gzims chung du phebs pa dang zhal 'dzum dang dges dges ci yang mdzad/ gsol ja gcig gi ring bzhugs/ 'gag tu phebs tshe sde pa nas kṣiṃ mdangs cher mi 'dug ste mjal bas blo skyog tu ma song gsungs/ de rjes gsang chab zhig byung ba ltas legs pas/ mchod yoni dam tshig gtsang ba'i rten 'bral la thams cad ya mtshan/ gsang chab de sde pa la byin rlabs rten du gnang / 'tsho byed rnams blo bde ba tsam byed snang yang gsol ba rags pa ci yang ma bzhes pas blo gdengs ma khel bar ci yong mi shes zer/ snga nas sha'i rigs bzhes pa lta zhog spyan lam la yang 'grim sa med pa zhig yin rung / de res ska'i 'phrod bsten du 'dug bsam lkog tu bzhes thug la lug sha skam thal phran bu zhig btab nas zhus pas/ ci ci snam 'dug gsungs ci yang ma

go༅༅/ /bzhes/ tsha rang nas kyis da ni gzhan thabs med/ sgog skyaphran bu zhig a ru dang bsres nas zhus na zhu bar bzhin du zhus pas des rkyen byas 'phrod bston bzhes/ phyag mdzod nas dge 'dun gyi sde chen po sum cu rtsa grangs la sku rim la dmigs pa'i mang 'gyed rnam gzhag rgyas pa dang / sgar grwa tshang rnams kyis mdo sgrol sogs 'bum btang / chos skyong gi bskang ba brgya tshar mang po/ sku 'khor gyi bla ma slob dpon dge 'dun dang bcas pa thams cad kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ dbu che grwa yon so so nas brtan bzhugs grangs su ma bcad pa phul/ lhag par rje rdo rje 'chang gis sku dang 'bral med du bzhugs/ tshe dpag med lha mgon sogs kyi dbang rjes gnang tshar mang po dang bcas bla ma yi dam la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong la dam sgrag mdzad pa sogs kyi rten 'brel bsla ba

med pa dang / 'tsho byed rin po che byang ston stakṣa ༄la mtshan/ dpon tshang nor bu ba/ dpon tshang la ra ba/ dpon tshang tsha rong ba rnams mkhas myong che bas 'phrod bsten phul bar brten ji ltar me tog la chus bran pa'am/ bsil zer byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gza' las grol ba ltar/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i dpal gyis brgyan par gyur to/ /yul stod spel du sku mdun tshe bkras pas/ dkar brgyud gral rim gyi bris sku bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la spyan drangs par phebs/ kong po nas chos rje rgyal dbang sku skye daphro slob rta dre'u ja sogs 'bul ba rgya cher bcas 'gror/ dgung lo bcu bzhi pa zil gnon te me pho rta lo gsar/ lhun rtse nas mi dbang rpā grub rdo rje snyan dwangs dga' ston 'bul bar phebs/ rgyal bu don thams cad gyub pa'i li ska khyad mtshar/ hor dril/ hor sngag /kha thi/ lug sogs 'bul stobs che

/bar mdzad/ gnang skyes kyang / thub pa'i sku brnyan zangs thang ma sogs stsal/ de bzhin rtse chen 'brong rtse sogs dad ldan gyi grwa yon mang kha ston legs ja'i 'bul ba rnam thos bu'i 'gror pa la 'gran pa bzhin bsgrubs so// //rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes spyi gzugs rnal 'gror dbang /slar yang sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i dpal 'dzin grub pa'i khyu mchog lha rtse rje/ /rigs kyi khyab bdag chen por bsten nas tshul khrims kun bzod yangs pa'i na bang lung man ngag rin chen mdzod 'dzin ded dpon nā ro pa zhes grags/ /dkar brgyud bstan pa'i shing rta stag lung pa'i/ /dgongs pa bskang ba'i cho ga bas tshe/ /dag snang lha yi lam du nyi zla bzhin/ /thams cad mkhyen gnyis bstan 'gro'i dpal du mdzes/ /sna tshogs 'dzin ma'i thig ler legs byas rdzi /

dpal la dbang sgyur mi dbang 'khor bcas pas/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod las bsod nams tshogs/ /zla tshes yar ngo'i dpal dang 'grogs pa bzhin/ sprun nyon las kyi bag chags yongs spangs pas/ min rtog stun dris gcos pa ga la srid/ /kun rmongs byis pa 'drid pa'i thabs de yang / /kun mkhyen bla mas kun la brtsephyir bstan/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan sku ngas 'du'i dpal gyisde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ rab tu byung zhing thos bsam gyi bdud rtsephan bde'i dpyid du bzhes pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas/ da)da kyi dpal mo'i lang tsho yongs su bdo ba dag byed zla ba'i nang du lhan po rtser chibs kha bslar/ gzhis ka bsam gyub rtse nas phebs lam gyi thegs 'dzin 'bul lam rgyas pa

ra༅༅/ /mdzad/ gser mdog can gyi mkhan po sogs grwa sa che phran gyi mkhan slob rnams dang / dpon skya/ drung 'khor sogs kyis mjal mi dang 'bul zhabs kyang rtsis las 'das pa byung / glang la thon mtshams/ bsod nams dang mi 'phrog pa'i dad stobs kyis mngon par phyug pa/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa'i gzi byin gyi nyin mor byed pas pha rol mun pa'i dpung la 'thing slad ster ba sa'i brgya byin mi dbang don grub rdo rje dpon blon drung 'khor rta pa'i tshogs las tshan skya rags sogs kyi chibs bsu'i bkod pa rmad du byung ba sum rtsen gyi 'dun sa lta bu dang / ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag brgal bas dkon mchog gsum mchod par bsngags pa'i mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i ser sbrengs kyi bkod pas gnam sa'i gzhi khyab pa lta bu'i mdun bsus te/ mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang phun sum

tshogs pa'i legs byas 'bum sde'i dpyid du grub pa de dang nye ba'i skyed tshal/ 'bras bu'i snyem ngom pa'i bza' shing gi ra ba dang dri bzang po'i ljoni pa'i 'phreng bas kun nas dkrigs pa 'chi med kyi dga' tshal lta bu sman ljongs dang me tog sna tshogs pas kun tu khebs pa/ nyin mor byed pa'i tsha zer gyis gnam sngon bzhu ba sa gzhir 'khyil ba lta bu'i khras kyi rdzing bur chu bya rnams snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa/ 'bab chu shel gong ltar dwangs shing gtsang ba'i rgyun 'bab pas chu zil gyi mu tig 'thor ba/ margad kyi khu bas lan /rgyar byugs pa'i ne'u gsing rma bya'i mgrin mdangs kyang mog por bgyid pas sa gzhi khebs pa'i dbus su/ an da rnyil gyi khang bzang byi ru'i ka ba du mas bteg pa'i thog 'phar ma tharke ta'i mda' yab rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan g.yo bas mdzes pa/ dge legs kyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye zhing yid du mchis pa'i dpal

go༅༅/ /thams cad tshogs pa gang der phebs/zhabs phyir yang rgyal rigs kyi paṇḍi ta chos kyi dbang phyug /lha sger gyi snyan ngag mkhan rin spungs pa zla ba bzang po/ gzhan yang dbu che drung 'khor rgyal byed sngags bshad cog grwa rnying pa sogs sgar grwa tshang shin tu gtos che ba phogs bzhes rang yang nyis stong la nye ba tsam/gzhi len phebs spro'i dga' stoni gyitsha mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rjes mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag las brtsams pa'i wegs par bshad pa'i 'bel gto gyis dgyes pa bskyed/sde srid dpon blon la gnang skyes sku 'khyos kyi tshul du/ rgyal ba ma pham pa'i3 brnyan li dkar rgya gar shar phyogs pa sogs rgya spam can dang / dbang chos kyang bzhed pa bzhin du stsal/ de dus tshad ma gtso bor gyur pa'i phar dbu sogs mdo phyags kyi gzhung yan lag dang

bcas pa'i rgya bod kyi spyi 'grel thams cad la gsan spyong rus su bton/ gser mdog can/ thub bstan gnyis/ bya gzhongs/ chos gsor lhun po/ bkra shis lhun po sogs lung rigs smra ba'i chos grwa so so'i mkhan slob dka' bcu rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa mang du 'dus/ 'bel gtapa dang rigs lung gi khor mo yug tu 'byams klas/ spyi don dang gzhung don gang la yang gsung bshad dang rigs lung thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyis dpyod ldan mtha' dag gi yid dbang phrogs par gyur to/ /sang gzhi'i rjes gcod du tsha mo rong gi chab tshan yang gnang / yun ring mo nas yul dam pa bsnyen cing bkur ba la goms pa'i sa skyong dbang po de nyed kyis phul du phyin pa'i ri mor mdzad/ jo nang nas rje btsun kun dga' snying pos bkur sti chen po'i chab shog dang bcas ja zhus 'gror pa'i skyes lan 'bul bar rje dgo

༄༅༅/ /mtsho byang pa mngags/ mnga' ris mang yul gyi rgyal po stod smad kyis/ gser sogs 'bul ba stobs che ba dang / grub chen bde ba rgya mtshos spos shel gyi zhags pa bcu phrag bzhi brgal ba sogs 'bul tshan che ba 'byor/ gzhan yang nā gasko ṭa/ gan zhwa/ khu nu rong / gu ge/ pu reng / ru thog /gro nod/ slo bo/ tre nag tshang sogs nas kyang zhal skyin mjal bar mang du lhags pa rnams la'ang chos dang zang zing gis phan bde'i snying po can du mdzad/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mi gzugs su byon pa rje bla ma dam pa de nyid la/ bka' 'bum rin po cher bzhugs pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ dgyes rdor yab bka' yum bka'/ gur rigs bsngas/ bde mchog yab bamakha yum banakha/ gdan bzhi yab bsha' yum ba/kha/ ma hā mā ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ 'jigs byed sogs

zur bka'i rigs ji snyed pa dang / phyag chen/ bsre 'pho/ snyan brgyud/ bla sgrub/ rten 'brel/ 31 rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ ro sgoms sogs 'brag skor gyi gdams pa rnams kyi khrid/ rnam bshad/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim/ mā ya/ gdan bzhi/ rim lnga/ sbyor drug /zhi byed/ rdzogs chen sogs kyi rmon ngag mang po/ chos skyong skor sogs bka' 'bum rin po cher bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bgrang bar dka' ba gsan/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas bdag chen rin po ches zhu yig bkur stis brgyan pa gnang ba'i skyes lan kyang gya nom pa phul/ ngam ring sogs la stod lho byang gi chos sde so so'i bla slob dge 'dun rnams dang shrī bsam gling gi mkhan po tshul khrims rgya mtsho ba dang / mkhas grub o rgyan pa'i dbon brgyad chos rje byuta tra ba/ spro bde nas chos rje mdzo bzang pa/ bar 'brog rdor gling / bde chen

ba sde so so nas kyang zhal dkyil mjal mi chos zhu ba mang po 'dus pa rnams smin grol gyi gdams pas re 'bras snying po ne tshe ba sogs kyi gzhis su'ang spyan 'dren zhus/ so so'i tshogs gnyis gong du spel/ spre'u zhes bya ba me mo lug sa dang / snod ldan gyi skal ba can du gzigs pas lhun rtse nas sde srid yab sras gtsa bor gyur pa'i don gnyer mang po bzhi rdzogs stsal/ mchod yoni lhan rgyas su khro phu dga' ldan du phebs/ rgyal ba ma pham pa'i sku la gser chab dang mchod ri sa kyi rten gzigs kyang gnang nas gnas srin po rdzong du zhag 'gazha bzhugs/ de dus stod marga bkra shis mthong smon

du/ chos rje mdo sngags rab 'byams pa'i gdan sa dang mang yul rgyal po'i bla mar zhwa lu rab 'byams pa dar rgyas la bsko 'ja' gnang ste brdzangs/ mang yul nas slob gnyer ba mang po'ang slebs/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rjes grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan dgongs grol zhus/ dge ba'i gshes gnyen rgyal stoni rin po che dbang phyug rgyal po la 'jam dkar gyi sku li ma sogs bsko 'ja' bzang po stsal te bdud 'dul grwa tshang gi slob dpon du bskos/ grwa tshang khrod nas bde kye gsang gsum gyi rgyud/ bsre 'pho 'grel chen sogs rgyugs 'bul ba mang po byung bar rjes su yi rangs ba'i 'dzum zhal phye ste so sor mthun rkyen bzang pos thos bsam la spro ba 'phel bar mdzad/ tsa ri rgod pa'i 'gro mgon du chos rje rlag tshang pa/ gsal rje sgrab sder rin po che sangs rgyas gser 'od/ rgyal byed bshad grwar lung rigs smra ba bstan pa dar rgyas rnams

ra༅༅/ /bskos/ bshad grwa 'di la chos gzhis ha cang mi bzang bas lo brgyad tsam sgar gyi phyag phyir khrid/ de nas bya khri dpon sku mched kyi spyan 'dren gser yig par sngags grwa rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis sogs 'gror/ phur bu ste sa pho spre'u lo shar mtshams/ sa skyong ba'i brgya byin don grub rdo rje gang gis bsod nams kyi mthus bskan pa'i dpal 'gyor phun sum tshogs pa don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ dus tshes bzang po la pho brang mdun gyi bzhugs khri chen mor gdan drangs/ rgyal dang de sras rnamasar skro sku gsung thugs rten khyad par du 'phags pa du mas byang drangs pa'i shel spyad gser dngul sogs rin po che'i rigs/ rgya hor gyi sbug sil/ yol ba bla bre/ ja gos dar/ rta dre'u/ mdzo g.yag /go khrab/ khro zangs/ snam ras sogs gnod sbyin gyi khengs pa 'phrog cing 'jig rten na yod ṅgā cog

zhing bshams pa rnams/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bar ma dor chud mi 'dza' ba'i yongs su bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa'i skor sogs zab rgyas kyi bka' du ma dang / mi dbang de nyid kyis kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po rje gong 'og gi rab gnas dang / sbyin pa'i bdag por bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sogs 'dod dgu'i dngos grub char du rja mchog lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang brdzangs/ sde srid gtsang pa'i spyan 'dren la 'brong rtse khang dmar ba ra/ tshong 'dus khri khang pas mchod/ lce mkhar du bsod nams chen po'i byin dang ldan pa'i sa skyong chen po rkarma

༄༅༅/ /bstan srungazhes grags pa'i nga ro mi zad pa dpa' zhing brtul phod can gyi dpon blon/ zhabs phyir rgyal rtse/ skyid shod pa sde pa yid bzhin sogs dbus gtsang gi sde dpon che khag du ma dang bcas pa'i chibs bsu'i bkod pas pa snam klu khang du spyan 'dren zhus/ dgung zhag bdun la nye bar bzhugs ring / zhabs drung dpon g.yog rnams sgar mjal la nyin re bzhin phebs/ bzhugs gdan bkod pa sogs bkur sti rgyal ba dmi pa la ji ltar zhu ba bzhin mdzad/ bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga'i thags sku gras gtsang khyad mtshar/ dkar 'bras nyin mo bde legs ma/ ding phon khra ser gyi pang khebs sogs shin du spus gtsang ba'i 'bul chen phul/ sde srid du'ang gnang skyes rgya che ba dang / blon khag so sor yang zang zing gi 'du 'god bzang pos mchod yon thugs snang dag par byung / 'bras khud phyin chibs

srid nas 'phros mol la'ang / 'brug pa dpon slob de shin ri/gas par 'dug sogs bsngags pa mdzad ces gleng ngo / / dbang b.lakha mang po dang gnang cha yang gya nom pa stsal/chang la/ dpal rdo rje nag po 'a po phyag bzhi pa'i rgyud dpa'ir ba dang bcas lcam dral gyi rgyad so gnyis tsam dang / spre

༄༅༅/ /gsan/ rtse chen du phebs zhal ngo spyi la tshe bka' sogs dang / sde pa kun bzang rab brtan pa'i ngor gtum po nus mthu'i skor cha tshang gnang / sde pa des chos sder gtum po lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub mchod btsugs/ phyag rdor gyi bsnyen sgrub la'ang brtson par mdzad pa zhig byang / kong po nas mtsho mjug sku skye dpon slob 'bul ba dang bcas 'byor/ dbang chose zhu ba dang thugs gnyer la lo gsum tsam bzhugs ring dbang rgyud man ngag gis tshim par rjes su bzung / ri khrod dga' ldan chos sde chen po dang bcas zhabs kyis bcags/ rgyal rtse klu khang du rin sdings pa dang gur pa sogs kyi bla slob dpon/ drung che las tshan dpon rigs che phran sogs skya ser gyi khrom chen po 'dus pa la/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ de dus gdan sa ra lung nas spyan 'dren nan chags

kyang 'bram bu'i stabs kyis phebs ma thub/ gnam gru bzhir zhabs drung grub thob rin po che rgyal ba nyid mjal ba dang / gzhung sger gyi ja zhus 'bul mi byung bar skyes lan yang gnang / 'brog stag lung du zang zing gi 'bul stobs shin tu che/ dad ldan mang po la chos 'brel stsal/ phebs lam gyi yul gru dang sgar khrod du'ang 'brum pa 'ga' re byung yang / rgyal ba'i sku la ci yang ma nongs/ de dus gong dkar nas spyan 'dren thengs gsum byung yang phebs pa ma shar/ gri gzhi 'bul ba bzhes/ shel mkhar du bya gong ma chos kyi dbang phyug dpon blon phebs bsu la byon 'dug par/ khri rdo'i zhal dkar/ hor sil sogs gnang skyes rgyas par stsal/ de bzhin rtse mo ri/ rdo rje gdan/ seng ge rdzong rnams su skyes gnang dang so so'i phebs spro yang rgyas pa bshams 'dug pa rnams don yod par mdzad/ zhor la gnyal gyi me tog bzhes

go༅༅/ /nas chos rgyal gling brgyud byams chen du phebs/ chos rje rgyal dbang sku skye me rag mdo'i spyi blar bskos/ rgyal tshab byams pa'i li ska mtho lding ma dang / sku ber mtshal kha gser sgril thags kyi ri dwags kha sprod can sogs chos kyi 'phrin las rgya cher 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnang cha stsal/ rgya rtags skya cod pan bcings te shis brjod kyi me tog char du bsnyil/ me mdo spyi par yang mang ja dang sgrigs su bca' ba'i bka' shog gnang / chos rje 'di bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs pa lugs gnyis mar mkhyen daphyod yangs pas kun mthun snang grub cing / chos 'chad nyan sogs 'phrin las che bas sgrub sde'ang grwa bzang zhing thugs dam smar/ phyis 'byug chos sdings kyi gtsug lag khang rten gsum dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa gsar du bstun pa sogs bstan pa la mdzad pa che ba zhig go/ /lo gro dang

byar gyi me tog bzhes/ dgun byams chen du bzhugs ring dbu phar 'dul mngon sogs kyi gsan sbyong 'phro bskyangs/ bstan 'gyur gras shog bu mda' tshad lnga brgya tsam rgyun du ljags skyore gnang ba sogs rtag 'grus che bar mdzad/ rdor 'dzin kun dga' snying po'i sku skye bya rigs su 'khyangs pa rab tu byung / sku gzhogs su bzhugs rtag par mdzad cing ljags nus dang gus zhen che/ de lo rje rdo rje 'chang chen por/ phyag 'a grub snying skor/ bsre 'pho/she lam zab/ ro sgoms/ rten 'brel/ ras chung ༅ rgyud/ mai tri snyan rgyud/ o rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ khrid 'a brgyad/ ri chos sgor gsum/ dge sbyor bdun pa/ nā ro gsang spyod/ ti phu'i bzhi chos/ ngam rdzong snyan rgyad sogs zab khrid mang po'i yig rnying / nma 'byugs pa lha so bdun ma'i dbang bsha'/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gasnan gyi sgrab dbang / myang lugs kyi drag po dmar

༄༅༅/ /chen gyi dbang / mgon po'i dkyil chog rnying pa'i dbang / rnam sras bu lugs kyi rjes gnang sogs dbang lung mang po gsan to/ /zhi ba ste sa mo bya lo'i rang zhal gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ston la/ rje bla mas/ zhabs kyi padmo rtag brtan 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rten 'byung gi sgor/ gser bzang pos sder spyad yongs su gang ba sogs 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad/ sku rim du 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog chen btsugs/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbe'u ris phyag bris su bstar te tshe bdag gi dkyil 'khor 'khral med de 'di 'dra zhig 'ong bas phyag tshags zhu gsung phul ba/ phyag dpe khang na bzhugs shing thugs gtsigs che/ de dus kong po nas chos rje rin po che mi pham bkra zhes blo gros/ gyang tho ska skye/ stag rtse rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams dpal bzang / mkhan rin po che 'phrin las rnam rgyal

sogs dbu che yang mang bar 'tshogs/ rje mnyam med chen po gong 'grong nas spyan 'dren byung ba bzhin thegs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dpon slob rnams khu khud dgoni pa dang rdo rje gling du phebs/ zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs/ de'i tshe/ dus 'khor bde kshi gsang 'dus sogs rgyud sde mang po/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor sogs rgya gzhung / de rnams kyi spyi ṭīka rje gong mas mdzad pa rnams la thugs rtog zhib 'thems gnang / gzhung lugs mtha' dag la dpyad pa zhugs pa'i thugs bskyed shin tu che ba byung / rdor 'dzin mang thos pad darkan gyis zla ba tsam bsnyen bkur/ cig car rgod pa'i 'gro mgoni du sngags 'chang khrag 'thung rgyal po bskos/ ri pa gnas brtan sogs las tshan dgos pa thams cad khong rang gi slob rigs khrod nas khur du blangs/ gnang cha mgu ba bskyed pa stsal/ mtsho mjug ska ste de'i grwa tshang gi bla

go༅༅/ /mar/ byus kyi ber dang padma rā ga'i cod pan bcings te brdzangs/ dbyar gsang gling du bzhugs/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mang po la rnam dgrod kyi gzigis pa stsal ba/ bar gseng la mchod rten dang dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi thig rtsa/ gzhal yas khang slong thig rnams phyag len bshad pa dang bcas pa mkhas dbang mji gīrtis phul/ gzhan bde dgyes dus gsang sogs bla med gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud sde rin po che'i dpokha gnad dang thig rtsa'i dogs da1da 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rdo rje la'ang mdzad/ lnga bsdus skor sogs rtsis skor lam pa rin po che 'jam dpal grags pa dang dbyis phyin pa bla ma rin po che phug nas la gsan/ de lo dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas dam pa gnas chen tsa ri trar phebs/ kong phyogs kyi grwa yon mjal mi mang por chos sbyin legs par gnang / ltas ngo mtshar

ba mang po zhabs 'bring du yod pa kun gyis kyang mngon du gyur na rgyal ba nyid kyis dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ci yang gzigs pa lta ci/ 'on kyang skyes chen dam pa rnams dgongs pa rgya mtsho ltar zab cing dgyer che bas/ rang gi yon to ji lta ba gzhan ngor mngon sum du mi mdzad par ji tsam gyis gdul bya 'dul bar nus pa de tsam zhig stoni pa yin no zhes grags so/ /phyis bsha' las/ ngos tsa ri la ma phyin bar ni/ thos bsam byed pa'ang ha cang nus po med/ 'dzin pa dang go babs shes rab 'bring po tsam/ de nas nus su yang song / shes rab kyang go ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis ka la drag tu song bas tsa ri tra bskor bas mngal grib dag pa'i rtags su 'dug kyang / de nas gzhan phan du snyad pa'i rnam g.yeng mang po'i 'go tshugs pas gang la'ang rang re kho thag chod pa zhig ma byung ba 'di kha'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni dgongs pa can dang / lhag

go༅༅/ /par dam pa 'di ni yun ring mo nas 'jig rten chos brgyad rtsa lag dang bcas pa spangs/ zhi dul des pa'i sgo nas dman cha 'dzin pa la goms pa'i dbang gis che ba'i yon tan gang la'ang ngom ngom yer yer gtan mi mdzad par khengs skyung 'ba' zhig gnang ba 'di yang dam pa'i spyod tshul rmad du byung ba zhig ste/ legs bshad las/ blun po'i yon ༅ khar 'byin te/ /mkhas pa'i yon smo khong du sbed/ /sog ma chu yi steng na 'gro/ /nor bu steng du bzhag kyang 'bying / /yoni tan chung rnams nga rgyal che/ /mkhas par gyur na dul bar gnas/ /chu phran rtag tu ku co che/ /rgya mtsho ca co ga la sgrogs/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /gzhan de res phebs pa nas bzung ste gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad kyi dka' gnad la the tshom gyi mdud pa grol/ grub mtha' smra ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa

dgongs gzhi dang bcas pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log pa thugs la nges pas/ mkhasapa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa mchog tu dge ba can 'gran zlas dben pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug chen po'i go 'phang brnyes par gyur to/ /ston lho rgyud ral gsum gyi nas phud bzhes/ dgun gsang sngags chos gling du bzhugs/ thugs dam rgyun 'byer khrigs su bca' ba mang po dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung 'grel che phran mang po la thugs sbyong mdzad pa'i thun mtshams su/ gnyug mar gnas pa dang slo bur du lhags pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa rnams dang rigs lung 'bel gtas/ zhar byung du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gyi phyag tshad sogs sbyong bdar gnang ba dang rjes 'brel/ rpā gnyer 'ga'i dad rten du phyag gi 'du byed kyang thor bu bskyan/ phyis sor sngal ska sas sgang pa zhes ri mo ba mkhas pa'i tshad du phyin pa de la thig rtsa sogs

ra༅༅/ /mthar phyin pa gsan pa'i tshul kyang bstan/ rgya mtsho grwa tshang bar/ tshe dpag med zhi khro/ bde mchog /rnam 'joms sogs kyi dbang / cho ga'i skor sogs nyer mkho'i lung dang bcas pa stsal/ bka' bcu pa mchog legs sogs pad dkar grwa tshang ba 'ga' dpal 'khor chos sder grwa skor la rdzong pa gnang / thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi lo/ mya ngan med pa'i ljon shing gi phreng bas mdzes par byas pa rang byon rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i gling du byon/ chos rje rnam rgyal bkra shis tsa ri cig car gyi rdo rje 'dzin par/ gnang cha bzang po dang bcas te shis pa brjod/ mi ring bar dpal ri rdo rje gdan du phebs/ snga gong bya pa zhal ngo thugs 'dod mamanyam pa'i rgyas dus zing ci rigs byung bar/ de res zhal ngo dpon g.yog rnams lhad med du 'gyur ba'i bapokha khyab mdzad pas bde 'jam du song / de

nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrub bzhed/ de yang mngal shol gyi zla ba dang lo snga phyi'i ngo thams cad kyang grangs su bgrangs nas/ thugapa'i bcas mtshams las mi 'gong ba'i gseb lam khyad par can du dgongs shing / rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab kyis kyang dgung lo bcu bdun la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gtapa rgyud bsgon med 'dug pa dang / rje gong ma kun mkhyen chen po padma dkar pos kyang mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi spyan sngar dgung lo bcu bdun la bsnyen par rdzogs pa ltar/ rje yongs 'dzin dam pa dang / mnyam med sems dpa' chen po spyan 'dren du mngags pa ltar 'gyangs med phebs/ gnyal yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po'i dbus dpal gyi ri bo'i ngogs rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i sgo mangs su yab sras mjal/ de mtshams rgyal dbang dam pa 'di nyid 'dren pa zas gtsang sras kyi

go༅༅/ /rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba'i rten 'brel gyi dge legs spel ba'i slad du/mkhan po brtan mkhas kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa sems shin tu rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom pa chen po/don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po ngag dbang bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang /las kyi slob da' rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i ngur sprig 'dzin pa yongs kyi khyu mchog sems dpa' chen po rin 'a dpal bzang po/gsang ste ston pa'i slob da' gzhung brgya smra ba mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal grags pa/dus kyi brda' sprod pa'i grib tshod pa chos rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/grogs dan pa mkhar chu slob dpon sdom brtson sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/gzhan yang dad pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbus su/gsol ba dang gzhi'i las kyi cho ga nyams pa med pa'i sgo nas/bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos

po gsos btab pa'i mod la sa chen po 'di yang kun tu g.yos/ sngon myong ba'i yul du ma gyur pa'i dri bzang po dang / me tog dkar po'i char yang dal bus babs/ de'i tshe rje bla mas/ snam sbyar mngags thags khyad thon gyis gcos pa'i 'bul ba rgya chen po dang / gzhan yang dbu che grwa yon serdzo sos dpag tu med pa phul/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su dag pas/ 'jig rten na yod do cog gi spos kyi dris gnon par mi nus pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos dpag tshad khyab cing / gar bzhugs kyi dgrad pa rnams la yang tshul khrims kyi dri bzang po rgyan ring por 'byung ba zhig go/ /skabs der rje sems dpa' chen por/ tshe bka' sogs kyi dbang / phal chen dang dkon

༄༅༅/ /brtsegs kyi ljags lung yang gsan/ de nas bzung 'brug skor gyi zab khrid sogs chos tshul ji snyed pa zhig sbyopas/ rdo rje 'chang bla ma rin po che rnam gnyis zhes bkur snyi'i gnas su gsal bar grags so// //rnam par rgyal byed khang bzang ‘brgya byin/ /mthu stobs rdo rje'i mtshon cha 'phyar bas phas rgol lha min tshar gcod cing / /phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal la dbang bsades/ /yon gnas mchog la sri zhu bgyis pas bsod nams mi dman don kun grub/ /ji bzhin khyod ni spyan ras gzigs nyid phyir/ rtu//smos ci 'tshal/ /ji snyed chos kyi'ang mngon par byang chub tshul/ /ji srid bskal par brjod kyang zad pa min/ /sde snod gsum dang rgya

dgrod bum par bzung nas gdul bya yi/ /kun rmongs dri ma 'khrud pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /'gro ba'i mgon 'di sngon med drang srong yin/ /rang bzhin dang bcas kha na ma tho'i dres/ /nam yang ma gos tshul khrims ngur sprig gis/ /khyod sku dpag bsam ljoni shing la 'khril ba/ /thun mtshams gos dmar 'dzin pa'i gser ri bzhin/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dgazha ba'i zlos gar las/ shes bya rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son nas bsnyen par rdzogs te dge slong gi dngos por byon pa'i rab tu byed pa ste lnga pa'o// //de yang ji skad du/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dge dang mi dge'i las

༄rsha0/ /gang gang / /skye ba'i zhing la skye bos bakha/ /de dang de yi rang bzhin de/ /yongs su smin pa'i 'bras bu spyod/ /zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun par gtsang stod lhun po rtser mi dbang don grub rdo rje gang gi thugs rgyud kyi steng na rnam par smin pa mi bzad pa myong 'gyur gyi las sngar bsags bag la nyal gyi tshul du yod pa/ khro phu'i byams chen gyi zhabs tog gtsug lag khang gi zhig gsos/ yoni gnas dam pa rnams la bkur sti/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi dge ba rlabs chen mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis las ngan srabs shing lhongs pa'i mthu dang / 'bangs gyen 'o(ga gi g.yo sgru'i 'phrul la brten bzhugs stabs ma bde ba nas sa skyar phebs dgos pa byung bar/ phyag mdzod rdzong kha pa/ ding phon yug /gser zho brgya phrag /chibs serdzogs skya gnang cha bcas/ sngoni las bdag gir du

bzung dgos pa'i chab shog yid kyi ngal gsor gyur pa stsal/ de nas pho brang yang rtser phebs/ bya pa'i rgyal bu sku mched khri 'don gyi sgo nod/ gdan sa ra lung nas 'gro ba'i mgon po bstan pa'i nyi ma khu dbon yang spyan 'dren 'gab tshul gyi slob ston gnang ba bzhin zhabs drung khu dbon spyan drangs/ sgar gyi dbu che drung 'khor las tshan sogs dang bya pa rta pa'i tshogs brgya phrag la nye bas mdun bsus/ mchod khang rnying par mjal 'dzom gnang / gza' tshes dus sbyor dge ba'i nyin/ bya nag chen po'i rigs las byung ba'i chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi dbang phyug khri'i drung dang gangs dkar rnam rgyal sku mched/ rgyal phran du ma'i gtsug gi nor bus btud pa'i seng ge'i khri la/rin po che dang 'bab ldan gyi rgyan bzang pos gang ba'i dgos 'dod 'gyung ba'i bum pa thogs te bden tshig gi shis pa brjod bzhin du rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang

si༅༅/ /bskur/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun byin/ dga' ston gyi rjes 'brel du/ gser gar lugs kyi tshe dpag med/ dngul gyi sgrol ma/ hor sil/ chibs chibs rol/ ding phro sogs khyad gos yug /yol ba bla re/ gan dashar/ dngul tir/ shal pa dadzin dmar/ ber sogs kyis gtsos pa'i sang cha rgya spam yo stsal/ sne'u sdong rtse sogs sde dgo che phran dang mnga' 'og gi skya ser so sos kyang mchod yon so sor legs 'bul 'gror/ de dus gtsang nas nang so rdor legs pa 'grod tshangs dang bcas te chos bros la byon pa/ slog mi gtos che ba byung dus/ mi dge ba'i las byas shing bsags pa la gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags bsdams dang / khro phu'i byams pa chen po'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba dgos pa sogs sdig spong dge sgrab kyi bslab ston dang bcas te phyir slog /mtsho sna ba rnams

kyis spyan drangs/ de'i tshe kha ba shin tu che ba babs pa'i rjes su me tog gi char ngo mtshar ba'ang byung / khong rnams rje gong ma phebs dus kyang 'di 'dra babs pa yin zer dgazha dga' byed/ 'brug chos sdings su bzhugs/ dad ldan gyi 'du tshogs shin tu che/ gser sogs zang zing gi 'bul ba bsam las brgal/ zhabs tog kyang sdig dang ma 'dres pas shin tu dang ba 'dren/ thams cad kyang mos gus la tshad bzung med pas dam tshig gtsang / dbang chos kyang yid dang mthun par stsal/ dkar chen kun grags pa'i sku skye'i gtsug phud bzhes/ mdo mkhar bas mkhar gdong du spyan drangs/ gas 'dud dang bkur sdi che bar mdzad/ slar yang byams chen chos gling du phebs thog /gong 'grong / 'brong rtse/ rtse chen pa sogs dbus gtsang gi sde dpon rnams kyis spyan drangs/ gri gur phyogs zhag tsam bzhugs ring rje bla mar rgya ras

ra༅༅/ /bamanya 'bum sogs gsan/ 'gror ldan rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya chen pos mchod/ dbang chos kyang yid bzhin du stsal to/ /'gal byed de lcags mo phag lo/ za hor gyi rgyal rigs rim par bsti ba'i pho brang 'phyeng dbar stag rtser phebs/ lcang gling sgang du bzhugs sgar mdzad thog sku mtshams bcad rgya zhig gnang / 'jam dkar gyi ljags bsnyen kha gso tsam gnang bas lañdza'i yi ge'i a yig thog tshad tsam 'od 'phro ba yun ring por gzigs/ sku mtshams grol bstun zhal ngor dbang rjes gnang 'ga' shas dang chos sde rnams la mang skol kyang gnang / rim pas grwa sdings po che dang / thon mi'i gdung rabs dri ma med pa sa skyong ba'i dbang po yar rgyab pa dpon blon gyis bsu ba'i bkod pa dpe bral du bshams/ gus pa chen po'i sgo nas bkur sti phul du phyin/ sde par gyub rgyal lugs kyitshe bka'

brgya rtsa/ tshe dpag med gong khug ma gnyis kyi dbang / tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ khyad par tshe dpag med zhi ba lha mangs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang rgyas pa gnang / de skabs glo bur du rdul tshon rlung gis khyer ba'i ltas ma legs pa byung ba/ rgyud sde rin po che las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin phyis rgyal chen gling pa'i mtshan byus 'gro khyab cher mi yong ba'i mtshan mar 'dug gsungs/ lum par sde pa dgos dgos pa'i lam stoni la spyan drangs/ sde par dmigs pa'i 'bul ba rgya cher bgyis pa bzhin dus 'das rnam byang du bsgral/ spus ri sgra gcan gyi gtsug tor nor bu'i tshul du mdangs gsal ba'i he ru ka rang byung gi lha khang du phebs/ de nub 'khor lo sdom pa'i ska drung du bzhugs/ ṭwāṃ ki ma bal mo'i cha lugs can gyi gzhon nu ma mang pos mchod cing phyag dang bskor ba byas pa'i mthar de rnams

ra༅༅/ /mgrin gcig par rdo rje'i glu mang po dang / bod 'bangs kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs pa'i lung bstan mang zhig zhu ba phyis de kho na thog tu babs gsungs/ sang nyin gong ma chos kyi rgyal po mi'i dbang po dpon blon gyi chibs bsu dang ser sbrengs rgyas pas mdun bsus te pho brang gong dashar du phebs/ de dus rnam rgyal lhun po'i gtsug lag khang gi phyi rgya grub/ rtogs ldan rnams kyis rgyal dbang rje dang kun mkhyen padma dkar po'i sku brnyan dang / chos rje dbon po bas/ rje chos kyi mgon po/ rje yongs 'dzin dam pa/ rgyal ba dam pa rnams kyi sku brnyan bzhengs 'dug par rab gnas rgyas pa gnang / chos rje dbon po bar/ khyod kyis bstan pa la bsam pa che ba dang / bla ma rin po che'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba byung 'dug pa'i legs so yin no gsungs/ gser srang gang sogs gnang cha dang / spyi sor yang

bla bre bum stan ma/ bkras btags kyi skusnal ba/ gnas bcu'i bris thang gras mtshungs nyi shu lhag pa/ tshogs khro serdzogs spyi rdzas su 'grerdzo ba'i dngos po rgya che ba dang / mi'i dbang por yang gnang skyes sogs 'dod dgu ji bzhin du stsal/ rje bla mar/ mchod yon lhan rgyas su mar mi ras chung lo rgod kyi bda' 'bum/ sku sgor gyis mgon po'i mdos thags kyi phyag len yang gsan/ de'i tshe rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las/ da ni dbang lung man ngag mtha' dag gzhan la 'doms pa sogs gdul bya'i dbang po dang rjes su mthun par bkri ba'i mchog gi rdo rje'i slob dpon bdag po chen por mnga' gsol zhing thugs khur bla lhag tu babs pa yin pas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ dbang lung man ngag sbyin pa sogs thams cad rgyal dbang dam pa nyid kyis gnang bar 'tshal zhes zhu nan gyis bskal/ sde srid khu dbon dang / bla ma rin po che

si༅༅/ /rang gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dbu che grwa ris kyi 'dus pa chen por/ chos 'byung bstan pa'i padma rgyas pa'i i byed sogs spyi chos dang / gzhan yang dbang lung man ngag gis phye ba'i chos sbyin dang de 'phros khrom dbang zhig kyang stsal/ de nas rim par chibs kha bskyar/ rtse chen gyi sgrol ma lha khang du/ rje yongs 'dzin dam par/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi so so thar pa'i mdo dang bcas pa gsan dus mtshan gang 'dul lung tshar gcig gcags pa gnang bas/ 'dul ba'i darkang gnad la dgyes phyin pa'i thugs skyed shin tu che ba byung / gzhan yang / rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing / skyes rabs so bzhi pa/ sems 'grel skor gsum/ kha sbyor gyi 'grel pa man ngag sge ma/ nyi ma dpal ye shes kyi mtshan brjod 'grel pa/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ rngog pa'i rin chen rgyan 'dra/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter chos

drag po dmar chen gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs blo spyod dpal ye ma sogs chos kyi rnam grangs shin tu mang ba gsan pa'i zhabs 'bring du/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje dang / rin po che chos grags rgya mtsho sogs kyang yod/ sger chos su 'jigs byed thub pa nag po dang / sngags sdebs snying gzer nag po'i phyag khrid gsan/ phyag chen nyams khrid cig gsan bzhed par/ rje'i bama' las/ nā ro paṇa chen gyi dus nas thugs dam rang bzhin yongs su mkhyen pa 'di ka yin pas/ ka dpe ma'i khrid rim ce la dgos/ thugs rig bkra po rang 'di 'dra'i rigs la gnas pa 'thug po'i sgom 'di chags pa dmanya se yod pas/ 'di bzhin gnang ba zhu gsungs ngo sprod kyi brda' thabs 'gazha yar 'bul ba gnang bas/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sgrib bral du gzigs pas gang shar chos ska'i rang rtsal du rig /sgom pa sems 'dzin la

go༅༅/ /ma ltos pa'i gnad ka thugs su chud par gyur to/ /de yang bsha' las/ lar rje rdo rje 'chang de nyid nged rang la dag snang gi thugs gcigs che ba dang / gzhan mar thugs 'dzangs se1gas nas lung stabs kho na las gzhan pa'i khrid tshul sbar lakha gnang ba zhig ma byung bas/ de dus rang de tsam gyi phugs 'grus pa zhig ma byung mod/ ting sor gsung re re dran pas kyang dogs pa chod pa dang nges shes skye ba'i gnad mang pos sems la shin tu phan par byung gsungs/ de skabs bla ma ren po che rin chen dpal bzang la/ dkar nag rtsis kyi dogs dpyod/ zhal lung gi rgyu mtshan rtsis/ dgrangs 'char/ gyim shang sogs kyi mtha' dgrod dang bcas pa rtsis skor mthar phyin gsan/ pho brang der zla ba drug tsam stan chags/ de nas sa skyong tshe dbang don grub yab sras kyis 'grong rtse dang rgyal byed du spyan drangs/ ska

mtshams rgyang tsam gnang ba grol nas thub pa'i skyes rabasatshogs chos su gsungs/ tsa ri'i gnas 'dzin mgron phyag ri pa sogs brdzangs/ mi dbang don grub rdo rje yab sras slar yang sa skya nas lho rgyud la phebs dgos shar/ yongs 'dzin te chu pho byi lo/ gtsang nas chibs kha bsgyur ste/ sde srid 'bring mtshams brgyad yar 'brog tu 'gror bstan ba chos su mchod yon mjal zir bun stabs sde pa'i zhabs phyir cog grwa rnying pa dang sgar pa rags bsdus mu tig pa sogs rdzong ba gnang sdza / /dpon slob rnams 'grong rgyas nas sgrub sde'i sa phul ba a jo rdzong du phebs/ ming 'brag rgyas bsam gto rdzong zhes 'dogs pa gnang / sgrub sde'i sa byin gyis brlabs/ gnas bdag tu/ dge bsnyen smyon kha bskos/ bka' bsgo dam bsgrags mdzad rā/ de sha'i mod la mdun gyi mtsho de rmug nag 'jigs su rung ba khrag gi rba klong g.yo ba'i zhud

ra༅༅/ zhan tu che ba zhig tu gyur pa kun gyis mthong / rten mkhar gyi dar cog la'ang 'ja' nyi ma 'ga'i bar du zug pa byung / 'brog bod kyi dad 'dus bgrang bar daskakha ba la chos kyi sbyin pa bkye ste lha gzigs kyi pho brang chen por phebs/ rje bla mar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rab 'byams padma chos skyong nas/ bla ma ren po che dpal gyi seng ge las brgyud pa de dang / dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi/ 'jigs byed rwa pod kyi yig cha yongs rdzogs/ mgon po'i thod nag gi phyag len/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyi gter byung gi gza'i sgrub skor/ gnubs kyi gza' bcos nyi ma mdung gang ma sogs zab khyad can mang po gsan/ de nas bya rigs chos kyi dzol pos spyan 'dren byung ba ltar byams chen du phebs/ mi dbang don grub rdo rje yab sras rab tu byung ba sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bka'

drin rgya cher stsal skabs/ sde srid nas 'bul ba stobs che ba dang / sgar grwa tshang sogs la'ang mang 'gyed rgya dpangs can mdzad do/ /bag med de chu mo glang lo'i sos dbyar mtsho skyes dang gsal rje gangs kyi ra bar phebs/ ska mtshams se ba'i ngang nas lhag pa'i lha mang po'i gsung bsten/ rlung rtsol dang shin tu spros med kyi ting nge 'dzin brgya rtsa dang / chos skyong gi rgyun gtor sogs thugs dam khrogs su bca' ba'i rim pa mang po la rtag 'grus su mdzad/ rin po che shes rab chos 'phags gshegs pa'i bsngo rten dang lho brag la spyan 'dren pas slebs/ de'i tshe snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i rnam 'gyur mi srun pas bod khams rnams legs byas ma yin pa la spyod pa'i dus 'byug tshabs che bar langs/ kun dga' ste shing pho stag lo gsar/ byar stag rtser dpon sa bstan 'dzin rgyal mo ma 'tsho ba'i 'dad kyi gral dbur phebs/ ska rgyan

༄༅༅/ /g.yu mu stag sogs kyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba stobs che/ yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa'i bsngo ba'i mtshams sbyor bzang po mdzad de gnyal sor byar gsum gyi me tog bzhes/ de dus stag rtser bla ma rin po che dpal gyi seng ge'i spyan sngar/ gsor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma nā ro lugs/ phag mo bden gnyis zhal/ dpal mgoni phyag bzhi pa/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma rnams kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs/ gu ru drag po gī la ya'i byin rlabs/ drang srong gza'i rjes gnang sogs dbang chos mang po gsan/ slar chos rje rgya ras kyi sgrub gnas byar skyid phug zab yangs theg chen rtser phebs thog /bla ma rin po che yang gdan drangs te bsha' mchid la / snga sor rje yongs 'dzin dam par/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag bzhes dang mthun pa'i nyams khrid rgyas pa zhig zhu 'dod rung / khyed rang nā ro pa'i dus nas chos thams cad

kyi bdag po yin pas/ ka dpe ma gzhan la stoni stotna ci la dgos/ 'on kyang kha na ma tho ba spangs phyir/ gdams pa mtha' dag lung stabs su 'bul thub pa gcig pus chog gsung 'gro rtsis dang / tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs mang po lta rtog byed dgos sogs kyis rnam g.yeng gi dbang du gyur pa zhig byung / da lam dkar brgyud rin po che'i phyag bzhes la nges shes bskyed pa dang / gdul bya mchog dman mtha' dag la legs par 'doms pa serdzogs kyi ched du/ nyams khrid du bstar ba zhig byed dgos 'dug gsung ba phebs pa ltar/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi nyams khrid rgyas pa/ ro sgoms nges pa can sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes bsha' rgya dang mthun pa'i khrigs su bca' ba can/ chos drug /lam zab/ bla'o rgyan bsnyen sgrab/ mai tri snyan rgyad/ rten 'brel rabs bdun ma serdzogs khrid tshul mtha' yas pa gsan

khrid sogs khrid mang po'i dasha' gnad kyi dogs dgrod kyang zhar byung du 'them par mdzad pas nges don gyi skor la rmongs pa'i rab rgya nag nas gtam 'bul ba go shrī rgya mtsho 'od zer/ sog yul nas bla ma sbyin pa pad dkar/ stod gro shong nas bya btang nam nas kyi cod pan rin po che'i phra rgyan du mas spras pa gyis dbu sgom gyi rgyan du gnang ba/ snam sbyar mngags thags/ gos 5 kyi brgya 'bul du ma 'dug pa/ zab yangs theg chen rtse'i rgyal dbang dmi pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i bzhugs khri'i khar phebs nas ba sde'i brje len ri pa rnams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khrungs rabs/ lam zab kyi dbang bzhi/ gtum mo'i me

dbang / gtum mo zhag gsum ma/ bla sgrub/ rten 'brel/ gsang spyod khrid rnams 'dod chos su bstsal/ de'i tshe mkhas dbang 'jam dpal grags pa'ang dgung lo don gnyis su phebs pas/ da ni na tshod kyang 'di ltar rgas pa dang / mig kyang mi gsal ba sogs nas zos bde'i dge sbyor bgyid chog pa zhu ba bzhin/ na bza' sogs mkho ba'i yo byad gya nom pa/ rim gro pa dang bcas byams chen gzims spyil du bzhugs/ de yang / dam pa rnams ni byas shes drin du gzo ba'i phyir ding sang gi bar du/ na phra dus rin po che des sgo gsum gyi spyod lam lang du ma bcug pas drin shin tu che ba yin gsungs/ de nas rje btsun sems dpa' chen po dang / bya khri'i drung mchod yoni stag rtser phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dpon slob dbyar gsal rje'i gangs 'dabs su ska mtshams kyi nges pa mdzad/ lhag pa'i lha'i bzlas brjod sogs chag

ra༅༅/ /med sngar 'khyud ltar nas/ khyad par srog rtsol dang / phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bog gi mnyam gzhag la chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'gror du bzhugs/ rin yo che shes rab chos 'phags kyi dgongs rdzogs 'bul mi dang / kong po nas rta drug ja gos dar sogs 'bul ba dang bcas chos rje rgyal dbang pa 'gror/ yang rtser da' sa'i rten 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho gzhi sgo nas ye shes sems dpa' bstims/ dga' ston shis brjod rgyas par spel/ lho rgyud ral gsum gyi dad ldan rnams kyi bsod nams bya ba'i dngos yo bsgrun pa'i slad du phebs/ so so'i 'gyor pa dang bstun pa'i 'bul nod kyi dge ba rdzogs byang gi rgyur bsngos te byams chen du phebs/ srin po ste shing mo yos lo/ phyag mdzod legs par gyub pa la phyag nas 'thor/ khams rgyal stoni nas rin po che lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pos nga

mig brgya phrag brgyad/ gos dar yug mang po sogs dang / ri bo che pa bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'phel gyi 'bul ba tshan che ba dang bcas bla ma rang zhabs drung du 'gror/ be ri rgyal pos sgrub sde zhig 'dzugs dgos zer byung ba ji ltar 'gad kyi bslab ston zhu bar lung bstan mdzad/ mi ring bar sgrub pa'i sde stobs che ba tshugs shing dar rgyas kyang dpe med pa byung ngo / /rgya mtsho grwa tshang du/ stag rtse skyu skyes thugs khur bzhes/ dus 'khor sgrub mchod tshugs pa'i legs sor/ snam sbyar/ rgya sbug sogs gnang cha dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rdul tshon kya dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ gzhan yang tsha dpag med gsang sgrub/ rnam 'joms sogs kyi dbang stsal/ dud sol lha mo'i rigs bzhi dang po'i bsnyen chog gsung rtsom gnang / de skabs rje lha rtse ba chen po de nyid mjal bar shin tu thugs la 'dod kyang / dus kyi rnam

ra༅༅/ /'gyur sna tshogs pas bzhed pa bzhin ma 'grub/ brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba 'debs pa por bla ma khams pa mngags/ 'phyong rgyas nas zhabs drung bgres pa sku ma 'tsho bar gnang cha dang bcas gzims chung chos mdzad brdzangs/ rdo rje gdan gyi bla mar rig sngags 'chang sge stag pa bskos/ de nas ji skad pu longs spyod skad cig kho nas brel ba'i nang / /'gror pa rmi lam bag ma len dang mtshungs/ /bde ba'i dpal ni rlung bsnun mar me'i rtse/ /srid pa'i spyod tshul 'di dag smyon pa'i gan/ /zhes pa ltar/ srid pa'i 'du 'god glog gi rnam 'gyur dang / gar mkhan gyi lag pa'i 'phral lta bus thugs nges par 'byung ba je 'phel du gyur cing / lhag par jo po dī paṃ ka ras/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes parmi/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /

rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar bya/ /zhes bshad pa dang mthun par rje btsun gyis kyang / tshogi thub bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod dbul/ /bdud ris bar chad mang ba'i phyir/ /rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi 'tshal bar/ /bu sgrub pa snying por longs shig gsung // zhes sogs kyi nges pa la snyigs dus kyi chos byed rnams drang ba'i phyir/ lo gsum phyogs kyi rjes 'brang dang bcas pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'gror mthar phyin pa'i mchog gi dngos grub chen po'i go 'phang la reg pa'i dus kyi rnam gzhag sgrub par dgongs/ bshad sgrub kyi sde so so'i mgoni du gyur pa rnams la bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i bslab bya stsal/ rgyal byed bshad grwa pa rnams kyang gnang cha bzang po dang bcas te yar slog /mtshan mo'i mgon po sbyon dang 'grogs pa'i yar ngo / /gza' tshes dus spyor mchog tu dge ba la/ sngon chos

ra༅༅/ /rje rgya ras kyis lo ras la lung bstan pa'i gnas thub bstan lang tsho bdo ba'i thang / ma pham rgyal ba'i sku brnyan gser gyi 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i zel dngar srid pa'i nyer brgya skyob pa'i grib bsil du gnas shing / ngur smig 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde ngur pa'i khyu lta bus lung rigs smra ba'i glu dbyangs gsang mthor sgrogs pas/ yid kyi rnyog pa sel bar byed pa byams chen chos gling zhes grags pa'i mā li ka phyogs kyi rna ba'i dgyed du len pa de'i dbang ldan gyi mtshams po ṭa la'i gzhal med khang gnyis pa/ sum rtsen gyi dgazha tshal la 'gran pa'i 'khri shing du ma tshar du dngar bas/ 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis kyang bsgrun par mi nus pa'i ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal 'bras ster ba'i skyed mos tshal me tog sna tshogs pas gang ba/ darkani mchog rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs 'phags yul sogs yul gyu spyi dang bye brag las byung ba

'dren pa sras dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba du ma dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul gyi pustaka dharma gzhi ltar dkris pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod sdong du ma'i spyan sngar/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las byung ba'i mchod sprin rab 'byams kyis mdzes pa/ nges pa dang ldan pa'i phun sum tshogs pa lngas khyad par du byas pa'i 'og min gyi zhing 'dzin ma'i gzhir bkod pa lta bu'i bsti gnas ltad mo can zhes pa gang der/ nges pa'i sgo glegs mi shigs rdo rje'i phyag rgyas btab ste gdong lngas bteg pa'i nor bu'i khri la g.yo med skyil mo krung bcas nas bzhugs pa'i spros bcas spros med kyi thugs dam gyi rim pa mtha' dag brjod par ga la nus/ ljags bsnyen gyi rim pa'ang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dpon po dang / sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ tsakra sasba ra/ rdo rje

ra༅༅/ /gtum po sogs bsnyen skabs de dag las ji skad bshad pa ltar gyi rtags mngon du mdzad cing / de rjes bla ma drag po gī la yar sa ya gcig bsnyen pa'i tshe/ gnam lcags kyi sdig pa rwa bco brgyad pa lug thod tsam dngos nyams du mar snang ba phyag gis bzung ba las me stag 'phro ba dang / padma drag po'i sku dngos su bzhengs te khor yug chen po'i bar skus khyab pa sogs dang / gzhan yang 'phrin las chen po bzhis bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i ltas dpag par dpokha ba ci yang zhig byung ba rnams shin tu gsang ba'i ba/'a rgya dam pas bri bar ma nus so// //sna tshogs las kyis bris pa rnam bkra'i ri mor rjes su chags pa'i blo/ /'ja' ris bzhin du snying pos dben pa'i 'dus byas rang mtshang bstan pa'i rjes/ /mkha' lding rigs kyi thig le seng ge'i khri la dbang bskar shis brjod tshe/ /rin thang

cher bcang nor gyi phung pos phun tshogs dga' ston ci yang bsgrubs/ /phul byung mkhyen pa rab kyi chu gter du/ /dbang lung gdams pa'i chu klung bye ba brgya/ /rtag tu 'bab pa'i ngang tshul dpag dada' ba/ /skal bzang klu dbang kun gyi dpal yon yin/ /thos bsam yid bzhin nor bu cha brgyad pa/ /sgom sgrub rgyal mtshan rtsemor mchod las slar/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa'i/ /mthu ldan skyes bu mchog 'di ngal gsos bu/ /dus kyi rnam 'gyur mi bzad rlung shugs kyis/ /nges 'byung lhag bsam chu gter bskul ba'i rlabs/ /gyen du 'phyur des dkar brgyud khang bzang rtser/ /sgrub brgyud rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i byed por gyur/ /zhes dpal 'byug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos

ra༅༅/ /gar las/ nges 'byung gi glang po dben pa'i nags la phyogs pa'i rab tu byed pa ste drug pa'o// //de nas bla ma sgrub pa gnang / phyi sgrub nang sgrub gnyis song mtshams/ lhun rtse nas mi'i dbang po de nyid sngon las myong 'gyur la brten sku gzhogs nas phebs dgos pa'i sgo shar/ bcad rgya shin tu dam par bzhugs pa'ang gsung ngag grol te bug sgor bslab don stsal/ sde pa gtsang pa'i mi sna 'tsho byed blo rnam par/ sde pa lhun rtse dang gtsang sde srid rang khu tshan yin pa dang / nged la'ang skyabs su song ba yin pas da lam 'di skor la nged rang gi phyi nang gi dngos po yod dgu phyag tu bzhes kyang 'bul zhing / mdor na sde pa'i tshab tu nged rang 'gro dgos byung yang sde pa 'di phebs mi dgos pa'i dgongs grol dgos tshul bka' nan ci yang zhig gnang / slar rgyu mtshan skor sbyang mang ba zhig song

zhing / chos rgyal shel tham sogs dngos spyad rgya cher gnang ste gtsang sar grol cha dgos pa'i sgo ji snyed cig brtsams kyang bka' dang len ma zhus/ mi'i dbang po de ga'i gsung las/ bdag gi las dang bya ba thams cad chos rje 'brag pa'i zhabs tog 'grub pa zhig bgyid snyam rung / sngoni gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas 'di ltar gyur pa nas/ da ni sku gzhogs su bsdad kyang gnang gtad kyi rgyur 'gro rdo las mi 'dug pas/ skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi btang pa mkhyen gsungs spyan zung dri ma med pa'i chu shel tshad med pa'i gdung shugs drag po'i bsil zer gyis brlan pa'i mthus/ chu rgyun mi zad pa sa 'dzin 'dam rdzab tu nyer ba tsam phab/ yun ring por zhabs kyi padmo la gtsug gis btud/ smon lam rgya cher 'debs cing byin rlabs zhus te thegs par chas/ de'i tshe dpon slob thams cad spyir 'dus

༄༅༅/ /byas kyi mtshan nyid snying pos dben pa dang / sgos mi'i dbang po 'di'i sgo gsum gyi 'bad pa rgyal ba'i bstan phyogs su spungs par mi srid pa'i bdud dpung rgya mtsho'i g.yo sgru ngan pa'i rba rlabs chen pos mthar byed kyi lam la bskrad pa'i ngang tshul la thugs 'phreng ba'i sgo nas/ rkyen snang sngon las su rig pa'i lam 3khyer dang / mos gas gsal 'debs kyi ngang nas phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len la gnad du bsnun lugs sogs bslab stoni zhib thems dang nyer mkho'i cha rkyen dam rdzas byin rlabs dad rten dang bcas pa gnang / de skabs mkhar chu nas rin po che shes rab chos 'phags kyi sku skye phebs 'dug ces thugs dam brtag pa zhu mi byung bar/ mtshan lam du rgyal rnga chen po zhig brdungs pa serdzogs dpyad dka' ba tsam byung gsungs/ 'on kyang bdag rkyen gnang / gtsug phud bzhes nas rab tu

byung / dbang lung man ngag bstsal te grwa ris kyi 'dod bzhin grwa tshang gi bla mar ba〈snas rung / nas su smin ma bcug par srus la brngas pa'i nyams bag tsam byung zhes gleng / me rag mdo pa'i lho sgrub sde nas chos rje shes rab sku skye 'bul ba rgyas pa dang bcas 'gror/ slar chos rje sku skye rang gi bzhed pa bzhin rin po che sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la bsko 'ja' gnang ste dpon slob lhan rgyas su brdzangs/ de dus zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa drug pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug 'jang yul nas phebs par/ ber/ gan dkam chibs sogs dang bcas legs so 'bul bar drung yig chen mo mngags/ de nas nges pa can gyi bla sgrub bcad rgya'i 'phror bzhugs/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'gror dang la ma zab mo bla ma'i mos gas kho na la rtse gcig tu g.yel ba med par bzhugs pa'i skabs shig /mtshan lam du/ rje rdo rje 'chang lha rtse ba chen po de

ra༅༅/ snyad/ mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas rpā tsa ri'i dag pa shel gyi ri bo'i rtser chos grags rgya mtshos phyag rmen zhus/ 'ja' 'od sna lnga 'khrigs pa'i dbus na chos gos rnam gsum sku la gsol te bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyal ba nyid kyang bzhugs 'dug pa las/ ngos kyang phyin e chog zhu ba gnang tshe nyid kyang thugs sun pa las med pas byon chog ces gsungs mtshams mnal sad/ des rkyen byas tshad bzung med pa'i mos gus kyi gdung bas/ sku mtshams bcad rgya grol nas da lta rang mjal du phebs sam dgongs pa tsam du rang dbang med pa'i dad shugs kyis thugs brnangs par gyur kyang / gsung bcad shin tu dam pas phyir phebs sgo gnang ma bde/ de dus brtan bzhugs shig 'bul ba gnang thub tshe/ ska che'i rten 'brel 'grig rgyar 'dug pa la bar chad kyis bsgribs pa zhig byung zhes phyis

yang yang gsungs/ de nas rgya rtsis pa'i 'brug lo shar/ gro bzhin nyis brtsegs kyi mgo zla shol ma dor ba'i rgyal nya'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa phyi ma la/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing / grub rigs yongs kyi cod pan dam pa de nyid gzugs sku'i bkod pa mngon byang rdo rje'i mkha' dbyengs su brtul ba'i gtab bzod par dasha' ba dang lhan cig /rje nyid kyi phyag ting rgyun ma mtshungs med rgyal dbang rje'i phyag ting yin nges pa'i byin rlabs ༅ sogs phyag mdzod dbon po bas do dam bgyis te 'gror/ 'gro ba'i bla ma gangs can gyi mun sel bstan pa'i sgroni me de dbyengs su nub pas/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di mun pa'i khung bur re zhig yib bo snyam shin tu thugs ngal zhing mos gus gsol ba 'debs pa kho na la brtson par mdzad/ phyag gi bdog pa mtha' klas pa kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung 'ba' zhig tu sngal/ gdung 'bul mang 'gyed

ra༅༅/ /sogs tshan grangasal ma ltos pa'i mchod pa'i cha rkyen rnam rgyal lhun por spungs/ gzhan yang / dbus gtsakong gi grwa sa thams cad la mang 'gyed/ tsa ri dang lha sa sogs gnas rten khyad par can rnams la dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa ༅mas/ mchog gsum gyi ngo so rdo rje 'chang / /zhes sogs bstan 'gro'i don du sprul pa'i snang brnyan ston par gsol ba mdzad/ slar rnam rgyal lhun po nas dgongs rdzogs 'bul bar bla ma 'gro mgoni dpal grags pa 'gror/ thub pa zangs thang ma/ dngapo ji snyed 'dug kyang de thams cad phyir slog /rje gong ma kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu'i phyag bzo/ dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje'i rmu

btsugs pa 'grungs te phyis lcang lor 'khyil ba'i khyad 'phags mnyam med rje'i thugs dam de/ dad rten du dgos tshul gnang ba bzhin phyag tu 'gror/ phyi rten rdorje 'chang sku rgyan du gser gyi kuṇḍi ka dang spyi khab sogs gser g.yu gtos che ba gnang / de lo gnas kyi slob dpon gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po 'jam dpal grags pa'ang zhing gzhan du byon/ rin po che 'di shin tu drin che ba yin gsungs/ lho rgyud kyi grwa tshang so so dang / mkhar chu/ sgo chu sogs lho brag phyogs kyi 'brug dgoni rnams la mang 'gyed dang rten bzhengs kyang thugs khur bzhes/ de skabs ming lam du bshes gnyen de nyid ljoni shing gi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i skyed tshal zhig gi sgo na yod 'phro la nang du bzhud nas phyir 'thon ma byung ba mis/ skyed tshal gyi sa dbyibs khabs kyi gzhis ka de ji lta ba rang du 'dug gsung ba bzhin/ phyis ska skye sde pa gron pa'i sras su

༅༅/ /'khrungs/ thugs rab shin tu che/ gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan ngag dbang legs bshad yongs 'dur btags/ sku gzhogs grwa tshang du nas gnyer la bzhugs su bcug /bdag rkyen thugs rtsar sbyar ba gnang ngo / /rje bla ma'i phyi rten rab gnas dus su'ang / dkar me'i rgyur mar gtos che ba dang snyan ji mang 'gyed sogs sgrub par bla ma bsam gto chos gling pa brdzangs/ de nas dgung lo nyer lnga pa dmar ser can ste me mo sprul lo/ dgung skeg thog tu phebs ༅/ gu ru dragapo kyil ya sogs sngar gyiljags bsnyen khrigs su bca' ba rnams kyikhar/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdomapa lha bcu gsum gyi bsnyen chen dang / tshe ba kyi ljags bsnyen gyi rim pa/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang gabargya tshar mang po/ gzhan yang ba/'a bstan las byung ba'i smon lam gyi rim pa mang po/ rje btsun gong ma

rnams kyis khrigs subasdebs pa'i thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyun 'gyer/thun mtshams su/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro stog gi glegs bam rnams yongs rdzogs gzigs pa stsal/lo de'i rgyal gyis nya ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dbus ma'i tshas la/rje sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal bzang po gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phral 'od gsal dag pa'i dbyengs su thim pa'i gas bzod par dadzi' ba slebs/bcos min gyi gdung shugs chen po'i ngang nas/zab dgongs rdzogs thabs su dkan rmochog gsum gyi spyan sngar kun bzang mchod sprin zhing khams rgya mtsho gang bar sprul/bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dbyer ma mchis pa'i sgrub cing mchod pa dang /sku gdung rin po cher snyan dar bkras thags 'dom 'khor 'byug ris can la bstan 'gro'i dbyed du sngal ska myur 'asto gyi gsol 'debs/ skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma mchog/
