ra༅༅/ /gdul bya'i mos ngor chu zla lta bu'i 'phrul/ /ngo mtshar ci yang ri mor bsgrur mkhas pa'i/ /'gran bral bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /5na dang bde ba'i rin chen gter gyur pa/ /mchog mthun dngos grub kun gyi dpal gcig pu/ /zhing 'di'i skal bzang gdul bya smin slad du/ /slar yang ngo mtshar sprul pa stsal du gsol/ /de ltar gsol btab 'dod pa'i 'bras bu gang / /rje btsun bla ma'i snang brnyan ston pa la/ /bar chad mi mthun dpung las rnam rgyal zhing / /skye ba kun tu rjes su 'dzinapar sgordzog zhes phyag ris su bstar ba dang / gos phyi nang / mar gtos che ba sogs gdung 'bul dang mang 'gyed rnam gzhag /rten bzhengs kyi rgyar gser dngul gyi gnang cha dang bcas/ sde pa phyag mdzod ngag dbang rab brtan grwa sding po cher rdzong bdar gnang / chos sde grwa tshang so sor yang mang 'gyed rnam

gzhag stsal/ de yang bka' las/ lar babs bcad rgya de'i ring 'jig rten phyogs kyi khur 'khur mkhan tshul mthun zhig yod na/ ngo cag bcad rgya bgyis par don ldan zhig yong ba 'dra rung / las tshan bcu gsum gyi bkode pa thams cad nged rang la babs pa zhig dang / dus skabs kyang / bla ma rnam gnyis dgongs pa chos dbyengs su jim/ pha 'jam dpal grags pa gshegs/ sde pa lhun rtse nas 'byon dgos pa sogs/ de skabs sngoni las lhongs pa'i rnam pas rang sems la mnong 'grod spu tsam med rung / bstan par 'phel 'grib che skabs su song zhing / rgyu der brten gyi ri mgo gang mtho'i nyi ma bzhin/ dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i yon gyi bdag po rnams kyang phyi log nang log grangs mang bar brten/ nor dngos po'i 'bul ster/ gtam bden pa tshig gis 'grol dgos byung ba sogs zhib par chu lha'i lces kyang brjod par mi

ra༅༅/ /nus te/ yid skyo ba dang lhan cig rang las bdag gir bzung / zang zing gi longs spyod kyang spyad bzhin che bar go nas/ gtso bor bla ma rnam gnyis kyi sku mchod dang / bstan pa spyi'i rim gror dmigs/ nye skor gyi chos sde grwa tshang rnams la khyad ja 'ba' zhig gi mang ja 'gyed sogs ser sna can rnams smra ba'i sgo mang ba'i thabs la 'bad/ 'on kyang mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi las 'bras la yid ches par/ zang zing gi dngos po je 'phel du song ba gagatogs byed dada' ru ma song ba thams cad kyi thugs la gsal/ rting mar tshar lhongs 'grigs pa lta bu'i byed bde ru song ba'i khul nas lag g.yog kyang rags su song / byed da/'a dus 'khor mkhan kyang na hi/ srid na nam mkha'i bya'i dpe rang du 'dug go gsungs/ de yang sngoni chos rje rgya rasal lho brag mkhar chur/ bar chad che dus der chos slong yang dgra

ru langs/ da lta bdud kyang dpal du shar/ zhes pa bzhin no/ /yang de'i tshe bka' las/ rje bla ma zhal bzhugs dus sku gzhogs su nye bar bcar sdode byas nas bslab ston zhu dbang gis skal/ 'brug lugs kyi zab khrid rnams las slob gnyer yang gtsang du snga res sdod skabs tsam min pa sgordzogs che ba zhig ma byung rung / phal cher mtshan nyid kyi yig cha'i bshad sbyangs kho nar bas gzhan mar 'di dang 'di zhes stoni mkhan ni ma mchis/ rje bla ma rnams gnyis ni ma bzhugs/ 'ordzong ba thang skyur rang du byung / de'ang rje de nyid gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas mi ring ba zhig na/ nged rang sems sdug ches pa des nyin mtshan med par gdung shugs che ba zhig byung ba'i rgyar rten/ tho rangs zhig rmi lam la khang bzang sngo la dwangs pa beeḍūrsha'i rang bzhin lta bu'i nang na/ ras dkar po dri ma med pa ska la gsol/ kriṣṭha sā ra'i bzhugs

ra༅༅/ /gdan gyi khor sems nyid ngal gso'i bzhugs stangs mdzad bzhugs 'dug par/ nged rang gis zhabs spyi bor blangs yun ring du bzhums pas/rje'i zhal nas/de tsam du thugs ngal mi dgos/zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba 'dug tsha gzhis ka phyogs su skye ba myur du yong phebs pa zhig byung /mdo khams nas bla ma khams pas bskul ba ltar/ dpal ldan nā ro ta pa'i thugs rje'i 'phrul/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir bdag cig slob 'bangs rnams//brtsebs rjes 'dzin sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid/ /zhabs zung bskal brgya'i bar du brtan par shog /ces sprul pa'i skur brtan bzhugs kyang bgyis so gsungs/sku mtshams khog tu mnga' ris mang yul gyi rgyal sa chen po nas/rgyal po 'jam dbyangs rnam par rgyal bas/gser rgya ru spos shel sogs kyi 'bul skyel stobes che ba dang lhan cig spyan 'dren gyi

sa rje 'gromagon dpal grags pa/grub dbang shes rab 'brug rgyas/gzhan yang dbu che grwa yoni rnams kyis bas pa'ang bzhes/dus kyi pho nya ste sa pho rta lo tshas ljon gyi zla ba'i nang du/sku mtshams lo gsum phyogs kyi sa bsam las 'das pa'i 'grul 'khor brtsams pa stong nyid snying rje'i dpung gis btul te gegs med mthar yi ris dang bcas pas 'bru'i phung po ri i 'as zlar 'os pa sogs bkur sti ci yang bsgrubs/khong rnams la che zer ba'i skya ser gyi khrom la/bla ma'i rnal 'gror dang tsha bka' stsal/ de nas ska mo'i rten 'brel la

go༅༅/ /dgongs grub pa'i rgyal mos tshe sgrub pa'i gnas su bsngags shing bde ba can dang khyad par med par lung bstan pa/ rlon byes 'gol zhes bod pa der zla ba gcig gi ring ༷khri mtshams kyi nges pa shin tu dam pa la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig mtshan lam du/ da lam sku tshe'i bar chad sel phyir gnas chen tsa ri tror phebs dgos pa dang / de phyin gya sku tshe'i 'phrang rnams la'ang sel thabs kyi rten 'brel gnang na ska tshe'ang dgung lo bdun cur nye ba tsam 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i mtshan ma gsal por gzigs/ de dang mtshungs par dkar brgyud kyi cod pan dam pa sgam po pa nor bu rgyan pa zhes grags pa des kyang de mthun gyi lung bstan snyan 'bul zhu ba gnang 'dug na'ang / ska'i 'khrungs rabs snga ma rnams kyisarten 'brel gyi gnad dang / lhag par snyigs dus kyi skye 'gro mesod nams dman pa'i dbang las/ de bzhin thog khel ma

byung ngo / /de nas rlag tshang dang bde chen rmu steng / shel dkar rtse sogs su phebs/ der 'ja'i gur khyim 'dom gang tsam gyi nang du/ rje de nyid ras dkar po dri ma med pa bzhes pa zhig gsal bar gzigs/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur ba legs par nod pa'i thugs nyams shar/ 'ja' gur dang mthing shun dri ma med pa'i 'od khyimazhigani zhabs phyir yod pa thams cad kyis kyang mngon sum du mthong zhes grags so/ /byams chen du phebs/ sku mtshams zhig gi mu nas sngar gyi lung bstan ltar shin tu gsang ba'i zol gyis gnas chen la phebs bzhed/ chos rje brag rtsa sku skye snying stobs dang gas zhen nan ltar che ba nas/ phyag phyir 'os su gzigs nas zhabs 'bring du bgyis te/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba dang lhan cig phebs skabs/ byams chen phyag 'tshal kha'i bzhugs khrir phebs thog /zhing skyong

go༅༅/ /gi chibs bsu ban dpon gyi gzugs rna bug snyim pa tsam yod pa zhig gis chibs 'ol ba gsar gzugs can zhig 'bul du slebs/ de nas ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs pa khyad par can dang bcas te gegs med du skor ba gnang 'phral/ gsol dpon snyemanga' ba gtsang brkur gyi sar mi snar gnang ba 'khor te/ sde pa khag gnyis po'i nyan rna dang bcas 'gror ba'i slar yang tsa rir skor cig phebs/ de res dam tshig kyang ci rigs pa'i stabs kha ba tshan chen po babs/ brku rab pa'i nyan rna ba zhabs phyir yod 'phro la nyi ma'i dgung lam min du srung mas khrid/ ci bya ltos bral du gyur pa slar bka' bsgo gnang bas rnyed/ brag dmar de'ur phebs/ gshin rje'i zangs khang dmar po bla mtsho dang ro thang sogs rngam par gnas pa gzigs/ las kyi gzhin rje nyid khye'u khrag mdog can gyi tshul drung du 'ongs/ g.yar dam thod du

bcings/ pho brang g.yu mtshor phebs/ phu skor gnang / mkha' 'gro sna'i snying phug tu gsum zhag bzhugs/ de skabs char sprin sngon po glog gi ba dan can gyi gzhal med nas/ snyan par sgrogs pa'i na chung dbyangs bdun gyi rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i dge legs chen pos/ bdud las rgyal bas mthar byed kyi gnam the skyengs par byas so/ /de nas byar ༅la lo ro'i me tog bzhes/ byar stod du chos rje cog grwa pa chos ldan pad dkur/ bla ma rin po che sems dpa' chen tsho dgongs rdzogs rten bzhengs kyi rab tu gnas par phebs dgos tshul dang / gser gyi phan cha'ang zhu bar byon pa la/ bka' las/ rje gong mas/ rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po sogs sku drin che ba'i bla ma phal che ba'i dgongs rdzogs zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byung 'dug /ngos kyis rje de nyid kyi gdung bzhu ba dang rten rab sogs la sleb thub pa zhig ma byung / da res

go༅༅/ /bla ma rin po che de nyid kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba rang byed gsungs bka' bzhes bzang po dang / phyag nas gser stobs che ba'ang gnang /gnyal du chos rje spro bde ba 'bul ba dang bcas pa/ mdo khams nas dge bshes sangs rgyas mchog bzang gi 'bul skyel ba dar rtse mdo pa span sogs 'byor/byams chen du rje de nyid kyi sku mchod chen mo dang / sku'i rim gror dam tshig gtor ma zhig chos rje chu dbar bas mdzad/ rin po che stag rtse sku ༄skyes lha khrod du spyan drangs/ der cog grwa rnying pa gzhis byes kyi spyan 'dren pa 'gror/ stag rtser bya pa khri'i drung sku mched lcam sring gis zhabs nas bteg /de skabs sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal gyi thugs ljags spyan gsum ring bsrel dang bcas pa/ bya pa zhal ngo mjal kha zhu ba'i bzhed pa ltar/ spyan 'bebs su 'tsho byed ye shes rdo rje byung ba nas

thog mar rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyithugs kyi mos gas dang gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas dbu gtsug mngon par gtugapa dang lhan cig phyag tu bzhes tshe/ de sha'i mod la yungs 'gru lta bu'i ring bsrel kha yar phyag tu babs/ byar nas shasbyo'i gangs rgyab la byas gri gu brgyud brag rtsar phebs thog /'gong pos rgyud brlams pa'i skye bo'i spyod 'grose kyis snga gong sku la sang gzhi ngan pa zhig zhugs yod pa de dus langs/ gsum zhag tsam thogs/ shul lam du sku shin tu dub cing / mnyel babs lci bas dpon slob sgrub sde bsam gtan rdzong du bzhugs/ sgar dmangs khal bcas phar thal/ sgrub sder sku mtshams bdun phrag dam pa gnang / cog grwa rnying pa dang brag rtsa sku skye sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang / ska'i 'phrod bsten yang dbon tshang byar po chos mdzad kyis phul/ dad pa dam tshig gi rten 'brel gyis snyan cung zad dwangs/ zar po'i

༄༅༅/ kha rgyud/ grwa bkra shis gling du rin po che skal bzang pas gtsos pa'i cog grwa'i thab bsu 'gror/ rang bzhin spros med lhug pa'i 'dus tshogs kyi ser sbrengs kyis bkod pas mdun bdar te grub pa'i bsti gnas don grub mthong smon du phebs/ zla ba tsam stan chags/ phyi rten thub dbang gi sku rin po che las grub pa thog tshad gnyis tsam zhig dang / kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bus sgrub sde 'dir tshe dpag med kyi sku gcig bzhengs thub na dbus srid spyi la phan pa'i rten 'brel zhig yod gsungs pa'i lung bstan ltar/ mgon po tshe dpag med bla ma ran po che de nyid kyi spur thal las grub pa'i sman sku byin rlabs can gser zhun 'thug por gsol ba / gnyis ka la gzungs 'bul/ zhal gager spyan 'byed/ dbu mthing gsol ba rnams phyag bstar gnang / bde mchog nā ro bcu gsum ma rdul tshon gyi las rim

rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa zhag 'gazhi bar du mdzad/ chos rje chos grags rgya mtsho rje mi la'i sgrub gnas shel phug chu shing rdzong sogs gnas chen gyi 'dzin skyong dang / la stod phyogs su snying po'i bstan pa spel phyir bsko 'ja' shis brjod gnang / sku rim du/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa/ byams pa gling / gra thang / 'grong rgyas ri bo bde chen/ 'du khang ba/ spyan g.yas/ thang po che sogs dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su mang 'gyed bzang bar bstabs/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i rigs dbon chos rje 'dzol phu par grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan bsko 'ja' zhu ba dang / nang so rdor legs kyi 'bul ba dang bcas 'gror/ de dus 'phags pa brgyad stong pa gan shog la dzas chu bo'i gser bzang pos lañdza 'ba' zhig tu byas pa rgya nag tu bzhengs pa'i khyad thon de yang phyag tu smin/ srid shod nas rin po

ra༅༅/ /che 'gro mgon dpal grags pa dpon slob kyang byon/ de'i tshe bsgrub bya'i rgyad la nges 'byung gi tshul khrims bla na ma mchis pa bskran pa'i slad du/ dus tshes bzang po la/ mkhan po toni gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ rgyal dbang thams cad rmikhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde/ las slob mkhas pa'i dbang po ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje/ gsang ston chos rje dkon mchog rin chen/ dus kyi brda' sprod pa chos rje 'gro mgon pa/ kha skong chos rje rgyal ston lo tsā ba sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi dbus su/ bshes gnyen chos grags rnam rgyal/ rin po che skal bzang pa/ 'tsho byed phan bde 'od zer gsum sogs bsgrab bya mang po bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dngos por grub pa'i bskakha drin mdzad/ 'di mkhan po gnang ba'i thog ma yin/ cog grwa gzhis byes nas/ rdor

drel/ rgya sbug /bla bre mngags thagasarnams kyis gtsos pa'i/ ber/ yol ba/ rta dre'u sogs kha grangs la ma ltos pa'i dgu tshan nyer gsum gyi 'bul ba dpangs bstod 'dug pa bzhes/ chos rje 'dzal phu ba khro phu grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan pa/ bla ma skal bzang pa cog grwa rnying pa'i slob dpon/ rgod 'gro mgon du dbon po bkras dbang / dwangs ma lung du tsherdo chos mdzad/ yar 'brog gi bla ma mang por yang phyag nas gnang / dpal rab nas yar rgyab dpon sa nam mkha' mdzod pas bkur sti che bar bsgrubs/ dad ldan khri phrag mang po la tshe dbang dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdzad/ gzhis ka gong dkar nas spyan 'dren byung yang de dus phebs pa ma shar ro// //lung rigs smra ba'i dga' ston dad ldan byams pa'i chos kyi gling nang du/ /nges pa'i sgo glegs mi phyed phyag rgyas legs par btab pa'i brtul zhugs

ra༅༅/ khas/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen rang mdangs ting 'dzin rtsal sbyong 'bum phrag gis/ /bar chad bdud kyi dpung pa'i stobs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan mtho/ /zagamed yon to 'od du rab 'bar ba/ /'gro ba'i mun sel rnam 'dren nyi zla zung / /chos dbyengs nub ri'i gzims khri la 'dzags tsha/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin phung ci yang dkrigs/ /khyab gdal zung 'jug che las ma g.yos bzhin/ /rnam pa kun ldan sgyu 'phrul lha'i 'khor lo/ /cig car bsnyen pa'i ngo mtshar rol gar gyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'jug pa lhun gyis grub/ /slad nas dngos grub 'byung ba'i zhing de der/ /legs tshogs rten 'brel du ma'i sgo phye ste/ /mchog gi bla ma'i zab dgongs zla ba'i cha/ /yongs rdzogs nya rgyas dpal la smor bar mdzad/ /zhes dpal 'byug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa

dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dgazha ba'i zlos gar las/ lo gsum phyogs kyi rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa bsam gtan lhur len mdzad rjes 'phrin las kyi sgo dang por phye ba'i rab tu byed pa ste bdun pa'o// //de nas sgrub sde 'brug rgyas bsam gtan rdzong du phebs/ chos rje thugs rje dpal 'gror 'dis snga phyir zhabs 'degs dang bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong gi mig rkyen la mchog tu phan/ he ru ka rdzing kha ba dpon slob kyang 'gror/ brtan bzhugs phul/ gri gu nas bya pa sku skye rin po che khro phur gsan sbyong la rdzong gru gnang / byar du phebs nas bya pa zhal ngor dbang chos bzhed sbyar stsal/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa don gyub ste sa mo lug lo/ snga sor ska mtshams lo gsum skabs/ bla sgrab kyi bcad rgya nges pa can ha cang dam pa gnang stabs ma bde

ra༅༅/ /bas/ 'di res bcad rgya shin tu dam pa bzhed par ltar/ slob dpon padma dang grub chen lwa ba pa'i sgrub gnas min padma yang rdzong zhes bya bar phebs/ gtso bor bla ma sgrub pa'i thugs dam gyi rim pa kho na dang sngar gyi snyung gzhi'i ro langs kyis shin tu sku ngal bar byang ba la rlung rtsol rang gnad du bsnun pa gnang bas/ rang shugs kyis sku khrus mang po babs pa dang bcas stun babs lci ba de yang rgyu skar gyi dbang po gza' las grol rā ltar sku khams rje dwangs su gyur to/ /gdan sa ra lung nas zhabs drung bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul ba dang / dwags nas sde pa rkan tshe ba'i thugs dam 'dogs chas/ mnga' ris zangs darkan nas grub chen bde bas gur kum gyi ge sar ltang rtse/ tsan dan dmar po'i rdum bcad che ba sogs dang / bya btang nam ngar bas gser gtos che ba sogs kyi 'bul skyel du gro shod

dbon po dang blo gros dpal 'bar 'gror/ rin po che stag rtsepa dang ting ting nas kyis zhabs tog legs par zhus/ chos rje'i bga' 'bum sogs chos char phab/ byar nang gi me tog bzhes nas slar tshin du rgyang pa bzhugs/ bsgrub bya mang po'i rgyad la dge slong gi sdom pa bskrun to/ /drag po ste lcags pho spre'u lo byams chen du phebs/ rin po che bstan 'dzin chos grags pa'i phyi rten byang chub mchod rten bsnangs par gser gyi gnang cha dang / gzungs 'bul 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad/ 'bul lam thog longs sku'i chas su bzhugs/ khrom chen por bla ma'i rnal 'gror stsal/ cog grwa rnying pa'i bla mar chos rje shes rab ska skye dang / rgyal byed bshad grwar rab 'byams pa ngag dbang pad dkar la bsko 'ja' dang sgrab thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang stsal/ rdor gling gdan sa ba

nga po'i ngor/ kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs kyi bka' 'bum rin po che dang / rgyud 'bum 'gyur ro cog /gzhan yang dgos chos bzhi sogs kyi lung mang po stsal/ rgyad 'bum gnang dus chos thun re la po ti re tsam 'khril ba'i ljags klog sa nas bla ma dmi bstan 'phel gyis ja dar gtos che ba/ chibs sga 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'bul skyel du dge rgan grogs ṅge che sogs gnang cha rgyas pa stsal te bsrings/ rgyal yum mchog kyang de skabs dbu skra bsil zhing sku chos mdzad/ de'i ba bya mang po bsnyen par rdzogs/ de lo gtsang nas yar stod par bkar bskrun dpung 'jug mdzad pa shar/ skye 'gro'i bde

thabs la dgongs legs chings spel phyir phyag mdzod ngag dbang rab brtan dpon g.yog dkyil sgar du rdzong bdar gnang yang / sems can las la spyod par song bas spel sbyang thugs la ma bzhed/ 'dzin ma'i gzhir lha min gyi gnas 'phos pa lta bu'i 'khrug rtsod/ mkhar bzhig /yul phung sogs bsam las brgal ba byang / de dus kyang dad ldan mang po chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ rgya mtsho grwa tshang gi bla mar dge bshes chos 'khor rgya mtsho bskos/ spyi rdzas su 'bras spungs zloms cad mkhyen pa yoni to rgya mtsho'i thugs dam 'dogs chas skabs phul ba'i rgya sbug che legs shig gnang / de skabs lhun rtse nas sde srid don grub rdo rje dwags po dpal rab tu ska gshegs/ ska tshigs 'dzin pa dang sngar bzhu ba sogs dgongs rdzogs yongs su ma grub kyi bar thugs khur zhabs drung rgyal bu'i drung rang nas bzhes/ dgongs

ra༅༅/ /rdzogs dngos gzhi'i nyin/ chibs/ gser chas/ bla g.yu sogs 'bul ba rgya chen po 'dug pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar mdzad/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis/ bkra shis mthong smon gyi chos sde rten dang bcas/ bar skabs zing rkyen gyis phyir 'chan pa slar rtsis 'bul dang / mchod gzhis su rtsa brgyad za rong stod smad nas dud sum cu 'ja' sa dang bcas pa phul/ sngags grwa'i spyi rdzas pho brang yang rtser bzhugs pa'i gos ska chen mo/ dpon blon rnams kyi thugs bzhed ltar stsal/ dus 'khrag la brten bya gcen po khri'i drung bkral gong thang nas brku rab pa'i lag tu sgordzor lam lnga pa'i chos snyad du gyur/ gtsang dpung yar glangs mthil na yod skabs spel sbyang zhu bar drung yig nor 'phel btang dus/ bya pa'i 'tsho 'dzin la yul stong spel ba rgyal rdzong gyu byung / bya

zhabs drung gcung gangs dkar rnam rgyal dwags por re shig bzhugs dgos shar/ bkra shis mthong smon rtsis bzhes nas gzhis par dbu mdzad don grub mchog bzang bzhag /slar bla ma mi pham bkra shis gtsang nas smon gro ba'i bsngo zhus 'bul ba dang bcas byung ba nas/ bkra shis mthong smon bshad sgrib bde gsum gyi bla mar bskos/ gsang sngags chos gling yang brku rab pa'i la/ga nas de skabs slar phyag tu leni/ grub thob stag tshang ras pa sna'i yā na'i gnas 'khor te gser sogs 'bul ba dang bcas byams chen du 'gror/ blo ngan ste lcags mo bya lo/ bya khri'i drung gi dgongs rdzogs gral dbur chos rgyal gling du phebs/ 'bul lam dpangs bstod pa bzhes/ lam ston mtshan byang bzhu ba sogs mdzad/ sde pa de gshegs rkyen ngan pa'i dbang gis yud gcig bar srid du 'khrungs dgos byung yang / 'di ltar rnam dkar

ra༅༅/ /dge tshogs ci bgyis pa/ /zhes sogs bden tshig smon lam blo ka gsum pa zhig gsungs pa'i mod la gnas ngan las ldog ste/ mngon mtho'i lus thob pa gzhon nu la rab tu byang ba'i bsha' drin mdzad/ dbyar de chos rje rdor gling pa khu dasto gyis rdo rje gling du zla ba gnyis tsam zhabs nas bteg /yon gyi bdag po rnams bka' dbang chos kyis sgyum par mdzad/ ka ru brag gi gnas gzigs la phebs/ dag pa'i gzigs snang 'byams klas shing yul de'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa sngon ma myong ba'i lha'i spos kyi dri ngad 'thul ba dbang po'i tshon gyi gzha' ris kyis kun nas dkris pa sogs ngo mtshar gyis dus 'da'/ dpon tshang kun dgas zhus ngor gnas bstod zhig gsung rtsom gnang / rten 'brel legs par 'grigs shing rdo bod mang po smin grol la bkod/ de skabs chos

rje rin po che spyan 'dren la dpon tshang chos mdzad sgam po brgyud de gnang / chos kyi rje mi pham bkra shis blo gros dpon slob kyang 'phral du byon/ chibs byang rta/ ja gos dar/ kong snam sogs kyi 'bul ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs rgyas pa phul/ sku tshe'i 'phrang la nye ba nas/ tshe brkardzi brgya rtsa gsan bzhed par dponi tshang kun dga' brgyud nas phebs sgo gnang bas thugs 'dzangs shin tu che bas zhal bzhes 'bul ma nus/ slar nan skyed gnang bas/ 'o na gsang stabs kyikhog nas sku tshe'i rten 'brel gyi sgor 'bul ba zhu zhing / sku bzhengs pa sogs bla ma'i mthong lar mi gnang ba mkhyen gsungs/ thog mar grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa gsan to/ /de dus rje gong ma padma dashar po'i ska sog las 'byungs pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum rang byon khyad 'phags ngo mtshar ba thams cad kyi rtse mor soni pa de/ sde pa dpal bkras

ra༅༅/ /drung gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus su dpon sa tshe brtan gyis phul/ glang lo dgus srid mdzad dalakha stabs kyis bya zhabs drung gong ma rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gtsang du phebs dgos byung ba'i lo dgu ngu gter bzhugs pa shar/ bla ma'i thugs rje dang / zhabs drung rang gi sku bsod mngon par mtho ba la brten/ rim gyis g.yor po dol du phebs chog pa byung dus ska gzhogs nas gong ma rin po che gdan 'dren du chos mdzad mkhyen brtse rdzong bdar mdzad/ de skabs lho brag nas sgrub grwa lha gsum gyi spyan 'dren 'gror ba ltar zhal gyis 'chos/ bya gcung sde pa dmag dpon pa'i dgongs rdzogs su/ ljon skyed tshal phu 'brog mnga' zhing sbrags pa sde pa sras dang drung 'tsho ba dbu ches phul/ hor zla bdun pa'i nang du lho brag la chibs kha bskyar/ gnam do tshun chos rje rin po che mi pham blo gros kyang zhabs phyir

phebs/ de nas khong dpon slob dbus la thegs/ lho shar nas bsam grub dgon gsar du phebs thog /zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa drug pa'i mi sna 'gror/ gtapa shul ba rnams la chos sbyin stsal/ btsan gro nas gnas gzhi'i bla mas 'bul ba rgya cher byas/ de nas thang sku 'or gyi chu chen po'i 'gram du zhag bzhugs 'grigs/ zhod zhin tu che ba nyin mtshan sbrel nas babs pas chu klung rgas mi thub pa tsam du song rung / sang phebs khar yud tsam zhig la chu bri nas bzhugs sgar bteg /mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i gnas thig phyis su phebs/ gnas gzigs zhib par gnang / chos rje spang khang pa shes rab nyi ma'i dgoni ming mar spyan drangs/ 'bri spus gtsang nyi shu tsam gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul zhabs rgyas pa byas/ nang rten byin rlabs can 'dug pa rnams mjal ba gnang / de'i sang rlung rol brgal ba'i sham der sde pa lha khang pa/ chos

ra༅༅/ /rje cog grwa pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ lho spyi bla rin po che sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin sogs mchod yon rnams thab bsu dang bcas byon/ sgrub sde ba dang lha khang las tshan bcu gsum gyis bsu ba ser sbrengs gar 'cham gyi gzigs mo sogs dri za'i zlos gar lta bu'i mdun bdar te ljo mkho mthing gter gyi lha khang du phebs/ rnam snang chen mo sogs phyi nang gi rten khyad par can rnams la mchod sprin spros/ zhal ngo rnams la dbang chos 'ga' shas stsal/ rim pas mkhar chu rtser phebs/ grwa tshang rpāgatsor gyur gyis gang zag ri bzhugs thams cad ngur smig gi mdangs kyis ri sul khebs pa tsam du dbang po'i tshon ris bkra ba'i 'jo sgeg chen po'i bsu ba'i bkod pas gzims spyil nor bu spangs par spyan drangs/ gtsug lag khang du phebs spro'i zhabs tog rgyas pa dang / rgyal dbang rje'i bzhugs khri 'ja' tshoni mar

brgya 'bul stobs che ba bzhes/ de dus skal ba bzang ldan gyi khrom chen po la 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi stsal te smin par mdzad/ bsnyen rdzogs don du gnyer pa mang po'i mkhan po dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i rten mdos phyag bzo ma 'dzugs pa gnang / tsa ri rgod pa'i 'gro mgon las tshan rnams kyang brdzangs/ lo phyi ma dgung lo sum cu'i thog sku tshe'i 'phrang yod tshul sgam po zhabs drung nor bu rgyan pa zhes dus gsum gzigs pa des snyan du gsol ba dang / rje 'di nyid rang gi thugs dam brtag pa la yang babs par brten/ sku mtshams kyi bcad rgya la bya lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bdun nas bzhugs/ dbu che drung 'khor phal cher bkye nas dpon slob nyung shas tsam zhig mdzad/ de yang ska mtshams bcad rgya'i skabs phal cher phyag g.yog re tsam min pa dam par gnang skabs/ rje zhwa dmar ba drug pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen

/po gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /de wī ko ṭa'i gnas gzigs dang rgyal ba nyid mjal bar bzhed pas rgyal zla'i tshes bco lnga la mkhar chu rtser ༅ 'jam zhing phyogs kyi 'khor lo dbang po'i tshon ris bkra bas khebs/ bzhugs yul nor bu spungs par gnang / sang de gzims spyil dag pa 'dzom gnang dus rje 'di'i sku mtshams bcad rgya nges pa'i bug sgo 'dag sbyar gzigs ma khad dbu zhwa zul gyis phud/ gzims sgo'i 'dag sbyar / thal mo sbyar ba gnang ba serdzogs rnam thar gyi ngang tshul la thugs dag snang shin tu che ba 'khrungs/ gzims spyil nang du'ang sku rkyang las mi phebs nga gnang 'dug kyang / bla ma'i sri zhur dgongs nas gsol gzims sogs phyag g.yog lnga drug tsamatshud gamadzad/ snga sor mjal 'dzom ma grub

kyang thugs yid gcig 'dres yin pa dang / de skabs mjal dar gnang res sesgogs skyes chen rnams kyi dag pa'i snang tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ kur 'brug 'o ma rkyan gang zhes grags pa don mthun du song / de'i tshe rgyal ba gar gyi dbang pos/ rdo rje 'chang dbang kun dang dbyer med sgo /zhes sogs blo ka bdun yod pa'i gsung rtsom brtan bzhugs lhan cig /rten li ma dang rgya nag ma/ sku ber/ na bza' cha 'grigs/ ja gos dar/ chibs serdzogs 'bul lam rgyas pa 'dug cing / phar yang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying po mkhyen brtse gang / /sogs gsol 'debs glo ka lnga pa zhig dang rjes 'brel/ rten li ma/ sa'i snying po/ sku ber/ ja gos dar/ chibs sogs 'bul bar mdzad/ de nyin gsol ja brgyad kyi ring / chos kyi gsung gleng dang 'phral phugs kyi snang tshul rnams dponi slob phan tshun nas zhib mol

ra༅༅/ /gnang / khyad 'phags rin po che dang / rje btsun rin po che'i sku brnyan yid bzhin nor bu sogs sku gzhogs mchod bshams la bzhugs pa'i rten mjal yang zhib gzigs gnang / thugs dad lhag par 'phel/ khyad 'phags rin po che'i bzhugs khang gi phra rgyan la nor bu'i rigs kyang gyis rim par 'bul ba gnang / zhabs phyir sgar pa nyis brgya tsam phebs 'dug par tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bsnyen bkur rgyas pa phyag mdzod nas zhus/ sang nyin drung pa si tu rin po ches mjal/ ja gos dar sogs 'bul lam rgyas pa 'dug /bla ma jo bzang la sku yoni che bas mjal 'phrad shin tu mthun/ yun ring po'i bar gsung rab kyi gleng mo sogs mdzad rjes/ rten mjal yang zhib par mdzad/ rje gong ma'i gsung rtsom gyi phyag dpe 'dra dgos pa'i snyan 'bul zhus par thugs bzhed ltar gnang ngo / /gzhan yang

zhabs 'bring du rgyal ba'i dbang po chos dbyengs rdo rje'i yab dang sku rdzi/ spel dmar chos mdzad sogs 'dug par byin rlabs gnang sbyin dang / sgar dmangasarnams la yang zhal mjal phyag dbang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gzims bug nas stsal/ bzhugs zhag gsum gnang / thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur te/ khong dpon slob slar sras phyogs la chibs kha bsgrur/ de skabs drung yig chen mo rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin gyis/ bsre 'pho/ ro snyoms/ snyan rgyud/ bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi sku sbyong legs par phul/ de nas dgung lo sum cu pa rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi lo gsar pa'i cho 'phrul gyi dus zla ba gcig gi bar sku mtsharmes bcad rgya shin tu dam pa dang / gsol ja'ang phyag bstar ma gnang / tshes bzhi tsam nas ska khams ma bde/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu'i srod la zil shin tu che ba byung zhing / tho rangs khar rje bla ma de nyid mngon sum lta bur

go༅༅/ /mjal nas byin gyis brlabs shing bka' mchid gnang ba'i thugs nyams shar ba dang / shangs bug nas srog chags kyi rnam pa ring po zhig thon pas bar chad las rgyal te/ stun gzhi gar song cha med cing / de nas bzung spros bcas spros med kyi dge sbyor lhag par 'phel bar byung gsungs/ gzhan yang ba/'a las/ gnas de'i gzhi bdag smyon khas tha na ja chu tshun sbyin zhing / lhag par blo nye ba'i chos skyong nged rang sgoms chung la brtse bas skyong ba zhig ding sang gi bar du byed/ phrin las ci bcol ba thams cad sgrub pa zhig go gsungs/ de skabs shig ming lam du rgyal ba'i dbang po yin zer ba'i btsun pa gzhon nu zhig gi phyag tu rje mar pa'i ska 'dra gzungs gzhug la skyon yod pa gcig bsnams nas rje 'di par ston pa mdzad/ dpon slob gnyis kyi nye 'khor de na nags tshal mang po yod pa 'dra ba la/ me

tog de 'dra shar 'dug pas me tog 'di ci yin zhes dri bar mdzad byung ba/ stag ma'i me tog yin pa 'dug gsungs pas/ stag ma'i me tog red/ stag ma'i me tog red gsung lan gnyis mdzad pa zhig byung ba phyis kur bstan gyi 'phel 'grib la lta ba 'dra/ de nas nye char/ rgyal dbang dmi pa chos dbyengs rdo rje gsang stabs kyis gnas chen mjal du phebs/ yar stod khri pa dang rje dboni nam mkha' phyag phyi'i drung 'khor 'gazha dang bcas pa ngos phyar nas byon par zhabs tog rgyas pa zhus shig ces phyag mdzod du bslab stoni stsal/ yar stod zhabs drung nged be ri'i bathakha 'gyur bzhengs pa'i sku tshab la zhal mjal byin rlabs dgos tshul byung rung / sku mtshams dam skabs zhig dang 'grigs pas gnang ba ma shar/ dmi pa dpon slob de nub dur khrod la kha'i 'khris der bzhugs sgar mdzad/ de skabs stobs kyi dzol po gtsang pa dmi

go༅༅/ /phun tshogs rnam rgyal gnam du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su/rten li ma/hor sil/gnas bcu mi thang /chibs sogs dpangs mtho ba 'bul bar/sde pa 'brong rtsenas phun tshogs rdo rje dang nub ma ba rdo rje gnyis 'gror/khyi lo shar mtshams gtsang nas lcam dpal mtsho'i drung bya pa'i khab bzhes la phebs pa'i legs so zhu bar phyag mdzod pa daphro g.yog phebs/'brag pa kun dga' legs pa'i spras sku sde pa lha khang pa'i phyag g.yog zhig la 'khrungs/nyi zer la lug sha lag ya 'gel ba sogs grub pa'i rtags ngo mtshar ba mang po ston pa de la/ngos 'dzin bdag rgyan sogs grub thob rin po che la gnang ba bzhin mdzad/yab yum la blu yon dang khral chag sogs yid tshim par gnang /dbu ska gtsug phud bzhes/'byug ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po zhes mtshan stsal/na bza' sogs 'phral gyi nyer

mkho sgar phyag mdzod nas gnang ngo / /lho shel dkar du sgang chen pa lcam sring gis par gyi sbyin bdag zhus/ bud srinas par yig pa gtos che ba brdzangs/ kun mkhyen padma dkar po'i gsan yig yongs rdzogs/ bsre 'pho'i lam skor rnams par du legs par sgrub pa'i bka' khyab kyang stsal/ skabs shig mtshan lam du rje de nyidashin tu gsal bar byung ba'i sang de yongs 'odzan sprul pa'i skru'i zhu tho ljags spod ma zhig 'gror/ bsha' las/ sprul pa'i sku 'di la rang re lkog tu ma gyur pa'i yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed pa zhig byung yang / smra ba'i sgo mang ba nas re zhag brjod med du bzhag spo gsungs/ sku mtshams gyi sgang tsam la mkhan rin po che sang sa rgyas rdo rje dpon slob rgyal ba gtsang phyogs la spyan 'dren par phebs pa'i zhabs phyir/ bdag kyang dpal ldan bsngas rgyud rgyas 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od dang bcas dus 'khor rgyad 'grel gyi rgyags

ra༅༅/ /'bul bar yong pa snyan mtshor dwangs pa'i skal ba rab tu grub/ mkhan rin po che dpon slob rnams kyis rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku rim la dmigs/ dam tshig gtor ma'i sgrub pa zhag mang po'i bar du mdzad pa'i mthar/ dgra phyogs su gtor zor 'phangs pa'i ltas mtshan yang legs par byung / mkhas pa'i dbang por/ ngam ring mkhan chen klu grub pa'i rtsod spong nyi ma'i 'od zer yang lan dang bcas par lan gyis phebs par/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi bshad sbyar rgyal ba'i gan mdzod ces bya ba'i bstan bcos la rtsod pa spong ba'i gtapa srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa'i gter mdzod du gyur pa de rtsom pa'i dbu tshugs te mi ring bar gyub/ de skabs mkhan rin po che dpon slob sras mkhar gro 'o lung gi gnas rten rnams la mchod 'bul dang / rgyal

dbang dmi pa/ lho brag dpa' bor bcas pa'i yab sras rnams la brtan bzhugs 'bul bar rdzong bdar gnang / gnyen gzhin pa'i zhu 'phrin dpangs bstod/ rten bzang po dang bcas pa so so nas byung / de yang rgyal ba nyid kyi dgongs gtad la ska mtshams bcad rgya de ma'i 'phro 'thud nas rgyang tsam gnang rtsis la/ gtsang nas sde pa 'grong rtsebs spyan 'dren gsol 'debs snga gong nas yod bzhin pa dang / lhag par sda dus kyi spyan 'dren pa pos zhu nan la brten bkas bzhes te rim gyis/ hor zla brgyad pa'i dkar tshes bzang ba la bcad rgya 'grole ba gnang / gri gu dpon sa chos mdzad mas sgrub spyil du spyan drangs/ brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs thog /rten gsum mchod chas gser sogs 'bul ba rgya cher 'dug pa bzhes/ tshe bka' sogs dbang rjes gnang kha re stsal/ 'du khang du tshogs chen la phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor

ra༅༅/ /dang / chos drug gi ljags lung gnang / rim par gtsang la phebs pa'i sgo jod/ khang dmar nas mkhyen brtse dbang phyug gtsang du mi snar rdzong gru mdzad/ phebs lam gyi gzan shing sa rim rnams gtsang sa gzhung nas phul/ mkhar chu grwa tshang bar gnang cha gya nom pa bstab bo// //sna tshogs ris dang sde la chags pa'i 'brul gzugs rnam 'gyur ji snyed pa/ /bslu med las kyi byed pos bsgrubs pa'i me long ngos su shar tshe yang / /dam chos bdud rtsi'i char rgyun phab pas skal ldan smin grol la bkod nas/ /ngo mtshar yongs kyi rtse por rang byon yid bzhin nor bu phyag rtser lon/ /nye ba'i gnas chen de wī ko ṭa zhes/ /legs par bsngags 'os ḍā zhi'i do ra der/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gzi byin gyis/ /zhing skyong mkha' 'gro thams cad bran du bkol/ /dkar brgyad bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mtho mtho bar/ /

gas sku'i rol par tha dad kyang / /rang bzhin dag pa'i klong du ro gcig 'dres/ /de lta'i ya mtshan snang bas srid sa/ / /thub bstan dbyed kyi lang tsho bdo ba'i mod/ /lus can kun gyi phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas/ /zhes dpal shug bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar tha' dag 'grigs te rgyal ba gar gyi dbang po dang mjal ba'i rab tu byed pa ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas chu khyi ra/ lha khang du phebs/ sde pa zhal ngor/ rnam 'joms/ rme brtsegs/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa rnams gnang / ska

ra༅༅/ /gzhogs mchod dpon tshul khrims dbang po shes rab che bas/ bya yul lo chen shes rab dpal bzang gi drung du sgra ris slob par rdzong bdar gnang ba khong gis ka tsan gyi ri mo legs par 'khril te zhabs phyir 'khor/ sgo chu gzhis khar sgrub sde bas spyan drangs bsnyen cing bkur ba phyogs zhag tsam zhus/ khra pa / dmigs nod sgrub sde thar pa gling / seng rdzong / sman thang / rdza sna pa sogs mjal mi mang po'i bsod nams don yod par mdzad/ dbang chos kyi bdud rtsis dad ldan gyi bum bzang bkang bas nges legs kyi dpal la bkod/ 'grog zhags pa der 'ur khrom chen por tshe rta stsal/ der chos rje rin po che dpon slob kyang phebs/ mdo khams su dge bshes sangs rgyas mchog bzang khams ma 'tsho ba'i bsngo rten ja spob rtse kha yar dang mdzo rta sogs 'byor/ sad de gang skya'i gam du bzhugs sgar mdzad

thog chos rje rin po cher tshe dbang brgya rtsa khyad mtshar zhig gsan/ rong por phebs thog cog grwa rnying pa dbus nas zhabs phyir 'gror/ ri bo brag tu dga' ldan chos sde/ gur khyim pa/ thud dgon pa sogs grwa yoni mang po la khrom dbang yang gnang / stag lung du bkur sti legs par zhus/ der 'bog kong sde pa grags pa rnam rgyal gtsang du bu gter chud pa nas thon/ bshags pa dang bcas phyag 'bul du byung bar/ zhal mjal phyag dbang sogs rjes su 'dzin pa gnang / sde pa rang nas/ sngar byas la 'gyod sems kyis phyin chad zhabs tog sgrub chog pa dgos tshul ting ting nas brgyud nas phul/ kha ro gangs sbug mdor/ sna dkar rtsenas thab 'degs bkur sti rgyas pa byung / de nas gangs can ljongs kyi ri bo gyu 'dzin gdan sa chen po dpal ra lung thel du phebs/ bla ma mtsho yul ba sogs chibs bsur byung / phebs 'phral

go༅༅/ /khri lcam phyag 'bul la byon/ gnas nang pa rnams la mang 'gyed/ gdan sa gzhung du/ khro zangs/ gos snam sogs gnang skyes rgyas pa mdzad/ ska 'bag khams gsum zil gnon/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan sogs rten khyad par can rnams la snyan dar mar me rgyu stobs che ba dang / spos skya'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i rje rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i gser 'bum chen mor khyad gos yug gi snyan dar dpyangs/ dbu'i gtsug kho yun ring por baspyod de sgrubabargyud rin po che 'phel rgyas su 'gyur pa'i smon lam mdzad/ der chos rje rin po ches gsol ba bakha nas/ brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel sgrig pa sogs gnang zhing / de skabs hor zla dgu pa'i nang yin te mar khu gzhong zhes pa'i gzhongs de la mi sogs kyis 'bad rtsol med par glo bur du chu bo'i rgyan yid

du 'ong gababs te rdzing mer gyis khengs 'dug zer/ de dus chos rje rin po cher spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang zhig gsan/ chos rje mi pham dpon slob de nas dbus la phebs/ sa ral na rje gtsang pa sku gzhon nu'i skabs kyi zhabs rjes dang / gtsang gang pa'i lag gi rje gong ma'i sku gdung la byon pa'i kha sar pa ṇi de'ang der phebs pa stobs 'grig gis mjal ba gnang / 'phrang rings su gzug po nas kyis spyan 'dren pa slebs/ blo bder phebs gzug po bam chen rang gis gtsos pa'i zhal ngo spyi sgor tshang mar/ tshe bka'/ phyag rdor/ sgrol dkar/ lha mgoni sogs dbang rjes gnang mang po gsol ba btab pa ji bzhin stsal/ dad gus shin tu che/ de nas rin sdings grwa tshang gi chibs bsu dang / lcags grong du gtsang sde srid shan bstan skyong dbang pos thab bsu/ chos mdzad rgyal po don gyub dang sde pa smon grol ba/ mkhas pa

༄7/ /tsha dbang don grub sogs drung 'khor mang tsho bsu ba'i bkod pas mdun bdar te/chos sde dpal 'khor bde chen gyi g.yabs khra chen mor yol ba bla bre bzhugs khri sogs kyi bkod pa dge rtsa chen mo'i skabs bzhin rgyas par bshams nas gdan drangs/gtsang sa gzhung rang nas phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa dang /'bul nod kyang rgya spam che ba 'dug/de mtshungs rin sdings grwa tshang pa sogs kyis kyang bkur sdi bsgyusas/chos sde chen por mang ja 'gyed/mkhan slob las tshan so sor rnam gzhag dang bcas pa gnang / gtsug lag khang sku 'bum chen mo sogs kyi rten rnams zhab par gzigs/ mchod sprin gzhal du ma mchis pa dang /dkon gnyer rnams gnang sbyin gyis tshim par stsal/de skabs rgyal ba rkadze pa yab sras rgyal rtse dgazha tshal na bzhugs pa'i so so nas ja zhus rgyas pa 'dug cing

skyes lan dang / skya ser gyi'om shin tu che ba la bla ma'i rnal 'gror dang zhal mjal byin rlabs kyis skal ba bzang po'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzad/ der sde pa 'brong rtse bas spyan 'dren skyar ma 'gror/ gzhung gi chibs skyel rgyas pa rtsechen tshun 'dug /gram mdar 'brong rtsenas sde pa rgyal bu dpon g.yog byon/ sngar srol las mi dman pa'i lha sde mi sde nas mdun bsus/ myang lung pa'i lte ba chos grwa chen po rgyal byed tshal du phebs/ sde par tshe bsha' brgya rtsa sogs dbang rjes gnang / bsgrub bya mang po bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs chosakyi badzi' drin stsal/ sku rim dus gtor 'a mo'i dus rgyal byed mgon khang du/ mgon po'i bskang gtor thog tshad tsam phyag bzo mdzad pa phyis yun ring por song nas kyang bkrag mdangs ma nyams shing sems can gyis gnod pa med pa sogs byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma ci yang spel bar mdzad/ skyid sngag byang chub

ra༅༅/ /bsam gling gu grub pa'i dbang phyug shes rab mtshan can gyis spyan drangs/ der bzhugs khri gsar bzos thog nas/ khrom chen po 'dus par dbang chos stsal/ 'bul ba nas khal sum stong lhag tsam spungs pa spyan lam du smin par mdzad de gdan sa ra lung gi thab 'degs dang dkar me'i rgyur phul zhes gdams/ brgya lhag tsam sde pa rdzong kha nas sgres por gnang ngo / /slar rgyal byed du phebs skabs/ pa snam nas zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pas mang yul stod pa'i lha btsun rdzong bdar mdzad nas chibs lam bzhugs sgar du spyan 'dren mjal 'phrad kyi snyan 'bul zhus/ de yang rgyal dbang dam pa 'di nyid gnas chen me khar chur sku mtshams bcad rgya la bzhugs dus/ mi phyed dad pa'i nor can sde pa 'brong rtsepa hor tshe dbang don grub gang der bsnyan babs lji ba zhig byung ba nas/ bshad gaslob dponi

pa spyan 'dren la ched gnyer gyis gnang ba sogs dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas phebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan nan chags gaphul ba der 'dug cing / bzhugs sgar blo bder phebs 'dug zer gagasan pas shin tu mnyes te/ da ste 'an bu bdag cag rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal nges rang yin pa a skyid la gsung zhing chibs bsu la 'gron rtsis mdzad 'dug rung sku khams 'khrugs dogs sde pa rgyal bus byon par snang / hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la khro phur sgar pa phebs par thag chod pa dang / glo bur du hor zla bcu pa'i nyer brgyad kyi sku rim bskang gso'i gsung chog grol nas sde pa'i 'khris su phebs/ yang nyer dgazhi nyin gung la thengs gcig dang nyi nub tsam la'ang phebs nas 'pho dmigs gnang / de dus phyag thal mo sbyor ba tsam min pa gsung mi mkhyen pa 'dug zer/ sde pa rang thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs

༄༅༅/ /pa'i ngang nas lnga pa'i chos nyid du gyur/thugs bu ba chen po'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad/'phral du sa chog btsugs/sku gzhogs su bla ma dbu che sogs phyag phyir bzhugs pas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrags pa'i sgo nas ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga gnang /gzhan sgar dmangs/grwa tshang /phyogs 'dus kyi rtogs ldan dang bcas pa'i tshogs chen por 'brong rtse rang nas rmong ja bsnyen bkur sogs zhabs tog rgyas pa dang /phyag mdzod nas kyang mang 'gyed stsal/zhe dgu grol ba'i gshegs rdzong dngos gzhi'i wo sde pa de rang gi gsol go cha tshang /ja gos dar/khro zangs/rta dre'u sogs 'bul ba dpangs bstod pa dang /tshogs pa rnams la'ang mang 'gyed rgyas pa bsgrabs g.yongasasu bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs/phyin chad shis brjod kyis brgyan pa'ang gnang bas dmatha'adi nyid dgra gnyen gyi phyogs cha

gzhan ngor yang mi snang bas/ kun la thugs rjes sgoms par gzigs mode/ snying thag pa nas skyabs su song ba dag tshul 'di 'dra'i sgo nas kyang rjes su bzung bas de lta'i skal ba bzang po la kun smon par byed do/ /khrag skyag ces pa chu mo phag lo gsar/ khro phur spyan 'dren la slar mkhan rin po che sangs rgyas rdo rje dpon slob phebs/ de nas 'brong rtse/ rgya phibs/ yar gdong / nore gling sogs brgyud gru kha spel du phebs thog /pa snam klu khang nas sgar pa'i dbu che drung 'khor rags rim gyi chibs bsu/ zam gdong nas nyin byed gling pa/ zur ri ba/ 'gro ༄dun gling pa sogs dge 'dun brgyad brgya brgal bas snam sbyar dang zhwa khra gyoni/ gdugs rgyal mtshan/ ba dan phye phur/ dung rgya gling sogs mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i bsu bas spran drangs/ mjal 'phrad sngar 'gyud bzhin gsol ja mang po'i bar gsung gleng ska

ra༅༅/ /ngos nas gnang res gnyen gshin par mdzad/ nyin byed gling pa'i tshogs gur du spyan drangs 'bul ba rgyas pa 'dug /phan tshun gyi rab 2rgyams pa rnams bgro gleng smar ba dang / de rjes sde pa spel byung ba'i gur du spyan 'dren zhus thog /drung pa rgyal tshab rin po che'i phyag mdzod a'o mtsho byed byung / sgar grwa tshang rnams la mang 'gyed rgyas pa bstabs/ dkar brgyud dag pa'i snang bas yid drangs pa'i sgar grwa'i khrod nas mjal mi bka' 'brel don gnyer sogs mang po byung bar chos 'brel byin rlabs gang la gang 'os su stsal/ slar zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzims chung du phebs/ gsol ja kha shas bar bzhugs/ 'bul gnang rgyas pa 'dug /de nub gyu kha spel du phebs/ chibs skyel yang sngar lugs ltar mdzad/ khri khang zhal ngor tshe dbang sogs gnang / phyug po khang gsar du sde srid dmi

bstan skyong gi 'bul zhabs rgyas pa dang / rtse zhol nas mjal mi mang du snang bar zhal mjal byin rlabs stsal/ lcags pas chibs sgo(la thogs khrom chen po la phyag dbang byin rlabs mdzad/ snar thang brgyad gsing ma bkra shis khud du khro phu ba'i thab bsu/ rnam sras gling du mkhan slobe rnams kyis chibs bsu/ dar sna gdong nas grwa tshang dgon ma lag rgyal gyi shrī ri brgyud dong bcas pa'i ser sbrengs pa stong phrag brgal ba sogs sa tshigs du ma'i yul gru dang ljongs rnams su ji ltar thub dbang ser skya'i gzhir gshegs dus/ zas gtsang ma 'khor dang bcas pas mchod pa ltar mdun bsus/ rgya bod kyi paṇa grub du ma'i zhabs zung 'khor 'ordzos shis par byas pa'i bsti gnas/ dpal khro phu dga' ldan byams pa gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por phebs/ phebs spro rgyas pa dang / sgar dmangs zhabs phyi'i grwa tshang khag dang bcas par zla ba

ra༅༅/ /gsum gyi phogs gzab ma phul/ dgun bzhugs gnang / mi pham rgyal ba'i sku brnyan gser gyi lhun po'i dpal 'dzin pa gang la zhal gser spyan dbye/ khyad gos yug gi snyan dar dpyangs/ lha phran rnams la bkras btags sogs snyan dar dang / mchod sprin bzang du gtibs/ grwa tshang sger la bde mchog snyan rgyud kyi smin bda' 'bring po'i dbang / gzhan chos rpā gnyer mang por thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid sogs dbang lung man ngag gi chos char i re bzhin phab/ rtse chen nas dpon sa lha sras drung yum sras kyang la stod mtsho sgor bzhugs pa nas zhal mjal bar phebs/ 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ dbang chos dang 'gror pas tshim par mdzad/ gza' tshes bzang ba'i nyin/ bde yangs chen por gdong lnga kai la shar 'gying pa lta bu'i bang rim lhan po gnyis pa can gyi bzhugs khri gsar bzos thog tu spyan

drangs/ thog mar mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ rten li ma/ ja gos dar/ rta dre'u sogs rgya spam che ba'i rjes 'brel grwa tshang pa spyi sger dang bcas pa'i brgya 'bul/ de rjes la stod nas grub chen bstan pa ba dpon slob kyis kyang / gser zangs/ lcags ras/ ting shags rgya pon mang po sogs zang zing gi 'bul ba sogs stobs che bas rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i bang mdzod la spyad byar spyad dam snyam/ lha mi'i khrom pa thams cad zang zing gi bdog pa la 'ching ba grol te ci yod rgyal ba'i mdun ngor spungs/ khrom chen po la tshe bsha' stsal/ nye 'khor gyi chos sde so sor mang ja rnam gzhag kyang bstabs/ de'i tshe khyad 'phags rin po che'i bzhugs khang rgya bkod phun sum tshogs pa de bzhengs par bzhed/ bal po phra pa gsum gyis rgyal byed nas 'go brtsams rung thog mar ljags bkod kyi gzo'i gnad ma longs pa

go༅༅/ /'dra zhig byung /khro phur phebs bstan bal po mkhas pa za ma shrī yang thugs rjes bkug pa ltar 'gror ba nas/bal po lngas dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten gyi dbyebs su sgrub pa'i dbu tshugs/bzo khyad kyi bslab ston 'phral 'phral stsal/mkhan rin po ches rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen por snyan 'bul zhus pa'i sgoms chung bdag la'ang sgra ris ljags khrid ka lā pa yongs su rdzogs pa stsal/de dus ༷sgrub bya brgya phrag lhag pa la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa/rgyal ba nyed kyis mkhan po/rje bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rjes las slob/chos rje chos grags rgya mtshos gsang stan sogs mdzad nas bsha' drin rpā pos bskyangs/bya pa sku skye rin po che yongs 'du dbang po gsang gling gi mkhar las su dgos cha dang bcas rdzong bdar mdzad/cog grwa rnying pa'i slob da' chos rje shes rab ska skyes dgongs grol zhus te

/ par chos rje nor bu rgyal mtshan/ la stod bsam gling mkhan por chos rje 6ta tra ba sogs bla ma mang por / kyi rab 'byams pa mang bas/ sku gzhogs su nyin ltar gyi rigs lung shon tu smar bar brten/ ngam / skyin mjal bar byung ba/ ngam ring gi grwa skor las/ sku gzhogs 'di'i rigs lung go gnad che zhing lcam dral/ snyan rgyud mgon po/ beg rtsernams kyi ska thang phyag bris khe gtsang ma bzhi mkhan rin po cher ra/ rim gyis bsam grub chos sdings su phebs/ der bla ma snga ma bsod nams rin chen grongs pa'i

ra༅༅/ /dge sgrub 'bul ba 'dug /slar chos rje don grub rnam rgyal bla mar bskos/ de nas zhwa lu'i gnas gzigs la phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbrengs kyi bkod pa rgyas pas bsus te zhwa lu mthil du gdan drangs/ mkhan sar zhwa lu sku zhang bzhusas par go sa mtho bas mthong bzos che ba dang / mthil dang ri sbug gi dge 'dun gyi sde la dbang chos gang 'tshams dang mang 'gyed kyang stsal/ zhwa lu mthil gyi rten zhib gzigs dang lhag par ri sbug gi rten mjal gnang dus/ kun mkhyen bu'i dbang bum gyi bum chu lhag par khol/ mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas rdo rje yang phebs skyel la 'di tshun byon/ rim gyis sa tshigs so so/ra dad ldan rnams kyi re ba chos dang zang zing gis bskangs te rgyal byed tshal du phebs/ bzhugs yul sgrab sde rtser rje gong ma'i gzims spyil du gnang / skya ser gyi chos don gnyer mang

por/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgo mo stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i snying po/ dkar brgyad rin po che'i gzhung lam/ skal ba ༅ tshe gcig la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byed pa'i lam mchog thun mong ma yin pa phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor sgya nyams khrid rgyas pa dang / de'i rjes thogs su skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim sogs kyang khrid du stsal/ spyi chos su/ stoni pa'i skyes rabs brgya pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa/ sems 'grel skor gsum gyi ljags lung sogs gsung chos shin tu 'phel ba'i skabs shig /dam sri'i cho 'phrul gyis ska dngos la bar chad rtsom rgyur glags ma rnyed/ der sku chags thams cad sngags cog gnyis la 'gyur/ rgya med rkyen gyis bsgribs pa'i dag snang 'ja' ris 'phrog byed skya chom rkun pa rnams/ chos khrims kyis tshar bcad nas rnyog pa med par mdzad/ de

ra༅༅/ /skabs sgar chen rgyang rtser bzhugs pa nas/ de po' gnas tshul rnams rje zhwa dmar bar zhu ba gnang bas thugs gso'i bathakha mchid ci yang gnang / slar yab sras gnyis kur phran bu'i rgyu mtshan 'bul rgya dang bcas chos rje spro bde ba gnang dus/ rje zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pas gser gar lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan sogs zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'brel sgrig phyogs rgyas pa gnang ba smin/ kong po nas chos rje rin po che mi pham blo gros kyis jo bo rje'i sku thang byin rlabs can sogs brtan bzhugs kyang 'gror/ rgyal byed sngags grwa'i blamar chos rje chos grags rgya mtsho bsko 'ja' gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas te bskos/ de'i tshe chos rje rin po che rgyal ston pas rje gong ma'i mdzad pa phyag rjes su/ chos sde grwa tshang gtsug lag khang sogs grangs mang po 'di bzhin 'dug pa dang / ska thog 'di la

'phrin las snga ma las kyang mi zhan pa 'dug pas/ da cha sku gzhogs grwa tshang zhig thog mar 'dzugs pa gnang dbesnas zhes zhu bar bapokha las/ ma resna thugs bden che ste/ nged rang 'khos khyer zhan pa dang bcas gang sa nas gsar pa rang ni dbakha ba 'dra/ snga sor gyi grwa tshang gyo le ba 'di rnams la phan gang thogs zhig ni nged rang rje gong ma'i phyag bzhes kyi mjug skyong ba'i 'os bab 'dug pa ltar bgyid rtsis yin phebs par/ dgongs pa'i dgyel la babs par rig nas/ slar nan chags kyis gsol ba bakha pas/ phyag mdzod dang bsha' bgro ba sogs brling zhabs mdzad rjes/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya seng ge'i ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa khyad par can gyi dus chen bzhi 'dzom sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes/ gza' skar dus spyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ thog mar dbang dwangs bcu phrag la brten nas ska gzhogs yongs 'du grwa tshang

ra༅༅/ /btsugs/ khro phu ba'i dgebazhes mgon po seng ge dge rgan du re zhig bskos/ mi ring bar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i grwa sde chen por longs chos sgrig legs pa'i dper 'os pa dang / spyi rdzas dge 'dun 'du ba'i cha rkyen yang 'brag gi grwa tshang zhig la bzang bar grags/ gzhan yang rgyal ba dam pa 'di'i thugs rje dang / 'phrin las kyi stobs las mnga' ris stod du grub thob 6ḍi yā na pa dang ༄/ mi'i dbang phyug seng ge rnam par rgyal ba mchod yon gyis bde chen rnam rgyal gyi grwa tshang dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag pa tshogs pa'i 'dus sde btsugs pa dang / dbus gtsang 'dir mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang gtong ba'i nor ldan sa skyong don grub rdo rjes bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling gi grwa tshang btsugs pa chos kyi rje buddha badzra gyis legs par bskyangs te dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa phyis khro phu grwa tshang zhes

dang / rje rdo rje 'chang gis gong dkar thod ri rnam rgyal lhun por grwa tshang tshul gnas thos bsam la gzhol ba'i 'dus sde btsugs pa phyis bde chen chos gsor du bzhugs padang / kong por chos rje rgyal dbang sku skyes 'brag chos sdings kyi grwa tshang / lho brag sgo bcur chos rje shes rab sku skyes do dam bgyis pa'i grwa tshang / grub dbang rin po ches phyag bzhes su mdzad pa'i dre'u lhas kyi grwa 〉nga / stag rtsepad darkan 'brug rgyas su sa skyong dpal mtshos do dam mdzad pa'i grwa tshang dang / mdo khams phyogs su bla ma bstan 'phel gyis do dam mdzad pa'i grwa tshang sogs klog pa'i sde mang po dang / sgrub pa'i sde che 'bring chung gsum gsar du tshugs pa'ang bsam gyis mi khyab cing / de dag re rer gtsug lag khang rten gsum mchod rdzas dge 'dun 'du ba'i cha rkyen sogos re re nas brjod par ga la nus/ tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa

ra༅༅/ /rin po che la mdzad pa cher rlom phal gyis bskrun par mi nus pas 'di rnams rang sgor ma rtsi bar thugs rje'i 'phral du rig pas mos pa la brtson par byos shig /bde chen 'brag rgyas pa dpon slob smo par/ dbang chos kyang re ba bzhin stsal/ tsa ri'i sdor 'dzin gshegs pa'i brdze rten 'gror/ slar rdor 'dzin du chos rje mkhan po ngag dbang 'osgrin las rnam rgyal bskos so// //mnyam bzhag mi gasku'i ting 'dzin mchog las 'gro ba'i don du bzhengs bskul nas/ /dad pa'i shing rta la bcibs dam tshig gtsang ma'i spos sprin 'grul bzhin du/ /sa la rdzogs ldan slar yang spel phyir dge legs 'byung gnas dam pa'i shing / /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu tshugs pa'i dge mtshan 'jig rten gsum na mtho/ /de'i tshe phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /ches cher dar ba'i dpal yon dang lhan cig /skye

dgu kun gyi bde ba'i dpal de yang / /yar ngo'i zla tshes ji bzhin gong du 'phel/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa'i gtam snyan po/ /dkar phyogs lha yis bsgrags pa'i dgrar skyes rnga/ /thos pas thar 'dod skal bzang me bya'i tshogs/ /kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar ci yang rtsen/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i ra ba ru/ /blo gsal rkang 'thung yongs su 'du ba'i sde/ /lung rtogs me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dmid du rgya cher spel/ /zhes dpal 'brag pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zlos/ bstan 'gro'i dpal du ngur smig 'dzin pa'i grwa sde btsugs pa'i rab tu byed pa ste dgu pa'o// //de nas pho brang gong dkar nas sde srid phag mo gyu pa dang / lho rgyad nas bya pa nang

ra༅༅/ /so'i spyan 'dren pa 'gror pa ltar chibs kha bsgyur/ grang chen pa/ rin sdings pa/ sgar chen nas mjal mi sogs skya ser gyi khrom mi shogs pa tsam 'dus pa rnams mthong thos dran reg gis 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ rim gyis 'om thang brgyad stag lung du rtse nas bkur sdi dang / ba chos su/ zhags de/ gad skya/ ze de pa sogs 'brog gi bla tshogs mang pos 'bul zhabs dpangs bstod dang / ༄pha ba khongs su dgon ru 'brog pas bkur sdi rgya chen pos mchod/ dbang chos zhal mjal byin rlabs kyis 'brog pa rnams kyi re ba bskang / gong dkar du zhabs drung mi'i dbang po gnam du gshegs pa'i thugs dam 'dogs chas dang spyan 'dren nan chags pa byung ba nas bya pa'i spyan 'dren mi sna slog /de nas a jo rdzong du phebs thog mnyam med sems dpa' chen po'i sngal pa bzang yul grong

gsar du phebs pa de la bka' shogabartan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad gsol 'debs/dus gsumabade gshegs kun gyibartseba'i dpyid/ /zhes sogs blo ka gsum pa zhig dang bcas stsal bar/rdo rje tshon pa ngag dbang 'phrin las rnam rgyal rdzong ba gnang /mu tig /gram mda' brgyud/rta ra mdor rin po che chos ldan pad dkar gye sku skye khong rang tsho'i zhal ngor slar yang gyon 'dug par ngos 'dzin bdag rkyen gnang /gnas gsar du zhabs drung gdung rgyud rin po che mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug da' tsho/rnam rgyal lhun po ba'i chibs bsu dang bcas pa 'dug /zam lcog lho ma'i phyi rgyang ring ba nas/gsang phu ra ba smad pa/rnam rgyal lhun po dgo ma lag dang bcas pa'i 'dus pa chen pos bsus te/thog mar rje rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa chen por phebs/ der zhabs drung de nyid kyi ska gdung la dbang bskor dang lam ston

go༅༅/ /sogs mdzad/ de nasagazhis ka rtser phebs/ rgyal ba nyid kyi sku gnogs su sgar grwa'i bla ma dbu che sogs dge 'dun rags bsdus kyis bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i sgo nas gdung chog zhe dgu rdzogs kyi bar dang / gzhan rdo rje gdan pa/ ra ba smad pa/ rnam rgyal lhun po ba sogs dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po 'dug par mang 'gyed dang / gzhis ka zhabs drung du gdung 'bul spam mtho ba gnang / dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i nyin/ sku gsung thugs rten/ ind+ra nī la mkhyid gang pa/ ding pon khyad can gyi gsol pang / rgya tsher gyi gsol cog 'phral ma sogs brgya 'bul stobs chen mchis par yongs su bsngo ba'i khyad par yon bshad dang bcas pa rgya chen po dang / nang rten sangs rgyas so lnga'i gser thang bzhings pa la lhag par gnas pa'ang mdzad do/ /de nas mig dmar zhes pa shing two byi lo

gsar/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan chen po chos 'khor lha sar phebs/ grub thob rus pa'i rgyan can gyis bzang sdings su spyan drangs nas bkur sdi chen pos mchod/phebs nor la tshal dang gung thang gi gnas gzigs mdzad/ mgoni po'i ska de thog mar zhal gser shin tu 'thug pa gsesgol ba 'dra zhig la mthar me 'o(nga nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur yud cig mjal gsungs/ tshal gyi klu khang du gzhis ka bde lhan gyi rdzong dpon spel ser bas gzhis len dang / lha sar phebs gdong paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi chibs bsu dang / zhal gyi dkyil 'khor lta mi khrom shin tu che ba 'dus par rgyal po bya tri mig gcig pas khrims pa byas/ phyi nang gi rten mjal thog dkar me snyan dar sogs tshar du dngar/ lhag par jo bo rin po che la brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel sgrig pa gnang bas rten 'brel gyi ltas kyang legs par byung

ra༅༅/ /gsungs/ de nas yer pa brag gseb kyi gnas gzigs la phebs nas/ bstan 'gro'i don du smon lam rgya cher mdzod/ slar lha sar phebs gza' skar dus sbyor legs pa dang bstan/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi spyul pa'i skyu yongs 'dzin rin po che'i dbu ska gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub thub bstan dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ ngag la dbang ba'i nga mtshar zlas gar gang / /zhes sogs seng / mtshan dpes rab brgyan zhes sogs dang / sgrub brgyad bstan pa'i gsal byed gcig pu gang / /zhes sogs brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad kyang mang du stsal/ de'i tshe rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i skyes chen 'brom ston rgyal dro'i 'byung gnas kyi sngal pa'i ska 'bras spangs thams cad mkhyen pa chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen rin po che'i bkur ste rgyas pa byung ba'i lan kyang brdzangs so/ /de

skabs dashar brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po stag lung ya thang du spyan 'dren gser yig pa a'o 'dun grong pa dpon g.yog 'gror/ sngar yang zhabs drung rin po che ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba dang thugs yid gcig 'dres yin pa nas/ de res kyi nang ma'i phebs sgo la/ nged rang yang mjal 'dod che ba dang / lhag par dbon khri pa 'dir/ 'brug lugs kyi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa ljags thog nas gnang thub tshe/ bstan pa spyi bye brag la phan slebs bla lhag tu skurdzong nges 'dug pas cis kyang phebs dgos tshul byung / slar gdan 'dren skyar ma byung ba'i lan dang gang ci'i rgyu mtshan 'bul bar 'gro mgon bkras dbang gnang / mi ring bar zhing brjes pa zhig byung / de nas jo bo chen po lha gcig gi gdan sa snye thang 'or gyi rten gsum rnams mjal/ na bza' snyan dar sogs khyad par can 'bul ba mdzad/ rim gyis/ dus

ra༅༅/ /gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam 'phral du mas rtsen pa'i gnas 'brag se ba byang chub gling dgon du phebs/ dag pa rab 'byams su bzhugs yul gnang nas byang chub chen po sogs rten rnams la zhal rgoser spyan 'byed rgyal ba nyid skyos phyag bstar gnang zhing snyan dar sogs mchod sprin gyi 'phreng ba spel/ tshogs pa la mang 'gyed gnang / de skabs 'brag tu sngar mi yong ba'i sems can rgya gnyis byung ba ma 'ongs pa'i rten 'brel dang / rag ma'i klu btsan sogs gzhi bdag dga' ba'i mtshan ma yin 'dug gsungs/ snam mkha' gdugs 'jam zhing 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa sogs bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma byung ngo / /bkra shis rtser gzhis ka nas thab 'dzin/ chu shul nas rdzong da' gro mo che ba dang / chu bo rir zhabs drung ska skyes bkur sti zhus/ dom po rne thang nas/ byang phyogs nor 'dzin

skyong ba'i rje bo lha gzigs mi'i dbang po dpon blon gyis bsu ba'i bye brag bsngags par 'os pas spyan drangs/ sri zhu'i dpal 'gror lha'i zhal tshus lta bu na ma grangs mang pos dgyes pa bskyed/ gzhis byes kyi 'dus pa'i tshogs mang po la dbang lung man ngag gi chos kyi char chen po phab/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya mchog dman rnam sa gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dpal la 'god par mdzad bzhin pa nas tshes grangs dang rgyu skar bzang po la babs pa na/ yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku che 'doni gnang bar phyogs/ de yang bka' las/ rje de nyid rang gi grwa yon che phra mang po nas smra ba'i sgo ci rigs byung bar brten/ ngos mjal ma byung bar gsal po'i rgyu mtshan sna ma brjod cing / de yang dkar brgyad gong ma rnams la/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa bzod pa gcig pa'i lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'gror zhes bla ma gcig pus chog pa'i

ra༅༅/ /chos shig yod skad du 'dug kyang / ding sang gi dus na sna tshogs pa zhig yod 'dra rung drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus yin pa nas/ yid gnyis bsal phyir phyag 'bul ba la thag chod pa yin gsungs/ chos rje rin po che'i dgongs pa la phyag gnang ba rang 'thad rgyu mi 'dug zer/ de nas dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa'i khyad par du ma bshams/ khyams ra'i bzhugs khri chen mo'i thog tu gnang skyes phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi ngo sor bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid dang mi phyed pa'i sgo nas sprul pa'i skur phyag thog mar mdzad pas log rtog can gyi rab rib bsal/ de dang rjes 'brel lha gzigs mi'i dbang po setregs/ che phran mang pos 'bul spam mtho ba dang bcas gtsug gi nor bus btud cing / lhag par mdo khams nas bla ma ngag

dbang bstan 'phel bas yab sras lhan du 'bul skyel stobs che ba 'byor/ legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel mtha' dag rang shugs kyis 'grigs/ de mtshams phyag mdzod du phebs thog dngos dang 'dra ba bsres pa'i sku chas 'ga' zung zhal 'byed mdzad par so sor ngos 'dzin gsal por byung ba dang / mgon khang du phebs tshe/ zhal thang zhig sbas pa'i tshul du yod pa zhabs drung sku skye sogs la'ang thugs rgyus mi 'dug pa de ched du bzhes nas stoni pa gnang ba dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi tsasgoli rten gtor la btsugs pa rnams re re nas phyag tu bzhes/ rgyal ba nyid la dbang 'bul ba'i tshul mdzad pa sogs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi rnam thar rmad du byung ba du mas/ der 'dus thams cad dad pa lhag par 'phel bas kun rtog rags pa 'gags/ thugs yid rang dbang med par ches pa de dus mgoni khang du byon pa kun gyi thugs la gsal zhes

ra༅༅/ /thos/de ltar dad ldan gyi 'gro ba rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du 'dus te dge ba'i lo tog las bskyed pa'i phan bde'i 'bras bu yongs su rgyas par mdzad pa'i skabs nas/chos sde rdo rje gdan gyi rten mjal la mchod yon lhan rgyas su phebs/rten rnams la snyan dar dang tshogs par mang 'gyed stsal/rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi mdzad pa la rjes su yi rangs pa'i sgo nas bsngags pa che bar mdzad kyin 'dug /de nas gzhis shar phebs bkur sti rgya chen pos mchod/zhabs drung bdag mo la skru /sdus yodapa rgyal bur 'khrungs mi 'khrungs kyi lung bstan dpon tshang kun dgazha brgyud nas zhu ba gnang tsha/rgyal bur 'khrangs shing 'di ltar yong ba 'dra phebs par/ sa ji lta ba de bzhin byung gsungs thugs yid lhag par che bas ngo mtshar du sgrog mod kyang de 'dra dus gsum sgrib bral rgozigs pa

thams cad kyi chos nyid lags mod/de nas/dpal ldan rngog pa'i gdan rabs rim par byon zhing rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gzhung spel zhing gi gnas mjal la mchod yon chabs cig tu phebs/spre'u zhing gi rje mar pa'i gdung khang sogs rten khyad par can rnams dang /dben gnas/zlum khyung /rje mi la'i sgrub phug sogs su mchod pa dang smon lam rgya cher mdzad/rim gyis dol mda' brgyud grwa bkra shis sgang du chos rje gser 'od pas gtsos cog grwa gzhis byes kyi bsu ba'i bkod pa ci yang bshams te/don grub mthong smon gyi gtsug lag khang chen por phebs/der 'gro ba'i bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po'i sprul pa'i skur ngos 'dzin legs par gnang /sngal pa'i ska 'di ska'i sha tshugs gzhon nur snang ba tsam ma gtogs bla ma rin poche de nyid rang dngos su byon par 'dug gsungs/gza' skar phun sum tshogs

go༅༅/ /pa'i nyin/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi sku mdun du sprul pa'i sku'i gtsugaphud bzhes/ mtshan yang ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang po zhes don ldan du gsol bar mdzad/ sku tshe'i rten 'brel du grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe bka'/ bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir lha mgon gyi rjes gnang sogs dbang chos 'ga' yang b.lakha drin du stsal/ cog grwa gzhis byes dgon lag dang bcas pas zla ba lhag tsam bteg 'bul ba'ang rgya cher 'dug /de skabs kyang sprul pa'i sku khri 'don gyi bkod pa 'du khang du bshams te/ rje sems dpa' chen po de nyid dang miganyis pa'i sgo nas thog ma'i phyag 'bul bar mdzad do/ /de yang bla ma rnam gnyis kyi sprul pa'i ska ngos 'dzin che 'don skabs/ rgyal ba nyid kyis 'dud par mdzad pa ni thabs la mkhas pas dregs pa skyang pa dang / sgrab brgyad rin po che 'di pa'i rnam thar la bla ma kho

na mchod 'os su mdzad pa'i phyagalen gdul bya gzhan ngor stoni par nges sam snyam mo/ /de nas dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grubapa'i gtsug lagakhang gi ma hā bo dhi sogs/ rten rnams la zhal gser tshan che ba dang bcas mchod 'bul la/ bla ma ri bo che pa dang / sprul ska sangs rgyas grags pa brdzangs/ de mtshams paṇa chen byams pa gling pa dang lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde'i mdzad 'phrin rnam par dkar bas bskrun pa'i mchod rten chen mo gzigs par phebs/ byams khang yangs pa can du smar ston lung bstan rdo rje'i sku skye gra phyi phun rab pa'i zhal ngor 'khrungs 'dug pa gtsug phud 'bul ba dang lhan cig phyag 'bul la byung bar/ gtsug phud bzhes ngag dbang mi 'gyur bzang po zhes gdags par mdzad/ slar sdings po cher sngal pa'i skar/ dpal gyi 'byung gnas sems dpa' mi yi gzugs/ /sogs blo ka gsum

ra༅༅/ /yod pa'i brtan bzhugs skyes bcas rdzong ba gnang / de nas grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang du phebs/zhang snyo rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi gnas ngo mtshar can du rtsi ba de'i mgon khang du spyan gzigs bshams/gtor bsngo rgyas par mdzad rjes/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin bcol gnang bas ji bzhin 'grub pa'i mtshan ma gzigs/gra phyir tshogs byi rdzings pas bsnyen cing bkur/dge 'dun rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'gror gnang ste thel du phebs par phyogs/brag kha nas sde pa ma chen dpon g.yoganyang po gru khar chibs bsu la byon/zhal skyin mjal ba tsam gyis gus pa lhag par 'grungs/de nyin kun gsal gyi bu mo gdong pa'i rab rib phyis te dbang po'i tshon ris gsar pas khebs pa'i 'dzum bar nas manda ra ba'i char rgyun ha cang mi drag par mchod pa'i yon du phab pa'i

dge mtshan khyad par can yang mig ldan kun gyis mthong zhes gleng / sde pa tshor dbang chos kyang thugs 'dod gang ba gnang / mi ring bar dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi rnam 'phrul bde bar gshegs pa phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa rin po che thel du phebs/ gzhis byes kyi chibs bsu dang dge 'dun brgya phrag mang pos bsu ba'i bkod pa gzhal du med pa'i mdun bdar/ chos rje smra ba'i seng ge zhes sod pa zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa sku gzhon nu'i dus kyi slob dpon/ ting sor nyin byed gling gi mkhan po mdzad pa de nag khrims bzo bar byon 'dug pas/ 'bel gtam shin tu smar ba dang / thel pa grwa tshang gzhis gyes kyis gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs/ 'bul zhabs dpangs bstod/ so sor bamanya 'brel dang mang 'gyed gnang / 'jag spyil du ska 'dra rin po che'i drung du zhag bzhugs mdzad

ra༅༅/ /tsha/rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gang gi sku gsung thugs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags mtshan yang legs par gzigs/der 'chang rkan nas lha rigs dmi chos rgyal gyi ja 'bul dang /'grong rgyas kyi lcam drung pa dang / zangs ri nas dpon sa yum sras kyang dbang chos zhu ba dang bcas byung bar bzhed bzhin stsal/ de dus mtshan ldan dbu thod mjal ba gnang / rten 'brel gyi che bas ka pā la'i bdud rtsi lhag med du bzhes/slar brag khar phebs/zhag shas bzhugs/chibs skyel la sde pa sku mched gru kha tshun byon/dad shugs kyi gdung bas spyan chab 'byin pa sogs thugs 'phreng bas 'bral mi phod pa lta bu mdzad kyi 'dug /de nas rtsed thang /khra 'byug/yum bu sasgang /thang po che rnams kyi rten mjal yang gnang /bathakha las/thang po che'i

chos skyong 'dis 'phyong rgyas pa'i mi ngo'i mthong dang sbrags kho bo la dungs par byas gsungs/ rgyal yum mchog gis grong gsar du spyan drangs/ 'grong rgyas rdzong dpon pas bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa'adug /khrom che ba la tshe dbang gnang / de rjes gri gu /se khun sogs gar phebs su dad ldan gyi 'du tshogs/ 'gror ldan gyi 'bul nod sogs bgrang bar dpokha ba dang bcas shel mdo nas/ bya rigs mi'i dbang po gangs dkar rnam rgyal dpon blon gyis bsu ba'i bkod pa legs par bstar te gzhis ka chos rgyal gling du phebs/ gong ma rin po che dang / gtsang sa'i lcam bdag mo dpal mtsho'i drung phyag 'bul la byon/ bdag mos mjal ba'i thog ma yin/ 'di nas bzung dad gus sprin glog lta bu ma yin pa rdo rje bzhin du brtan pas/ dpal gyi 'gror pa las byung ba'i sri zhu phun sum tshogs pa/sa yul khyad par can la bsti stang dang ri

ra༅༅/ /mor bgyi ba ci yang bsgrubs/ der zhal ngo la tshe bda' sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang sogs stsal/ dngul zam khar gsal rje bla ma grub mchog rdzing mo nas kyis tshogs 'khor brtan bzhugs rgyas pa phul/ gong ma rin po che dpon g.yog sngon la phebs pa'i sab mo bung du mchod yon gyis chibs bsu dang / chu mdo rgyud la thug pa tsam gyi dge 'dun grangs mang pos mchod pa'i bkod pa ci yang bshams nas gdan sa chen po dpal byams chen chos gling du phebs/ phul du byung ba'i bkur stis phebs lam gyi dub pa bsal rjes/ gong ma rin po ches sgar dmangs la gsol phogs phul/ de'i tshe rgyal dbang dam pa sku mtshams bcad rgya'i nges pa la bzhugs nas lhag pa'i lha mañdza shrī'i ljags bsnyen gnang / ska gzhogs pa rnams kyis rje'i ska rim la dmigs 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i gtor bzlog rgyas pa

bsgrubs/ nas phud bzhesagruba'aphral gsang sngags chosagling gi gtsug lag khang shing rtsim gtogs sngar bas kyang legs pa grub 'dug pa'i 'du khang du dus kyi shārgyas pa mdzad/ khro bo ste shing mo glang lo byar tshin padma yang rdzong gi dben gnas su phebs/ padma tshe khrid kyi bsnyen chog gsung rtsom gnang / de skabs chos rje rin blothugs dam brtag pa bzhin ska mtshams bcad rgya dam par mdzad/ phyag mdzod kyis dbu byas sgar dmangs rnams bkra shis mthong smon gyi zhig gsos la brdzangs/brten bsam chung ci rigs skya smra sgo ci yang zhig phye rung / snyan gong utpal rgyan du dpyangs pa shar ro gsungs/ sku mtshams grol rjes tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khophebs/ thog mar rdor 'dzin spang mor gsum zhag tsam mdzad nas/ dbu rtser ska mtshams bcad rgya dam pa la zla lhag tsam bzhugs ring gtso bor 'khor lo sdom pa

ra༅༅/ /pa'i thun bar la rlung rtsol dang tho rangs kun rdzogs stong ra brtsegs pa gnang tshe/ gnas dang skyes bu dam pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs kyis spyir sregs tshogs kyi rten 'brel mtha' dag 'grig cing / khyad par zhing 'di'i bstan 'gro'i dpal du zhabs kyi padmo rtag brtan 'gyur ba med par 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rten 'byung du/ dkar brgyud kyi gtsug rgyan sgam po pa'i spyan snga rin po che nor bu rgyan pas dwags lha sgam por phebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / brtan bzhugs 'bul bar rgyal ba nyid kyi zhal slob/ lo tsā ba lug ra chos mdzad dang / bya yul nas mchod yon so so dang / kong po nas chos rje rin po che sogs/ bla ma dbu che bshad sgrub kyi sde so so nas phul ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs brgya phrag brgas ga'agyor/ de dus 'bri khung zhabs drung mi chos pa gnas gzigs la phebs/ chos zam bla ma brgyad mjal

'dzom dgos tshul gyi bka' tho 'jam chags pa byung rung / bcad rgyas mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma shar/ sku mtshams grerdzol bstun gsar ma yang mdzod la phebs pa'i dgongs pa gtad/ dus sngas shing lhag par de lo kha ba che bas zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyi blor ma shong bar bshol 'debs kyi rgyu mtshan ci phul yang gsan ma bzhed par zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la cig car mthil du phebs nas phag mo lha khang du bzhugs dgongs gegs med bgrod pa'i mtshan ma gzigs/ tshes lnga'i snga char phebs nas/ lcags sbal rong gi brag la zhing skyong yab yum dang / rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sku gsal bar gzigs pa zhabs 'bring rnams kyis kyang mjal ba'i skal ba dang ldan par mdzad/ de nub lwa ba phug tu bzhugs/ sang de sgrol ma bla mtsho'i dbus su utpala'i sdong bu lardzi'i tre yig gis mtshan pa dang / brag gi rtser rig 'odzin padma gtso

ra༅༅/ /'khor/ padma spungs pa'i mchod rten/ rje btsun byams pa bzhengs sku'i tshul/ byin la gnas brtan bcu drug rnams gzigs/ la brgal ba'i g.yon phyogs su dpal ldan lha mo'i sku brnyan shin tu gsal ba dang / mgon po gdong du phebs tshe bya rog che la snam pa zhig skad snyan par sgrog pa kun gyis mthong / rjes bya rog gdong can dngos su zhal gzigs/ lha mo sgang nas mu men mthing mtshor phebs lam gyi zam pa zhan tu bgrod dka' bar zhabs phyi rnams ma thar/ rje nyid yud tsam gyis chu pha khar phebs/ der nyi ma shin tu dro ba la mtsho mtha' 'ja' 'od kyis dkris pa kun gyis mjal/ rje nyid kyis dpal ldan lha mo sku smad sprin gseb tu bzhugs pa zhig gzigs pa ltar phyag bris su bstsal ba'i gos thang zhig sdings po che'i nang rten gras su bzhugs so/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang gtor bsngos

'dod gsol rgyas pa mdzad/ slar lha mo sgang du phebs/ sang nas gsar ma'i lam la zhugs/ gangs shin tu che bas ri klung mi phyed pa lta bur snang / spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu la gsar ma yang mdzod kyi gnas sgo 'byed mkhan 'dan zhwa dmar ba'i phug pa khrus mtsho'i sham du phebs lam gyi rong der/ rdo rje drag po rtsal stod khro rgyal smad phur zhabs can dang gzhan yang phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams zhal gzigs/ rong thorni mtshams mkha' 'gro mas rdo pha wang gru bzhi dbyibs chu zheng khyad du mtshar ba'i bzhugs khri phul/ der zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyi bla gos btings te brtan bzhugs phul/ ji srid bskal par bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhesazhus tshe/ bka' las/ spyir bskal pas ma khyogs pa'i rnam g.yeng gozar zir 'di dang bla ma 'pho len dus zhe 'dod 'khongs 'tshengs kyi sun po ma btang na/ de ka byas chog gsungs/ de nas 'phreng lam gzar po

ra༅༅/ /zhig la phebs dus kha ba'i gong bu dang lhan cig khang pa ka gnyis ma'i tshad tsam gyi brag chad de 'ur sgra dang bcas dpon slob rnams kyi thad gdong du byang ba la/ rgyal ba nyid kyis spyan lta stangs dang phyag gis sdigs mdzub gtad ma thag rang thad du bsdad/ gnas dngos gzhir phebs dus tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya cher ba'ems/ gserdzol 'debs mgur dbyangs sogs mdzad pas/ snga nas med pa'i sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dpag med zhal phyag lhung bzed dang bcas pa shin tu gsal ba 'ig dang / de dang nye bar thub dbang la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba gco 'o nas dharma ta tshun gsal por gzigs/ rim gyis sbug pa'i zhal khebs g.yogs/ mgon tshe dpag med mjal bar phebs tshe/ phyag chen gyis snga 'grose la phyin dus/ tshe chu cher med pa la/ rgyal ba nyid phebs pa dang tshe chu'i rgyan lhag par

che ba babs pas mdong mo grangs kha byas blangs chog pa byung / sang de rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi rtser byon dus/ nyi khang shin tu dwangs pa la phyogs kyi bu mo dbang po'i tshon ris gsar pa gos su rgyarno te rngom brjid bgyid pa la 'gran pa bzhin du/ dbyig ldan ma'ang ge sar gyi tshems dkar 'dzum pa'i 'dab brgya'i 'phreng ba kha dog sna tshogs pas mdzes par bgyis pa sogs dge legs kyi snang ba rgya cher 'phel bar gyur/ rim pas lug thug thang dang lug lhas bcas 'ong la brgyud de 'od 'bar phug mo cher bzhugs/ 'di lta bu'i dus snga ba la gsar ma bgrod pa'i lo rgyus sngar med/ rdzu 'phral gyis phebs par 'dug ces kun gyis sgrog /de nas pho brang g.yu mtshor sngal pa'i lha zhal mngon sum du gzigs par spyod cing zhag bzhugs gnang / stag tshang snoji / ka la dung mtsho rnams su zhag bzhugs re/ rdo rje ra ba brgyad cig car

go༅༅/ /dpal gyi nags ljongs su phebs gdong / bya yul nas gong ma rin po che dpon g.yog /grub dbang sngerab brtan/ lhun rtse zhabs drung sogs phebs/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen pos dkyil 'khor ma lus pa mchod/ dwags kong tyāstsal/ slar zhabs phyi mang po dang bcas phu skor mdzad/ bdud mgon bla mtsho gzigs gdong / nags gseb nas bu mo gsum res ga nas yin dris pas sgom lha ba yin zer/ rin po che'i sor gdub phul/ gral la 'khod nas tshogs la longs spyad/ de zumor brdzus nas mjal bar go/ dmar nag rakta la phebs lam du tshe chu ngo mtshar ba zhig gzigs/ rdo chu rin po che yang dus der

lnga pa zug/yul smad du zhing skyes kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba dang bcas rdor 'dzin pa byung bar ga ṇa tsakra dang mchod thebs kyi rgyu stsal/zhing skyong gi lcags zhwa sogs rten rnams zhib mor gzigs rjes/zil 'a gsang ba chen tsho phug tu bzhugs/sang de yul stod kyi gtsang pa spang mor phebs/las 'dzin so sor mchod thebs gnang sbyin sbyar/de yang gnas chen du snga phyir phebs skabs gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang lhan cig spyod pa'i dag pa'i gzigs snang rgyal ba nyid kho nas bdag gir mdzad pa ni choganyid yin mod/zhal gzigs ngo mtshar ba mang po phyis kyigadul bya rnams kyis kyang mthong ba'i skal ba can du byin gyis brlabs so//de nas chos zam dang gsang gling brgyad/mdo sde phal po che sogs nas lung bstan pa'i gnas byar smad be'u rar phebs/sangs rgyas sman gyi bla beeḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po'i ska

shegs par bstar te mjal bar mdzad/ rim gyis byams chen chos gling gi gzims spyil ltad mo can du /ra bas ri mor bgyis so// //kun khyab 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'jug pa nam mkha'i pha mtha' ji srid du/ // can mtha' dag mngon mtho dang / /nges legs bdud rtsi'i dpal la sbyor mkhas 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po da bya nyid du legs par grub/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser yang / /mi nub 'dzin mkhas 'grerdzo ba'i ra ba la/ /phun tshogs khyams chen yangs pa da gdod bkod/ /rtogs pa'i nor bu dman yang bgrang gzhi'i khur/ /

lci bas ngal gso'i stegs bu g.yin par/ /sprul pas sprul pa'i chos kyi dzol thabs che/ /yongs 'dzin dwags po'i dkar brgyad las gzhan su/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sku gsum ḍa ki'i mdun sa tsa ri trar/ /dri bral ye shes gzigs pa'i me long du/ /ngo rmotshar bkod pa'i gzugs brnyan ci yang bkra/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal ldabang thams cad mkhyen pa dpagabasam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog nyi zla ltabu sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed du bkod pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu pa'o// //de nas khyad 'phags rin po che'i bzhugs khang legs pa thams cad kyi rtse mor son pa de rgyal ba nyid kyi ljags bkod du thugs rje'i 'phrul las grub pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ 'di'i ska

ra༅༅/ /rgyur/ gser bco sbyangs zho drug brgya lhag pa/ g.yu sbyang legs pa mnga' ris rdzong dkar ba'i bla g.yu yin pa zhig lhun rtse zhabs drung gis phyal ba dang / rje rang gi yum gyi sku rgyan/ gzhan gsung bsngo zhu rten du phul ba'i g.yu spus gtsang kho na rtses srang gi nyag lnga song ba dang / nor bu ind+ra nī la'i rtog dang / padma rā ga /margad/ man shel/ ga dza mu tig sogs phra rgyan bla na med pas kyang mdzes par byas shing / mdor na sgong rgyab kyi gser zho khri phrag la reg pa tsam gyi dngos po song / bal po la'ang gser rkyang zho brgya dang sum cus gtsos/ ja gos dar/ yol ba bla re/ bya ru/ spos shel/ rta dre'u/ khro zangs/ ras snam gyi ngos sogs gser zho stong phrag gcig lhag pa'i yoni gnang zhing bzhugs khang phyi ma gser zangs la ljags brkod gnang ba'ang grub/ bzo stoni sogs 'phral gyi bdag

rkyen gyi cha nas kyang mgu bar mdzad/ de nas bkra shis mthong smoni du phebs/ gtsug lag khang rgya khyon ches pas zhig gsos mang bar dgos 'dug pa'i zhal ta gnang nas dpon slob nyung shas kyis lcang lo can dang mi gnyis pa'i sgrub phugatshe kong du sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs/ lhod pa tsam nas mtsho mjug dbu mdzad la ka lā pa'i sgra ris gnang / bya gong ma rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug kyang lha rtser phebs/ mgon po'i gtor chog rnying pa 'di dgrangs che ba dang bcas nub la nye ba tsam 'dug par dgongs/ gong ma rin po cher mgon po'i gzhung dgrangs dgrod pa gnang / badzi' las/ gong ma rin po che 'di man ngag gi mdzod 'dzin pa zhig yin 'dug pas rje gong ma nas brgyad pa'i zur bka' 'ga' yang gsan gsungs/ ting sor phyag tu 'gror ba'i las mgoni gyi ska rdo nag las grub pa de la/ de skabs mtshan ltas khyad du mtshar

ra༅༅/ /ba zhig byung bas byin rlabs can du go gsung ba tsam las zhib gsal gyi skabs ma dbye yang / phyis sgam po zhabs drung nor bu rgyan pa sogs skyes chen rnams kyis kyang de mtshungs kyi bsngags pa mdzad par 'dug /gnas der bzhugs thog sgam por spyan 'dren la lug ra lo tsā ba 'gror/ dwags lha sgam po'i gnas rten mjal ba'i dgongs gtad dang bcas phebs par zhal gyis 'ches/ de nas bkra shis mthong smon dang / byams chen du phebs/ gdan 'dren skyar nas byang ba ltar chibs kha bsgyur/ mkhar po brgyud ra la brgal ba'i grum lung gi phu rdzi sgam du yang ri'i thab 'dzin thog /phyag mdzod dar rgyas/ g.ya' bzang gnyer pa snga song dus 'gyur skabs srog skyabs pa'i drin gso 'bul bar byung / brku rab rnam rgyal du yang ri'i lo chen ska skye sogs chibs bsu gra 'grig dang / gnas gzhir dge 'dun lnga

brgya tsamakhyad gos kyi snam sbyar 'ba' zhig dang / mchod rdzas mchog tu bsngags par 'os pa du ma thogs pa'i bsu ba'i bkod pa legs par bstar/ bzhugs sgar gyi gzim gur mang po yang ri rang nas phub 'dug par spyan drangs/ kun dga' ra bar phebs dus drung pa rang phyi khyams su phyag 'bul la byoni/ skyes bu dam pa 'di 'dra bar bkur sti zhabs tog bgyid 'os pa rang yin zer gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag byed do/ /'du khang du yol ba bla re gos khyad can las grub pa du ma bres/ rten li ma gser dngul gyi sku 'dra mang po dang bcas pa'i mchod gzhom sogs dpal 'gror las byung ba'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dug /gral 'phros kyang thog mar drung pa rang gis rgyal ba nyid la zhus/ de rjes rin po che rdo rje gling pa dang 'bel gtapa dang shab 'dres pa'i sgo nas bzhugs gral gu yangs la rgod 'chor/ gzhi len phul du
