ra༅༅/ /phyin/ phar yang mang ja 'gyed rnam gzhag dang bcas pa rgyas par bstsal/ grum mda' tshun chibs skyel thab 'dzin dang bcas pa 'dug /sang de klu mkhar du gdung rgyad yum sras mjal bar byon pa la/ chos rje gong ma'i skabs bzhin gdung rgyud la ska bzhengs pa dang dbu thug tsam gnang / de nas rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i gnas marmig /dkar brgyad rin po che'i gdan sa chen po/ shar dwags lha sgam yo dpal sgya ri bo shāsti rgyal po'i pho brang gi mgul grub thob khams pa mi gsum la bla mas yar shog gsungs ma'i sa nas sgam po steng / grwa tshang pa/ sgrub sde sogs ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag lhag pa tsam gyis dkar brgyud kyi cod pan gzengs su mtho ba ni rgyan/ mchod pa'i bye brag phul du byung ba thogs/ sgo gsum g.yo ba med pa'i gsol 'debs drag pos mdun bsus/ gsang sngags pho

brang du phebs/ de nas spyan snga rin poche nor bu rgyan pa'am mtshan gzhan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug sgom sder bzhugs pa'i sar spyan 'dren pa byung / sngar nas dpon slob ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen pos thugs snang shin tu dag pa zhig yin cing / lhag par de dus sgam po nas dponi slob tsho'i khengs skyungs kyis ldem mjal dang phyag sogs dpon slob byes pa tsho rang gi dgongs pa la gang gtad zhu gsungs/ mjal 'phrad dus mjal dar dang phyag la su mgyogs mdzad pa sogs dag pa'i snang ba 'byams klas pa'i ngo mtshar chen pos khyab pa dang / thog mar spyan snga rin po che nas phebs lam gyi gnas tshul las brtsams gsung brtse'i dri ba ci yang zhu ba gnang ba la / rje nyid kyis gsung lan ji bzhin stsal te gsol ja mang po'i bar bzhugs/ mjal 'dzom thog skyes 'bul rgya cher mdzad cing / sgam po'i ri logs kyi dgon che phran

ra༅༅/ /tham sa cad la mang jo 'gyed bcas gzab ma bstsa bas je ras / gtsugre la lge khang chen mor rje zla 'od sa'on nu'i sku 'dra rin po che mthong ba don ldan la khyad gos kye ber thul sund 8 se dugs 4 chodang 'i rgyacharabashamacho/sa/dmang ri nga gnang/ gnari ri bye〉 rnga rngo byu dkar brgyad rin po che'i sgrub gnas du ma'i 'byung khungs zangs lung dpal gyi dben gnas suspan drangs pa'i phebs zherabreda'aphrang phugamo che sogasagazegs/ zengs lung du rterno 'brel gyi che bas chos gsan res kyi dgongs pa gtad/ sgam po zhabs drang nasatheng 'bul dgos kyang 'bu la/ tshur yang zhu gsungs pa la/ thog mar spyan snga rin po che la dbang chos 'ga' gsan/ lhag par dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi rme dbang grangs mang ba gsan zhing gter chos 'di nyid kyis rang re dpon slob kyi ska tshe'i rten 'byung 'grig go gsungs/ phar yang tshe dpag

med zhi ba lha mangs dang khro bo lha dga'i dbang sogs ji ltar bzhed pa ltar gnang / slar spyan snga rin po che rang gi gsan yig lung du stsal te kho bos gang thob pa thams cad kyang rje nyid kyis thob bo gsungs/ nang rten rnams zhigagazigs mdzad/ sku 'bum chen mor zhig gsos mdzad 'dug pa legs par grub pa'i rab tu gnas pa gnang bar da' slogaganyis ka phebs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i thog rdo rje'i mgur bzhes res mdzad pas der 'dus rnams la mos gas kyi 'a kha g.yos/ sgam po stengs su phebs tshe sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs can 'gas thog drangs brgya 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ zla ba tsam bzhugs/ spyan snga rin po cher rgyud 'bum gyi po ti lung dbang sogs stsal/ phebs lam du yang ri bas bkur sti zhabs rtog sngar bzhin zhus/ lto rgyad ral gsum gyi nas phud bzhes grub 'phral/ dpal bkra shis mthong smon 'phrul gyi

ra༅༅/ /gtsug lag khang chen nge rdzor phebs/ rngen cheragyis nyam/sa ri gso ba khri bang sogs gsar bzo phul du phyin pa grub 'dug par zhal gser spyan 'byed dbu mthing 'bul ba rnams phyag bsngaraganang / gzungs gzhags naXmatshogs nga di nga/ ska rgyar zangs/ la' grangs mang ba dang gzhu chad phud pa'i gser zho sum brgya gsol/ bal po la gser rkyang zho brgya nyeshus/gtsos byi4spos shel sogs gnang cha mgu ba 〉〉da pa dang do dam pa rnams la'ang gtang rag rgya cher bstsal/ de rjes khyad 'phags rin po che'i mchod rdzas/ gser dngul sogasarin po che du ma las grub pa rgya mchojo la gzhi lhas pa bslab ston ltar/ sprul sku sangs rgyas grags pas dpe stoni mdzad/ bal po za ma shring sogs kyis bsgrabs pa'i bzo khyad can de grub/ de nas gtsug lag khang rten brten rnga/ra bcas pa la rab gnas gnang bar mngon

du phyogs/ chos rje rin po che mi pham blo gros kyang rang shugs kyis phebs nas/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i las rim rgyas pa'i sgo nas rten lhag par gnas pa shis brjod brtan bzhugs kyimatha' brten yab sras gnyis dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas nyin mang po'i bar sbrel nas mdzad tshe byin rlabs kyi dge mtshan ngo mtshar ba du ma byung / bya rigs chos kyi rgyal po yab yum yang phebs/ dga' ston gyi nyin khrom chen po 'tshogs pa la dbang bshad sogs rgyal ba nyid kyis gnang rjes/ dbang bskur phyag len chos rje rin po ches mdzad/ gong ma chos kyi dbang phyug gis snyan bskul ltar mgon po lha mangs kyibargyud 'debs 'phromathud bstsal/ rgya mtsho grwa tshang gi bla ma chos rje chos 'khor ba dgongs pa grol/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims dbang por 'chad to bsko 'ja' gnang / chos kyi rje rgyal tshab dam par/ rje zla 'od gzhon nu'i khyad

ra༅༅/ /chos snyigs ngas rkya sulalton tshesacisanas rngo rje 'chang i sa ra 'khredapa'i la spe / ma/chos yang zab bla ma sgrub par grags pa/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos dwags lnga sgam me'i brasanyes / tha'adrab semasanas spa ra ngengs pa'e sanger chos desas nang mdzad jo/ /de nas byams chen chos gling nas rim gyis dngos grub 'byang ba tsa re tra'i rtsa song nga ma rtsa mchog ṅge sanas cigaX ra sdo phebs/ dwags kongagi g.yon mang pe 'dus par dbang chos byin rlabs so so'i 'dod pa bzhin stsal rjes rtse rā〉trer gyi gnas thegazigs lirshas par ma dzad/ de das mdo khams nas bla ma khams pas/ rten li ma khyad mtshar/ hor tshags kyi chibs chas spus gtsang ba sogs 'bul ba byas/ slar byams chen du bzhugs renga'asbre nang ka ru brag gi rtse g.yag po sga gdan nas/ tsa ri'i dag pa shrī na bun gyi gseb nas ze'u lha khang gi 〈sna dbye

ba ltar sgrib med du sku 'khor na yod pa rnams kyis kyang mjal zhing / rje nyid kyis rang byung gi mchod rten lha nyis stong brgyad brgya dang bcas pa legs par gzigs par 'dug /de dus ming lam gyi mtshan ma mi bsrun pa 'ga' zhig byung ba rnam rgyal lhun po sogs la blta bar 'dug gsungs/ zad byed de me pho stag lo tshes/ cho 'phrul gyi ring sku mtshams bcad rgya'i nges pa dam pa la bzhugs/ byang stag lung du zhabs drung rin po che ngagadabang rnam par rgyal gzhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su/ rten li ma/ sbug sil/ ja gos dar sogs stobs che ba 'gror bas mchod baspoyang dag pa gnang / slar gdung 'bul 'bul ba'i mi snar/ rdo rje gling pa rdzong ba mdzad/ bya pa'i zhabs drung khri pa lcam sring gi rten bzhengs su/ ston pa la nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba sgrab pa'i ljags bkod dang / gong ma chos kyi dbang

༄༅she /phyag nga ba sras nga/ sajerngo sasku ragyi chungabang brgaḥ rā josas ji rer sa/ri gtor chog rnying pa'i dbang bzhi rdal i gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas gnang / de nas ska zlotshar/ra bca dku rgyas/cingaX ri ri trī ra rī theb sarapa sa brngo pa ro ci/rgyangaze satsus rgyan sum po pa spyan snga mi ṅge'i / chos kyi dbang phyug sde pa re dga' bas spyan drangs sdurmi/ rgyal ba nyid mjar b.rachangarukanyer rgyabasi byam satshand thabs/ bsre ba'ibakong pa ci yang bstar/ zhag shas bzhugs ring / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha zhe dgu ma/ 'jam/ dpal phyagargyazi ro gasnan/ ya shesakye mgon po phyag ba'i pa'i dbang dkyil chog /rje gong ma chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i steng nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba gnang / (nar byung du lngabasnga sa myur rtsis kyi re'u mi ga che chung serdzogs sgrab tshul/ gza' lnga myur rtsis kyi spyi nor

'tshol lugs/ dus sbyor/ zhag gsum rnam dbye sogs kyi ri mo'i phyag khrid dgos tshul bzhin bzhed pa bskang / snga gong sgra ris gnang ba'i slob dpon zhig dgos phebs par/ rje nyid kyidangos slob lo chen lug ra ba rdzong bdar gnang ba las/ ka lā pa'i ri mo phul phyin gnang thub 'dug na'ang rnam dbye'i mtha' pu.o dang / kha skong āṇa sogs la dogs gnas 'ga' re 'khrungs 'dug pa/ sgrub tshul gyi sgo nas zhib bsed gtan la phab/ blo brtan bzhi pa'i 'grel pa 'di yang dgongs bde ba yodi pas tshar gcig bzhu ba gnang na 'gab gsungs phyi mo dang / mgon po lha mangs kyi sku thang rje nyid kyi phyag ris ma byin rlabs can yang thugs dam rten du 'bul ba gnang / tshur yang dkone mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bzhi tshe dbang dang bcas pa/ lam zab bla ma sgrab pa sogs phul zhing / mnyes gzhin pa'i phebs sgo sgam po zhabs

ra༅༅/ drang nas rarnga ze sa'isku 〉 rdu rtsa bde ri ci —ri — na ci'i'i chi ma ri b.risanges dzee rabasnga 0bso/las/ shir tu thub/sa snang dag pa byung / de nas sbam ngo 'basadrang lo rostod phyorgesakyi/bci ra sa sagrub/sa sna rdzo ci rī ri ci / shā ze/ sgru ba zu ri dzee shā pa sa dru ri/nge rī skarsārenanged che rdzong thogananganas bkra shis mthong sman du gang sar gzigs sheg zhib paramadzad ngos/ bstanas/ 'apel rgyas gyidathongasang bodasger pa rlo shā/ngabakakha drin khyongs/ da rgos tshul gnang / de mtshams nas phud bzhes nas chos rgyal gling du rten ba'engs/ grub pa'i zabaganas la/ spanadrangs / bde 4 rmyes bcu gsum/ ma'i sgo myos rab tu gnas pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi kha 〉(nga dang bcas pa mdzad/ bya zhabs drung yab yum snyel bkra shis/mthowa smo rno gyi zhabs tog tu'agyur ba ngagos pa'i bathakha stsal ngos/ kyis phebs pa ltar/ zhabs drung gangs dkar rnam rgyal

gyis grwa rgyun brgya lhag tsam dang bdag mo dpal mtshos sgrub sde'i sa thugs khag bzhes/ de nas rgyal yum mchog gis 'phyong rgyas grong gsar du spyan drangs pa ltar rim gyis chibs kha bsgyur ba'i rdo rje gdan du phebs thog sku la mi pi bzhes par brten/ grub dbang rin po ches sgar gyi gtso mdzad/ sde pa lhun rtse nas sogs sgar gyi drung 'khor las tshan rnams brdzangs/ rgyal ba nyid zhabs 'bring ba nyung bsdus dang bcas byar skyid phug tu phebs/ sku'i 'phrod bsten dpon tshang chos mdzad kyis phul/ sku si rang ljid po min pa 'dug rung mnyel gzhi'i steng du babs par brten/ sku shed gso dasha' ba tsam byung ba'i tshul bstan/ rab byung ste me mo yos lo gzims dpon chen mo dge slong pas zhabs tog zhus/ der ska mtshams zla ba gsum tsam dam par mdzad ring gtso bor ljags bsnyen 'khor lo bde mchog la gnang / ska mtshams grol

༄༄ /thosargyal /tsho grwa rangasing snangar ཿ rogs jid gis za nga rī spu ri ri ra3 na /ngas tre skab ma/chod btsugs pa grol bstan bka' dbang yang rgyas pa dang tshe ring ma ched snga re nt+ras sanang yaṃ ri stsawa / zi rī sa par bro ) ci ri ga ring kru sas twe smana'adrena'e rme bla ma rang 'byon pa 'byodro bar zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / rim pas byams chen du bebs thos /gzhin 'phraladang nga byedagyebadag/ mo'i sgya 'dra la krol rtsed dus/ ngan snyigs ma'i sems can gyi snang ngor shar bas/ lho nas gtsang du nged rang mchodad yen ma mthun pa 'i rtsa ba nang tshul gye ba mchu ma/rngabacad pa laXs shā yen/ da cha gtsang pas lugs mthun byed rgya yin na kha mchu 'di gcod dbertes gsung nan chags pa byung zer/ gtsang nas sgar du mi sna slebs/ zhes mas gsung rigs 'ji bzhin byung bas ska tshab 'phral rdzong jirsha|sa tshul zhu bar/ bka'

las/ gdan sa'i zhabs drung gdung rgyud rin po che'i phebs sgo 'di rnams/ nged rang gi tshe sngon gyi las las grub pa'i dgongs pa can dang dgongs min gyi gsung sna tshogasapa ma gtogs mtha' gcig tu nges pa rang e yod kyang mi shes pas/ da lam 'di skor la nged rang tshos mibatang yang ci byed las mi 'dug /kha rog bsdad pas mi cig thub zer ba'i dpe ltar gtsang du dgongs pa zhu mkhan zhig rang btang bas chog phebs par/ sgar gyi dbu che drung 'khor rnams bda' bgros/ des na gtsang du yang dgongs 'phog yong bas mi sna zhig btang ba 'gab pa dang / grwa tshang / sgrub sde/ phyogs stobazhugs pa'i bla ma dbu che thams cad la bapokha gros bskor ba 'thad zer/ bskor sbyong btang / chos rje rin po ches/ da lam gyi 'di bstan pa'i ska chags kho na yin pas/ gzhan 'di lathobs med/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams

go༅༅/ /dgongs pa mnyam pa'i gsol 'debs rang la 'bad dgos gsungs/ 'khor 'das dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bstan 'dzin thamasacad lhag bsam mnyam/ /sku tshe 'phrin las dpag med pas/ /'gro kun byang chub cher 'god shog /ces pa'i smon lam yang mdzad/ kong po nas chos rje rgyal dab pas/ 'di skor la ngas yar 'brog sgang du thab 'dzin gyi sgar bteg /phan tshun gyi dbu che bsam yod thams cad 'dzom nas/ bstan pa dpang du btsugs pa'i zhu spra'abul ba 'thad zer ba sogs bsam pa che ba'i snyan 'bul de rnams ba/kha gros pa rnams 'jig rten snang ngo'i dbang du song nas don thog tu ma khel/ slar skul byed rghaṃrkyen mang bas mi snar bslab don du/ lho nas zhabs drung rin po ches dgongs pa dang dgongs min gyi bka' bsgos ci 'dug kyang / nged rang tsho rgyal dbang gong ma'i spe

skye yin min la rtsod dgos pa ma byung / nged rang sems kyi de nyid rtogs zhen 'dod langs nas sku skye yin byas pa ni min/ rje gong ma de nyid kyi dbu che bu chen thams cad kyis ngos 'dzin mdzad/ rje bstan pa'i nyi ma rang yang phebs nas skra phud ni bzhes/ ming zhig kyang gnang / bsha' 'brel gyi tshe dbang zhig kyang gnang mdzad 'dug kyang bstan pa'i gegs kyis rten 'brel ha cang 'grigs pa rang ni ma byung 'dug /gang ltar de nas bzung rje gong ma phyogs gtogs kyi grwa yoni thams cad kyis/ rgyal dbang padma dkar po'i sprul pa'i sku yin no zer ba'i ming gi bla dwags 'di bkrus pas 'dag par mi 'dug /ngos rang la ni tshe gcig gto don gnyer ba la dkor dang rnam g.yeng che ba/ gdan sa'i dgongs pa la mi bde ba 'di las lod pa zhig ma byung / da cha gdan sa nas zhabs drung rin po che rang / rgyal dbang padma dkar po'i sngal pa'i

༄༄〉༅/ 〉yinaganangab la/ nged rang gis rtsod pa zhu rgyu mi 'dug/dgongs pa la yod paphyogs cha dang nye ring med pa skyong bstar zhig ni gnang dgos/de'i sku khag gtsang pas kyang bzhes pa zhig byubastun nas bsdad chog/'o nged rang la zhu tshig 'di las med pas/gzhan lab lab mang po byed mi dgos gsaphul tsha/skyes bu dam pa'i bka' rang 'dod dang phyogs lhung gi dri mas ma gos pa la thugs mgu yang /rnam smo mkhar bragapas/khyed dpon slob kyi grekhi gakho byed ngo mi dod pa 'di 'dra ci yin/lho nas 'phyong rgyas snyu

shudzod zer/ de'i 'khrul ma theg par/ gdung rgyud rin po che 'di gtsang pa rgya ras kyi tsho nas zhabs drung rin po che dang / thams cad mkhyen pa chen po phebs dgoso pa'i khra ma dzod/ mi sna rnams sku zhabs su 'gror te rgyu mtshan gnas tshul phul bas rje'i bdang zhal ngo la glang dar gyi dpe sogs 'dren pa 'di 'dra las gsog pa'i rgyur song 'dug smu pa'i ska min gsung ba dang / rtogs ldan lha rtse bas/ dbu che gzhan rnams la rgyu

ra༅༅/ /nor gyi rngan pa byin/sde pa lhun rtse nas dang 'brong rtse ba yang rgyu nor gyis bslus/sprul sku min pa la brdzun ma bcos/rje bstan pa'i nyi mas dbang zhig gnang 'dug kyang /rje mi pham chos rgyal gyi bslab stoni la/ da lam de la dbang zhig gyis/slar de dam nyams la 'bud pa'i khyad yong gsungs 'dug gsung ba sogs/zhabs drung rang gi ljags spod ma'i zhu khra sde srid dponi blon la phul 'dug pas/de'i lan mi 'bul lamed byung ba yin zhu bar/bapokha las/khyed tsho la lugasaganyis kur re de min tsalayod pa yin te/gdan sa'i zhu khra de ljagasaspod yin kyang dgongs pa ༅ dang dgongs min gyi dgos pa ci yod kyang khyed tshos gang shes/gdan sa'i phyag g.yog 'dras ngan rtsom yin yang srid/de rigs la rje gong ma yang thugs sun pa'i rnam pa byung tshul rnam thar na gsal bar 'dug pa/khong lta

nged rang la lta ci smos/ lar rang sku skye'i rtsod pa 'di/ yangs sa ru dog pa'i las kurang yin 'dug /chos rje rnam grags pa'i dris lan du rje 'i skye ba yin pa rnams kyi snang rore yin/ min pa rnams kyi snang ngor min/ yin par bsgrib dgoso pa'i ngal ba ma dgoso gsungs 'dugapa/ kha tse ga /gsung de yang ma 'ongs pa 'di rigs la yang dgongs par snang / rje lha rtse ba meegs/ rje gong ma'i dbu che mkhyen rtogs gnyis ldan gyi sa chen pos bstan 'gro'i don mdzad mkhan gyi skyes chen de rnams dang / sde pa lhun rtse nas sogs dad ldan gyi yoni bdag de rnams/ kun mkhyen la yid ches khungs btsun zhig ga nas byung yang de la skyabs su mchi ba ma gtogs/ rgya nor la ltas pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dam tshig khyad du gsod

ra༅༅/ /mkhan de 'dra min 'dug /lar zhabs drung gdung rgyud rin po che rang rje gong ma'i sprul sku yin par thugs thag chod na/rje bstan pa'i nyi ma 'grong rgyas su 'thi dgos pa'i rpā yang mi snang / nged kyi skra gcod pa ming 'dogs pa dbang bsgyur ba sogs gnang nas ci mdzad/rje mi pham chos rgyal gyi bslab ston yin zer ba 'di nged la gang min mdzad 'dod pa'i dgongs pa can gyi gsung ma gtogs/rje de nyad mar pa lo tsā'i sprul par grags shing /gzhan la phan dgongs kyi thugs rje can zhig las mtha' ngan de 'dra mdzad mkhan gyibla ma min nam bsam/rje gzhan don la dgongs khar/lhun rtsenas mtshams spyor gnang /bka' dbang chos zhu ba'i gsol ba bakha pas phebs sgo la de la'i dgongs pa cis kyang legs/de bzhin yin na/mi gon yang na so rgas/rgyan ring sdod pa'i chu med/'phul du shog

gsung ba'i ba/kha shog byung / yar chas yar 'brog tu slebs skabs/lha khang pa'i sde pa gshegs pa'i yar 'dren la yong dgos pa'i 'bod mi byung /nged rang gi bsam pa la gang la yong gci'i don du 'dug pas/gdan sa rang la 'gro 'dod pa tshad med pa byung yang /sde pa rdzong kha nas sogs sgar gyi tsho 'dzin rnams kyis bgros byas/lha khang pa bstan pa'i sbyin bdag yin pa la/'o brgyal skabs ma byon na mi yong zer/rang dbang ma 'dus par lho brag la khrid/tshur lam yong tshul gyi snyan cags btang bas/da lam sprul pa'i skyur bka' chos thogs shas shig 'bul thub na/bstan pa'i sa 'dir slebs che ba zhigayong ba yod de/rdzong kha nas sogs gdan sa la midaga' ba 'di rnams kyis rten 'bral 'di gang byas kyang 'grig tu 'jug par mi 'dug gsungs/sgar gyi bka' gros pa rnams la yang bskakha bkyon zhing shin tu ma

si༅༅/ /mnyes pa byung snang /'on kyang gang rtsol shog gsung ba'i phebs sgo byung bar/lho brag gi brel ba gang rtsol bcad nas yong rtsis la/rje gshegs pa'i gtam ngan byung /rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba rje 'di'i zhabs ma zin pas 'chugs pa zhig kyang byung /rje bstan pa'i nyi ma yang thugs ru ngar zhing zhal gsal bas thugs rgyal bzhengs pa'i thog/bka' bkod mtho rgyag dma' rgyag ci rigs gnang ba zhig 'dug pa ma gtogs gzhan ma nged rang lhun po rtser 'gro nor gyi thengs gcig rnyas gdan sar yang shog gsungs/skor tsam phyin skabs thugs skyon ma chags pa'i bsha' bkod kyang gsal po gnang zhing dgasnang yang bapokha drin bskyangs/lan rtseg rtse 'a du phyin skabagazhig/bas la sgar basmo ༅ rje nyid kyang dbus la phebs pa dang 'grigs/nged tsho yar yong ba'i skad cha gsan mthag/gdan sar 'bod

pa yin gsung bshar nas phebs 'dug kyang /nged rnams kha ror slebs pa dang 'grigs/srin lag tu rje rang yang thab 'dzin la phebs/thang der gdan sa la zhal gzigs pa'i bzhugs gdan gung gzhibs mdzad/g.yu legs pa gcig gis gtsos pa'i gnang cha bzang ba dang bcas mjal 'dzom shin tu thugs nang gtsang ba byung dus phebs sgo la/gdan sa ru snga 'phar btang ba'i nang gtsang byas phebs dgos rgyu la nang mi gtsang mdzad/rin po che 'jam dpal grags pa gdan sa dang thugs nang tsang ba'i khungs yin te/khyed kyang sgrigs ma kho ka mdzad byung gsungaswāskyu rtsed la snyad pa dang /sgar gyi badzi' gros pa rnams la gta bayo yang tho re gamadzad/de nas gsung gi tha ma/nged tsho gdan sa gog po 'dzin dgos pa 'dis/phyags bral gyi bstan pa la phan thogs cher thub par mi 'dug/khyed da' slobakyis phyogs bral

ra༅༅/ /gyi bstan pa skyong dgos gsungs bslab ston yang gnang / de nas mi 'gyang bar gzhan smo la dgongs pa zhig byung song /rje bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sku tsha'i smad la thugs snang dag tu song ba ma gtogs/dgongs par ma bde ba cher med de/phyis 'gal rkyen mang zhing mthun rkyen dkon gzhis bstan pa'i gegs 'di 'dra zhig byung song /lhag par da lam gtsang du ngag rgyag la phan tshun gnyis thad nas yong dgos pa'i khas len so so'i mi sna rnams kyis byas pa 'di 'dra/lho nas zhabs drung rin po che rang phan dang mi 'dra bas thugs tshod zhig los yod/da ni gtsang pa da' tsho rnams g.yo che bas blo bde po ma byung /ri 'ong blo ldan dang seng ge'i dpe ltar byas na phebs srid bsamapa'i gang min gyis sgrigs yod na/nged rang la ma lan pa'i khagagayogs mitsha las gtamatsha ring ba yong bas/khyed rang tsho ci

pe 'gro thag chod yin gsungs sku mtshams skyar sdem dam pa mdzad/ mi sna rnams la yang ngas bslabs pa bzhin ma byas/ ngan rtsom gyi zhu khra de 'dra nang khul gyi mdzes 'chor ba las kyang ches 'chor zhing ma shes pa chen po byung 'dug gsungs ma mnyes pa mdzad do/ /zhes ska gzhogs nye bar gnas pa /ga gi gsung las thos la/ 'di thad yig tshogs la ma 'dzems par zhib tsam smos pa'i dgos pa/ phyogs 'dzin can gyi skyi bo rnams lta ci/ gzur sne pa 'ga' yang / tshul 'di skor la/ log rtog gis bsod nams ma yin pa'i rgyur 'gro ba'ang srid pas de dag la brtsebs sgro skur spangs te bkod pa ba brgyad dpal ldan 'byug pa'i slob rigs dge slong ngag dbang chos rgyal dbang po sngon gyi bag chags sad par brten/ slob dpon chen po padma sasbya

ra༅༅/ /lus dngos nyams rmi lam mang por rjes su bzung ste/zab gter mtha' yas pa bzhes pas mtshan rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying por grags pa de bya pa gong ma yab sras kyis spyan drangs/yang rtse brgyud byams chen du phebs par dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gsang ba'i tshul gyis gsan/rig 'dzin chen po nyid la myang lugs kyi drag po dmar chen gyi dbang bzhi dang /drag dmar gyi po ti'i lung /gter mgon gyi dbang lung rnams gnang /de skabs shig gong ma rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug cung zad bsnyung ba tsam byung bar/phyag na rdo rje lha bcu gsum ma/rnam 'joms/tsha dpag med dkar po lha dgu ma rnams kyi bka' dbang gnang 'phral bsnyan las grol/grab dbang rin po che dpon slob rnams gra 'grig cing gdul 'phrin gong 'phel nas/dbus phyogs 'khor ba'i

brgya 'bul stobos che ba byams chen byang gi bzhugs khri chen mor bzhes so// //bsngags 'os bsod nams mthu las yongs grub rin thang dpag dadzi'i rin po cher/ /bi sha'i 'du byed rnam 'phrul pir gyis ngo mtshar bkod pa'i gzugs brnyan bkra/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i mchod sdong mchog tu rgyal bas lung bstan bsngags pa'i gnas/ /dpal ldan dwags po'i dkar brgyud zhes grags grub mchog yongs kyi bsti gnas der/ /rgyal kun rgyal ba'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gzugs/ /rnam med rnam pa'i mes klung du 'char ba/ /tshad med tshad kyis gzhal ba'i yul 'das phyir/ /blo chung blo yis dpag par ga la nus/ /gangs ri'i dpal 'dzin gnyis 'thung 'gying 'dra'i ngogs/ /dga' ldan snang cha 'phos pa'i gtsug lag khang / /thub dbang gser gyi lhan po dang bcas pa/ /skye 'gro'i legs byas spel ba'i zhing du bskan/ /

ra༅༅/ /phyogs 'dzin phrag dog du ba'i ral pa can/ /snyigs ma'i rnam 'gyur mi srun 'bar ba'i mes/ /bsregs kyin bzang po'i 'od 'byin dag pa'i gser/ /chen po'i zur phud mdzas pa'i rgyan du gyur/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/phul du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin skye 'gro'i mchod sdong dam par lhun gyis grub pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de skabs khro phu dga' ldan byams pa'i gling gi chos grwa nas/sdom gsum gzhung 'grel bsre 'pho 'grel chen sogs rgyugs 'bul bar bdag sogs grwa pa na gzhon 'ga' yang yod/chugs 'bul bzhes rjes/rgyal ba dam pa'i bka' las/sgra tsand+ra pa'i ri mo 'di da/kha bar brten gtong mi nyung bas

rgyun yang nub dogs 'dug gdang bcas/ khyod kyi shes rab dang 'dun pas lcogs pa tsam yong shas kha bas cis kyang slobs shig gsungs/ zhwa'i sa ris slob pa'i mthun i sne sbyor sogs thamasacad sku gzhogs nas gnang ste byar stag rtser lo 'a pradzñā shrī'i ma' ༅ la bdagagis yongs su rdzogs pa zhus so/ /rpā gyer 'gas gsol gabakha ngor/ gong ma chos kyi dbang phyug sogs la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyis pa lkog pa'i dbang bdun/ gong mche chung / rdo rje slob daphro bdag po 'a tsho dbang gi bar yongs su rdzogs rpāstsal/ pad dkar grwa tshang pa sogs la lagazab kyi smin ba/'a rgyas pa mdzad/ de lo bkroshis mthong smon gyi khor yug gi lcags ri/ grwa rgyan so sor spyi khang / bde 'a 'byug rgyas su sgrab pa'i sde gsar 'dzugs sogs bya pa zhabs drung 'gyur med lhan grub kyis do dam mdzad legs par gyub pa'i

ra༅༅/ /rab tu gnas pa/dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba lha mangs kyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rdul tshon gyi las rim rgyas pa'i sgo nas zhal phye sgrub cing mchod pa dang sbrel lhag par gnas pa zhag mang po'i bar du mdzad tsha/bskang gtor las bdud rtsi sbrang rtsi'i nying khu lta bu'i rgyun ci yang babs pa sogs dge mtshan mang po'ang byung /grol ston la bya rigs chos kyi rgyal po yab yum drung 'khor dang bcas pa dang /bla ma dbu che sgar grwa sogs skal ldan gyi tshogs pa stong nyis brgya tsam la/dbang cha snyas su mdzad de/sta gon/dngos gzhi bde 'a thugs gsung gi lha so so'i dbang /sku 27 gyi mgos po rnams kyi dregs pa'i srog dbang dang bcas pa rgyal ba nyid ska drag po'i chagasu zhugs te shin tu rgyas pa stsal/byin rlabs kyi zil mtshungs pa med pas byang chub

sko du gnyer ba dag la mi mthun bdud kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i bka' drin mdzad/ de mtshams bod yul gyi mda' bsnun gnyis pa kun spangs rje'i sgrub gnas / sgrub pa'i sde gsar du btsugs pa'i mthun rkyen bzang po rgyal ba nyid kyi dgongs bzhed bzhin bdag mo dpal mtshos thugs khur bla lhag tu bzhes/ myang skyid sbug ba sde nas sgom chen zhe bcad ma dman pa grangs ldan lo gsum nas brje len dang / grib mtshams smra bcad 'dag sbyar shin tu dam pa'i sgrig srol sogs dkar brgyud nga ma'i phyag bzhes las mi 'gong ba dgos tshul bka' stsal pa bzhin legs par grub/ bsam gto gyi khang bu gsar du grub pa rnams la gzigs rtog phyag nas nang / kun spangs rje la lab kyis mas zab mo'i gdams pa bstsal cing gyub pa'i slob da' brgyad cu rtsa bzhi mchog la dngos dang / dman pa dag la'ang bya rgod du

ra༅༅/ /sprul nas rje gong ma na rim phebs skabasakyi dus kyang byung ba bzhin/ 'di res kyang tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ mgron spyan 'dren gyi thugs 'dun gtad pa tsam gyis/ lho phyogs kyi mkha' las bya rgod brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs kyi nges pa ༅ 'ongs te bag phebs par nye 'khor der 'khod cing 'dug pa las/ tshur mthong giskye bo dag kyang dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing yid ches kyi mchi ma 'khrugapa de lta na/ zhabs 'bring na gsod pa'i gang zag dam pa rnams la ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo chi yang yod par mngon zhing / rje btsun dam pa nyid kyis zhi khro rgyal ba rab 'byams dang / mchog gi sa la rnam par rtse ba'i grub pa'i slob dpon de dag gi zhal ma' sum du nges par gzigasaganyid do snyam du dpyod ldan rnams rtogago/ /de nas bkra shis mthong smon gyi mgon khang rnying pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba der rten

gtor thog tshad tsam phyag bzo gtsang mar mdzad/rgyal ba nyid rang gi ljags stong nas bskang ba brgya rtsa sang bas ltas ma' yang legs par byung gsungs/༅la lor byar gsum gyi nas phud bzhes nas gsang gling du phebs/bla ma lha khang gi rdzo rtsi dang 'grungs rabasas gnyis phun sumatshogayo༅ rim pa ltar/bya sku skye rin pochesado dgamadzad/sprul skyasangasargyasagrags pas legs par bzhengs pa'i rabatu sasapargyasapar stsal/dus gtor dang bstun 'jam dpal tsha bdag nag i dkyil 'khor rdul rdzo gyi sgo nagazhal phye/sgrub 'a dang 'brel bas skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i tshogs chen por dbang skur rgyas pa stsal skabs/thugs 'dun gtad pa'i bam zhag mang por chud mi 'dza' ba sogs ngo mtshar ba ci yang byung / dam can rgya mtsho mchod sprin bdud dgra tshar gcod ces pa'i bzhes sgra de yang de dus su

ra༅༅/ /gnang / rnam byung ste sa pho 'brag lo/ gsang gling rtse'i gzims spyil khyab gdal chen mor bcad rgya sku lo mtshams kyi nges pa la bzhugs/ stod nas chos rje ngag dbang thogs med/ gro sgordo dbon po sogs dang / mdo khams nas bla ma bstan 'phel ba'i dgo po stag gu ras pa da' slob dang bcas pa 'byor/ soso'i 'bul ba rgya che ba bzhes/ zhal gdams dbang chos sogs 'dod sbyar stsal/ de skabs drung pa si tu rin po che zhes dmi pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po de re dgazha nas kyi yar 'dren la byon dus/ byapas nas mo rdzong du spyan drangs/ de nas byar smad be'u kha dang byar po nags dgon sogasakyi gnas gzigs la phebs nor gsang gling du'ang gdan drangs/ ska gnogs kyi rten mchod rnams la gzigs rtog zhib pa dang / lhag par khyad 'phags rin po che bzhugs khang dang rgyal ba'i

mdzad pa bcas pa la shin tu bsngags pa che bar mdzad/ sngags grwa gsar pa'i bla ma bsam gtan bstan 'dzin grongs rjes/ slar bla ma'i 'os mthu sna tshogs pas thugs sun gyi mchod rpāphul kyang / phyi lo chos rje dar ma sgang pa bstan pa dar rgyas la bsko 'ja' shis brjod kyi 'phreng ba bcings pas bstan pa la phan par byung ba yin no/ /de skabs shig bku' las/ sgar 'dir yang rje gong ma'i dus sgrig legs par byung 'dug cing / da cha ngos rang sems chung ba dang bcas/ phal cher gyis brnyas bcos byed pa zhig 'dug mod kyang / chang khrims sogs med mi rung du snang bas/ sgrig yig tshogs gtapa mang po sngar yang song ste chos dang mthun pa byed mkhan dkon pa 'dug ces/ dgongs pa can gyis zhe dam nyer gcig ma 'di gsungs so/ /ngag la dbang ba'i byin rlabs nor bu'i gter/ /bdag gir mdzad pa'i dran mchog rje bla

ra༅༅/ /ma / /rin po che ltar dpal gyi 'byung gnas mchog /bzang por grub pa rnam gnyis gang der 'dud/ /gsor bar 'khyams pa'i slob 'bangs tha shal bdag /snyigs dus las ngan spyod pas gtses 'di na/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis ma bor rtag gzigs la/ /bsam don myur du 'grub pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /deng dus bstan par snyad pa'i brel g.yeng dang / /'khos chung chen po'i go sar steg pa dang / /ming tsam bla ma'i khur gyis dub 'di na/ /gcig pur ri la sdod pa zhe dam yin/ /bcas pa'i tshul khrims nyes pa'i skyone gyis nongs/ /tha snyad shes byar sbyangs stobs rab tu dman/ /gnas lugs rang mtshang rig pa'i re ba zad/ /da ni dben par yib pa zhe dam yin/ /rang don mngoni du ma gyur gzhan don 'dis/ /gzhan mar mi phan rang la gnod par nges/ /bdag gzhan gnyis phung las 'di spangs nas

su/ /sems kyi bzhugs tshul blta ba zhe dgayin/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin mi bsrung bar/ /ltar snang tsam gyi chos bshad dbang bskur des/ /bstan par phan pa'i cig shos 'byung nye bas/ /chos brgyad khengs grags spong ba zhe dam yin/ /dbang bsgrur gnas pa'i mthu dang smono lam dang / /sngoni las thams cad 'dus pa'i rang gzugs las/ /lan chags sgeg pa'i cho 'phrul 'di bsam rung / /blo :sgrub la gtod pa zhe dam yin/ /rang nyid bla ma'i tshul du gnas pa la/ /'khor slob phal cher ban ma hor 'drar song / /gnyis med seng ge'i rnam thar 'di bsam rung / /mi med ri khrod 'grim pa zhe dam yin/ /chos min bstan pa bzhig la dpa' bor rtsi/ /snyoms chung chos mthun ma lus khyad du gsod/ /la g.yogs bden par yong ba 'di bsam rung / /sna thag mgo bor dkri ba zhe dam yin/ /rang gi 'dun gros mngon

ra༅༅/ /sum gsal bzhin du/ /gzhan la 'gran 'dod bsam pa lhag par 'phel/ /pags byi'us rbede la steg 'dra 'di mthong rung / /chags sdang nyon mongs spong ba zhe dam yin/ /rang rang bcol ba'i bya ba rgyab tu skyur/ /ma bcol las kyi rim pa dang du len/ sha ba yu mo'i mjug ma mang mthong rung / /rang don rang gis sgrub pa zhe dam yin/ /zang zing longs spyod mnga' thang ma lus kun/ /rang rang bsod nams mthu las grub mod kyang / /nga che nga btsan sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /'du long rnyed pa spong ba zhe dam yin/ /kha rog mi smra 'dug na lkug par mthong / sha tsha bden pa'i gtam la nyan mkhan med/ /ji ltar bgyis kyang snyad 'dogs 'di mthong rung / /dpon med g.yog med byed gzhe dam yin/ /dngos su legs nyes mi smra kha 'jam la/ /lkog tu shub bur 'bu zhing bshe ba sogs/ /ngo lkog gnyis

'gros spyod pa mang mthong rung / /kha dang zhe phugs bstan pa zhe dam yin/ /gnyes par bskyangs pa'i tha ma dgra ru ldang / /ma tshor rgyab nas sros pa ha ma go/ khye nang 'bral pa'i 'khor lo 'di mthong rung / /thams cad btang sgoms 'jog pa zhe dam yin/ /sdom pa dam tshig mi bsrung btsun pa dang / /ngo tsha gzhung bsrang bral ba'i mi chozlo sogs/ /dran tshad lag thog len pa mang mthong rung / /bas mtha'i nags tshal sgeg pa zhe dam yin/ /mi dang 'dod pa bstan na zin pa med/ /blo 'brid snyan snyan gtam dbang mi gtong bar/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dus kyi 'gyur ba dang / /sngar byas ma brjed sems pa zhe dam yin/ /rang skyon ri bo tsam yang lkog tu sbed/ /gzhan skyon ska rtse tsam yang mdzub rtser len/ /'gyel pos yon por 'cha' ba 'di mthong rung / /rang skyon mtshang nas 'don pa zhe dam yin/ /sngon rabs mang po'i las

ra༅༅/ tsā'i sbyo dag la/ /'byung ba 'phel zad 'khrugs pa'i rkyen byas te/ /sman dang sman ltar zas skom bcos 'dis na/ /nad kyi rgyu dngos spong ba zhe dam yin/ /dbang po'i dwangs ma mig la rab rib dang / /so yi 'phreng ba tha ra tho rar song / /mgo bor rgas pa'i pho nya skra dkar slebs/ /da ni 'chi chos bgyid pa zhe dam yin/ /'bad nas zang zing g.yeng ba byas gyur kyang / /zin pa med pa'i 'bras bus dben pa'i steng / /mgu med 'khang ba 'ba' zhig la bsam nas/ /thams cad cam de 'jog pa zhe dam yin/ /dbyar dgun char lhags 'dzem med 'khyams pa 'di/ /sgar smyon rnams ni gso ba'i thabs su bas/ /da dung lab pa'i rten mar bgyid mthong rung / /snying nas zon skyor sems pa zhe dam yin/ /gzhan mar blta ba'i mig dang ldan mod kyang / /rang nyid blta ba'i me long med 'dis lan/ /rigs mthun

thams cad gcig tu tshogs nges pas//gzhan skyone bzhi nas migleng zhe dmayin//de ltar zhe dmanyer gcigabacasapa'adi//gegs med lhun gyis 'grub nas tsha 'di la / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob nges pa'i/ /dngos grub myur du stsol cig rje bla ma/ /zhes snyigs ma'i snang tshul mang du mthong ba'i rkyen gyis khyab gdal 'a mor thun gseng la reg zig bgyis pa'o//zhes so//de nas lo gcig bcad rgya shin tu dam pa la bzhugs/mgoni po'i bsnyen chen gnang dus bsnyen rtags ngo mtshar ba mang po dang /khyad par dpal las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gyis/badzi' rtags kyi cod pan spyi bor bcings te 'phrin las sgrub par dam bcas/'di skabs gzim chung gi steng dang rṣa yug phal cher bya rog snam zhing che bas 'khor mor khengs pa kun gyis mthong zhing /chos skyong rang gis bskal ngor gtor chog 'phrin las

ra༅༅/ /myur 'grub zhes pa'ang mdzad/ljags bsnyen gyi mthar sbyin sreg kyang gnang /sku mtshams grol skabs gong ma rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug phebs/gtsug lag khang du chos skyong 'khor dang bcas par gtang rag gi gsung chog zhag mang por sbrel ba gnang /klu sdings su zhabs kyi padmo bskyod de rten 'bul gyi rem pa yang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gzhin rje'i mdun sa khyad par du byas pa ltar bsnas par mdzad/grub dbang sprus pa'i skus dus 'khor bsdus rgyud rgyugs 'bul mdzad/nas mor spyugangs dkar rnam rgyal gto zhal gyis spyan drangs/bka'i bdud rtsas tshim par mdzad de gong ma ran po che dang mchod yoni lhan cig par byams chen chos kyi gling du phebs pa dang dus mtshungs/chos rje rin po che mi pham blo gros phebs/'di nyid kyis bskal ngor gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang cho ga rnying pa zhig

'dug pa de la gzhi mdzad nas gsung rtsom gnang /stag lung rin po che nas brgyud pa'i ba/'a gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang /rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang /phag mo'i byin rlabs/spyi 'dus kyi tsha dbang sogs gsan/de skabs gong dkar sku gnyer dpon paṇa chen chos mdzad pa rje'i zhal dkyil mjal gdang gsung gi bdud rtsi myang bar 'gror/rtse nas brgyud pa'i rtsa 'cham 'di khungs btsun zhing rgyun bzang bas legasapa 'dug gsungs sku gzhogs pa rags rim la slob pa'i zhal bkod gnang /phur pa'i rtsa tshig 'jamadapalatsha bdag gidakyil 'khor rgyas pa dang sbyar/legs par 'khril nas rgyal ba nyid kyi zhabs phyir zhabs drung gong ma rin po che gtso bor bzhugs pa'i gsung chog gsung mi chad gnang /las rim rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i 'cham gyi gzigs mo phul tsha dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal kunda'i ge sar ltar phye

ra༅༅/ /bar gyur to/ /der rgyal ba nyid kyis mkhan po/ chos rje rin po ches las slob mdzad nas yang rtse sngags grwa'i slob da' bstan pa dar rgyas sogs bsgrub bya mang po bsnyen par rdzogs shing / de rjes bkra shis mthong smon du sde srid lhun rtse nas rgyal bu sogs mang po dge slong gi dngos por sgrub pa'i bsha' phrin mdzad/ grwa tshang par gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang / cho ga gsar pa'i ljags lung stsal to/ /de nas sprul lo'i dgung dog sel phyir lha sar phebs bzhed/ dgun bkra shis mthong stso1na nas e chu mtsho brgyad/ brag lar phebs dus srid pa'i lha chen yar lha sham pos rnam mkha' gdugs 'jam zhing bkra shis pa'i rtags kyi re khās mtshan pa'i 'ja' sprin sogs ngo mtshar spyo bkur sti ci yang bsgrabs/ yar 'grong brgyad grong gsar lumbi nī'i tshal du phebs thog pho brang chen po sne'u

sdong rtse nas spyan 'dren pa 'gror/ btsan thang 'bum mo cher sde srid phag mo gru pa da' tsho gyis thab 'dzin dang chibs bsu'i bakho pa/ rtser phebs gdong tshogs wo pa sogs dge 'dun mang pos mchod pa'i rdzas bsngags par 'os pa thogs pas mdun bltas te pho brang chen por phebs/ zhag shas bzhugs/ sde srid la dbang chos thugs bzhed bzhin stsal te/ rnam sras gling dang / gra phyi spel dmar du phebs/ der 'khrul zhig bkras gling pas sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs byas 'dug par/ bkra shis chos gling zhes dgon par ming 'dogs dang 'khrul zhig rang la bsko 'ja' gnang / mgan rtsar zhag bzhugs sar mtshan mo mun pa'i smag rum la mar me sogs med par sku'i dkyil gsor gyi 'od zer kho nas mtha' dag gsal ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ rim gyis pel mda' sogs sa tshigs rnams su skya ser gyi 'dus pa chen po rnams zhal mjal

go༅༅/ khyen rlabs kyis re ba bskang ste/ 'od yul dbus 'gyur 'chang gi rdo rje gdan/ dpal 'phrul snang gi asar phebs/ 'ongs stod zhing khar bzhugs sgar mdzad/ nyin re bzhin jo mjal la phebs/ rten gsum rnams la dkar me snyamadang / lhag par jo bo rin po che shwakya mu ni la zhal gser gdan zhus rgyal ba nyid kyis phyag bstar gnang / nub gcig zhabs 'bring bache'i sku drung du bzhugs/ de dus so skye'i blos dpag par dka' ba'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang rten 'brel ci yang 'grigs par snang zhi gsol ba btab ngor smini lam tshigs bcad 'di gsungs so// //rgyal kun thugs rje'i spyi gzugs 'phags mchog gi/ /sbyo

'phel nor/ /yongs 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po zhabs brtan zhing / /bzhed don ji bzhin myur du 9 sgro lam bco brgyad las lhag pa'i/ /khor yug dang bcas 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu/ /'phrin 'arol gli /phyogs las rnam rgyal srid la dbang bsgrar te/ /yangs pa'i phyogs rnams kun tu nd+rabazung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /khyod zhabs padmo bsnyen dang mi 'bral zhing / /dgongs dorno shog /mdor na bzang ngan 'brel ba thogs gyur pa'i/ /sems can lam sog btang sgoms shā

ra༅༅/ /'dzin pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa dang / yang lhun rtse nas zhabs drung rgyal bus gsol ba btab ste 'di stsal to/ /bdag gis bgyis dang bgyid 'gyur bgyid pa yi/ /dge tshogs yar gyi zla bzhin 'phel ba'i mthus/ /sgrib gnyis lan chags phung po byang gyur te/ /myur du pha rjes zin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bu slob 'khor du gtogs pa'i 'dus pa kun/ /bag yod tshul gnas thos bsam sgom la 'bad/ /dpon slob rten 'brel 'grig cing dam tshig gtsang / /bsam don gcig nges chos bzhin spyod gyur cig /chos brgyad hor 'dra'i tshul las blo ldog cing / /phan par 'doms rnams ji lta bzhin smo pa'i/ /sgo nas gzhan skyon mi blta rang skon 'don/ /ming don mthun pa'i btsun pa nyid gyur cig /dkar brgyad gong ma'i rnam thar srol bzang po/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas zin gyur

nas/ /ji srid rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob kyi bar/ /gegs dang bar chad 'gal rkyen zhi gyur cig /mdor na bzang ngan lan chags 'brel thogs pa'i/ /ris med lus can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i 'dren pa dam par bdag gyur te/ /yang dag mtha' nyid mngon du byed par shog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang / /sngon gyi smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor dang / /bdag cag lhag bsam bzang po'i bden tshig gis/ /smon lam bakha 'di myur du 'grub gyur cig /de nas dgung lo so bdun pa dashar po zhes pa sa mo sprul lo shar/ cho 'phrul dus chen gyi ring bzhugs sgar rang du sku mtshams dam pa la bzhugs/ grol nas bstan pa spyi'i rim gror dgongs chos skyong gi gtor bzlog cig gnang bas nag tsho rtsa lag zhi bar mdzad do/ /zhal 27 blta bar khrom chen po 'khor mor tshogs pa la i re bzhin

༄༅༅/ /tshogs chos su rgyal po bka' 'bum stsal/khyim pa mang por bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa lan grangs du ma dang /rtse gdong pa'i phyag mdzod pa dang stag lung pa'i 'bul sdud pa sogs sog yul 'khor ba'i mjal mi mang po la/bla ma'i rnal 'gror dang thugs rje wo po'i sgom bzlas gnang /bzangasdings sgraji sde dang daspyan brgyud chos sdings su/chos rje sku skye dang /bla ma 'gro mgon dpal grags pas spyan drangs/skya ser gyi tshogs chen po zhal mjal byin rlabs sogs sa tshim par mdzad/zhar la bla ma zhang g.yu brag pa'i gdan sa tshal dang gung thang gi gnas gzigs la phebs/mgoni khang rnams la gzigs rtog zhib mo dang /'phrin las bcol ba mnga' gsol gyi spyan gzigs sogs stsal/ska 'bum chen mo zhig gsos byas 'dug par phyag nas dang /tshal gyi gdan sa par mgon po'i dbang bzhi

gnang / khong gisazhusangor mgoni po'i brgyud 'debs 'phro 'thud stsal/ de res lha sar zla ba lhag tsam bzhugs/ phebs khar bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi dzol mtshan yang der phebs/ ja 'dren gyi skyes gzab ma gnang res dang / skabs shig jo mjal la phebs pa dang dkon gnyer rnams paṇa chen rin po che phebs bsu la song ba 'grigs/ dkon gnyer sgug dgos pa 'dra zhu bar jo 'o shākya mu sna'i lha khang gi lcags drwa rang bye la song nas thogs med phebs chog pa'ang byung ngo / /rim gyis snye thang 'or brgyud spus ri sgra gag gyi gtsug tor srin po ri'i bde mchog lha khang du phebs/ de nub shrī tsakra sasba ra'i sku drung du bzhugs/ sang de chu lha lo hi rdzi phar 'gram nor bu gling zer ba'i lcang tshal na/ yongs 'dzin rin po che dpon slob phebs/ bkur sti dang bcas pa'i bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po legs par

go༅༅/ /bstar te bde chen chos 'bor du spyan drangs/phebs spro phul du phyin pa dang /sprul pa'i sku'i ljags steng nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang po'i rgyugs 'bul mdzad/de mtshams yongs 'dzin rin po che dang /grub dbang rin po che gnyis gtso bor bzhugs pa la/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig/thub dbang bstan pa'i srog shing /kun mkhyen 'brag pa rin po che padma dalan po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i bka' 'bum rin po che'i ljags lung gnang ba'i dbu tshugs/sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis la sger bye dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang dang /phyag 'a gyi khrid gnang /khrom chos kyang wo re bzhin chag med stsal/snga gong 'gro mgon bkras dbang sgar nas mdo khams kyi 'bul sngad la brdzangs pa 'khor/ja gos dar sogs brgya 'bul rgya cher byas/sgomado ba ska skye rin po che dang /sde pa rta ra

mdo pa sogs gzhis rka' drung 'khor skya ser thams cad kyis sri zhu legs par bgyis/ tshe bka' sogs so so'i 'dod bzhin stsal/ he ru ka rdzing kha pa'i sku skye 'brog sgog mkhar ba'i sras su 'khrangs zer ba de phyag 'bul la byung yang / grwa pa 'gas cal sgrog min pa skye bar thugs yid ma ches pas btang snyoms su 'jog pa mdzad/ rgyal byed mdo grwa'i mchad nyan du rab 'byams pa bstan pa rgyal mtshan bskos/ grum pa g.yu mtsho ba'i 'bul ba bzhes/ khong tshor bla ma drag po gī la ya'i byin rlabs dbang bskur dang / bde mchog mai tri snyan rgyud kyi ljags lung gnang / de'i tshe yang ri ba brku rab nas/ gtsang la bteg gong dkar du 'gror par/ dge 'dun sgyi sor mang 'gyed/ drung par ja 'dren rngo thogs pa dang bcas drung yig pa brdzangs/ de res zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs/ lugs smad bkra shis sgang tshun yongs 'dzin

ra༅༅/ /rin po che dpon slob kyang byon/ de nas rje jog pa'i gdan sa gzhung sprel zhing mjal bar phebs/ de nub mar pa'i gdung khang sku gzhogs su bzhugs pas rten 'brel gyi sgo legs par dbye ba'i dge mtshan khyad par can yang gzigs/ gnas gzhi gong 'og gi rten gsum so sor mchod pa'i bye brag mang po dang / lhag par ye shes kyi lha mo dud sol ma'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can de la snyan dar gtor 'bul dang 'phrin gsol rgyas pa gnang / rngog pa'i zhal ngo khri thog pa 'jam dgrangs 'od zer dgung lo dang thugs dam zung du smin pa des/ rngog stoni byang chub dpal ba dang / mtshungs med rgyal dbang rje nas bzung dpal ldan 'brug pa dpon slob dang thugs 'brel chags sa rang yin pas/ nged tsho la mi ngo zla thung ba dang bcas gang sar spyan ras kyis btsa' ba dgos tshul sogs nang ma'i snang tshul zhu don du

/ra rtsar bzang yul grong gsar ba/ rgyal gling du tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa sogs so sos bsnyen cing bkur/ de nas smu pa'i sku dpon slob kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas te don grub mthong smon du spyan drangs/ bkur snyi'i khyad par du ri/ sger so /sor chos sbyin gang 'tshams dang / khyad par sprul pa'i skur rab byung gi tshul khrims dang / lam zab mo bla ma rgosum ma'i dbang bzhi rgyas pa/ drag po phur zhabs can dang / rdo rje gtum po'i dbang / ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi su gnang ba sogs stsal/ grwa mdar yongs 'dzin rin po che dpon slob zhabs phyir 'gror/ de res dpal bsam yas

ra༅༅/ khye gtsug lag khang chen po mjal bar phebs/ bu tshal gyi nye logs klu dbang tshal du bzhugs sgar mdzad/ dbu rtse chen mos gcos pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang / byang chub chen po sogs rten gsum rnams mchod 'os rgya mtshos legs par mchod/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang sems can la bde skyid 'byang ba'i smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor gnang / mchims phur phebs/ gu ru phug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ der bla ma rdzogs chen pa phyag 'bul la byung / slarjo mthil du phebs tshe/ pe dkar lcog tu spyan gzigs snyan dar ci yang bshams te chos skyong chen por bstan pa bsrung ba'i bsha' bsgo 'phrin gsol gnang / de nas brag ga sde pa bde legs rab mdzes pas spyan drangs/ dga' bde tshal du bzhugs sgar phab/ zla ba tsam bzhugs te/ skya ser gyi 'dus

pa tshad med pa'ang chos kyibadud rtsis tshim par mdzad rjes/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod la phebs/ grwa tshang gnyis kyis gtsos ri pa rnams kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa khyad par du gyur pas bsus/ mchod khang chen mo/ 'jag spyil sogs gnas rten rnams la mchod rdzas kyi 'phreng ba legs par bstar te srid zhi'i dge legs gong spel du mdzad/ gzhis byes kyi grwa tshang rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'gror dang bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon dkyil gyi lung sogs stsal/ der sde pa lha rgya ri bas spyan 'dren pa 'gror/ klusang gru nas sde pa dpon blon gyis chibs bsu/ dwags po grwa tshang ba sogs dgon sde phan tshun gyi ser sbrengasargyas pa bstar te/ cha dashar du phebs/ sde par tshe dpag med kyi chos skor tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ phyag chen/ chos drug /ro sgoms sogs zab khrid 'gazha yang stsal/ 'bangs rnams kyang dad

ra༅༅/ /pa che bas zhal skyin mjal ba dang / bsnyen gnas/ ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sogs zhu mi grangs med pa nyin re bzhin lhags/ dpon 'bangs thams cad 'brel tshad don ldan gyi dpal la bkod/ lha bris pa 'ga' dang bcas bya pa sku skye rin po che gsang gling gi shing rtsi ldebs bris kyi do dam du rdzong ba gnang zhing de res legs par grub/ de nas sne'u sdong rtser phebs lam nyang po gru khar brag kha nas sde pa ma chen phyag 'bul la byon/ nged kyi tshe phyi ma'i re sa rje nyid dang / zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa las gzhan med pas thugs rje'i skyabs 'og nas mi 'dor ba mkhyen/ zhes gus pa'i zhu mchid ci yang bzhesal ba ltar zhal gyis bzhes/ de mtshams sde srid phag mo gru pas bsu ba'i bkod pa chen pos skyed tshal nor bu gling du spyan drangs/ tshes bcu zhig dang bstan rtser spyan 'dren zhus/ las rim dang 'brel ba'i gar

'cham gyi gzigs mo dang bkur snyi khyad par can bsngags par 'os pa grub rjes/ mchod yon lhan rgyas shel brag gi gnas gzigs la phebs/ slobe dpon padma'i gzims phug tu ska mtshams zhag gsum pa zhig mdzad dus/ ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs pa 'ga' yang byung b.rabadug /btsan thang dang khra'abrug zhor la gzigs nasaslar pho brang chen por dmo tshe/ gzhis ka zhig gsos mdzad 'dug par phyag nas gnang / gtsang nas dge slong bzang skyong slebs/ khro phu'i mkhan po chos rje rgyal ston dbang phyug rgyal po zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul ba dpangs mtho ba dang / sku gzhogs grwa tshang bar sman yol sogs spyi rdzas su sbyar/ grong gsar du gdan drangs/ 'grong rgyas kyi skyaser tshang mas gas 'dud dang bkur snyi chen po legs par zhus/ lhag par thang po che'i chos skyong skyes bu'i lus la brlams te/ chos skyong

ra༅༅/ /rang gi lcags rmog sogs phul/ ci bsgo ba'i bsha' nyan 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / dpal bkra shis mthong smon gyi srung ma byed par dam bcas/ de'i tshe chos skyong gi gtor chog zhig kyang gsung rtsom mdzad/ de nas spyan g.yas dang zhang mkhar brgyud/ sgrub sde 'brag rgyas bsam gtan rdzong du phebs/ der mkhar chu ba rang gi 'dod bzhin sku skye la bsko 'ja'i gnang sbyin rgyas par stsal/ sde pa 'brong rtse nas dpon g.yog gtsang rlo spyan 'dren gyi snyan 'bul zhu ba dang bcas mjal bar byung / sde pa la/ rje gong ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i stong nas mgon po'i dbang bzhi dang / thugs sgrub kyi dbang gnang / dbang bzhi'i dus bya rog che la snam pa skad snyan par sbyordzog pa zhig dbang khang gi seng g.yab nang du 'tshangs nas bsdad pa kun gyis mthong ba zhig

byung / chos rje brag rtsa ba'i brgya 'bul thog bod 'brog gi khrom che bar 'tshogs pa la chos sbyin stsal/ mthong thos dran reg gi smin grol 'ganyal brgyud shel mdo nas lho phyogs kyi nor 'dzin chos bzhin du bde bar skyong ba bya rigs mi'i dbang po dpon blon gyis bsus te/ pho bra bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa gsar 'debs mdzad 'dug par phebs/ de skabs kong po nas chos rje rin po ches mgon rta sogs kyi 'bul ’ skor zab rgyas can zhig gi dpe stsal nas de khas gsan par nges so gsung ba dang bcas nang so rin chen rgyal po grogs mched 'byor/ snyusngags pho brang du/ yongs 'dzin rin po che dang / grub dbang rin po che/ bya zhal ngo gtso sor gyur pa'i dbu che grwa slob chos rpā gnyer sgro

ra༅༅/ /mkhyen chen po pad dkar zhabs kyi bka' 'bum rin po cher bzhugs pa'i dbang lung man ngag gi rim pa mdo rgyud rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i nying thu/skal ldan tsha gcig gis rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sar bkri ba'i lam mchog ma tshang ba med pa mtha' dag stsal zhing /khyad par rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i zur bku' rnam par dag pa mtha' dag gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba so so'i mngon dkyil las ji ltar byung ba bzhin/mkhas grub gong ma'i phyag len rgyun ma nyams zhing phan tshun bsre bslad med pas yongs su smin pa dang /byin rlabs smin byed kyi rim pa zab khyad can du ma/sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/rjes gnang nyer gnyis sogs rig gto rjes gnang girim thabagrang bar dka' ba sogs ming tsam 'dzin pa la yang dka' ba bskyed par 'gyur ba'i dbang rjes gnang byin rlabs sgom lung gi rim pa bsam gyis mi

khyab pa gnang / yang rtse'i 'du khang chen mor/ rje btsun rdo rje yan lag masarjes su bzung ba'i grubapa'i slogadapon chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyi khyad chos dbang bskyur rdo rje 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad du lhag ma rnams kyang 'du bar bshad pa ji bzhin dbang zhu lnga brgya tsam la smin rgyas su stsal ba'i sbyin bdag bdagamo dpal mtshas mdzad/ de dus stod skyar skya ba'i 'bul skyel ba rnams la/ phyag chen/ bla sgrub/ chos drug /rten 'brel/ ro snyoms rnams kyi yig rnying rje gong ma'i tho yig bzhin dang / sgrub thabs skor lnga sogs sgrub skor mang po'i yig rnying ljags lung du stsal/ de nas byams chen du yab sras mchod yon lhan cig par phebs/ bya gong marin po ches zla ba gsum gyi ring kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bkur snyi phun sumatshogs pa bsgrabs/ rgyud 'bum gyi ljags lung dang / sgrab skor gyi 'phros

ra༅༅/ /rnams gnang ste/babakha dbang chos rags pa 'khril rjes/sku drin gtang rag gi tshul du yongs 'dzin rin po che da' slob dang /mdo khams nas blam rkarma bstan 'phel gyi 'bul wo/gser dngul/ja gos dar/rta dre'u sogs stobs che ba phul/byams 'a sgo mangs nas sgar grwa tshang lo ro stod smad dmag sde tshar bdun sogs skya ser gyi 'dus pa wo po la/rgyal ba nyid longs sku'i chas su zhugs nas bla ma'i rnal 'gror dang tsha dbang stsal te mthong thos dran reg gis gdul bya rpā yod pa'i 'bras bur sbyor bar mdzad/de nas stod kyi dpal tsho dus rsā la bab tsha yongs tshon mchog gi sprul skur/rje nyid kyi gsan yig steng nas dus 'khor gyi dbang dang 'dul lung ma gtogasadabang lung thams cad bum pa gang byor stsal/dpon slobo rnamasabazhed don mtha' dag grub ste nyi ma dbus phyogs kyi

rgyal khams su phebs so// //gang dag phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang rgyal yugasems dpa' sems mar bcas//rnam mang gar dgazhi nyams kyi nyamasaldanabokhro mo ma lus pa//gdan gsum lha yi rgyu 'phrul smyu ma chi yang rol pa thar pa'i grong //ye shes lus can dad ldan dad pa'i lkog ngogasa' por lhun gyis grub/bod yul dbus 'gyur 'chang gi rdo rje gdan//mdzas byed bskal bzang rnam 'dren shākya'i ski/mos dasnya rgyal ma' rtser mardzo tsho lam gli/mchas sbyor ba po bstan 'tsho dpal du mdzad//rab tshoms sko7 'khor 'bor tsho marsā po mchog/ngur smig gar gyis gang 'dul der rsā pa'i//kun ma' bla ma'i zhalabumabazang las//dbang bzhi'i rgyan phabasgrib bzhi'i bag chags bkrus/ /yongs ye gdod nas chos tshul rgya mtsho la//yongs dag ma' pa rab kyis dbang bzla

ra༅༅/ /ba / /yongs su 'dzin pa'i ded dpon snying stobs༅/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdagapor yud kyis bskrun/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ yongs 'ogron mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chos kyi 'khor los sbyar bar dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //rab myos te lcags pho rta lo tshes/ gong ma rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug la/ rdo rje gtsug lag gi chos skor dbus pa du gu rin seng gi gter ma 'jam dpal gzhin rje khro chu'i skor rgya zhang khrom gyi gter kha yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung / bai ro'i rgyas sdebs/ ratna gling pa'i gter kha rlung dmar gyi skor/ gu ru chos dbang gi zab gter rlung nag gi skor/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter kha

yom nag gi skor bsrung zlog bsad gagazhin rje rta zhon/ gzhan yang bsrung zlogabasad gnan sgragaphran sogs/ snga sor blam rnam gnyis la ma gsan pa'i rigs mang ba nod pa mdzad tshe ba/'a las/ rang re'i bsrung zlog tsam ma gtogs mi gzhan la mthu'i rigasasbya da mamyong zhing byed 'dod med kyang lag len rnams kha skad du ma bzhag pa yin gsungs/ zhabs drung 'di yang gdung khyad 'phags shing bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa yin nges su mchi zhes bsngags pa chen po mdzad/ gzhabs drung gangs dkar rnam rgyal yab yum gyis/ yang rtse'i pho brang rnying pa la zhig gsos mdzad bzhed pa ji ltar 'thad dang / thugs dam brtag pa zhus dus bapokha las gzhan ma dgongs gabo bzhin mdzad pasathuga'adug /'on kyang zhabs drung nyid rang nas mo dang stagartse gang rigs su bzhugs pa gnang / ar las

ra༅༅/ /ma grub bar mi phebasapa 'gagaganang 'dug kyang / mkhar las kyi 'go sgang tsam la phebs nas yang rtse klu khang du bzhugs/ nyes skyoni mi ring bar byung song / hor zla gsum pa'i yar tshes dge ba la yang rtser phebs/ bka' srung dang gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma bda' bsgo gnang / yon gyi bdag po dang las mi rnams la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i bcol gtad mdzad pas/ mkhar las 'go zug pa nas rtsel 'khyon gyi bar skyon 'gyur ci yang ma byung / de yang bka' las/ khyab 'jug la sogs pa'i sde brgyad rnams ngos la snying brtse ba zhig byung ba los yin/ gang bcol ba'i 'phrin las mthar phyin pa sgrub pa zhig byung gsungs/ dgrar de bkra shis mthong smon gyi gtsug lag khang gi ldebs bris dang shing rtsi dgos pa'i rigs rnams dang / rten chen gyi khri rgyab bzo ba'i ljags bkod

/gas nyi shu la nye gtsam gyis bsgrubs/sngar gyi ldebs bris rnams ma' lugs phul sa bzhengs pa bzo 'phror 'dug pa/de skabs gang brdar sogs 'phro rnams tshar bar bzhugs khang gangs gzugs mdangul las bzhengs par bzhed/bal po phul pa la bas/'phyong rgyas nas lugs sku legs rab shes pa zhig gis kyang zangs thang ma 'dra ska tshigs la lho pa'i ༅ ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa gsal rje sgrab sder bzhugs pa'i

ra༅༅/ /khyad 'phags de la bzhugs khang mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs kyi khubs su rin po che las grub pa ba gdan sa chen po'i spya 'bum zhig ral du gyur pa ni gso ba'i skal bas dben/ des sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la gnod paragasungs/de lo tsa ra cig car gyi rdor 'dzin mkhan chen 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis dgongs grol zhus/'gro mtsho bkrashis dgang ci'i rten 'brel sgrig phyir gnas rpā la phebs pa shar/bkra shis mthong smon nas sgothagabargyud gsang gling du phebs/sgam wo du phebs/da' slobo thugasayid gtsig 'dres kyirten 'byung gis cig car du gdan 'dzom/gter gsar gyitsha dbang dang sna

gyur cing / sgam po pa'i thugs bzhed ltar drang srong gi rjes gnang zhig 'bul gaganang / phag mo lha khang du dpon slobe gnyis rgyun ring po'i sdod tshe/ sgam po zhabs drung gis/ rje 'di'i ska rgyab tu dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma shin tu gsal ba bzhon pa bong bu'i 'thur lhug rnal gzigs/ phyis zhal gzigs ji bzhin rgyo bris sku phyag ris ma zhig kyang phyag tu 'bul ba mdzad/ de nas dpon slob phan tshun phyag yul gyiskabs nas/ rje 'di pa daphro slobakyis sngon ma mdzad/ dmar nag sogs mjal/ pho brang g.yu mtshor gdan 'dzom/ yang zil ga gnang ba'i sang de kur phebs cing / chos kyi bka' mchid dang 'phral yun gyi snang tshul zhib smed mdzad res sogs dgongs pa gcig tu

ra༅༅/ /mnyam par gyur/rje nor bu rgyan pas gong du lha mo'i sku sgrib med du gzigs pa nas bzung rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku'i gnam logasasu mi bya'i rgyal mtshan zhig 'khor mor gzigs pas/dud pa'i sol ba ma bka'i 'bangs su grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i sku che ba'i yon to la mos pa mi 'phrog pa'i bsngags pa mdzad/slar gsang gling dang /seng rdzong brgyud bkra shis mthong smon du phebs nas rab gnas chen mo gnang bar mtho du phyogs/gong ma rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gtso bor gyur pa'i bya pa zhal ngo gto zhal yang phebs/snyan rgyud kyi smin bka' 'bring tsho sgo nas rdul phro gyi 27 gsor la brten pa'i lhag par gnas pa spros pa dang bcas pa zhag mang po sbrel nas gnang ba'i mthar rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg kyang mdzad/ldebs bris kyi ngos la phyag nas mang du chags pa'ang byung /bal po/ri mo

lugs bzo ba/ 'bag bzo ba/ shing bzo ba/ lcags bzo ba rnamasa'ago dang ston mos rmagu spobaskyed/ dga' ston yang rgya cher spel/ de res rab 'byams pa spu bstan ye shes sogs 'ga' zhig la bsnyen rdzogs dang / rab 'byams pa rang mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi slob dpon du bskos/ khams rgyal stoni du lo chen sangs rgyas /la bzang gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'gror/ de skabs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rmad du byung ba 'ga' zhig gis bskal ba'i rkyen las/ ye shes kyi lha mo 'dod khams sung phyug ma'i snang brnyan byin rlabs kyi zil mtshungs pa med cing ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul can de yang slar nā ro pa nyid skya zhabs drung du lho/ rje zhwa dmar pa de nyid stod du bsnyan pa'i ska rim du dgongs mang ja 'bul 'gyed gnang ba'ang 'gror rgya'i nub mtshan lam du rdor dril chag pa zhig phyag tu bzhes pa rmis gsungs/ yab sras la

go༅༅/ /brtan bzhugs 'bul mi gnang ba bar lam du rgyal ba'i dbang po dang mjal ba zhig byung 'dug /rdo rje gling du lam zab/ phyag rdor gcipa po lha bcu gsum ma/ mi 'khrugs pa lha so bdun ma'i dbang bdang sogs gnang / der sde pa 'brong rtse ba'i spyan 'dren pa mdo chos pa 'gror pa bzhin bzhugs sgar bteg nas chos rgyal gling du phebs/ bkur sti phun tshogs bsgribs/ shel mdo tshun zhabs drung gangs darkan rnam rgyal dpon g.yog chibs skyel la phebs pa'i phyi phyag zhu dus spyan chab 'byin pa sogs shin tu thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam pade sa slar mi mjal ba la lta bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas gar phebs kyi yul gru so sor chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas lus can rnams la rnam dashar gyi sa bon bskyan bzhin pa nas gri gur phebs thog /sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal bzang po'i sngal pa'i ska dpon slobadabad chos

gsan pa la zhabs phyir 'gror/ dusatshes dgeb la thogamar chos kyi sgo 'byed du lam zagamo blam sgrub pa'i smin bka' rgyas brten 'brel gyi sgor stsal/ bragakha nas sde pa rgyal bu'i mchis 'brang 'dus byas su gyur pa'i bsngo zhus mu tig gi lhug rgyus sogs phul/ dus 'das byang grol la 'gode pa'i bsngo smon rgya cher mdzad/ de nas ba chos brgyud gnod sbyin gang bzang mched kyi gzhogs su phebs nyin gdugs 'jam zhing phyogs kyi 'bor lo dbang po'i gzhus bkra ba sogs gdan sa'i thad kyi bar snang khengs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo tshur mthong mig gi dga' ston du'ang bstan/ blo bder rin sdings grwa tshang gi chibs bsu rgyas pa dang bcas rgyal rtse klu khang du bzhugs sgar gnang / rtse nas gzhi len zhus/ zhal dkyil blta ba dang / rnyed bkur gyis mchod pa'i slad du 'ongs pa'i skyaser lha skye bo'i tshogs 'a po 'dus pa la/ dbang

si༅༅/ /chos zhal mjal byin rlabs sogs rang rang gi yid la bzhed pa bzhin stsal/ chos sde dpal 'khor bde chen du rin sdings pas spyan drangs/chos sde chen po spyi sger dang rtse chen chos sder mang bskol rnam gzhag dang bcas pa gnang /gram bu nor bu snang du 'brong rtse bas thab 'dzin dang /rgyal byed sngags spyod chos sde gong 'og gi dge 'dun stobs che bas ser sbrengs kyi bkod pas mdun bltas te skyed mos tshal du phebs/mi ring bar sprul pa'i sku ga'i bzhugs la / kun mkhyen padma dkar po'i bka' 'bum yid bzhin nor bu bka' chos su gnang ba'i dbu tshugs/i re bzhin chos thun gnyis gnyis ma chags pa dang /thugs brel che skabs thun che ba re gnang /spyi chos su tshogs gur rsā mor bka' gdams glegs bam pha chos bu chos bcas lung du stsal/yongs tshon rin po che da' slob

la stod phyogs su mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sdi gnogs su gsan bsam la 'byon nor bzhugs sgar du phebs/bsu ba ser sbrengasasogasabakur snyi rje lha rtse ba chen po de nyid la ji lta ba bzhin mdzad/de nas 'brong tshoms chen stong du yab sras gsum lhan rgyas sgar grwa'i gsung chog pa gtos che ba dang bcas dus gtor rgyas pa'i thogalas rim dang 'brel ba'i 'chagasogs spros pa rgya cher mdzad/gza' tshas dge ba'i i sde pa phun tshogs rdo rje gang gi dpal 'gror phun sum tshogs pa rpā ldan du bya phyir gzhis ka mdun gyi bzhugs khri' mor rgyal mchog yab sras gsum/bla ma dbu che'i 'khor dang bcas pa gdan drangs/rten gsum/ding phro gyi bla bres gcos pa'i gos dar yug mang po/khyad gos 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag du ma sogs brgya 'bul stobs che ba phul/khrom la tsha dbang

ra༅༅/ /gnang /skyid sbug byang chub bsam gling du/grub dbang bdag ste lcags mo lug lo gsar pa'i dko rsā 'grong rtsenas rgyas par gams/kun dga' ra ba gnyisapagangade'ispolachen du sna mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs/ skache ba 'dug pas kha sang nas mtshams dam nges sa pa byed dgose byung /da rung rmigagogo gi bar chos thun re khrul rgya nas/de yang kṣ-is kyi sgo yan la/sngal pa'i ske

dang bstun/ da' slob gnyis po las mi phebs pa zhu zhing / da lam ngos kyi bcad rgyar bar chad tsam du 'dug ste/ nyid da' slob chos rpā gnyer gyis phebs ngadang / dgos med kyi re dogs sna tshogs kyang 'char rigs su 'dug par rang re bla ma'i bgazha drin bsab phyir yin pa nges 'tshal/ lar babs mtshams 'di la'angarigs mang po yodi pa'i skabs 'gar zo sod kyi mtshams/ skabs 'gar dgos dbang gi mtshams/ skabs 'gar mi byed ka med kyimatshams sogs yod 'dug pa'i rngares phyi ma yin pa'ang nges gsungs pa phebs pa ltar/ sku mtshams 'og tu chos thun che bar gnang / bsre 'pho snyan rgyud skor gyi zab chos rnams bsha' drin du stsal/ skematshams grol bstan grub dbang shes rab 'byug rgyas mchod yon gyis gang ser du spyan drangs/ ja gnas pas sgar dmangs la gsol phogs phul/ chos kyi gsor hūṃ

ra༅༅/ /rgyun mi chad pa skor bzhin pa nas myang stod kyi skye bogal cher 'dus pa'i mjal mi shin tu mang bar 'dod chos sogs gang la ci 'os kyis rjes su bzung / khrom dbang gnang ba'i nyin pa snam nas ra lung man dang mgo yul stod gsum gyi mi tshogs 'dug zer sngar ma grags pa'i khrom shin tu che ba tshogs/ yig legs pa dang ja gnas pa sogs kyi 'bul chen bzhes/ brag kha nas sde pa ma chen gshegs pa'i byang zhu 'bul bar nang so phun rab pa byung bar/ ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga dang bcas thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug dang / stag ri mar bla ma bya btang gis spyan drangs/ dbang chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs kyi 'bul lam rten li ma sogs stobs che ba 'gror bas mchod 'bul bsngo ba dang sa lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i smon lagayang dag pa gnang / rgyal byed

du phebs/ dbo zla'i ring sku mtshams khog chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub kho na gnang dus bya yul du mi legs pa'i ltas mtshan byung bas/ 'di phyogs kyi brel ba rnams mgyogs par gcod dgosagasungs/ de nas khro phu ba'i spyan 'dren ltar chibs kha bsgyur/ 'brong rtse/ rgya phibs/ yar gdong / nor gling / gru kha spel sogs dad ldan 'gror pas phyug pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis re ba 'bras ldan la bkod/ bsam grub chos sdings pas gdan drangs/ gser mdogayo grwa tshang chen mo ba sogs kyi bla ma bka' bcu rab 'byams mang po gsung gi bdud rtsi myang bar 'gror pa rnams dang bcas rigs lung gis dus 'da'/ der myang smad kyi dad 'dus khrom chen por dbang bka' sogs gnang stephan bde'i lo toga'aphel bar mdzad/ rim pas stagal shar nub kyi thang smig rgya 'khrigs pa de myur 'gro'i rlang shugs kyis bcad de/ rnam

ra༅༅/ /sras gling du khro phu grwa tshang pa'i thab 'dzin chibs bsu dang / dar sna gdong nas grwa tshang dgon galag bcas pa'i rig grol ngur smrig 'dzin ༅ 'dus sde grangs mang bas bsu ba'i bkod pa tshar du dngar te bzang lung khro phu dga' ldan byams pa'i gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por phebs/ der zla ba tsam bzhugs ring / la stod lho byang / shangs rta nag /zar 'bri mtshams sogs phyogs bcu nas dad ldan gyi skye bo bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa 'dus/ zang zing gi 'bul ba gtos che/ so so'i re ba bzhin dbang chos byin rlabs zhal mjal gyi sgo nas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi dpal la 'god par mdzad/ chos bzang lha'i mdun sa a mo lde sha'i khri steng nas/ spyibla brang drung 'khor sogs kyi brgya 'bul bzhes/ lha mi thams cad byang chub kyilam la bkod/ mtsho sgo nas rtsechen pa yugasusakyang 'bul ba

nga bcas mjal bar tho pa rjes su bzung /grwa tshang spyi sor mang ja'i thog bkras btags yol ba sogs gnang /chos rje sto bu rgyal ma' sku khams lcong pa grol/slar chos rje 'dzal chen chos grags rnam rgyal la sku ber sogs bsko 'ja' gnang /brag rtsa skuskye gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'gror/grwa ris kyis skye myur 'byon gyi smon lam zhig kyang mdzad/grwa tshang de pa bslab sbyangs smar zhing 'chad nyan gyi rgyun bzang bas/rgyud sde'i gzhung 'grel gyi rgyugs 'bul dzi/ byung bar legs so'i sang sbyin gzab pa dang /'du khang chen mor rje sems dpa' chen i sprul pa'i sku gtso bor bzhugs pa'i grwa tshang ba sogs rpā sa rpāchen pol/dus gsor/gsang 'dus/tshogs byed/tsha bdag sogs dkyil 'khor chan po 'ga' zhig gi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa mtho

ra༅༅/ /dkyis gyi lung dang bcas pa/ spyi chos su chos 'byung sogs i bstar gyis stsal/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nas/ rje btso dam pa'i sprul pa'i sku thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po'i ja zhus rgyas pa bkur bzos che ba'i chab shog dang bcas pa 'byor lan gzab ma 'bul bar gser khang chos mdzad mngags/ de skabs zhig ming lam du/ bya pa'i spyan 'dren yin zer skyes pa gzan thig sgor gyi ri mo bkra ba rgyan pa zhig rmis/ drang srong gis spyan 'dren par 'dug gsung ba la/ ma 'gyangs par zhabs drung ngag dbang lha'i don grub gshegs zer ba'i pho nya ba bya yul du phebs dgos tshul ring khyad kyi bsngo zhu dang bcas pa byung bas/ dam pa ni gzhan don la skyo ngal med pas phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ byams chen gyi snyan shal la lha gos yug ring po'i snyan dar sogs mchod rdzas bzang po

bstar/ slar rnam sras gling tshun khro phu bas thab skyel zhus/ stag la brgyud de phyug po khang gsar du/ gtsang sde srid kyi thab 'dzin rgyas pa/ bla ma lcags pa dang / 'brug chos ldings pa rnams kyang mjal bar slebs/ zhwa lur mang ja 'gyed chas stob par bla ma bstan pa rgyal mtshan btang / gru sper gangs ri ba dang sgordzol por dpal ri ba yar gdong du spel ser ba/ rgya phibs su chibs bzhol sogs/ so sor dbang bgazha rjes gnang 'gazha re stsal rjes 'brong rtser zhag lnga bzhugs/ sde pa nas/ bya yul gyi thugs brel chod 'phral gtsang la slar phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba nan chags 'bul ba la de ka byed gsungs/ sgar grwa tshang dmangs rnams 'brong rtser bzhag /rags bsngas shig shad rtsol gyis phebs/ a jo rdzong du chos rje thugs rje dpal 'gror gyi nang rten la rab gnas mdzad/ de nas pho brang yang rtser

ra༅༅/ /phebs/ rgyal ba 'di nyid rgyun du gsol ba rags pa mi gnang ba'i gzhis dman mos tshur mthong gi ngor sku ngal ba'i tshul ston pa zhig snang yang / 'di skabs bzhin gzhan phan la shad rtsol chen pos phebs dgos pa 'dra dang / khrom chen por bka' dbang phyag bstar gnang ba sogs la skyes bu dar ma stobs ldan dag kyang ngal gso rten dgos pa la/ sku ngal ba'i tshul tsam yang med pa 'di ni 'gro ba'i don la skyo ngal med pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar gyi gnas shig go/ /gdung 'bul gnang cha stobs che ba dang / mi 'gyangs par gdung chog tshugs sku gzhogs su mi 'khrags pa lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga dang / yang rtse ba/ sngags grwa gsar pa/ cog grwa rnying pa/ rgya mtsho grwa tshangarwa / stag rtse sgrab sde ba sogs dge 'dun stobs che

bas/ rnal 'gror rgyud lugs kyirdo rje mi 'brags pa lha so bdun gyi chog grwa zhe dgu tshun btsugs par sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i dge rtsa dang / sgar phyag mdzod nas kyang mang 'gyed gnang / gshegs rdzong dngos gaske'i nyin/ pho brang mdun gyi zhing steng du cog grwa pa'i tshogs gur du dge 'dun nyis stong lhag tsam tshogs pa'i gral dbur phebs/ bya pa rang gi bla rdo slob dpon padma'i sku brnyan dmi bdud 'dul du grags pa'i rten khyad par can des gtsos pa'i rten gsum/ ja gos dar/ ther zangs go khrab/ rta dre'u sogs 'bul chen/ tshogs par lag 'gyed dang bcas sngar rgyun las mi dman pa bsgrubs pa rnams rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs stsal/ skor drug byams chen brgyad bkra shis mthong smoni gyi grwa tshang bzhugs yul gyi gling dang / sgyi khang gsar 'debs gyub pa rnams la gzigs rtog dang phyag nas gnang / slar

ra༅༅/ /yang rtser phebs mchod khang rnying par bzhugs pa'i drang srong gi sku brnyan ma'agrug mngon sum pa de la gser gyi mgul rgyan phyag gdub sogs 'bul ba gnang /de'i zhal nasapa babs/klu khang gsang sngags pho brang du bzhugs yul gnang /smras pa'i sku sogs chos don chos kyi 'khor le 'u yang bskor/cig 4 dpal gyi nags ljongs kyi rdo rje 4na par/'brug pa podabang bstan 'dzin bzang po nyid/rdor tshon gzhan las lhag pa'i bsko bzhag gnang /'di nyid sna

la sku btsun pas khyad par du byas pa'i brtul zhugs chen pos gzhan snang dbang du 'dus pa'i 'phrin las kyi snang bas thub bstan gsal bar mdzad cing / dpal rir grwa tshang 'dzugs pa serdzogs bstan pa'i bya ba'ang rgya cher mdzad do/ /rgyal ba nyid zhabs phyi ba rags bsdus tsam gnang / 'bri nang ka ma ru'i gnas gzigs la phebs/ gnas mthil du tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas pa gnang / g.yag po sga gdan du phebs skabs 'ja' 'od kyi gan khyim mtshar ba'i dbus na dag pa shrī shel dkar gyi mchod rten snang la rang bzhin bral ba lta bu zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis kyang mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dus rdo rje'i mgur bzhes pas shar phyogs nas lha'i rol mo gsal bar grags pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi snang ba bgrang las 'das/ klo bod rnams smin par mdzad de pho brang yang rtser phebs/ rten bzhengs kyi zhal bkod

ra༅༅/ /gnang bar phyogs/bal po mkhas shing mang bas bzo grwa btsugs/spyan ras gzigs kha sapo ṇi dang byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i sku phul thog re'i tshad tsam bzhengs pa'i 'dra dpe zhal bkod tshang ma rgyal ba nyid kyis gnang /zla ba gsum tshun la grub/sku byon gtsang ba dang byin chags pa'i dper 'os pa byung /gzungs 'bul dang zhal gser phyag bstar gnang ste 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor phyag bris su bstar/rtsen sta gon nas brtsams rab tu gnas pa zhag mang po sbrel/kha skong la gya sa pa'i sbyin sreg kyang mdzad/sprul pa'i sku da' slob la dkyil chos/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang sogs chos char 'bebs bzhin pa nas/rab gnas kyi dga' ston thog 'bul lam rgya spam can/bzo bo rnams la yon rdzong dang bcas pas lha mgu mi mgur gyur/de nas gtso bor gtsang sde

srid kyidagongs gtad dang / byachung srid thams cad kyi 'dod la'ang 'dug pa nas/ zhabs drung sku skye rin po che khri thog tu bton/ bdag mo 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba'i rnam pas chos mdzad chog pa'i dgongs pa nan chags zhu ba zhig byang yang / rgyal srid sngar lam bzang po ltar skyong dgos pa'i bslab don phra zhib gnang ba'i bathakha dang du bzhes so/ /de skabs sku srung pa tshe bdag dpa' bo la rig 'a〉sna 'ja' tshon snying pos gdan drangs pa'i gter chos gsan bzhed/ dpon tshang phan bde 'od zer sogs brgyud nas phebs sgo gnang bar/ thugs 'dzangs la brten 'bul ma nus/ slar rgyal ba nyid nas/ gsang ba'i bla ma la gang yang zhig yong 'dug gsungs pa sogs kyi phyag bris nan lcir gnang bas/ dkon mchog sri'adus kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang / tshe dpag med gnam lcags rdo rje/ thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol/ zhi khro nges

ra༅༅/ /don snying po/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter yig phur sgrub thugs kyi nying khu rnams phul/ sku gzhogs pa yongs 'du grwa tshang gi slob dpon par cos rje rdo rje gling pa bskos/ bstan pa rin po che rnyed pa dang bkur sdi'i sgo nas yun du gnas par bya ba dang bstan rtsa dge 'dun la rag las pas dge 'dun 'du ba'i cha rkyen la dgongs/ grwa tshang gi rgyurdzas la/ rten mchod/ rol cha/ yol ba bla bre/ khro zangs/ zhwa phod 'bag sogs 'cham chas/ rdor dril rten khebs sogs yo byad zlong la spus gtsang ba du ma dang / mchod gzhis su/ ljon skyed tshal/ gtsang sde srid nas phul ba'i bkra shis mthong smen nye skor gyi dud sum cu/ bya pas phul ba'i mkhar ltag dang gnyal nas dud grangs mang ba/ tshong 'dus brag kha bas phul ba'i dgu bsngas nas dud lnga bcu lhag pa/ gzhan yang stosna dbus nas sa zhing 'bul mi byung

ba'i sa ris phal cher grwa tshang par sbyor 'jags mdzad pas spyi rdzas chos gzhis kyi cha la ni 'gran zla med par grags so/ /de nas dgung lo bzhi bcu'i thog sku tshe'i 'phrang dog pa'i bar chad sel phyir sku mtshams kyi nges pa la bzhugs bzhed de/ gsang sngags chos gling gi klu khang du/ gzims spyil 'debs dgos tshul bya pa zhal ngor gega' phebs ltar legs par bsgyubs/ der lcags lug zla ba bcu gnyig pa'i nyer drug nas sku lo mtshams kyi bcad rgya nges pa can la bzhugs/ de skabs mang yul nas la dwags stod smad kyi dzol pa rnam gnyis bsam grub rtser byon pa dang / rgyal dbang dam pa ska mtshams bcad rgya gnang rgyur 'dug ces gleng ba des/ gtsang sde srid nas pho nya ba mgyogs 'gro'i bzhon pa can brdzangs pa'i gzhis ka rtse nas gsang gling bar shad rtsokla gyis slebs par/ stod mang yul nas rgyal po rnam pa gnyis 'dug

ra༅༅/ /pa / thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs drung kho nar gtad/ snying po'i don len par sa nag po mdom dang sprin dkar por tshad btsugs nas 'dir 2gror byang ba/ da dung sa thag ring pas sku gzhogs su 'phral 'gror thub pa mi 'dug pas sku mtshams bcad rgya'i khongs su tshud pa'i sku ngo thugs la 'dogs pa zhu gsung ba'i snyu yig byung ba ltar/ mi ring bar byon rgyal po gnyis la bug mjal stsal/ gser/ byi ru spos shel sogs kyi 'bul ba gtos che zhing / gtsug phud bzhes/ rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal gyi gcung ngag dbang rnam rgyal rab tu byung ba'i mtshan 'brag dpag bsam bstan 'dzin bzang po zhes dang / mang yul stod pa'i rgyal rigs mthu stobs dbang phyug rab tu byung ba'i mtshan/ dpag bsam gter 'dzin du btags/ de nas brtsams te rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs drung du dam pa'i chos kyi bdud

: ci yang gsan pa'i snyim pas bzhes shing / khyad par du rgyal ba'i bsha' rab 'byams ma lus pa'i snying po'i don phyag rgya chen po'i nyams khrid/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i nges gsang nā ro chos drug gi khrid/ dpal ldan 'brag pa rin po che'i gsung ngag ro sgoms/ bla sgrub/ rten 'brel sogs mtha' dag gsan/ sgrub tshugs kyis kyang tshangs pa'i drang srong la skyengs pa sbyin te/ phyi 'dul dro'i kun spyod las ma g.yos shing nang snying po'i rnal 'gror la gzhol ba'i sdom 'gron sa mā dhi'i bcud len mkhan gyi skyes bu chen por gyur to// //khor yug me lcer 'bar dbus mig sman ri bo mun pas byugs pa lta'i/ /drag shul stobs kyis nyi zla'ang za byed mi bzad dpung pa'i stobs ldan pa/ /dregs pa'i lha srin yongs kyi gtso bo khyab 'jug la sogs sde brgyad kun/ /gang gi bapokha yi zegs ma tsam yang dkar po'i thod bzhin rnam par 'dzin/ /phun

ra༅༅/ /tshogs lha yi dpal la dbang 'gror zhing / /rdo rje'i ma/tshon cha gdengs pas gzhan sde'i dpung / rab tu gzhom la dpa' ba'i rtsal ldan pa/ /sa skyong grags pa'i mu khyud can des mchod/ /dpal gyi seng ge'i sgyu 'phrul zlos pa'i gar/ /sgrub brgyad 'dzin ma'i gzhi la bsgyur ba der/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i gter sgo kun gtad nas/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog tu mngon dbang bskur/ ma 'dris 'gro la phan dgongs thugs rje'i gter/ /yangs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po'i med byung gtam/ /cha tsam rna bar lhung ba'i legs byas kyang / /nam mkha'i pha mthas mtshon par ga la nus/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rgya mchos

smu pa'i skyes mchog sgrib brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par rjes su bzung ba'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas aji ra zhes pa chu pho spre'u'i / rig 'dzin 'ja' snron snying po bya pas spyan drangs/ rgyal ba'i sku mtshams 'og tu mjal bar phebs/ gter gsar gyi chos zab khyad can mang po skyes su phul rjes sung bcad dang / su la'ang zhal mjal mi gnang ba sogs bcad rgya dam pa la bzhugs/ bsnyen sgrub kyang darkani mchog spyi'adus kyi bzlas brjod bshad tshod ji lta ba'i smu su/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ ji skad du/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ khro bo sangs rgyas lha mo dang bcas sa par ro yi rdo rje dang ni sa yi snying po sogs/ /rab tu dga' ba'i thugs rnams rnal 'gror pa la grub pa'i dus su nam mkha' la ni mngon sum 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs

ra༅༅/ /pa ltar skabs shig /bskal pa'i me phung 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus na dpal ye shes kyi mgon po/ g.yon na yum tsaṇḍi ka /g.yas na las mgon bya rog gdong can gsum drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg cing zil mtshungs pa med pa zhig rgyun ring por gzigs pa dang / yang mgon po'i gtor khang yin snyam pa'i nang nas rgya nag gi sher shing las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od phung 'bar ba zhig phyag tu bzhes pa rmis pas 'di dag kyang bsnyen rtags tsam du 'dug gsungs pa las dgongs pa zab pas mtha' dag ni bka' mi stsal to/ /sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin/ rgyal ba gang gi yum sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul phyag mdzod nas dpon tshang brgyad phul bar/ nye skor gyi dasmo sde so sor mang 'gyed/ grub mtha' nges med kyi bla ma che ba kun la gsung btso rten/ byang ngam ring nas kong tsho bar gyi chos sde che

ba kun la mang 'gyed kyi zhal bkod tsam gnang ba ji bzhin phyag mdzod nas rdzong bdar mdzad do/ /de skabs sgam po zhabs drung rin po che nor bu rgyan pas/ rab tu hor zla brgyad pa'i nang tsam du sgam por phebs thub pa dgos shing / bzhugs rgyun yang rgyang tsam gnang ba'i rtsis dang / de min kyang 'ordzo phyi ma'i hor zla gsum pa tsam la cis kyang phebs thub pa dgos tshul byung bar/ lerdzo mtshams kyi nges par song bas 'ordzo ma 'khor bar ni mardzong mi thub pa dang / de rjes yong gang thub zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan gnang bas/ slar nan chags kyis/ da lo'i sku tshe'i 'phrang gi dog cha hor zla bdun pa tshun gyis grol nges pa nas/ rang re dpon slob gnyis thad du khyad snga che ba tsam 'dug pas gang rtsol phebs e thub gsung ba byung rung / ska mtshams nges pa can du song bas phebs ma thub par/ bka' las/ de res bcad rgya'i stabs kyis 'grerdzo ba ma

ra༅༅/ khor/de skabs ngos sku gzhogs su sleb tsha snyu rme rten 'brel 'grigs rgyu tsam yin tshod/ting sor gzhan tho du dgongs pa'i gnathos pa dang 'grod pa che ba tsam byung /'on kyang rang dbang 'dus bzhin ma phyan pa min pa nas cung zhig drag gam snyam gsung ba dang / yang bcad rgya de zo sod pa sbyor 'phel zhing khams kyang bzang bar byung ba nas/ rgyun sring ba zhig snyigs ma'i snang tshul nye ring drag zhan so so'i spyod tshul mthong bas bgyid 'dod kyang /pa'am de la ma bsam zer smra ba'i sgo mang po byung dogs pa dang bcas/lo gcig dang zla ba gnyis tsam nas 'grol ba shar gsungs/ 5 mtshams khog der skebar chad kyis ma tshugs par brten/mkhar chur ska skye dang grwa ris ma mthun pa'i 'tshub 'gyur tsam byung ngo / /chos grags bstan pa rab 'phal gyi ska skye stag rtse ṭī

bla ma/ bya pa'i ti shrīr yang gyur pa/ dus phyis lho rgyud phyogs kyi bla ma dbu che 'phrin las che shos de dgung lo smin ches pas gshegs/ de kha'i dgongs rdzogs kyi do dam rnams bya pa'i bdag mos mdzad pa shar 'dug pa nas dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbur rib tsam phebs e thub zhu ba byung yang bcad rgya'i stabs/ sku skye myur 'byon gyi smon lam zhig mdzad/ sdings po che nas spyal pa'i sku gdan 'dren pa 'gab ces bslab ston stsal/ grub dbang rin po che tsa ri kong po sogs la 'byon zhor sku rkyang la bug mjal dang tshe dbang dgongs bzhed bzhan stsal/ sku mtshams bcad rgya'i ring jo bo dmag dpon du 'bod pa ngo bo rong lha rgyal mtshan de/ rje la lhag par gus pa'i tshul nangs re bzhin byed pa'ang byung 'dug /nub cig rje nā ro pa'i phyag bzo yin zer ba'i dpal ldan lha mo'i 'jim ska khru gang tsam pa zhig mjal ba rmis gsungs pa'i sang nyin

go༅༅/ /chos rje rin po che mi pham bkra shis blo gros kyi phyag nas/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma'i sku byin rlabs lhag par che ba de/ brtan bzhugs zhu tho dang bcas/ lhun rtse zhabs drung rgyal bu dang / gser khang chos mdzad gnyis kyis skyon med phul/ thun mtshams la rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'bum la gzigs rtog zhib par mdzad pa nas/ zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can mngon du gyur te/ bka' las/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur thob pa 'di/ mos gus la rgyun chad med cing dam tshig la sel ma zhugs na bla ma'i gzugs sku dngos bzhugs ma bzhugs khyad med du go gsungs/ de yang ji skad du/ rnal 'byor pas ni de lta'i de nyid thob/ /rgya dang mi rgya'i bdag nyid 'gro gnyer gcig /ye shes rang bzhin mi yi seng ge gang / /mi zad lus thob ma lus 'gro ba'i
