rgyu/ /de ni yoni po'i lus kyang drang po yin/ /bstan la gnas med gyur kyang gnas pa yin/ /de ni mig btsum rgyar kyang rnam rgyas mig /de ni mnyam ma bzhag kyang mnyam bzhag nyid/ /de sna tshig dang ldan yang brjod bral yin/ /de ni longs spyod ldan yang srid bral yin/ /de ni 'ejig rten mgon yang gzhan bral 'gyur/ /gang zhig de nyid rtogs shing nyes kun zad/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rje rdo rje 'chang gis/ 'bral pa rgya 'byams rig par song / /gdul dasha'i nyon mongs grogs su shar/ /tshan tshan thams cad gcig tu 'dus/ /gnas 'gyu gnyis la 'dam ka bral/ /zhes sdusags gsungs pa'i don dang mtshungs pa'i 'dod pa'i dngos grub chen po slar yang mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de lta bu'i 'dod pa'i dngos grub de yang / spyan ras gzigs kyis/ de ltar sdo rje'i rnal 'gror gang zhig dpag med bde

ra༅༅/ /gshegs rnams kyis brten cing bstan pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje mchog 'dzin gsang sngags rig pa kun gyis yang dag brjod gyur pa'i/ /'gyur med mchog gi bde ba rnal 'gror de ni dus kyi 'khor lor blun po bdag brjod 'dod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas dpal gdong ste chu mo bya so/ hor zla dang po'i dus chen gyi mjug la nang mtshams rim pas sengs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin phyi mtshams grol/ chos rje rin po che'i brtan bzhugs kyang de nyin 'gror bas rten 'brel bzang bar byung / bya pa'i zhabs drung bdag mo dang / nye 'khor gyi bla ma dbu che grwa yon sogs tshogs che bar khrom dbang dang dpon sar tshe dbang brgya rtsa gnang / stod nas mgron gnyer don mchog 'khor/ mnga' ris rgyal po mchod yon gyi zhu tho gser sogs 'bul ba stobs che ba dang bcas

'dug /gzims spyil bkra shis lha stengs su phebs/ sku 'dra rin po cher zhal gser phyag bstar gnang ste gsol/ slar gsang sngags chos gling gi gtsang khang na padma dkar po'i bzo rig pa'i tshad kyi byang chub chen po dang / rje gong ma'i thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i sku 'dra rin po che rnams la'ang zhal gser spyan dbye sogs phyag rang gis gnang / sku'i rim gror gdugs dkar lha bcu gsum gyi cho ga'i gtor bzlog rgyas pa rgya mtsho grwa tshang pas phyag phyi zhus nas mdzad/ de nas pho brang yang rtser dpon sa bdag mos spyan 'dren byung ba ltar phebs/ lhun grub pho brang du gzims chung gnang / de dus kyang rje sems dpa' chen po'i sprus pa'i sku dang / mnga' ris lha btsun bgres gzhon sogs la khrid lung 'gazha dang / bya zhabs drung ska skye rin po che dpon g.yog gtsang sde srid kyi drung du thegs pa nas phyar 'khor/ mchod yon lhan

ra༅༅/ /du gzims chung ka drug mar/zhi byed lha mo bco lnga'i smin gti/ma.āo dashar rtag pa'i rdo rje/mas ser 'jam pa'i rdo rje/mtsho dmar chags pa'i rdo rje/mgon mthing zhe sdang rdo rje rnams kyi rjes gnang /myang lugs kyi drag dmar/sprul pa'i sku nyid sku rkyang la dregs pa'i srog dbang sogs dbang rjes gnang mang po stsal/gza' skar dge ba la/bya rigs chos kyi rgyal po rim par bsti ba'i gnas sde brgyad 'du ba'i pho brang chen po khri khang yang rtse'i rdzong gsar legs par grub pas thog lha gsol ba'i dga' stoni rgya cher bsnabs/lha bsangs rgyas pa'i dus drang srong la gtor chogabasha' bsgo gnang ba'i dam bzhag skabs rwa bzhob tshub cing ska 'khris pa rnams la zil che ba'i khyab 'jug dngas su 'ongs pa'i cho 'phrul che ba byung /brtan zhing shis pa'i phyag nas stsal/rim pas byams chen chos gling du

sa pa'i la dwags lha btsun ngag dbang rnam rgyal sogs don gnyer gyi tshogs la/ rgyud 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi ljags lung gnang tshe gong du po ti re dang gsol tshigs spyan 'bebs tsam grol rjes phyogs mtha'i mjal mi'i re ba skong ba'i thugs brel chod bstun chos jis re 'khril ba gnang / rags bsdus la gzims chung du/ phyag chen/ bsre 'pho/ bla sgrub/ ro sgoms/ rten 'brel sogs ba/ snyan rgyud skor gnyis sogs zur bsha'i rigs ji snyed pa dang / sgrub thabs skor lnga/ 'phral dgos kyi chos bzhi/ rwa pod re lung dang 'ga' zhig gi pod dbang gnang / pad dkar grwa tshang gi kun dga' ra ba na bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs bzhugs pa'i

ra༅༅/ /sar/ sprul pa'i sku'i phyag phyi bdag gis zhus te da' slob gnyis la badzi' 'gyur ro cog gi pusta dzi'i lung dbang yang bda' drin chen pos stsal/ phyag mdzod ngag dbang rab brtan sku gzugs lci bas dgongs pa grol rjes/ grwa yon kha shas gcig gi 'dod ltar nang so ngag dbang grags pa bskos/ pad dkar grwa tshang gi slob dpon pa chos rje rgyal dbang pad dkar thugs bsam che ba dang grwa tshang chos sde tshugs che zhing gang sa nas 'os par dgongs/ chen po'i go sar spar ba'i bsko 'ja'/ skru ber/ dbu sgom sogs dang / grwa tshang spyi sor mang ja'i thog hor sbug dang gos gser ma'i yol ba sogs gnang sbyin rgyas pa stsal/ skru rim la 'jam dpal gshin rja tshe bdag gi thod pa zhal dbye gtor bzlog dang lhan cig gong ma yab sras kyis sbyin bdag mdzad/ da lta 'jam dpal khang du bzhugs pa'i tsha bdag

gi sku brnyan gyi rab tu gnas pa'ang gnang / yongs 'du grwa tshang dang yang rtse sngags grwa bas 'cham sogs phyag len las rim rgyas pa ltar mdzad/ sgam po zhabs drung nor bu rgyan pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul ba/ sku ber/ chibs/ gos dar sogs 'gror/ phar gdung 'bul dpangs mtho ba dang bcas mi snar bla ma dung la ba brdzangs/ sprul pa'i sku dpon slob/ zhabs drung bya pa gong ma yab sras/ grwa tshang gsum sogs skya ser stobs che ba la 'du khang du/ dpal mgoni phyag bzhi pa'i gtor chog rnying pa dang 'brel ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor phyag bris ma bstarate/ dbang bzhi las rim rgyas pa'i sgo nas stsal/ de mtshams gtsang nas 'brong rtse ba'i spyan 'dren la bshad grwa slob da' pa 'gror/ da' slob nyung rags kyis bkra shis mthong smon gyi mgon khang gtor gsos la phebs/ de yang rgyal bas mdo sde

ra༅༅/ /dag las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don la dpag tshad brgyar yang chos ston du 'gro/ de bzhin du dpag tshad stong dang / khri dang / 'bum gyi bar du sems can la chos ston pa la yang nem nur du mi byed cing / rnyed pa la mi lta/ bkur sti la mi lta bar chos rab tu ston par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi gcig tu zhi bde don gnyer gyi rnam pa kun tu 'dug pa ni skyes bu chen po'i tshul ma yin pas/ sngar smos pa ltar/ dbus gtsang lho byang stod smad yar 'brog lho brag sogs mnga' ris mi gcig pa'i sa phyogs mtha' klas pa dang / ring srid kyi lho rgyud ral gsum sogs yul gru sna tshogs su phyogs ris med pa'i skye 'gro mchog dman bar gsum la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher spel te skal ba dang ldan pa rnams mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi dpal la spyor bar mdzad cing dman mos pa dag

kyang mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas dngos dang brgyud pas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad do/ /de nas mtsho sna brgyud pa'i gtsang la chibs kha bskyar/ 'brag chos sdings su phebs/ dad ldan gyi 'dus pa shin tu che/ chos dang zang zing gi 'du 'god bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / zang yag /dom tshang sogs grwa pa'i slo/ dpon chen po padma 'gyang gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mang po 'dug pa rnams gzigs/ lhag par moni pa'i skye bo 'du tshogs che bar dbang chos byin rlabs kyis rjes su bzung sterā tha' 'khob kyi lus can rnams la thar pa'i sa bon grung po bskrun/ padma sambha was grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi la phyag rjes bzhag zer ba'i nang tshan gyi mtsho ya mtshan che zhing phyag rjes gsal po 'char ba zhig 'dug pa de gzigs shing mtsho 'gram du tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ kong po nas chos rje rgyal dbang pa dpon slob

ra༅༅/ /'gror/rten li ma sogs 'bul ba stobs che/sgrub sde bsam gto rdzong du yongs 'dzin rin po che dpon slob kyang mjal bar phebs 'dug pa'i brtan bzhugs thog 'bul lam gya nom pa dang /mu stag dgon par smar ston lung bstan rdo rje'i sku skye mjal bar byung /bka' dbang chos gsan par byon chog pa'i snyan 'bul zhus/gram mdar phebs thog/'jang sa tham rgyal pos bya ma rta sbrel po rgyal ba'i bapokha 'gyur mo cag mtshal par ma khyad mtshar gyi 'bul skyel gyi snyan 'bul 'gyor/rim pas 'brog bod kyi sa tshigs so sor/chos dang zang zing gi 'du long bsam gyis mi khyab pa nas/nor bu gling du sde pa dgo o rta pa'i tshogs dang bcas phebs bskur byon/ser sbrengs kyi bkod pa'ang phun sum tshogs pa 'dug /'brong rtse dga' tshal du bzhugs sgar dang / gzims chung la dmigs pa'i khang bzang

da pa bde ba gsar 'debs mdzad 'dug par bzhugs/ byang stag lung nas phyag mdzod pa grerdzongs pa'i bstsod rten/ stag lung zhabs drung gi chab sgordzog dang bcas ji/ grub dbang rin po che kong po nas phebs pa'i 'bul skyel du slob dpon pa ngag dbang pad dkar byung / sde pa zhal ngor/ tshe rta/ gī la ya/ padma 'od 'bar/rdor/ mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs stsal/ sku gzhogs grwa tshang pa sogs skya ser gyi khrom che ba la spyi chos su bsha' gdams glegs bam gnang / yul stod spel la dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i rjes 'dzin mdzad rjes skyid sbug tu dbu mdzad rin po ches spyan drangs/ 'bul zhabs rnam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa lta bu bas/ 'brong rtse nas lcam rje btsun mas nas gtos che ba phul/ der dad 'dus kyi khrom chen por bsha' dbang stsal/ slar 'grong rtser phebs 'bul chen gyi nyin/

ra༅༅/ /yon sas dam pa rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa wo po 2bor dge ba'i bzhes gawo du mas bskor ba bzhugs khri wo mor gdan drangs/skye ba nu mar yon gnas dam pa la sri zhu bgyis pas phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la dbang 'gror ba/phun tshogs rdo rje yab sras kyis/khyad gos 'ba' zhig las grub pa bzo sakod phul du phyin pa'i spyan gzigs za ra chogs gling bcu gnyis yod pas gtsos/rten mchod/ja gos dar/rta cu sogs brgya 'bul dngos zhen ༅ rnams skrag pa skye bar 'gyur ba bsgrubs/khrom la tsha brkang stsal/li ma 'brong rtse nas phul ba sogs khyad thon bzhi bcu tsam rgyal byed kyi li ma lha khang du bzhugs su bcug /slar smid sngag tu phyogs zhag tsam gdan chags/phyi mtshams kyi khog nas khong da' slob la/lam zab dang bde mchog nā ro ༅ gsum ma'i dbang /ma tri snyan rgyad kyi cha

lag thod dbang me'i 'khor lo'i byin rlabs sogs stsal/ de skabs paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan myang stod phyogs la phebs 'dug par yar lam ja 'dren la gser khang chos mdzad gnang / phyir lam khong dpon slob kyi mgron gnyer yang ja zhus 'bul bar byang / dgun bzhugs 'brong rtse rang du mdzad/ chos don gnyer mang por phyag chen bla sgrub sogs khrid bka'i rigs ji snyed pa dang / rgyab chos su ljags lung mang 〉'ang stsal/ sde pa ma chen la mgon po rigs bzhi'i rjes gnang dang gto mgon gyi dbang / rdo rje 'dzan pa chos kyi mgon pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog steng nas mgon po'i dbang bzhi rgyas pa dang / 'jam dpal gshin rje khro chu'i dbang lung zab khyad can sogs gnang / gser mdog can pa'i bka' bcu rab 'byams 'ga' zhig la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bka' drin kyang mdzad/ rgya'/ dbang dmi pa

ra༅༅/ /chos dbyings rdo rje'i yab gshegs pa'i smon lam rten chab shog dang bcas pa'ang 'gror/dus 'khrugs la brten khams ri bo che ma thang gi gdan sa la gling log byung bas ri bo che khri thog pa stag lung du byon 'dug par/thugs kyi ngal ba mi 'tshal ba'i chab shog snyan 'jebs dang bstun mnyel ja dpangs bstod nu bar 'gro mgon bstan 'dzin chos grags brdzangs/de skabs/stod mnga' ris kyi rgyal sa chen po nas/grub thob chen po u rgyan pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang /mi'i dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal mchod yon gyi 'bul skyel/gser/gur kum/byi ru/spos shel/ka shi rka' ras sogs stobs che ba dang /khyad par rgyal ba'i thugs rje la nye ring med kyang bdag cag stod phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams la brtse ba chen pos gzigs pa'i phebs bzhugs bka' drin chen pos bskang du

gsol/ zhes spyan 'dren nan chags pa 'byor/ lo dus kyi sku rim chen mo btsugs pa'i nyer dgu la gtor chen las rim dang 'brel ba'i 'cham sogs rgya cher mdzad/ gnam gang la rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang si sku mchod dang / dngos po ste shing pho khyi lo gnam du shar ba'i thog ma'i dga' ston rgya chen po spel rjes dus chen nas bcoms sku mtshams kyi nges pa dam par rgyang tsam bzhugs/ grol bstun 'grong rgyas kyi lcam yol gdong pa nor bu khra sgor dang / gdong dga' ba dbyangs can gnyis mjal bar byon/ dbang chos dang dngos po'i gnang skyes kyis tshim par mdzad/ stag lung zhabs drung rin po che mdo khams phyogs kyi bstan pa'i kha gsor phebs 'dug pa'i cog rtse la nas ma thang khri thog pa brgyud/ phebs lam du bar chad mi 'byung ba dgos pa sogs kyi snyan sgron chab shog 'jebs pa'ang 'gror/ be ri dpon klu btsan rgyal

ra༅༅/ lnga pa'i chos nyid du gyur pa'i mang skol dang thugs dam 'dogs chas/ kho pa mchod yon gyi 'bul skyel dang bcas pa byung bar thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug mdzad/ gnas chen tsa ri tra'i rgod pa'i ri bskul slebs par masngoni phyag ri pa rnams gnang cha gya nom pa dang bcas brdzangs/ sa gzhi tshes lnga la ja gnas pas gang ser du spyan drangs/ dbang gzhi bteg pa'i thog grwa yon rnams kyi brgya 'bul rngo thogs pa 'dug cing khrom la tshe dbang stsal/ zla ba tsam bzhugs ring don gnyer so sor 'dod sbyar gyi dbang khrid dang / spyi chos kyang gang mtshams su gnang / sgam po zhabs drung gi rten bzhengs kyi rgyur sman pa'i dngul zhu mi byang bar pon che ba bstabs/ chos sde gnyis la mang ja rnam gzhag dang bcas pa gnang / de skabs dang 'brong rtser bzhugs dus kyang chos rje rin po ches brtan bzhu/sa kyi 'bul skyel

grangs mang ba 'gror/ phar yang sku tshe'i rten 'brel du brtan bzhugs 'bul mi mngags/ ja gnas pa'i brtan bzhugs 'bul lam thog longs sku'i chas su mdzad de bla ma'i rnal 'gror stsal bas der 'dus la byin rlabs kyi zil dngar ci yang phab/ rim pas rgyal byed tshal du phebs/ sngags bshad gnyis nas bkur sti zhus/ dad ldan gyi 'dus pa rdo chal mthil gang ba tsam la/ skal ba mchog dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gnas thob par byed pa'i lam mchog thun mong ma yin pa/ nges gsang bla na med pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag gi gdams pa'i rnying khu/ dkar brgyud rin po che rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su byon pa'i gzhung lam/ rje btsun dpal ldan nā ro ta pa'i khyad chos bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams smor zhes sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ mkhas pas bkral/ grub thob kyis bsgoms/ paṇḍi tas

go༅༅/ /bshad/lo tsā bas bsgyur/ rgya bod na nyi zla ltar grags pa de ni/ kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs kyis/ chos bshad na rgya che bzung na 'gril/ /rgyud zab mo kun gyi khong pa'i snying / /lam yang zab bsre 'pho ma lags pa/ /gzhan gdams ngag kun la yid ma shor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'grel spyod rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i steng nas rgyas bshad mtha' dpyod dang bcas pa/ kha skong so so'i thad du lam skor gyi yig cha gsar rnying rnams kyi lung /khrid yig rdo rje theg par bgrod pa'i shing rta chen po'i steng nas dmigs rim shin tu 'dril ba'i nyams len 'byer bde ba/snyan 'jebs tshangs pa'i dgrangs kyi sgo nas bsre ba 'bum nag tu grags pa stsal/nor la bde kye gsang gsum sogs cho ga mang po'i lung nyer mkho'i tshul du gnang / sde pas gsol ba btab ngor khrom chen

gas kyi tshe ba/'a dang / sde pa dang rong sgrub chen gyi 'bul chen thog rin po che'i sku rgyan bzhes/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha byad du mdzad nas bla / khrom pa rnams la ngo mtshar ba'i mthong snang mang po byung 'dug cing / nyams 'bar ba dang byin rlabs kyis rgyud smin pa sha stag pas mthar lam na pa spyi'i rim gror dmigs/ bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal bar byed pa'i dpal mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba lha mangs kyi mdos phyag ri chog rgyas pa'i sgo nas mdos gtor gyi sgrub pa zhag mang po'i bar du mdzad rjes thebs dang bstun nyer bdun la mdos rgyag dang / de mthun ba gnang ba'i gtor chen dang bcas pa rdo chal mthil du dpags/ rgyal ba nyid khri'u shing gi khar bzhugs/ ska gzhogs g.yas g.yoni du gsung

ra༅༅/ /chog pa rnams gnam sa ber ba tsam gyi rol cha dang bcas bzlog bsgyur grub mtshams/khrom tshang mas mthong bar/mdung tshoms kyi steng nas/gtor chen khru gang tsam nam mkha' la 'phags pa dang lhan cig thug chom gyi sgra chen po byung bas khrom pa rnams la 'jigs zil shin tu che ba byung /mi 'gyang bar rje gong ma kun mkhyen padma dkar i sku mchod chen mo gnang bar phyogs/rdul tshon gyi 67 'khor mang po zhal phye/mchod sprin gyi bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pa du ma bshams/yongs 'du grwa tshang /sngags grwa/bshad grwa/rin chen 'phreng ba sogs dge 'dun bdun brgya tsam tshogs pa'i gral dbur phebs/phyag mdzod nas mang ja zur sbrel nyin re bzhin zhus/sgrab cing mchod pa zhag mang po sbrel nas mdzad rjes/grol stoni la ska gzhogs grwa tshang pa rnams kyis 'cham gzigs rgyas pa phul/rgyal

byed du bzhugs thog smar ston lung bstan rdo rje'i sku skye mi 'gyur bzang po zhabs phyir yod par ka lā pa'i ri mo yongs rdzogs mtha' dang dang bcas ljags khrid du stsal/rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sgrub mi shin tu mang bas/ grub mtha' mtha' dag na rgyal ba 'di'i mkhan bus phyogs kun khengs par gyur/ dbang chos zhu mi'ang bgrang bar dka' ba byung bar so so'i yid bzhin chos sbyin rgya cher stsal/ chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i sku tshigs bdun par phebs pa'i rang byon bcu gcig zhal da lta cog grwa rnying pa'i rten gtsor bzhugs pa la bzhugs khang gser dngul las grub pa'i bkra shis sgo mangs kyi dbyibs bum nang du dkar brgyad gser 'phreng phyag bris su stsal ba yang ljags bkod gnang / rgya phubs su khang dmar bas spyan drangs/ tshe rta dang lhag pa'i lha 'ga'i rjes gnang mdzad/ slar tsu91 byed du phebs/ gtsang gzhung nas chibs sogs

ra༅༅/ /'bul lam rgyas pa 'bul bar spel ser ba byung / de res gtsang phyogs kyi grwa yon rnams kyi 'dod bzhin re zhig gtsang du bzhugs par dgongs kyang / bya yul du gong ma rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la spyan 'dren nan chags pa ltar bzhugs sgar bteg /bod 'brog li yul gru so so'i thig le 'dzin pa gtso bor gyur pa'i skye dgu rnams la rnam dashar gyi sa bon bskron bzhin pa nas byams chen chos gling du phebs/ gong ma chen po'i dgongs rdzogs su bya mcho skyes rdo rje'i phyi rten du bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po ches thog drangs pa'i 'bul lam dpangs mtho ba dang lho rgyud kyi lha sde mi sde'i tshogs la 'gyed cha phun sum tshogs pa 'dug pa de dag gi dge tshogs bar ma dor chud mi 'dza' zhing sa lam gyi bar chad zhi ba'i yongs su bsngo bas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad do// //ngo

mtshar bkod pa'i phul dang rab ldan yid 'ong bsam gtan khang bu der/ /dkar brgyud rigs kyi gangs ri las 'ongs rtog ge'i rnyog chus ma bslad pa/ /tilli nā ro mar mi la sogs grub pa kun gyis bston pa'i bcud/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub mchog tu grags de byin rlabs mngon gyur tshul yang bstan/ /de'i tshe snying po'i bstan padabyar gyi mtsho/ /ches cher spel ba'i 'phrin las chu 'dzin 'phreng / /phyogs mthar 'khrigs pas sred gdung kun bcil nas/ /phan bde'i 'od ngag ci yang 'bar bar gyur/ /'on kyang mi bsrun snyigs ma khros pa'i khas/ /'gro 'di'i bde skyid rtsa lag kun zos mthar/ /lus can thar pa'i srog 'phrog gnod pa'i me/ /rnam par spro ba'i du ris 'grog por g.yo/ /phun tshogs bsod nams stobs ldan sa 'odzan sgo /dad pa'i phrag gong mngon mtho'i rtse mo ru/ /snyigs dus mtshan mo'i mgon po spyan drangs de'i/ /

ra༅༅/ /'phrin las 'od dkar snang bas sa 'di khyab/ /ces dpal 'brag pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dgazha ba'i zlos gar larab/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub brnyes te 'phrin las kyi zhags pas kun gsal gyi 5 mtha' bcings pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas na tshod ldan te shing mo phag lo bya yongs 'du'i dbang po gto zhal gyis spyan drangs te rgyal khab yang rtser phebs/ kong po nas mtsho mjug sku skye dang / ngag dbang sku skye sogs 'bul dngos stobs che ba dang bcas sku zhabs su 'gror/ khong dpon slob nas gsol ba btab ngor rje padma dkar po'i bka' 'bum rin po che'i ljags lung yang rtsegatsug lag khang du tshogs pa shin tu che bar chos kyi 'khor lo skor bzhin pa nas/ spral pa'i skyes

mchog chen po gsum yang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po sgrub par gsol ba'i bzhed don bzhin/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na mkhan po rgyal dbang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag bsam dbang po/ 'khor dgra bcom pa rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa chos rje mi pham blo gros dang rgyal dbang pad dkar sogs rig grol smra ba'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su dgun zla bzhi pa'i gral tshes bzang po mngon du gyur par grub dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po/ pad dkar grwa tshang ba/sngags grwa gsar pa/ ska gzhogs skusnangs 'du grwa tshang pa sesgogs dang / dpyid zla dang po'i gral tshes la/ sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang po la dwags lha btsun ska gzhe3 pa/ ska skye chos rgyal dbang po/ cog grwa rnying pa/ kong po mtsho mjug grwa tshang pa sogs dang / dpyid zla gnyis pa'i gral tshes dge bar/

ra༅༅/ /yongs 'dzin kun dga' lhun grub thub bstan dpal bzang po/ lha btsun bgres pa bstan 'dzin bzang po/ grwa sgrub mang ba la bslab gzhi'i dngos po stsal nas ngur smig gar gyis mdzes pa'i dgra bcom nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar grangs mang zhing / bcas pa'i ngang tshul gyi mig rkyen bzang pos thub bstan gsal bar mdzad/ sprul pa'i skur phyag rgya chen yo lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi nyams khrid dang / yongs 'dzin rin po cher 'dul ba lung dang / khro chu'i yig skor gsungs/ e ba lang gzims khang pa'i lag tu bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po rje rgya ras kyi sku tshigs la phebs pa de la tsandan las grub pa'i bzhugs khang reg pa med pa'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs can ljags bkod ma dang / 'phyar dar mchin kha zhig la khyab 'jug gi ska phyag bris gnang skabs sa g.yo ba'i 'tshub 'gyur yang shin tu

che/ yang rtserming pa dang / sngags grwa gsar pa khyen gcig tu dril/ mgon po'i gtor chog rnying pa dang 'brel ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyi5 'khor zhal phye/ gsung chog rgyas pa gnang / dbang bzhi rkyang stsal/ chos rje rin po che mi pham blo gros kong por phyir phebs su nye ba'i da' slob dam pa'i chos kyi gsung gleng gis dus 'das shing / ro sgoms kyi gsal byed nyung ngu zhig kyang gsung rtsom gnang / rje de par sku tshe'i rten 'byung sgrig pa'i gnang cha stsal te/ byams pa chos gling du phebs/ mtsho mjug sku skye sogs 'dus pa'i tshogs chen por/ lam zab/ gu ru drag po gī la ya/ bde mchog drug cu ma/ tshe dpag med khro bo lha dgu/ mi 'khrags pa lha so bdun/ 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag sogs kyi dbang bka' gnang / nyi ldog skabs ska srung pa tshe bdag dpa' bo gtso bor gyur pa'i ska gzhogs rin chen 'phreng ba rnams kyis 'jam

ra༅༅/ /dpal khang du/ tshe bdag dang / khro chu sogs srung bzlog gi sku rim dang / rgyal ba nyid re zhig sku mtshams la bzhugs/ de nas sgrub grwa lha gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor lho brag la chibs kha bsgyur/ ldo rong gi phebs lam bgrod dka' ba rnams su gzhi bdag mi ma yin rnams kyis bkur sti bsgrubs/ khrar sde pa ma chen gshegs pa'i dge sgrub gral dbur spyan 'dren la sde pa sras po ched gnyer gyis byon/ phyogs zhag tsam bzhugs/ 'dad kyi nyin gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun stobs che ba'i gral dbur phebs/ go khrab/ khro zangs/ rta dre'u/ snam ras sogs 'bul ba rgya che ba dang / dge 'dun dang mi sde la'ang 'gyed chas bkur snyi dang bcas 'dug /'das po rnam grol la 'god pa'i bsngo smon sogs bu ba 'a pos rjes 'dzin dang / zhal bzhugs rnams chos dang zang zing gis re ba gang

nga zur gong brgyud mthing gi zam pa bgrod tsam nas/ lha khang nas sde pa dpon g.yog dang / cog grwa rin po che sangs rgyas pa dpon slob phebs thing gter gyi lha khang du phebs gdong sgrub grwa gnyis sogs kyis ser sbrengs kyi bkod pa dang gzhis ka rtse nas bkra shis khra ring skyong ba sogs//nga bcas zhag shas bzhugs nas mkhar chu rtser phebs/ mi ring bar rin po che rang thugs 'dod rdzogs te bstun gzhi cher med par gshegs// par gshegs rdzong gi bkur sti dang / zhal chems bzhin bsngo rten 'bul ba rgya cher 'dug pa rnams yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs mdzad/ mtshams la bzhugs/ rin po che de'i phyi rten bzhengs grub 'dug pa'i rab gnas kyang mdzad/ grwa tshang ba gco bor gyur pa'i dad 'dus la/

ra༅༅/ kham zab 'khor lo bsgyur drug bde mchog nā ro lugs lha bcu gsum ma sogs kyi dbang / phyag chen/ bla sgrub/ rten 'brel/ ro snyoms snang dril sogs khrid rim mang po stsal/ 'jam dpal gzhin rje khro chu'i las byang 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i nga ro dang / gnas 'di'i srung ma smyon kha dang dur khrod bdag mo'i bskang ba rnams gsung rtsom gnang / de mtshams sne'u sdong rtse dang / bde chen chos 'khor gyi spyan 'dren pa 'gror/ cog grwa'i bla mar chos rje nor bu rgyal mtshan bskos/ lha khang nas sgo chur phebs/ gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs la/ rab gnas nyin gcig pa zhig dang grwa tshang la spyi rdzas kyi gnang sbyin mdzad/ sman thang brgyad/ 'grog phyogs kyi grwa yon dad can mang po'i legs byas kyi rgya mtsho/ thugs rje'i bsil zer gyis gong nas gong du spel/ hor bya rig tshang gi 'bul ba dang sdig

slong gi dam bca' bzhes/ ma ṇi'i sgom lung stsal te rta ra mdor phebs/ gnas gsar dang nye ba'i thang nas yongs 'dzin rin po che dpon slob kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa tshar du dngar ba bshams te bde chen chos 'khor du phebs/ gzims chung gro bo lung du gnang / tshes bcu'i mchod pa la gu ru drag po dmar chen gyi gsung chog gral dbur yab sras lhan du phebs par/ grwa tshang pas 'cham gyi gzigs mo spros pa can dang / 'bul chen thog tshogs chen gyi brtan bzhugs phul/ 'phying ru phu mda'i skya ser drag zhan mang por dbang chos byin rlabs sogs gang bzhed du stsal cing / yo ngas 'dzin sprul skur brtan bzhugs gnang skyes rgyas pa mdzad/ rgyal ba 'di nyid khengs dregs dang che 'gying la sogs pa 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba las grol te sems dpa' chen po'i ngang tshul la gzhol ba la/ rgyal dbang dmi pa chos

ra༅༅/ /dbyengs rdo rje thugs kyi dgyes pa lhag par 'phel te/ gnang skyes gya nom pa dang bcas brtan bzhugs 'bul bar/ tshar pa sna nas a zhang khumi 'od zer rdzong gru mdzad pa 'gror/ de dus bya bral dad gus can zhig gis rnam thos sras kyi sku brnyan khyad du mtshar ba zhig phul ba de rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo 'byed du 'dug gsungs/ mi 'gyang bar rgyal dbang dmi pa phug ron ni tsu la'i tshal du bzhugs sgar phab/ dgongs pa can gyis cag zhag bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar mgron gnyer bla ma ri bo che pa gnang / de rjes rje 'di pa dpon slob kyang 'phral du phebs pa'i mjal 'dzom yong du nye ba la rten 'brel dbang las glo bur gyi thugs brel zhig gis 'gyangs/ der sog po hwam thā ci'i mi snar bsam yas chos mdzad pa zer ba slebs/ bla bre shin tu che ba zhig gi rten dang bcas/ nged rnams bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa

mjal 'dod thun mong ma yin pa yod pas byang phyogs su phebs dgos tshul nan chags zhus/ khong pa rgyal blon rnams la sna len dang bod sog lugs legs dgos tshul spro bar khang dmar chos mdzad dang sog btsun pad dashar bkra shis mngags pa rong po 'dam du 'gror tshe kho'i dmag rgod rags rim 'brog sgang du slebs/ grwa sdings po che nas spyan 'dren la mgrozhe gnyer dbang phyug pa 'gror/ grwa yang kha nas la dwags rgyal po lha btsun dang nang so phyag mdzod pa gnyis/ rgyal ba /mi pa'i skru gzhogs su gang ci'i gnas tshul 'bul bar grwa phyir rdzong bdar gnang / tshogs dge 'dun sgang pas bsu ba ser sbrengs rgyas pa dang bcas gtsug lag khang gsar bzhangs su spyan drangs/ 'du khang la phyag nas shis brjod zhus/ de mtshams rje sems dpa' chen po'i sngal pa'i ska dpon slob rnams kyis don grub mthong smon du gdan drangs/ zhag

ra༅༅/ gas bzhugs spyi dgos su bsha' dbang chos kyi gsor lo bskor/ zhabs 'degs dang brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'ang rgya cher snang / grwa phyi bkra shis chos gling du 'bral zhig rang dang smar ston zangs mtsho ba sogs kyis bsnyen cing bkur/ der yar 'brog tu sog po a sa lang hwam thā cir sems can gyi bde thabs smu phan pa dgos tshurla spro bar chos rje nor bu rgyal mtshan dpon slob btang bas/ hwam thā ci yar 'brog nas dol rnam rgyal du slebs pa dang 'grigs/ rgyal ba'i bsha' shog mjal 'phral mi phyed pa'i dad gus skyes/ ci gsung ba/'a sgrub zhu ba'i khas len bzang po phul nas/ nged cag gi 'dren pa nyan pa'i bla ma zhig kyang rdzong bda' gnang dgos zhu ba'i snyan 'bul byung bar/ bla ma mi nyagapa legs bshad pad dkar 'os par dgongs bsko 'ja' shis brjod kyis brgyan ste rdzong ba gnang / khong gis zhus ngor

smon lam/ rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' bzhin pu /bsgrubs 'dis byang gi phyogs su sdig zas sogs/ nyes pa'i las kun bstan par phan sems kyis/ /skad rtseg nyid la 'dag par gyur cig gu /zhes gsungs te/ bya sa lha khang nas sde srid sne'u sdong rtse pas bsu ba'i bkod pa tshar du dngar te pho brang chen po rtser phebs/ de dus sog po gar thon ma nges pas dbus lho byang gi skye 'o rnams shin tu nyam nga ba'i skabs/ rgyal ba 'di nyid pho brang chen por bzhugs stan chags pas thams cad 'jigs pas nyen pa la dbugs dbyung byin/ der 'jang rgyal po'i zhu 'phrin gyi tham kha/ gser gyi 'khor lo/ ba/'a 'gyur rin po che mtshal par ma glegs bam glegs thag na bza' sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i bzhugs sgam bcas/ dngul ja dar sogs brgya 'bul stobs che ba 'bul bar bla ma rgyal dbang bstan 'phel 'gror/ ska gzhogs

༄4༅/ /dge 'dun rags rim gyis badzi' 'gyur rin po cher mchod pa'i bye brag dang bcas ser sbrengs kyis spyan drangs/de nyin me tog gi char chen po babs/rgyal por skyes lan dang rten bcas gyis gnas chen mkhar chur bzhugs dus bsrings/mi 'gyang bar gtsang sde srid nas skye 'gro'i bde thabs la dgongs mi sna gnang dgos tshul byung ba nas/bla ma ri bo che pa dang khang dmar chos mdzad mngags/ de mtshungs/shar dge/stag lung sogs bla chen so so'i phyag mdzod mi sna bsha' shog gnang skyes dang bcas pa'ang brdzangs 'dug /sog po'i sde nas rgyal ba nyid spyan 'dren pa rab tu rong po 'dam tsam du phebs dgos tshul zhu ba dang /byang lugs kyi ja 'dren snga mgyogs su/rgyal po'i chibs sga 'khor cha tshang /gos chen yug lnga bcu sogs 'bul bar za dmar rab 'byams pa sog po mi bzang 'ga' dang

bcas che chen gyis btang ba 'byor/ rje nyid byang la chibs kha bsgyur ba ma shar na gar bzhugs kyi sar mjal ba la rgyal blon tshang ma mardzong ba'i zhu ba nan chags pa 'dug par/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems la goms pas gdug rtsub can de rnams yong tshe lam dang lam rnams su 'khod pa'i lus can rnams la mnar sbyangs byung dogs pas byang rgyab tu phebs pa'i zhal bzhes gnang / mi sna rnams la dbang chos zang zing gi gnang cha bzang po stsal te slog /de bstun rgyal ba dmi pa dang / gtsang sde srid nas kyang bod sog 'dun chings spel bar phebs dgos tshul byang / de skabs dbus gtsang lco byang thams cad du 'bram nad me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs yin cing / gtso bor ska nyid kyis 'brum pa ma bzhes pa dang / sgar khrod na'ang 'athrem pa ma thar ba mang bas/ da lam byang du phebs pa zlodi gnas ltas

ra༅༅/ /kyang mi legs zhes sku 'khor ba rnams kyis zhus 'dug pa la/ b.lakha las/ lar theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la sems can gnyig gi don du yang rang blos gtong dgos pa yin/ lhag par 'brum nad la chos rje 'brag pa rang gi gdams ngag ro sgoms kyis lam du 'khyer dgos pas 'dzem pa'i rtog pa skyes na de thog tu 'gro dgos pa yin mod/ bod khams kyi skye 'gro'i bde thapas la dmigs dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa sa da lam bar chad kyi rigs mi yong gsungs/ phyis de kho na ltar 'bram pa sogs kyi nye zho spu tsam ma byung / hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum la sne'u sdong rtsenas chibs kha bsgyur/ bsam yas su mdo sde mchod pa dang 'grigs/ snyan dar soshermi 'bul mi gnang dus chos skyong tse'u mar skyes bu'i lus la brlams pa'i ngag las/ paṇḍi ta da lam byang phyogs la phebs pa 'di bod

gangs can gyi bde thabs la shin tu phan zhing / de la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las zhabs tog kho bos kyang sgrub pa yin zhes dam bcas/ gsang sngags bde chen du gtsang gzhung nas zhabs phyir mi sna spel ser ba dang pa snam skyong ba gnyis phebs lam gyi zhabs tog 'bul bar 'gror/ khar ba shan brgyad 'phan yul blo mos rgyal dang nye bar bzhugs zhag gnang tshe grwa yone mang pos 'bul ba dang bcas mjal bar 'dug pa rnams la bsha' 'brel dang / lhag par 'bram narsha gis skye bo mang po shi ba'i bsngo ba byang chog bla ma gzhan 'brum 'dzem gyis zhu sa ma rnyed pas bar ma dor lus skabs/ gshin po rnams brtseb chen pos rjes su 'dzirno pa'i ba/kha drin mdzad pas/ de dus bsngo ba byang chog thob pa'i gshin po rnams bsod nams che bar kha tshon bcad/ chag la'i nang du stag lung pas thab bsu dang phyag mdzod pas gtsos dbu che drung 'khor

ra༅༅/ /rnams chibs bskur 'gror/ gling grwa tshang gi dge 'dun stobs che bas ser sbrengs kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dug /gnam 'od shin tu che na'ang / rgyal ba'i spyan sngar ser sbrengs kyi ring nyi khang lhag par dwangs pa byung bas rje'i zhal nas stag 'brug dam tshig gcig pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug gsungs/sang nyin rdzong du zhabs drung sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i khog tu dpon slob nyung bsdus tsam spyan drangs/ zhabs drung nyid gzims chung 'gag tu phebs 'dug par mjal dar phyag 'bul rtse sprod gnang / bzhugs gdan sogs sngar rgyun ltar legs lam che ba dang / 'bel gtam bka' bgros sogs thugs yid gang ba gnang ngos/ da lam gyi sog po byang 'grul ba 'di rnams sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i gdug rtsub can bod du 'gyul pa sleb pa tsam la stobs che ba zhig 'dug pas/ sgo gang zab kyi rten 'brel

sgrig pa zhu gsung zhal ta legs par gnang bar/ rje nyid kyis kyang / da lo tsho sems can rnams la 'tshe ba chen po 'dug pa blos ma bzod pa dang / rgyal ba kurma pa'i bkas bskul ba dang / sde srid nas kyang dgongs gtad 'dug pa ltar/ dkon mchog la gsol ba btab nas rim bzhin yong pa lags/ 'jig rten phyogs kyi blo gros dang mthong myong ma mchis pas/ thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug zhu gsungs/ de nas grog la brgyud thang 'brog tu bzhugs sgar phebs thog /sras zhing bla ma dang dge legs seng ge zer ba chog thu'i 'bul ba'i phying gur su thang gi gnyer pa yin pa zhig byung nas/ nged kyi dmag rnams 'dam smad na yod/ nga chog thu gzhung gi mi yin pas thog mar nga'i sde nang du phebs dgos zhes gus 'dud kyi zhu yig dang bcas 'gror bas zhal bzhes gnang / de nub char shin tu che/ sang nyin lha chu la thar ba'i re med/ zhag

ra༅༅/ /gnyis gsum tsam bzhugs dgos zer na'ang / rgyal ba'i thugs rjes sang nyin lha chu'i khar nyi khang dwangs shing gnam then dus kyi chu tsam las sred par khal rab kyis thar ba byung / rab thon 'phral chu nag po gnam la 'phyo ba bzhin rgyas nas phar mchongs tshur mchongs la song bas lha chen thang lhas bkur sti sgrub par 'dug ces thams cad yid ches kyi dad pa'i me tog 'thor bar gyur/ de nas mchod rten dmar 'bal du phebs/ bla ma 'bab rong pa sogs sde nang gi ser mo ba'i bla ma rnams dang mi bzang rta pa brgya skor gdan 'dren du byung / sang snga bar sog po'i sde thog tu bzhugs sgar phab/ rgyal mo gun ji dang / blon po che chen gyis gtsos pa'i mi bzang rnams 'bul ba dang bcas gzims gur du mjal bar byung / skyes bu dam pa rnams gang 'dul gzugs ska'i bkod pa chu nang gi zla ba bzhin ston par gsungs

pa ltar/ chog thu rgyal po dang dbyer mi phyed par mthong bas dad pa dang zil tshugs pa med pa byung 'dug /de nas hwam thā ci'i dmag na dmar mtsho skyar yod pa'i thog tu ko khyim gyi la brgyud nas phebs/ sgar tshugs gsum gyi gung tshigs thog tu rgyal po'i mi sna ching dge slong zer ba de 'byor ba'i zhu yig tu/ nga'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa phebs pa shin tu legs/ er ci 'di nga'i sar marbhe1gas par phebs dbo sa zhu bar btang ba yin/ zhu yig gzigs rten bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas zhes gus 'dud kyi gdan 'dren 'gror/ sde nang du phebs par nye ba dang / lo tstsha ba khun ching blon po u'i ja sang sogs rta pa mang po 'ongs/ gza' skar stabs kyis nged kyi phying gur du da lta phebs dgos zer ba'i zhu ba dang / phyag mdzod mi sna rnams la sngar gyi tshig gzhug mnan pa'i nga'i bros po rnams khrid yong rgya med pa la khyed rnams gang gi don

ra༅༅/ khi ci la yong dgos yong zer 'ur 'joms gdug rtsub kyi rnam 'gyur shin tu che ba ci yang zhig byas/ dasto slob rgyang ring po nas mthong ba tsam gyis dad gus lhag par skyes/ kho ra'i phying gur che bar khri stan phun sum tshogs pa bshams/ da lta nyid du phebs pa zhu zhes lo tstsha ba dang am ji gcig gzhug cig non gyis spyan 'dren la byung / de 'phral phebs as lang hwam thā ci dang lu po ṭa gnyis kyis phying gur phyi nas bsus/ bkra shis kha btags zung 'brel re'i phyag mjal byas gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bgyis/ byin rlabs zhus/ de'i tshe sog yul nas yar yong skabs lugs gnyis kyi don chen po chog thu rgyal pos mngags pa rnams dran/ de ma thag tshe rta zung 'brel gyi bka' dbang dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa ltar gnang / mi sna rnams la 'jig rten lugs dang 'brel ba'i bka' bgros skor g.yeng

she thabs kyi khra ma yin gsung ba'i ba/'a khra/ don gyi tshig sdom dang tshig sbyor rgyas par spros pa'i bapokha tham 4 gnang / rgyal blon mi bzang dang bcas par rdo rje'i gsung 'di ltar ba/'a stsal to/ /'o nga dang chog thu rgyal di de'i rgyal rgyud kyi bu dang blon 'bangs yin na chog thu rgyal tsho 'di phyi'i rpā khyod rnams kyis sgrub dgos gtad pa'i khra ma 'di la nyon las/ bod sog gzhung bzang po sgrig ste rtsa sngon po yod pa'i thog 'di la log thub ba pa'i dam bca' phul/ 'jig rten lugs kyi mna' bskyal to/ /de rnyir shin tu mi bsrun pa'i kla klo'i dpung

go༅༅/ /tshogs stobs rsha po dang ldan pa'ang gsung thengs gcig gis g.yul ngo ljogs pa'i rdzu 'phral bstan nas bod khams kyi skye 'gro thams cad bde ba la 'god pa'i bka' drin stsal ba yin no/ /de mtshams gtsang sde srid nas sog po la rdzong ba stob dgos rnams ce /rtsi kha'i lan zhu ba dang bcas bla ma khag so so'i phyag mdzod mi sna rnams dang / sog po'i mi bzang bzhi sogs gtsang du brdzangs/bod sog 'dun chings legs par 'grigs rjes/hwam thā ci mi bzang dang bcas pas zhu ba 'di ltar gsol te/chog thu rgyal po dpal gyi bzhed don/bla ma rdo rje 'chang nyid mtsho khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram du spyan drangs te/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba bakha/rgyal po rang yang bla ma khyed kyi spyan sngar dmag mi byed pa/ri dwags bsad pa'i sha mi za ba/theg chen sems bskyed kyi

dam bca' chen po 'di gsum phul te/ zab chos rnams nyams su bzhes rgyu yin/ sog po'i rigs kyi mi gdug rtsub can 'di rnams kyang gdul byar gzigs pa'i chibs kyi kha lo byang du bsgyur ba zhu zhes gsol nas/ chog thu rgyal po'i spyan 'dren gyi zhu yig sogs phul ba la/ rje'i bka' las/ spyir gyi yang da lta sog yul du zab khrid ston pa skabs su ma bab cing / lhag par skye ba 'di na so yang song / sha sogs zas rags pa cher mi 'gro ba 'dis rkyen theg pa mi 'dug pas da lam 'gro mi thub/ slar rten 'brel byed pa yin gsungs/ de nas sog po rnams bla ma gzhan zhig yin na shed mong gis kyang gdan 'grongs pa 'dug ste/ bla ma 'di sku zil che bas de nee mi nus/ ska tshab zhig zhu ba 'thad zer ska tshab zhus par zhal bzhes gnang / chog thu rgyal pos gal srid bla ma spyan ma 'grongs na nga'i 'bul ba dang dam bca' 'di

ra༅༅/ /rnams dbus gtsang gi cha shas ga na bzhugs kyang 'bul thub pa gyis zer ba yod 'dug pa ltar/ nyin cig khri chen po brtsigs pa'i khar rgyal ba nyed spyan drangs/ sde so so nas ko drwa mang po khyer ba'i sog po stong tsho du ma tshogs/ de thog chog thu rgyal po rang dmag mi byed par dam bca' ba'i 'bul ba/ lcags dkar gyi rmog sbugs brdung khyung rdor 'brug lag langs/ phyogs bzhir gser gyi stag seng khyung 'brag /sog yig dang bod yig gi rgyal po dpal gyi 'bul ba zhes pa dang / kha skor la lañdza'i a sas bskor ba'i rgya tshags rtsod med/ khrab lcags danan gyi byang bu dbuzlo lta bu'i steng du gser gyi lardzis brgyan pa/ rta go lcags gzhib cha tshang / bsad sha mi za bar dam bca' ba'i 'bul ba rgya dngul lhad med kyi sha gzhong dngul srang stong dang / sha thur dngul srang sum brgya yod pa/ ri dwags mi rngon par

dam bca' ba'i 'bul ba/ sag thag dngul shan ma/ mda' dngul dong mde'u gser tshags mas gang ba/ dpa' bo'i gzhu mchogo dngul gyis byas pa/ ral gri rgyal po dpal gyi ming gser tshag can/ kho ra'i bzhon rta khu ri smug po la gser sga/ srab rmed hor tshags/ mu tig gi gzar spu len dang bcas/ me lcags hor tshag me khug rgya bzo/ me rdo rin po che'i rigs las byas pa/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bul ba/ bkra shis pa'i kha btags kyis sna drangs/ ja mang po dang / gos dar gyi bzang dos rnga mong sum cu'i rgyab/ gzhan yang rgya hor gyi dngos spyad bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ de dang rjes 'brel du/ srog mi gcod pa/ dmag mi byed pa/ ma ṇi dung phyur dang / nyin khri mtshan khri 'dren pa'i dam bca' 'bul mkhan yang sog po stong tsho zin pa byung / de thams cad

ra༅༅/ /kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub 'a por bsngo bar mdzad cing / khrom la spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom lung bda' 'brel du stsal/ hwam thā ci dang lu po ṭa gnyis la bde mchog gi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyal mo mi bzang dang bcas par bla ma'i rnal 'gror dang / thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang sogs stsal nas mtha' 'khob kyi skye bo mi bsrun pa de rnams smin grol gyi gnas la 'god par mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos lha sar jo shāka mjal ba dang bsam yas su dngul gyi maṇḍal 'bul bar phyin chog pa'i gnang ba zhus par/ bka' las/ khyod rgyal rgyud kyi rigs stobs chen po'i gnas mjal 'di dge las sdig che ba yin/ 'on kyang khyod sa thag ring po nas 'ongs pa yin pas/ sems can la gnod 'tshe med par lha sa mjol zhig /bsam yas ni mi grong mang po bshag dgos pa yin pas bde thabs su mi 'gro

gsung ma gnang / dmag tshogs byang du 'ordzog 'gro ba'i dus tshes nges pa can la bkar nas bod la chibs kha bsgrur/ chibs skyel la rgyal po hwam thā ci dang mi bzang lnga brgya tsam 'dug pa rnams kyis thab skyel sar zhabs spyi bor blangs/ mig nas mchi ma 'don zhing 'bral mi phod po'i dad shugs chen pos/ da bla ma khyed dang mjal ba'i skal ba e yong zer ba la/ sdig spong dge sgrub la 'bad na nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin gsungs/ de nas gnam mtsho'i mdun rgyud la gon la phebs/ 'dam smad du gun ji rgyal mo dang che chen thā ci'i sde nang du spyan drangs/ rgyal mos/ gos chen gyi rgya gur/ bkras btags kyi yol ba tshe ring ljongs can/ mu tig gi sa gdan/dngul las grub pa'i thab chas/ mo rang gi rgyan gon pa dang bcas te phul zhing / che chen gyi rta dang gos yug mang po phul/ sgrol dkar dang spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes

ra༅༅/ /gnang sogs 'dod chos gang dgos stsal/bla ma 'bab rong bar gu ru drag po'i dbang byin rlabs gnang / rta dang gos sdig sogs 'bul ba rgya chen po 'dug /'bab rong gi gdan sa 'di la thugs rjes 'dzin pa zhu zhes pa'i zhu ba'ang gsol/ de nas stag lung ya thang du phebs/ cag zhag gzhi len phul phyin 'dug/grwa tshang gis gtsug lag khang gsar par spyan drangs/rab tu gnas pa dang bstan srung chen po ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rgyas pa dang /gling grwa tshang thams cad la mang 'gyed gnang / zhabs drung rin po che skru mtshams 'og tu sngar ltar mjal 'dzom mdzad tsha/ gsung las/ spyir bod khams spyi dang / khyad par nged byang phyogs pa rnams la bka' drin che bar byung /zhes sags legs so'i bka' mchid mang po mdzad/de nas chag la brgyad lhan grub rdzong du sde pas bkur snyi

phul phyin bsgrubs/ za dam gyi spyan 'dren pa 'gror/ chibs bsu ser sbrengs sogs phun sum tshogs pa dang / gtsug lag khang chen por dge 'dun tshogs pa'i gral dbur/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa thams cad mkhyen pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi gdan seng ge'i khri la phebs/ tshogs pa thams cad kyi bkra shis kha btags dang sman rtse zhe gcig gi mjal dar dang / spyi so phyag mdzod rnams nas 'bul zhabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug /tshogs chos su bla ma'i rnal 'gror ches rgyas pa zhig dang dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed kyang stsal/ rten gsum rnams mjal bar mdzad tshe dkar me snyan dar se(gas rgyas pa bstabs/ de nas lha sar phebs/ sde bzhi'i chibs bsu rgyas par 'dug /jo shwaka rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i rten khyad par can rnams la zhal gser dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pas mnyes

ra༅༅/ /par mdzad/ jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du zhag gcig bzhugs/ bod 'bangs kyi skye 'gro rnams la bde skyid 'byang ba'i smon lam rgya cher gnang ste bde chen la chibs kha bsgyur/ de mtshams sog po rgyal blon rta pa stong tsho tsam dang bcas lha sar jo shāka mjal ba dang bla ma'i zhabasaX sgro zin re nas yong 'dug kyang / bzhugs yun thung bas zhabs phyi ni ma zin/ bde chen du zhabs phyi sgegs pa'i mi snar er ci dang che chen nang so sogs rta pa bcu brdzangs/ gos chen kha dog sna tshogs la chos skyong gi sku brnyan rgya nag gi ri mo yod pa'i 'phyar dar grangs mang ba sogs phul/ nged rnams mtha' 'khob kyi mi bsod nams dman pas lha sar bla ma'i zhabs phyi ma zin/ da der yong na ni kha sang lha sa mjal nas log 'gro dgos gsung ba'i bapokha dang 'gal bar 'dug /nged rnams kyis lam du sems can dang lo tog

smu gnod pa byas pa med/ da la 'ur log 'gro bas sku tshab kyi bla ma gnang dgos zhes nan chags byung bar/ mdo nas chos rje ngag dbang don ldan dpon slob 'gron du bcug /gser la brgyud bsam yas su phebs/ sde pa brag kha bas zhabs tog chos gzhis kyi 'bul sbyor rgyas para'adug /de thog bsam yas su mchod 'bul gyi mi snar che chen nang so rta pa mang po dang bcas dngul gyi maṇḍal shin tu che ba rnga mong gi rgyab longs gcig /gzhan yang gser gyi maṇḍal sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rje nyid du'ang thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i 'bul ba kha shas dngabacas 'byor/ byang chub chen por khyad gos yug gi snyan shal sogs bod khams sri'i bde skyid kyi smon lam gnang / de nas lha gzigs chos kyi rgyal po rim par bsti ba'i pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtser phebs so// //ris med 'gro la byams

ra༅༅/ /brtses brlan pa'i thugs rje'i cha rdzogs spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las chen por yongs grub 'gro gsum rnam 'dren dgongs pa'i dkyel/ /phan bde'i rgya mtshor ro gcig 'dres pa'i dba' rlabs darkan pos phyogs thams cad/ khun tu khyab pa'i dge mtshan chen pos srid zhi'i dpal la mnga' dbang bsgrur/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i rang rtags ma nyams pa/ /mtshon phyir kla klo'i gnod pas bod yul dbus/ /mun par byed la mngon du gzhol ba'i tshe/ /'phrin las bsol zer snang ba phyogs bcur spros/ /bem po'i dngos la sgru ma'i rol rtsed tsam/ /bstan la'ang dpyod ldan mtshar du rtsi ba na/ /rdo rje'i tshig gcig kho nas stobs ldan dpung / /bzlog pa'i rdzu 'phrul mthu 'di su yis dpag /de sna rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i bang mdzod la/ /'gran pa'i 'gror pa rgya mtshos mchod pa'i sprin/ /rgya cher spel

ba'i dad ldan klu'i dbang po/ /'gro 'di byed pos gsar du sprul pa snyam/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dgazha ba'i zlos gar las/ mtha'i dmag dpung thugs rje'i zer gyis bzlog par mdzad de bod yul gyi skye 'gro phan bde'i dpal la bkod pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bco lnga pa'o// //de yang mtha' dmag gdug pa can rnams byang la log 'gro ba'i khas blangs phul tshe/ spel ser ba'i rtog pa la sde srid gtsang pa dang ni 'dun chings legs par 'grigs song / rang rang gi bstan pa 'di la'ang dus dang bstun pas sbyin bdag gi shed mong la brten pa zhig ma byung na/ chos phyogs gcig pus bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong 'di yang shogs yong ba zhig mi 'dug pas/ da rang sog po 'di byang rgyab 'dir bsdad

ra༅༅/ /kyang skyoni mi 'dug snyam pa shar/ rgyal ba nyid gzims gur rgya gur na 'gol bzhugs gnang 'dug pa'i zhabs drung du/ bdag la zhu ba zhig 'dug pas dgongs dgos zhus pas/ nged rang gnyis nang gtsang zhing nyid bstan pa la zhen che ba yin pas zer rgyu ci 'dug lab chog gsungs/ gong gi rgya mtshan rnams gus pas/ bka' las/ khyed bstan pa la bsam/ ma bzod pa'i snying gtam cis kyang yin 'dug kyang / spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zer ba 'jo snying por dril na / sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ma gtogs kha dragalongs spyod dpung brtas su che rang la bzhag pa zhig min pa 'dra/ lhag par sog po 'di dus snyigs ma'i skabs su 'byung ba'i mtha' dmag zer ba de yin

pas/ 'di la slob dponi chen po padma sambha was bzlog thabs 'ba' zhig gsungs pa ma gtogs 〉rdzor thabs gsungs pa mi 'dug /des na rgyal ba bordzong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa dang 'gal 'gro bar 'dug pas/ da lam gyi gros thag de nged rang gis chod pas de mi byed/ nged ra'i 'khor rnams la yang de'i 'phros pa ma gtong mdzod/ da lo sgar pa 'di rnams la'ang rgya 'dre'i dkor rtags kyi rnam pa zhig slebs 'dug pas chog byed nyog byed kyis zhe sun pa las med/ khyed rang bsam pa che ba rjes su yi rang / nga ni brel ba 'di rnams chod nas bya yul du mgyogs par sleb dgos pa 'dug /bya pa ska skye rin po che dpon blon yang mdzad sgo sngar dang mi 'dra ba 'dug pa dang / lho rgyud phyogs su brtag pa yang legs po zhig ma byung / rje gong ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs chormi kyi grags par rnyan kha'i lung bstan gyi dus rtags kyang

ra༅༅/ /'grigs par nye bas thog mar bya yul phyogs rings stabs byas 'gro/ gtsang sog gi rtsi kha gtsang du byed rgyu'i dpang por nged yong dgos tshul non che ba 'dug kyang bod sog gi brtan chings mi 'gyur ba'i mjug sdom ni bgyis yod/ 'di tsam gyi dpang po sa khyad nye ba dang bcas bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po ches gnang bas 'thus tshul lab yong gsungs pas zhu lan ma spobs/ de nas gong ma mi'i dbang po mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug ces mi 'phrog pa'i thugs dad can des da lam byang phyogs su phebs bzhugs gnang ba ni bod spyi la tshad bzung med pa'i thugs rje'i gzigs pas ma bskyud cing / sog po rgyal blon sogs byang phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams kyang 'brel tshad don ldan du gyur pa'i bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis/ 'di tshor rgyang tsam ska mnyel bso dang bcas bzhugs gdan 'jags pa ci nas

mkhyen zhes snyan 'bul gnang bar/ da lam bya yul phyogs rings khyad 'dug pas yun ring mi sdod/ de bar ska rim dbang b.lakha dgongs par gang gtad zhu gnang ba ltar zhabs drung zhal ngor ba/kha dbang gi rim pa mang po gnang zhing / nyin ltar gyi zhal dkyil mjal ba'i skye bo'i 'du tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par phyag dbang zhal mjal dbang chos sogs so so'i re ba ltar stsal/ khra 'brug gi gnas gzigs gnang / bod spyi'i bde skyid kyi rtsa ba gcig 'di na yod ces smon lam dang rten gsumal snyan shal sogs mchod sprin rgyas pa dang / chos skyong la'ang padma sambha lnga'i dam tshig gi ra ba las mi 'da' bar gyis zhes gdams/ bzhugs zhag gi sa gsal khang tshun rtse zhabs drung rin po che'ang zhabs skyel du phebs par lugs gnyis kyi gnang skyong bzang po mi g.yo ba'i snyan sgron bda' mchid stsal nas 'grong rgyas su phebs/ der skya

༄7/ /ser gyi 'dus pa sna shin tu che/ chos sde tshwas kyi dge 'dun rdzong dpon sogs la 'dod chos dang / thang po che/ yang ri/ ri bo bde chen/'phags sde ba/ spyan g.yas pa sogs la mang 'gyed kyang gzab ma gnang / 'gag pa rnams la kho bor 'phrad pa 'dod pa rnams drag zhan la ma lta bar su 'dod btang bas chog ces zhal gyi dkyil 'khor blta ba kun dgazha mgazhi dpal gyis srid pa'i gdung ba bcil/ 'khor ba'i 'dam la rgyab kyis phyogs pa mang po'i gtsug phud bzhes te thos bsam bgyid 'os pa rnams grwa tshang du rdzong ba gnang / de nas gangs rgyab mgo nag ri'i mdun du phebs skabs bya yul du gtsang gi lcam drung dpal mtsho dpon g.yog la dam bcur dang / seng rdzong shel mkhar blangs pa sogs sde gzar langs pa'i gnas tshul snyan du son pas/ nged rings khyad kyis yong par don ma byung /

mtshan don kyang mi yong ba'i khar mi sde la brdab gsig chen po yong / 'on kyang sngar zin la bcos su med/ da rung sdig g.yos chen po gto ma mdzad/ dpon sa bdag sa btson la 'jug pa mi chen gyi lugs su mi 'gro/ khyad par bya pa la mdzad rjes kyang mi dman pa yin pas/ nged kyi ngo la gtong dgos rgyu yin sogs snga bar mi sna rdzong ba gnang / rim pas gnyal chos lung chen po'i lte ba rdo rje gdan du phebs/ gtsang sa nas kyang bya pa dang sog po sogs 'brel ba'i yo 'byom che ba byang dogs bde thabs kyi ba/'a 'doms dgos tshul zhu bar spel ser ba rdzong gru mdzad pa 'gror par/ bsha' las/ da lo 'bram nag 'di'ang shin tu rtsub pa zhig 'dug she/dus dbang gi skye bo rmu rgod ༅ 'di rnams kyi spyod 'gros 'di ltar mchis kyang / sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can re re'i don du ska srog btang na gzhan ci smos/ nged

ra༅༅/ /kyang 'bram 'dzem dang snying las chung ngur 'dug rtsis ni mi byed/ gtsang pas kyang nged 'brug pa la rdo rje dang rdo 'jong gi dpe mdzad pa zhig las ma mchis kyang ngan lan bzang pos 'jal ba zhe dam yin gsungs/ zhabs drung sku skye sku zhabs su byon par/ da lam brtag pa yang legs po ma byung / rgyal srid kyi byus don la brtan brling che dgos lab pa de bzhin yin kyang / 'bangs kha rgyal gyi dbang du song na dpon la gnang dasha' 'di bzhin las 'os ma mchis kyang sgo gang zab lta dgos gsungs/ de nas bya pa'i mtshan don re zhig dus la babs pa dang / gtsang sa yang dpung shed che ba dang / sog dmag gdug rtsub can de slog pa'i ba/'a drin mi bzo bas legs spel gnang ba la ji mi snyam par bya zhabs drung dpon g.yog bzhugs stabs ma bde yang / rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i grib bsil gyis lho rgyad kyi skye 'gro spyi

la bde thabs kyi bsha' drin gzhal du med pa bskyangs/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa stsal bas rdo rje gdan du gnyal gyi srid sde phal cher 'khang bas/ 'ga' res che srid 'di pas brku rab pa'i skabs lugs gnyis ka nas ma 'thus pa chen po byas/ mdor na nged rang sgar pa'i bang phyin 'grim pa tsam la'ang gnod pa byas zer bar/rje'i bda' las/ de 'dra byas pas mi yong / chos pa bya ba gnod lan phan pas 'jal dgos pa yin/ rdo rje gdan du nged la ltad nas yong ba rnams la nye 'gyang med/'di na yod pa su la'ang snyad 'tshe sgar grwa tshang su nas byas byung yang nged kyi dam nyams yin no gsungs/ gzhan yang che srid chung srid sogs lding so sor khro chen po res gtsos dngos po'i gnang sbyin rgya cher stsal bas bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dgra gnyen la phyogs cha ma gnang zer/ zhe nas dad pa skyes bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor

ra༅༅/ /zhing / yang 'bog kong nas tsho la'ang mdzad gtad du gya bar thugs brtse bas bakha' 'doms gzhan dang mi 'dra ba gnang / 'di rigs rje gong ma rnams kyi thugs rjes ma thul ba rnams kyang rgyal ba nyid kyi gdul byar gyur pa ni gzhal du med/ bdag mo dpal mtsho 'khor ba la thugs 'byung bas sku chos mdzad chog pa'i dgongs pa nan gyis zhus par phugs khyed rang gi thugs 'dod ltar sku chos mdzad chog pa yong / re zhig 'di phyogs su 'od 'jags pa yong bas lo gsum gyi ring thugs khur bzhes/ de las bzhugs mi dgos pa mdzod gsungs gtsug phud bzhes/ re zhig ska lus ma bsgrur ces lugs gnyis kyi bslab ston bcas yang rtser rdzong pa gnang / de nas sde gzar rnams thag chod/ gtsang sa'i dmag dpon gnyis la rdzong ba'i gnang spyan bzang po mdzad/ spel ser bas re zhigaphyag phyir bzhugs/ bkra

shis mthong stsokho gyibla ma lha khang girab gnas la chibs kha bsgyur/ rdo rje gdan gyi phur bzhugs sgar phab/ banakha las/ dmag de 'dra dang bral bas dmyal ba nas thon pa lta bu byung / da lam dmag skor de la mi dang dud 'gro shi ba khrims bcad pa rgyu nor phrogs pa sogs mnar sbyong byung ba la bsam gyis khyab rgyu gang yod snying rang rje gsungs/ spel ser nas kyis/ sde gzar 'di'i sdig pa rtsa ba thug pa'i byed yo rang la yong ngam cha bgos nas yong lags zhus pas/ bgazha las/ rgya 'bras 'di bden drags pas gte po rnams la ni re re ma gtogs cha phral nas yong rgyu ga la yod/ char gtogs rnams la sems rtse gcig pa'i las 'bras ni thamasaca cad la yong ste/ dmag la sogs pa don gcig phyir/ /thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan/ /zhes gsungs pas rang rang gi bsam pa dge mi dge'i las 'bras che chung so sor smin

ra༅༅/ /pa yin mod/ khyed rang yang bsam pa dge po 'dug pas de ring phan chad khra shig ge ba yod yong / de ring nas dge grogs dang sdig grogs zer dkar ba'i 'go tshugs pa yin gsungs/ bla ma'i dkor 'di yang zhed po yin pa 'dra lags zhus pas/ spyir/ bla ma'i rdzas ni srog ji bzhin/ /zhes shin tu gnyan par bshad 'dug /de la dkor yong mi yong las 'phros/ rgyu 'bras kyi brka' chos bslab bya zhib par gnang / bkra shis mthong smon du phebs/ bla ma lha khang la gnam rgyan khyad besgos 'ba' zhig dang / sku brnyan thams cad la na bza' dbu zhwa dbang chas zhal dkar stegs bcas serdzogs mchod chas rnams legs par bshams/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor sal tshon las phyag ris mar bstar/ gsung chog tshugs nyin ska cung zad mnyel ba'i tshul bstan/ grol nas gzims chung du

phebs/ 'bram pa zer ba kherdzo da lam gyi 'di yin pa 'dra gsung ba la/ des na rab gnas bsngas pa zhig mdzad/ sku mtshams bcad rgya dam pa gnang na 'gab tshul gsol ba ba)ba pas/ bsha' las/ lar gnas dus 'di rnams dang / lo gsum ma'i lha mo'i lung bstan/ chos rje rin po ches tshe'i skeg gsungs pa sogs la lo drug tsam las mi 'dug pas bcar ba tsam ni yin 'dug /da lam nyes skyon mi yong / rab gnas 'di lcogs pa byed gsungs/ ye shes sems dpa' mngon sum du bstim pa'i dge mtshan gyis dus 'da' ba nas/ dngos gzhi'i nyin tshogs kyi mchodi pa rgya chen po dang bcas bkra shis mnga' gsol mdzad/ sku re la rgya dang kha dog sna lnga'i na bza' re phyag bstar gyis gsol ba dang bstan smon lam re gnang / rje mi pham chos kyi rgyal po'i skar na gza' gsol ba dang / rje 'di nyid mar pa'i rnam sngal yin

ra༅༅/ /par grags te thugs rje yang mar pa dang 'dra ba byung 'dug /nged rang 'brag pa nang khul gyi rten 'brel rje 'di nged kyis mjal ma thub pas 'chugs gsungs/ slar yang thugs khar dbu btsugs nas smon lam zhig mdzad/ de nas gzims snang du phebs/ de ring khams dwangs pa byang gsungs/ de'i sang 'bog kong nas mang ja 'bul ba dang bcas 'byor/ sku ltem pa 'di la dam sel gyi skyon byung dogs pas btang ba mi 'gab pa 'dra zhes zhus spros/ de snga sna rje gong ma thugs gtum pa dang 'bog kong nas tsho yang mdzad spyod ma legs pas 'gras gzhi che/ nged rang gi thog rang la ni ma thus pa che ba med cing / kho rang tsho bstun phyogs gang legs byed kyi 'dug pa dang / nged rang dgra gnyen la phyogs 'dzin cher med pas btang chog /dam nyams zer ba de chos zhus nas las rgya 'bras la mi rtsi bar chos

ma mthun byed mkhan tsho yin pa 'dug ste phyag dbang 'gegs thub pa mi 'dug gsungs/ de skabs myang ྅sgod skyid sbug nas grub pa'i dbang phyag shes rab 'brug rgyas zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs 'bul ba dang bslab stoni zhu mi slebs pas/ rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag de nyid dgung lo mthon po smin pas ma legs gsungs/dpon slob nyungabasdus kyis bde mchog gi gsung chog /sgar grwa tshang la mang ja/ grwa ris kyi 'dod pa ltar sku skye myur 'gron gyi smon lam dang sgrub sde'i 'dzin skyong gi bslab ston dang bcas pa gnang / lo gro dol pas skyar langs kyi rnam pa zhig byas par so sor gnang sbyin bslab ston stsal te bde bar bkod/ bkra shis mthong smon nye skor gyi nas phud bzhes/ de nas thugs dam brtag par pha ras su phebs na bzang ba byung ba ltar/ pha ras su phebs pa'i sang nyin spel ser bas ska gzhogs su byon pa

ra༅༅/ kha / rmi ltas 'di yang rgod bro po 'dug /mdang 'bram pa thon 'dug /da na rgyu gang yang mi 'dug gsungs/ zhal dkyil phyag zhabs kyi mthil la thor pa bcu gnyis tsam shar rnag mabosna khel tshar 'dug pas bdag skusnagazlo rnams bserdzod nams che bar byung zhus pas/ dus la ma bab na/ na tsha che yang 'chi mi thub pa 'dug /na nas 'chi rgyu yin na nged rang gi lus po gcong ma 'dis skye ba brgya yang blangs los yong / bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i tshe 'phrang bar la mgo la rdo rgyab kyang 'chi ba med gsungs/ de skabs sku tshe'i rten 'brel sgrig pa sgo gang zab bsha' drin bskyangs dgos zhus pas/ yos lo shar 'phral nas mkhar chur mtshams bsdams pa'i zos bde ba byung na tshe mtshams thub kyang byed bsam pa yod/ da bar ni bstan pa'i khur zer ba 'dis rnam g.yeng 'ba' zhig la song / tshe smad 'di tshe dang sgrab pa mnyam

pa zhig byung na rab tu 'dug /de ltar ma byung yang 'ordzo gsum gyi bcad rgya dam pa rang zhig byed bsam pa yerdzod na'ang / rten 'brel gyi shugs kho na gtso ba 'dug gsungs/ der dol pa rnams kyis khrom dbang zhig gsol ba btab par/ sku ma dwangs par mi 'gab tshul zhus par/ dol pa 'di rnams dad zhen gnyis ka yod pa'i sbyin bdag yin pas khrom dbang bshar mi thub 'dug ste chos bshad dang khrom la phyag nas zhig ma byas na mi yong gsungs/ bzhugs khri thang du phebs bka' chos rgyas pa gnang / sbyang bcod dar ras sogs yul dge dang mthun pa'i 'bul ba phul/ zhag shas bzhugs te byams chen chos gling du phebs so// //yangs pa'i rgyal khams phan bdes 'tsho ba'i 'phrin las chen pos mkha' khyab tshe/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed grong gi bdag po'i dogs pa'i rgyal mtshan cher g.yos pas/ /dge legs

da rmed pa'i phrag dog mda'/ /gnad du lhung ba'i zug rngu mi bzad rta gdong me lce ltar 'bar bas/ /mkha' kyang ma ngoms gdug pa'i blo/ /ha la ha la'i dug bzhin rtsub pa de/ /skye 'gro'i 'tsho srog 'phrog la rings // /chos dbyings nub ri'i phag la mngon phyogs dus/ /lhag bsam zla ba'i 'od zer rab bsil bas/ / da kyi bag chags yongs spangs pa/ /gzhan la rngom phyir rdo rje'i tsher ma yis/ /ma nongs mtshan dpe'i cha ra/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin nge che dzo95 dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan

yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gan las/ phul du byang ba'i mdzad 'phrin rnam par dkar bas ma dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig rjes bzung ba'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu drug pa'o// //skabs shig chos mdzad byang chub rgya'༄ mtshan gyis dpon tshang byar po chos mdzad phan bde 'od zer drung la sku gzan gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba zhig mdzad/ khyed thugs bsam che zhing sku gzhogs su bcar ba dang / lhag par rtogs ldan gyi ma lta bu yin pas/ nged rang chos rje 'brug pa snying po'i bstan pa'i bdag po bla na med pa yin ga sa/ 'brag pa'i pha chos khrid chen 'di rnams kyi rgyun gyal dbang dam pa nyid nas brgyad pa zhig byung na babs bzang zhing khungs btsun par 'dug pa nas/ da lta dus la bab nges ḍū 'dug pas/ chos kyi 'bor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa gnang bkos zhus pas cis kyang

ra༅༅/ /zhu zer/ lan cig gzims chung du shog gsungs/ nged la chos shod dgos pa'i zhu 'phrin bskur ba ris kyang legs/ sngar phan ni bla ma rnam gnyis sogs bzhugs pas/ sgar pa khrid zhu ba rnams kyang sku gzhogs so sor brdzangs/ nged rang gis dbang bskur rjes gnang / lung sgordzod pa/ rab byang bsnyen rdzogs sbyin pa ni bgrang bar mi dpyod/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya rnams la nan tan chen po yang bslabs skusgod/ khrid btab pa rnams la dri ba rdo rus gtugs narmi len ma grub/ da cha chos don gnyer su 'dug la nyams khrid du bstar nas gang la gang 'dod shod pa'i rtsis yin/ sbyin pa'i nang nas chos sbyin 'di phan yon che bar bshad/ de bzhin skal ba po la'ang phan yon bas/ma gyis mi khyab pa gsungs 'dug /ding sang phyag mdzod rkang ma zhig med pa dang / gong ma rnams kyi ska tshe'i tshad la ltas kyang

'bring tsam du sleb 'dug pas/ phyag mdzod rnams la lta rtog byas ngos/ skye ba rim par yong rgyu'i khul yin pas/ dbang chas mchod gzhom nang rten khyad 'phags rol cha skor rnams la yang deb bsgrigs shig byas/ bla bre rten khebs spyan gzigs sogs mchod rdzas bzo rgyu dang 'phral gyi bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong gi dgos cha rnams kyang dbye bsal byas/ dad 'gror gnyis ldan rnams kyis lhag bsam rnam dag gis phul ba'i rgyu dngos rnams chud mi soni par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal ba'i ba/kha 'gyur ro 'og cig kyang gser las bzhengs thub pa da gzod grub pa byed dgos 'dug pas de ma'i grabs yul gyi brel ba rnams ding sang bcad nas snga 'gros mtshams kyi bcad rgya zhig byed rgya yin na'ang mtshams 'og nas kyang bug chos 'chad dgos pa 'dug gsungs/ de'i sang gza' skar shis pa dang bstan phyag mdzod rnams la phebs/ deb sgrig gi 'go

ra༅༅/ /tshugs/ rgyan ring mi bzhugs pa'i mdzad bkod zhal ta mang du byon 'dug kyang su la'ang de 'dra'i rtog pa ni ma shar/ phyag dpe dbang chas nang rten rol mo rnams zegs med dgos rmo'i phyag deb mjug tu chos skyong rnams la babakha bsgo dam bzhag bcas bka' tham gyis mnan/ bapokha 'gyur gyi rgyar/ stod gser 'ba' zhig mgur zho stong dang brgyad brgya lhag tsam snga 'gros su 'dul ba dang / mon la shog sgrub kyi zong dang 'bul sdud mi sna bsha' shog dang (lcas rdzong pa gnang / glegs shing gi zhal bkod sogs rags rim grub nas/ nyer gsum nas gnam gang bar rje bla ma rnam gnyis kyi sku mchod lo gsar dang bcas pa tshugs/ phyag mdzod tshoms chen du mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams/ dpon slob bzhi bcu tsam gyis bde mchog 'khor lo'i sgo nas gsung chog rgyas pa

mdzad/ dbang phyug ste me mo glang lo gsar/ sgar gyi dbu che drung 'khor rnams banakha bgros pa'i sde srid gtsang par chos gzhis shig zhu ba 'gab zer dgongs pa zhus pas/ bka' las/ lar gyis sna rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis sa cha la thugs bzhed gtan nas ma gnang 'dug /de 'dra'i thugs 'dod yod na rje gong ma 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa de tshos dbus gtsang lho rgyad kyi sa cha'i phyed bdag po mdzad kyang los yong ste ma mdzad 'dug pa/ sa cha 'di yang chos pa'i gnya' 'chor sa zhig yin/ chos gzhis rgyal khams phyogs med la byejo pa 'di rang chos pa'i rnam thar bzang ba zhig 'dug ste/ nged kyang rgas shing tshe mjug 'di la mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam pa zhig kyang byed bsam pa yin/ sgar 'dir yang rags rim la la 'gre 43 'pher ba yang 'dug /la la sto gos la gyong bskar nas bya ba thongs pa 'dra yang 'dug /la

si༅༅/ kha rang se zin pa yang 'dug ste/ la la zhig nged rang la ltas nas sto re dgos pa yang 'dug pas/ dus kyis ma khyogs pas chos pa'i 'tsho ba 'di yang sngar dang mi 'dra ba khag po zhig 'dug pas dgos shas ni kha/ nga ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba 'di shes po yang med/ byed par yang mi spro/ sngar phan chad kyang khyed rang rnams kyi gros stengs su bzhag pa yin/ da lam yang khyed rang bgres pa rnams phal cher 'dzom 'dug pa bgros sgo mdzod/ spel ser ba grwa yon gnyis ka yin pa 'dug /lhag par 'di la 'brug pa nang du phyogs cha dang nye 'gyangs kyang mi 'dug pas gros spel chog /khong 'jig rten gyi myong ba dang gtsang sa'i rgyus kyang che ba yin/ nged rang gi bsam pa la da lam phyag mdzod kyi deb bsgrig byed pa la yang khong sde dpon chen po'i go sar bsdad pas nyapas myong yang che ba dang bcas yod pa byed

bsam yang la la'i thugs la sku(da po rang mi 'dug /de yang bstan pa'i la rgya la bsam pa che bas mdzes mdzes kyi dbosnangs pa len phyogs ma byas pas lan pa 'dra/ zhu rten med par ni gtsang nas chos gzhis mi gnang 'ong / gos dar sogs 'phral dgos kyi dngos po rnams zur na yod pas gang 'gab bsdur la 'os gzigs mdzod gsungs/ mi snar chos rje rdo rje gling pa dang / spel ser ba/ drung yig nor 'phel gsum la gega' gnang / de bstan chos rje rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs kyi mang 'gyed dang / skyid sbug sgrab sder dbu mdzad rin po che'i gshegs rdzong mang 'gyed kyang rdzong ba gnang / sa cha gzhan gyi lag nas phyogs pa lta bu'i sa mi gtsang ba byang na de len mkhan rnams la maX nin len gyi nyes pa chen po yod pas dug dang 'dres pa'i zas mi za bya ba yin/ de rigs ma byung ba mdzod/ gzhan kha ta mi shes khyed rgarmo chen gsum

ra༅༅/ /po gros mdzod las gang legs mdzod byon gsungs zhabs dbang bka' bsgo dang 'ja' tshugs thum re/ byang dar lu hang gi ljags mdud bzang po re gnang ste/ nged ra'i don gal che ba zhig la bya pa phyogs gtogs kyi nas mo bkra shis sogs bkag po 'di rnams bsten chog pa dang / lto skal re yang sku ngo yod pa/ chos byed 'dod byung na chos sgor bcug chog pa zhu nan yod pa mdzod las/ de dzi'i gsal kha myur stabs su bsrings mdzod/ nga yang da lam res kyi brel ba de tsam la cha bzhag gzims spyil 'di khar bcad rgya dam pa zhig byed/ chos zhu ba rnams la bug chos dang dri ba len pa sogs byas nas chos kyikhral 'jal du ma song ba zhig byed rtsis yin gsungs/ de nas ska mtshams mus nas mnga' ris stod kyi rgyal po lha btsun rnam gnyis sogs chos don gnyer rnams la zab khrid mang po/ dkun brgyad

gong ma'i bskakha 'bum gyi lung mang po rgyab chos dang bcas pa stsal/ gzims bug nas dri ba yang zhib par bzhes/ slar yang bdag mo dpal mtsho sogs drag zhan mang yo la phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi nyams khrid sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ rgyal po rnam gnyis sogs phyi 'dul ba'i bslab khrims la gnas shing chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis mdzes pa/ nang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag can gyi zhal slob kyang de dus mang zhing / bya pa'i drung 'khor gyi bkag po rnams skra bcad mi 'jigs pa sbyin/ zhabs drung sku skye rin po che gshegs pa'i gnas tshul dang bcas lding dpon rnam rgyal 'gror bas/ bda' las/ zhabs drung de la lugs gnyis thad du nged rang gtan nas mi bzod pa las kyis yong ba la khong nga la ye mi gsan pa zhig byung / da dkon mchog ra mdar sbyon pa las bya thabs med gsungs/ de 'phral gdung chog

ra༅༅/ /btsugs/ bsngo smon thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug nyin re bzhin mdzad/ dgongs rdzogs su 'brag rigs kyi grwa sgrub rnams la mang 'gyed dang /gnyal lor byar gsum gyi lding la gnang cha phyag mdzod nas stsal/sgar chen dang bka' bgros bstun pa'i mi sna gnadro ste byar dwags sogs kyi bkag po rnams la bde thabs mdzad/de nas sku mtshams grol/byar gnyil gyi me tog bzhes/yang rtser zhabs drung bdag mos bkur sti phul du phyin pa zhus/'bra mang ste sa pho stag ro shar/byams chen du phebs bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i dbu tshugs / de skabs bangag kyang sngon las mi bzad pa myong 'gyur gyi durmi la nye bar bab pa gzigs/khro phu grwa tshang gi slob dpon du bsko bzhag mdzad pa'i bsko 'ja' zhu bar zhabs drung du 'byor/ mnyes mnyes gnang /da lam bsko 'ja' gzab nas byed

gsungs/ gzims spyil ltad mo can gyi gzims chung byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bar ba der/ shis brjod phyag nas dang lhan cig /rgyal ba nyid rang gi sku ber bzhes 'phro byin rlabs can/ jus kyi sgom zhwa/ rgyun ring bzhes pa'i sku chos sku dreg 'byar ba/ kurma gan dril snas gtsang ba sogs dang grwa tshang spyi rdzas su rgya sil legs pa bcas rgya cher stsal/ 'gol bzhugs kyi skabs shig /rje nyid kyi rnam thar bzang sdings chos rjes bsgrigs pa de mthar phyin ma phyin gyi gleng 'phros byung bar/ bka' las/ khong gis dang dod chen po byas song ste/ tshe la bar chad byung bas lag tu longs ma song / sa bon zin bris rnams da lta 'di na yod/ mkhan rin po ches gnang ba'i rtogs brjod rtse dgazhi 'khri shing de yang 'byungs rabs bcu gcig pa yan chad ni legs pa'i dper 'os pa snang / nged rang gi thad du sleb man zur za ring mo'i tshul du

go༅༅/ /'dug pa/ nged rang sgoms chung thams cad gong du 'bur bsam pa zhig yin pa la rnam thar zur za po de 'dra'i ris bzod pa 'dug /des na nged kyi blo dang khyod kyi rtsom pa'i babasamathun mdog kha bas sgrig pas chog phebs par/ drung yig nor 'phel sku gnogs na bzhugs 'dug pas de 'os po yin 'dug zhus song / bdag rang ni ha las pas/ yul khyad par can de lta bu'i rnam thar bdag 'dra ba gang zag phal pas sgrig par ga la spobs/ skye ba phyi ma rnams su smon lam 'debs dgos pa 'dug zhus pas/ a'u rtsi rjes su gnang ba yin mod gsungs/ 'on kyang de dus zin bris rnams zhu bar ma nus pa/ slar grub dbang shes rab 'brag rgyas kyi dbon po'i drang rgyal byed sngags grwa'i bla mar bsko bzhag gnang ba'i bsko 'ja' zhu bar byon dus/ dpon slob gsung 'phros byung ba yin 'dug pas khong gis do sdom

mdzad/ zin bris rnams yar gnang / rgyal ba mchog gi dgongs pa la gtad 'dug pas khyod kyis cis kyang sgrigs shig gsungs pa byung na'ang / dus ngan gyi dmod pa drag po dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar bas ring du gzir nas 'gyangs gzhir song ba'i khar/ sa bon rnams kyang phyogs bcur 'thor ba/ slar skyes chen 'gazhi bkas bskul ba dang rang res kyang rtsol ba skyed pa'i khul byas nas sa bon tsam du bsgrigs pa la ham pa che bar mi dgongs 'tshal lo/ /brka' 'gyur gyi do dam sde pa sna mo shag pa ngag dbang bstan bzang la dgongs pa gtad pa ltar 'chol ba gnang / bsha' las/ sgar phyi nang drag zhan thams cad da lam don chen 'di'i bar chad du ma song ba'i mthun 'gyur du gang 'gro so so nas theg pa khur blang byas na las 'bras bsla med yin pas rang rang gis rgyal ba'i bsha' 'gyur re bzhengs pa'i phan yon yong ba'i steng / bla

ra༅༅/ /ma'i dgongs pa bsgrubs pa'i yon to gyis skye ba nas tsha rabs thams cad du nged rang gis rjes su 'dzin pa yin/'di la bar chad du song na dgral ba mnar med du 'gro ba yin pas thamasacad kyi khur dang bsam pa che dgos gsungs/ e nas dpon yig pa brgya dang bcu drug tsam 'bod pa gnang /gnyal nas kyang mang bar byung /'phral gyi phogs ja chang sogs ka dpe ma med par gang dgos su gnang /'dzugs ston thog yig phud bzhes pas yig mkhan brgya dang brgyad tsam gyi bris 'pher ba byung / de 'phros rnams shog 'dul sogs la chug pa gnang /slar yang dpon yig gral du chug pa dbo/sa tshul gyis 'gror ba rnams kyang yi ge legs pa rnams bris pa'i khrod dang / yig bris mi 'pher ba rnams lag g.yog gang la gang 'os su 'jug pa gnang bas/ bka' 'gyur skor rang la phogs len nyis brgya

tsam/ yi ge 'bri bar bla ma sde dpon gang gi sar phyin kyang 'di 'dra las snags yangs pa ma byung zer/ de dus sog po nor bu rin chen stod du slebs te/ stod 'grul pa chad/ phyag mdzod du rams ma rnyed/ 'di la rams ci 'gro med zer do dim pa rnams ci drag la thug par rje'i zhal nas/ gzhan lugs kyi phyag mdzod ltar 'dod dgu 'dzom po rang zhig med na'ang / chos phyogs kyi bya ba la dboni mchog la gsol ba btab pas mi 'grub pa rang yong ma myong khyed rang tsho thugs g.yeng mi dgos/ thub bstan yar 'phel gtsang la rams sgrub par thong gsungs gser srang do sogs gnang bas rams dre'u'i khal gzhogs gcig tsam las spus kha ma 'grub/ skru zhabs su 'gror dpon yig rnams la bstan pas rams 'dis phyed tsam 'gro ba 'dug zer bas kyang do dam pa rnams 'tshab par gyur pa la/ rje nyid nas mi sto ldeng 'ong zhas bka'

ra༅༅/ /stsal to/ /yang rtser rams kyi chus bskor btsugs/ rams mnyed ma rnams par bu zhig tu bsags nas ri rams 'dzad mi shes pa lta bu byung / bsha' 'gyur yongs rdzogs ldeng nas kyang par bu'i zhabs 'khor ba tsam lhag mar byung bas thama'adug ces gleng / rgyal ba nyid re zhig sku mtshams la bzhugs/ sku srang ba tshe bdag dpa' bor rta phag gi dbang brgya rtsa dang / rdoyig /dregs pa nyi shu/ 'jigs byed mun gza' nag po/ ta dbun gyi rlag rnying dang / rje padma dkar pos mdzad pa dgra mnan kha la nd+ra srung par/ lcags sdig /bya rog ma bstan srung / gtum po nus mthu'i skor sogs yig rnying 'ga' gnang / spel ser ba :

las/ da lam b.lakha 'gyur gyi bya ba 'di tshabs su 'gro ba byung / ding sang chos gzhis rnams kyi yong sgo la khyed kyis gto 'bebs deb 'bod cig mdzod las/ slar phyag mdzod su byed la byed bde po yong ba zhig bzos/ da lta chos smar ba yong bas chos shod tshad la mgron gnyer brgyud mi dgos yong pas chog gsungs/ spyi chos su bapokha gdams glegs bam/ mi la dang ras chung pa'i rnam thar sogs dkar brgyud gral rim gyi rnam thar mgur 'bum/ sger chos su phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor/ chos drug /ro snyoms sogs nyams khrid dang / bde mchog sogs dbang rjes gnang mang po gnang / zab khrid gsol ba 'debs pa po sku srung pa tshe bdag dpa' bo dang a lce chos drung yum sras sogs kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod spyin bsgrabs/ bka' 'gyur zhus dag rkang ma rin po che ral sgang pa thub bstan ye shes

ra༅༅/ /dang rab 'byams pa dkar ༷sgrod sogs kyis mdzad/sngags sogs dga' gnad rnams phal che ba rje rang gis ljags zhus khor yug tu sang ba dang /lho rgyud kyi dgon sde da' rigs che phran so sa nas b.lakha 'gyur 'degs zhu mkhan rnams la bzhugs gral/phyag mdzod nas khro phu grwa tshang bar rgya dngul spus spong la rin po che'i phra rgyan du mas spras pa'i dung gzhog khyad thon gnang ba'i bal por zhal bkod dpe ston sogs bslab ston khor yug tu stsal/ snar thang gan rtsa pa gsor ba dong sprugs byas/rje'i zhabs drung du snyegs pa khrid kyis smin par mdzad/khong sogs 'ga' la rlung 'khrul 'khor gyi phyag len rnams rje nyid rang gis phyag khrid du ston pa gnang nas rlung ra chag med du tshugs/zla ba phyed gnyis tsam la bka' 'gyur rin po che legs par grub/ yig mkhan rnams kyang yid spro zhing 'cham pa tsam

zhig gi na tsha yang ma byung / thams cad yig grwa ga la phyin kyang 'di las bag dro ba dang yi ge 'bab pa ma byung zer/ de nas phyag mdzod du phebs/ dpon yig rnams la yon rdzong / che phran mang pos 'degs zhus byas song bar gdab lan/ lho rgyud khog gi skya ser rnams la'ang 'gyed gang drag re yang gtong dgos gsungs/ thog mar dpon yig rnams la gser/ shal pa dpon dmar/ rta drel gos dar/ snam ras sbrang lcags sogs yul thang gi sgong rgyab pa la lho rgyud bre'i khal khri tsho phyed gnyis ri ba / tog dkar ba dpon yig drag pa gsum la gos chas cha tshang gser zho lnga res gtsos pa'i gnang cha/ zhus dag dbu lung pa sogs las tshan rnams la gzan res gtsos pa'i rnam gzhag /bla ma dbu che drug cu skor la dgu tshan nas lnga tshan gyi bar/ gsung chog phyag phyi'i dge 'dun brgya tsam la spyi 'gyed dang lag 'gyed/ pad dkar

go༅༅/ /grwa tshang par gong ma rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs dus phul ba'i bda' 'gyur ro chog gi glegs bam dang /sgar gyidrung 'khor las wo rnams la rnam gzhag dang sgar dmangs la 'gyed/bya pa'i zhabs drung bdag mos 'di skabs kyang zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byung bas gnang cha dgu tshan bdun/phyag phyi drung 'khor rnams la drag zhan gyi gnang sbyin/lding re la go dkar ldem re dang khro ca ling res gtsos pa'i bcu gnyis tshan re/lung pa'i a'o drag pa rnams la so sor phyag mdud gnang sbyin/mdor na phyag mdud rang la bkras thags sman rtse byang dar dmar ser bsdoms pas kha brgyad brgya tsam/nyi ma bcu'i ring phyag mdzod du gnang sbyin gyi zhal bkod kho na la phebs/bcad khra so sor dam phrug gis gnon pa gnang /de nas gza' skar legs pa dang bstan byams chen gyi kun dga' ra bar spyan gzigs sogs

bkod pa'i khyad par ci yang bshams/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las rim rgyas pa'i sgo nas zhal phye/ sa chog gi nyin sku gzhogs grwa tshang pas mgo brnyan sngags 'cham sogs dang / dngos gzhi nyi ma lnga'i ring rgyal ba nyid tshogs dbur phebs/ rab tu gnas pa rgyas pa chen po'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs shis brjod sogs byin rlabs kyi char babs/ longs sku'i chas su bzhengs nas kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang khrom la tshe b.lakha stsal/ de nyin gdugs 'jam zhing nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khyab pa me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ni bsam gyis mi khyab/ sang nyin snga ba'i char/ phyag mdzod chen mo'i steng du phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon dang rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs/ ba dan srid rtser sgreng ba'i bar bar du lha rdzas kyi lda ldi nor bu'i 'phreng bas mdzes par byas pa'i spyan gzigs kyi sprin

go༅༅/ /'khrigs bsung zhim gyi dud pas phyogs kun 'gengs par byas te snyan 'jebs kyi rol sgra khor yug chen po'i mthar grags pa dang lhan cig bsangs kyi mchod sprin rgya chen po spel/ dga' ston bde yangs su mdzad/ gral pa gsum brgya brdal ba la dkar spro sogs lha'i longs spyod lta bu bsgrubs/ dbus nas sprul pa'i sku rnam pa gnyis/ sne sdong rtse zhabs drung rin po che sogs dang / lho rgyud nas grub dbang rin po che sogs phyogs mtha'i bla ma sde dasto che phran mang po'i legs 'bul dang / lcam dpal mtsho'i drung gis yang rtse'i phan nag dang / gser zho brgya phrag gis gtsos pa'i 'bul chen mdzad/ bzhugs gral de sha'i thog tu so so'i gnang sbyin rnams gnang bas/ dpon yig pa rnams kyis gtsos skya ser drag zhan thams cad lha mgu mi mgur btang / gling phyi nang thams cad kyang sme bos gang

zhing dga' spro'i glu gzhas byed pa sogs skabs gsum pa'i snang tshul sa la 'phos pa lta bu byung / slar gzims chung du phebs/ sgar gyi las tshan do dam pa rnams la thugs dges dges gnang / de ring thams cad kyis khur chen pos bca' 'grig po byung bas rjes su yi rang / sang khyed tsho la nged kyis yags so byed dgos gsungs/ sang las tshan rags bsdus la dkar spro bzhugs gral rgyas pa zhig dad byin rlabs 'ja' tshugs bcu phrag re gnang / grole mtshams/ 'o/ da ni 'phral dgos kyi chas phal cher ni deb la 'khyol yod/ gzhan ma lhag rol bzhag kyang 'khor g.yog dkor la sbyor ba las med/ khong 'jig rten pa la mi mkho ba med pas/ kha sang nas dbye bsal byas pa'i lhag gang 'dug dpon yig rnams la byin cig gsungs pa ltar/ khong rnams kyi mdun du sngangs pas/ thog so gnyis tsam gyi

ra༅༅/ /dpangs yod pa'i/ gser g.yu mu tig byu ru/ ka ra bu ram/ khro zangs/ pags cha/ snam ras gos dar sogs sna tshogs dngos gzhi'i gnang cha las lhag pa thob pas dad gus dang mgu ba so sor skyes/ dpon yig chen mos skra phud phul/ dpag bsam bstan 'dzin zhes ming stsal/ phyag chen gyi khrid rim stsal bas dge sbyor legs par skyes/ phyis e chung sog po rong sgrub sder bsam gto kho na la gzhol ba zhig byung / gzhan yang rang rang gi gnang sbyin bgos skal phul nas chos byed zer ba dang / re zhig bsdad nas bka' chos zhu zar ba mang po byung ba la/ slar rgya ri bas dgongs pa khrol na yong pas chog gsungs/ spyi dbang tshe rta zhig stsal/ sgyi 'bul rgyas pa 'dug pa nas phud tsam zhig bzhes te thams cad slog /de nas dpon yig rnams la lam chas khal ma dang bcas rdzong bda'

gnang / thams cad mos pas gsol ba 'debs shing / gzims spyil gyi rgyal mtshan mthong sa nas kyang phyag byed cing smon lam 'debs par byed do// //rnam mang skye dga'i bsetred nams las grub dpal 'byor chu klung ji snyed pa/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las zla ba'i ma mar ma lus gzhol bzhin babs pa'i tshe/ /rnam dag rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog 'di ring du 'phel rgyas bya ba'i phyir/ /rnam dgrod rab yangs bi shwa'i 'phral gyis glegs bam nor bu ci yang bskrun/ /rdul bral ye shes gzigs pa'i me long du/ /ma 'ongs srid pa'i gzugs brnyan kun shar ba/ /gzhan la 'doms pa'i brjo thabs cher bstan kyang / /gzhar yang mi go rmongs pa'i ngang tshul nyid/ /sprin glog chu lngar lta bu ma yin pa/ /mi 'gyur mi phyed rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i/ /dad pa mchog gis rje btsun bla ma la/ /rtag tu blo 'gel gsol ba btab pa yis/ /srid zhi'i

ra༅༅/ /phun tshogs yongs kyi rtser son pa'i/ /go 'phang mchog kyang bde blag stsol bas na/ /thun mong 'dod pa'i dngos po grub pa slo/ /mtshar du lhun pa byis pa'i blo gros yin/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/dad ldan gyi dge legs gong du spel ba'i phyir rgyal ba'i ba/'a 'gyur ro 'tshal rin po che las bzhengs pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas gzims spyil rdo chal mthil du bya bral pho mo stobs che ba la rab ston gyi tshogs 'khor skal ba rgyas pa gnang /chos khri khar phebs nas lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig stsal gyub pa'i mjug tu/'o/'dir tshogs pa rnams kyis nges dgos rgya la/ sngar phan bla ma rnam gnyis mya ngan las
