snadas rjes chos rje rin po che mi pham blo gros sogs sgom chen gyi bla ma mang po bzhugs pas nged rang gis so so'i 'dod dang bstun pa'i chos 'brel tsam ma gtogs khrid 'chad pa bzhin cher ma byas/ na ning sde gzar grol ba nas bzung thog ma'i gsol ba 'debs pa po spel ser ba byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis byas/ bug chos khrom chos sogs nyams khrid du bstar nas gang la gang 'os bshad yod/ khyed rnams la yon tan skyes lugs dang skyon gegs byung tshul gyi dri ba da dung byed rgya 'dug kyang dris mdzod/ sbang nge sbong nger bzhag na mi yong / yang sgom chen rnying pa thag chod pa 'dra yang mang po 'dug /gegs sel bogs 'don dgos pa 'dra yang yod 'gro/ khyed thugs dam pa drag pa rnams kyang zhag re gnyis nged kyi rtsar bzhugs nas semasagasar pa rnams la bslab stoni dang / khyed rang tsho yin gyu ba'i khungs rnams la'ang phub

ra༅༅/ /ma'i 'og gi chu dong gar yod mi shes/ thugs dam spu ris phyed pa thag chod pa rang zhig byed na mtshan nyid pa'i grwa skor dang 'dra/ bla ma mang po tsheg la dri ba phul/ mched grogs rnams dang nyams bsdar byas/ skabs 'gar kha nang du ltas nas dpyad cing sgom/ rang gi sems thog tu babs pa'i phan skyed yod pa'i tshig cig byung na mdze bo zhig gi kha nas byung yang khyed skyas gsung ba de yin 'dug byas babs btang rjes su yirang bsgom/ lar nged rang nā ro'i brgyud 'dzin 'di la thugs dam ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa dang / skyes pa'i gegs sel bogs 'don gang la yang lam zab mo bla ma'i mos gas las lhag pa med/ de yang dkar brgyud byin rlabs kyi lam/ byin rlabs mos gus kyi lam/ mos gus gsol 'debs kyi lam bya ba yin pas/ drin can gyi bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus la 'di phyi'i re ltos

bcas/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson na yoni tan mi skye mi srid cing skyes pa la 'ogs mi thon mi srid pa min/ yang chos bla ma la zhus nyams bsdur mched grerdzogs la gyis zer ba ltar/ ci zer lta ba dang nga rgyal khong 'tshangs ma yin pa'i nyams myong go tshul dang bstun nas dri ba 'dra byas kyang 'othos yong / sgom chen gyi chos skad nga rgyal can 'di ni bzod pa rang 'dug /phyir ma mdzes la nang du khong khros dge sbyor phran bu yod pa yang gtor ba'i rgyu yin/ sgom chen zer sems thog tu rdo rus thug pa'i nyams myong thon pa zhig gis chos brgyad la sdog rdzis byas/ zhen pa gting nas log pa zhig ma byung na/ kha nas chos skad thar thor lab/ stong rbad kyis sa gzhi bkang / dngos 'dzin dang kun slong phyogs zhen sogs tha mal gyi sprod 'gros skye bo 'jig rten pa las kyang lod pa de 'dras gar yang mi phyin

ra༅༅/ /yang / ding sang ni bskal pas ma khyogs pas de rigs rang mang ba yong 'dug /khyed rtogs ldan rgan pa rnams kyis kyang bsam pa gang che dang / nang na rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam yang phyi rtags kyi kun spyod gang legs/ chos dang gang mthun gyi ngos nas sems can la phan gang thogs/ mdor na rang rang gi bla ma'i zhabs mi 'dren tsam dang snying po rang gis rang mi khrel ba zhig byed dgos/ grong gseb sde dgon rnams su rtogs ldan 'cham 'cham mang po 'di yang ma mdzes po rang zhig 'dug pas ri khrod so sor bzhugs gang tshugs mdzod/ skabs su nged kyi sar yong 'dod byung yang yong chog /ja thug 'dir 'gror pa byed/ snga sor yin na sgar du rtogs ldan 'khor sa med zer ba'i sgra ngan pa zhig 'dug na'ang / sgar gyi tha shal kha cig la cha bzhag rgya ci yod/ las tshan drag rim rnams rtogs ldan

dgrar mthong dgos rgyu gang yang med/ rtogs ldan drag rim rnams la chos mthong los yod/ yin kyang nged rang gi rtogs ldan rig pa ngar langs tsam thugs dam gyis chen po ma dros pa 'ga' re/ bla ma bzang po tsho ltag tu khur/ mi phyed mir mi rtsi khyi phyed khyir mi rtsi/ tha na tshogs gral mang ja zhig 'tshogs kyang ras gzan dang bem po dpung mgo la gzed nas 'tshangs drag sgar gyi las tshan rnams la brang 'phul spung rdog sher gtam serdzogs byed mkhan 'ga' re skusnang 'dug pa/ de 'dra la ni nga rang yang dga' po mi yong ba 'dug /nang du rtogs pa ci 'phel yang bya bral gyi khyur zhugs phyin/ bya pa nang so'i zhal ngo yin yang dma' sa bzung / lto gos gtam gsum la gyong skar mkhan zhig byung na rab yin pas gral rtsod dang sder khas ci byed/ rab tu byung ba rnams rtags cha lugs kyi che bas gong du 'bur dgos pa 'di sgar pas sgrigs

go༅༅/ /gsar du bcos pa min/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge 'dun la rag las par bshad pa dang /khyad par dwags po dkar brgyud 'di/phyi rab tu byung ba'i rtogs ldan 'dul khrims la gnas pa/nang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying / mar mi yab sras kyi gdams ngag zab mo mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba rnams thugs nyams su bzhes pas bapokha phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres zhes grags shing /khyad par du 'phags pa de nas brgyud pa rnams/ nang rtogs pa'i gdeng dang ldan zhing /phyir dam chos 'dul ba la gces spras su mdzad de dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde la bkur sdi mdzad pa sogs spyan ltos bzang po 'di byung ba yin/ nged rang tsho'ang dwags brgyad kyi rjes lkogayin pas khong yab sras kyi bkar la smo dgos/khyed rtogs ldan pa sgar la rgyang slo sdod 'dod yod pa rnams

kyang / rab byung gi chas sgom sham tsam re mdzad nas 'dug na rigs 'gre zhing mang ja tshogs 'khor sogs la mnyam du 'tshogs/ mnyam za mnyam 'thung byas pas re sabang med cing so sor las mi gsog pa yong 'dug /sgrub sde so sor ni rang rang gi bla ma'i lugs de gras mtshungs pas skyon med/ de yang sbal mgo la shad ma rgyag pa asti dang zer ma'i smad g.yogs sul mang la shes 'dod byed pa lta bu/ spros bcas chos brgyad ma yin par ma bcos lhug pa'i sgo nas sgrub sde'i grwa 'dzin cing chos dang mthun pa sgoms chung ba zhig byung na/ bla ma zhal bzhugs pa rnams kyi brtan bzhugs dang dgongs pa sgrubapa'ang de yin cing / gshegs pa rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs kyang de yin/ gsang spyod chig ri 'grims pa'i rnal 'gror pa rnams la mgo stabs dang gos cha lugs la nges pa med chos brgyad kyi 'khri ba ma zhugs phyin rnyed na bcom ber

ra༅༅/ /dang gzan snal lnga rgyan kyang ci skyon/ ma 'gror na shing shun dang srang mdor dor ba'i lhan tshal bsgrigs nas rgyan/ mi tshe sgrub pa la skyal na pha mi la ras pa'i rnam thar 'khyongs pa ma gtogs mi mdzes pa dang rigs mi 'gre ba med/ phyis byung rtogs ldan gyis chog byas nyog byas zer ba'i la ba rgyu mang po 'di yang / cha lugs 'di stabs bde la shogs che bas/ bong bus gzig lpags rgyan pa'i dpe bzhin mi ma rungs pa 'ga' zhig gis cha lugs der bsgyur nas spyod ngan sna tshogs byas pa dang / rtogs ldan gyi khungs tshos kyang gu yangs kyi spyod pa ci rigs byung bas phar 'dres tshur 'dres su song nas rtogs ldan tsho zer tsho 'ded kyi skar 'debs 'di byung bar 'dug /rang khrims rang gis bzung na gser dang bong ba ga la 'dre/ so sos theg pa rang 'khur ngos dge sbyor la 'bungs mdzod/ sgos ma

rnams kyang tshul gnas kyi chos zhu mi ma gtogs/ sgar du mi mdzes pa'i skur ba yong ba zhig 'dug pas/ so so'i dgon gnas rnams su sdod la chos mthun dge sbyor gang 'phel gyis shig gsungs bslab stoni zhib 'thems stsal/ gan rtsa grub chen sogs ras rkyang pa brgyad grwa zhig rgyang tsam zhabs phyir brten pa gnang / de nas chos mdzad byang chub rgyal mtshan la da lam phyag g.yog tu 'gyur nges byung gsungs dashes pa chen po'i sgo nas gnang cha rgyas pa stsal/ bka' las/ da lam gtsang la yong don nged rang mkhar chur mtshams kyi bcad rgya rgyun ring tsam byed rtsis nas re zhig 'phrad pa dada' bas grwa rigs sbyin bdag dad can rnams la phrad kha gtongab/ grwa tshang sgrub sde rnams la bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong gi bslab bya byed pa/ lhag par phyag mdzod kyi skor 'di gtsang rang du thag gcod pa 'gab byung ba 'di rnams la khor tsam yong dgos

ra༅༅/ /'dug /rgyun ring sdod long mi yong khyed rang la kha sing nas zhib cha lab pa rnams sems la 'og gsungs/ byin rlabs rten stsal ba nus/ gnang cha rnams slar phul/ khong pa'i yum gyi don du ljags bsngo zhus/ rgyal byed sngags grwa'i rin po che dbon po la bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / rgya sbug /ber sgom sogs dang bcas bsko 'ja' rgyas pa gnang / de mtshams khro phu nas rgyal dbang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gtsang phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi skye 'gro spyi'i mchod yul du spyan drangs/ yang rtser sa skyong dbang mo dpal mtshos bkur sti rgya cher bsgrubs/ rdo rje gdan/ rtse mo ri/ zom phud brgyud kṣ-i mtsho snar phebs/ dad ldan gyi khyim bdag so sos 'bul zhabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug cing / dbang chos kyang gang 'os su stsal/ mon la 'og yul gsum dang gtsang pa'i mtsho sna rdzong

dpon mdos pas mon bod gnyis kur phan pa'i gcig shos su snang ba gnyis ka la badzi' 'doms dang khra ma gnang nas 'khon zhi bar mdzad/ mon grab dang sha 'ug stag sgor phebs/ grub pa'i slob da' 'a po padma sambha lnga'i gnas rnams gzigs tshe/ tshe chu 'bab pa dang 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas snang yang mang po byung / zhal gyi dkyil 'khor lta bar lhags pa rnams zhal mjal byin rlabs chos dbang sogs 'brel tshad don ldan gyi dpal la bkod/ mtsho snar gnas po zhig la sgam po zhabs drung nor bu rgyan pa'i sku skye yin zer ba zhig 'dug par gzigs rtog gnang / badzi' las/ thugs rje'i rnam par sprul pa sems yo gang la gang 'dul gyi ngor 'thi pa chu snod so sor zla ba 'char ba dang 'dra bas/ chos sgor lkog thub pa gyis gsungs/ khro phu ba'i ༅ 'dren skyar ma 'gror/ gtsang la chibs kha bskyar/ snyo

ra༅༅/ /bod kyi khra ma'i mjug sdom la/ grub dbang sprul pa'i sku mkhar chu nas gdan 'dren bsha' shog gnang ba'i dgu bsdus phur yab sras zhal 'dzom/ mon gyi bde thabs la phebs dgos pa dang bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi zhal gdams legs par gnang / gri gur chos dang zang zing gi 'du 'god che ba nas a jo rdzong du phebs thog /rje sems dpa' chen po'i sbrul pa'i sku dpon slob kyang phebs te/ brtan bzhugs 'bul lam rgyas pa mdzad/ na dmar tshun zhabs phyir phebs/ lha btsun bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhar chu'i bla mar re 'ig bsko 'ja' gnang / de nas ri bo brag /stag lung sogs su sde pa sna rtse bas gtsos skya ser mang pos 'bul nod bsam las brgal/ 'phrang rings su skyong nga bas gsum zhag gi bkur sdi bgyis thog /rin sdings pa sogs kyi chibs bsu 'gror/ rgyal rtse kla khang du

bzhugs sgar mdzad/ skye bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus pa rnams zhal mjal byin rlabs sogs 'brel tshad don ldan gyi dpal la bkod/ rin sdings grwa tshang par mang ja'i thog rgya sbug legs pa zhig gis gtsos gnang cha gya nom pa mdzad/ gram bu nor bu sgang du 'brong rtse nas dang rgyal byed pa'i bsu ba 'gror/ lung rigs smra ba'i bsti gnas myang lung ba'i lte ba chos grwa chen po rgyal byed tshal du phebs gdong / ngur smig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun grangs mang bas mchod par 'os pa'i yo byad kyi bkod pas bsus/ grwa tshang gnyis kyis gzhi len dang / sde pa 'brong rtsebs gsol phogs phul/ don gnyer mang por phyag chen chos drug sogs kyi nyams khrid/ spyi chos su chos 'byung bstan pa'i padmo rgyas pa'i i byed sogs chos kyi 'bor lo bskor/ lho brag tu rgyal po lha btsun rin po che spyan 'dren bka' shog dang bcas pa gnang / gtsang

ra༅༅/ /sar ja 'bul la drung yig pa dang / stag lung du dasto rin po che khri thog tu phebs pa'i khri ja zhu bar rin po che ral gri sgang pa brdzangs/ de rjes bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung gi rgyud las/ bla ma 'das pa'i lo zla tshes grangs dag /nges par bzung ste mchod par byas gyur na/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar gdul bya rnams drang ba'i slad du/ rje bla ma rnam gnyis kyi sku mchod rgyun ma chad par/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pas rgya cher sgrub pa'i phyag srol bzang po yod pa ltar de lo'ang rgya cher mdzad/ de skabs gtsang pa dang lho nas zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba gnyis lha pa'i 'phrul la brten pas/ lugs ma legs pa'i sde gzar langs/ gtsang dpung lhor bcug 'dug dus dmag dpon sgog lung par thal cha med ngos lugs legs

yong ba'i thugs bsam che dgos tshul sogs ba/'a shog dang gnang sbyin dpag med stsal/ bka' las/ da lam gyi 'di la nged rang la byed sa cig yod na rgyu lus gang rtse'i sgo nas 'gro sgo dada' las 'bur dgos pa byung yang byed dgos pa'i bab thob tsam yod na'ang / lho nas zhabs drung rin po che nged rang la gzigs phyogs ma legs pas byed sa ni gang yang mi 'dug /yin kyang blos bzod par mi 'dug pas 'di la bar bzhugs sa skya zhabs drung las 'os pa mi 'dug pa nas de gzhi zhabs bskul zhu bar sa skya la mi sna gtong dgos gsungs/ da lam gtsang 'grug gi sde gzar 'di la bar bzhugs legs spel gyi skabs babs de ka nas yin 'dug pa thal song ma byung tsam 'dir/ zhabs drung rin po che rab lho nang / de ltar phebs ma thub kyang phag ri tsam du phebs dgos zhu ba'i zhu tho dang bama' mngags nan chags pa dang bcas rdzong

ra༅༅/ /bdar mdzad pa bzhin/ sa skyar de ma'i zhu ba phul bas/ bdagachen rin po che'i bka' las/ 'brag pa thams cad mkhyen pa snyan grags dang mthun pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa bla na ma mchis pa rang du 'dug /lho nas dpon slob kyis khyed dpon slob la 'byuṅgi mi 'dzug 'di mdzad nas thugs kyis mi bzod pa 'di 'dra gnang ba mdzad pa la dad pa 'chor ba 'dug /zhabs drung thugs gyong gtsang pa dbang ches pas byed bde ba dang phan thogs pa zhig e yong mi shes te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' nan chags pa 'dug pas snga 'gros gtsang pa dang lhor mi sna zhig btang / de nas nga rang cis kyang 'gro gsungs zhal bzhes gnang / mdzad pa la bsngags pa'i zhu lan yang rgyas pa byung / de'i tshe bapokha las/ da lam lho'i dmag 'di la thal song chen po rang mi yong ba 'dug /mdang ngos kyi

rmi lam na khyi dmar po gcig dang spyang ki gcig 'dzings grabs la so sor gyes song / 'on kyang bya thabs med pa'i blo 'tshab po zhig rang 'dug pas/ sa skya zhabs drung phebs pa dang rtsemathun tsam la nged ra'i 'di nas kyang mi sna zhig gtong dgos pa 'dug /lho'i zhabs drung sku gzhogs su yang thar na zhu yig cig byed/ bka' bskrun 'dra yong shas kha ste mi don med kyis lab pa sna min/ khong gtsang pa rgya ras kyi gdung 'dzin gdan sa'i khri thog pa yin pas 'bur dgos pa'i bab thob yod gsungs/ de nas sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che chings don la chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gnas tshul gsan ma thag dbon po zhwags de bas gcos mi sna nyis sbrel zhig lho la rdzong ba gnang / thugs dam brtag pa ji bzhin sde gzar phar khag tshur khag tu song ba'i gtsang dpung rnams phag rir 'then pa dang thug /lhor 'gro ma dgos/ legs spel sa

ra༅༅/ /skya zhabs drung nas gnang / mi sna sbrel po tshur log /lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ sems 'tshab po byang ste da lam 'tshams po rang byung gsungs/ chos mdzad shākya phun tshogs nas/ lho nas khong dpon slob rnams kyis ni 'brag brdzus pa tsho rang gsung bsha' bskrun bonang ba yin/ nged rang dpon slob 'di 'dra'i thugs tshad gnang don mi 'dug zhu ba la/ rje'i zhal nas pha tshan dgra dang rus pa rshaser zer ba yin/ brdzus dngos ci yin kyang / nged rang gi cha nas/ chos min byas nas dkar brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar ma 'khyongs par 'gyod dgos pa yang med/ yang / chos rje 'brug pa'i bstan pa las kha phyir 'chus kyis zhabs 'dren pa yang med/ bstan bzhig chos min gyi las ka byas na ni/ rje padma dkar po dngos su dbu paṇa grong nger phebs kyang ldugs 'dug /bstan pa la gang phan dang / dkar

brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar 'grongs na ni brdzus ma yin kyang des thus pa 'dra/ lar rang tshig skam po'i phar lab tshur lab 'di la a 'thas kyi phyogs snga kun slong bcos pa 'di rang gis lan pa yin 'dug gsungs/ de skabs mdo khams nas bla ma dmi bstan 'phel ba sogs kyis 'bul skyel stobs che ba 'gror/ 'di dus be ris ja pa rnams bkag nas dbus gtsang la ja shin tu dkon pa dpe yags nyag re la khal brgyad tsam byed pa'i skabs su/ gsol ja nag rtsed dpe yags sogs khor drug ma mang po/ rten khyad 'phags/ gser dngul gyi mchod chas/ gzhan yang gose dar rta drel serdzogs brgya 'bul bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas tshe/ khams nas skusnang mkhan rnams blo stobs snying rus che ba dang / bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa thugs rje che ba'i dper byas so// //lhag bsam lhag pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan 'jig rten kun gyi mes po

ra༅༅/ /des/ /dkar brgyud dkar po'i chos kyi snang bas gdul bya'i blo mun bsal ba dang / /sgrub brgyud sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po mi nub ring du gnas bya'i phyir/ /don brgyud don gyi bstan pa'i bdag por chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskal/ /drang don tha snyad spangs pa'i nges don chos/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin 'byed pa rdo rje'i tshig /brtse ldan pha yis bu la 'doms pa bzhin/ /skal bzang slob ma'i tshogs la gsal bar bstan/ /e ma tilli nā ro mar mi sogs/ /grub brnyes gong ma byang chub sar gshegs pa'i/ kham mchog ma yengs dran pa 'di yin pas/ /blongan lam gogo gzhan la ma 'khyog cig /rtag tu gnod pa'i me lces tsam bsregs kyang / /phan bde'i dri bzang gzhar yang mi 'dor ba/ /yongs 'du'i 'khri shing sa ha ka ra 'di/ /'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor rgyal kun thugs rjes bskyan/ /zhes

dpal 'brugapa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan sku1ngas 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dgazha ba'i zlos gar las/ thun mong ma yin pa'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas yongs su gang ba sgrub brgyud rgya mtsho'i dpal du spel ba'i rab tu byed pa ste bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas myos ldan te sa mo yos lo dbyed kyi dus ston la phyogs pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje'i gong bu kun mkhyen 'brag pa rin po che khro phu dga' ldan du spyan 'dren gyi gsol ba 'debs pa la bdag gis rgyal byed tshal du phyin/ mi ring bar chibs kha bsgyur ba'i 'brong rtse sogs sde dpon che rū dang bsam grub chos sdings pa rnams kyis bkur sdi yang dag pa bsgrabs/ phyug po khang gsar du gtsang sde srid kyi ja zhus rgyas pa sgar dmangs la phogs dang bcas pa phul/ srin po rdzong du khro phu ba'i chibs bsu

ra༅༅/ /slebs/ rnam sras gling du thab bsu dang / mchod rten chen mo'i 'gram nas ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun grangs mang bas bla gos dang snam sbyar zlum por gyon/ rgya rtags kyicod pan 'od du 'bar ba gtsug tu bcings/ mchod pa'i yo byad tshar du dngar bas lag pa'i padmo brgyan te bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas mdun bdar nas rgya 'od kyi paṇa grub du ma'i bsnyi gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin dga' ldan byams pa'i gling zhes grags pa legs bshad smra ba'i chos grwa gang der phebs/ dga' ston gyi bkur snyi rgya chen po dang / bzhugs sgar yongs 'du grwa tshang dang bcas par gsal phogs phul/ der la stod lho byang sogs phyogs bcu nas dad ldan gyi snre bo'i 'du tshogs shin tu che/ so so'i dpal 'gyor don ldan du bya ba'i phyir zang zing gi 'bul ba char sprin ltar gtibs/ don gnyer gyi gdul bya mang por phyag

chen sogs kyi khrid bsha' dang / khrom chen por spyi chos nyin ltar gyis gnang / grwa tshang pas 'cham gyi gzigs mo dang / bde yangs kyi bzhugs khri chen mor gdan drangs/ brgya 'bul dpangs bstode bsgrubs/ de thog tu khrom shin tu che ba la tshe dbang stsal/ dad pa'i nor can 'on slon pas 'bul zhabs phul du phyin pas sri zhur bgyis/ rgyal po lha btsun stosna brag nas byon te/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa chen por ba〉rdzo bzhag gnang / de dus bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po buddha badzra yang shrī nas byon/ lha btsun phyag mdzod pa/ lhun rtse zhabs drung sogs sgar gyi dbu che yul gnyan phal cher gyis bla mar bkur/ gus 'dud chen po mdzad/ rje bla mas rgyal ba mchog gi ska gzhogs su bur ston 'bul lam dang bcas brtan bzhugs rgya cher phul bas rten 'brel shin tu bzang ba byung / gza' skar dus

ra༅༅/ /tshes legs pa la khro su bla brang gi ka druganub tu phyag mdzod rtsis sprod kyi dga' ston la dashar spro rgyas pa bshams/ rgyal ba nyid dbu che las tshan rags rim dang bcas pa gdan drangs/ shis brjod kyi me tog gtor/ de mtshams mkhan rin po ches/ lha bas phyag mdzod par lugs gnyis kyi blang dor sogs snyan sgro zhib rgyas phul rjes/ sku nyid nang gi rnal 'gror la gzhol ba'i thugs dam bogs 'tho gsang spyod kyis do zla min pa rang de sgar gyi phyag mdzod 'di mdzad pas yong gsungs pas thams cad bzhad mo 'chor ba byung / de yang rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dgongs gtad ltar/ lha btsun ngag dbang rnam rgyal phyag mdzod go sar bskos/ 'phrin las sgrab pa'i shing rta chen por mnga' gsol bas/ phyis bstan pa nyag phra dus kha na ma tho ba med pa'i kun spyod chos mthun gyi mdzad pa kho nas bstan pa'i

srog 'dzin bla na med pa byung ba yin no/ /dpal ldan sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/deng sang thugs zhib chen pos bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa la 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i skyes bu dam par bzhugs zhes gsung ba sogs bsha' tho bkur sdi che ba dang bcas pa 'gror pa'i lan yang zab rgyas gnang / khro phur bzhugs thog gtsang gi chos sde che kha phal che bar mang skol brdzangs/ byams chen mthong ba don ldan gyi dbu thog tu bla bre gser gzhi ma shin tu che ba dang / grwa tshang la khyad gos kyi spyan gzigs gong rgyan sogs gnang / phyag mdzod rgyal po rin po che 'khod nas sgar pa drag zhan thams cad la bsha'i phebs sgor/ sngar phan ni phyag mdzod snga phyi'i mtshams 'dir/ nged rang gis phyi nang bar gsum bkod pa bgyid dgos pa 'dra zhig gis zos ma bde

ra༅༅/ khi blo dang mthun pa rang zhig sus kyang ma byung / lhag par sgar gyi chang khrims 'di la yang yang sdom gcod byas pa yin na'ang / khyed 'go ru sdod mkhan rnams kyis khrims ma khur tsa na thams cad kyis bag yangs byed pa zhig 'dug /da nas rgyal po phyag mdzod 'di thugs mi sun zhing mdzad gtad du mi 'gro ba zhig khyed drag zhan thams cad kyis mdzod/ so sos gang bcol gyi las la khur dang bsam pa che bar gyis/ gzhan ma byung yang chang ma 'thung / kha mang dang dkrug shing ma byed/ chos dang gang mthun ngos sgoms chung du chug /de byung na nga yang dga'/ rgyal po phyag mdzod la yang des thus gsungs tshogs gtapa du mdzad/ bca' yig gcig kyang gnang / rim gyis shar phyogs la chibs kha bskyar/ gnas tshun chibs skyel la rje bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje yang byon/ der phyag 'bul ba gnang / mi rgan gyi

phye phyag yin/ da tshe 'di la mjal ba zhig dbakha bas thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug zhu gsungs zhabs kyi padmo la gtsug gis 'dud pa dang lhan cig spyan chab mdzad 'dug pas rang re yang yid shin tu skyo zhing mig nas mchi ma'i rgyun skyil mi thub pa lta bu byung / byin rlabs 'ja' tshon ma'i thum dang padma ra gzhi mdangs can gyi ljags mdud zhig gnang / sku tshe'i rten 'brel yin no gsungs/ bdag rnams la'ang byin rlabs dang phyag dbang srung mdud stsal to/ /de nas chibs rags mig mthong gi sa ma thon bar bdag dpon slob rnams kyis der bzhugs pas/ rgyal ba dam pa nyid kyang chibs sog nas phyi spyan yang yang gzigs pa gnang / shin tu thugs 'phreng ba'i tshul mdzad 'dug cing de nas ma mjal lo/ /yar tsam phebs pa dang bsha' las/ mkhan rin po che ska na byon pa'i thugs 'phreng ba'i gsung yin 'dug ste/ su'i sngon la su 'chi mi

ra༅༅/ shes na'ang /bgres sha chen po byung 'dug pas dge bzhes 'di 'dra da rang dkon po yin pas phangs po de yin 'dug gsung ba phebs/de nub gsing mar bzhugs sgar gnang thog gangs can gyi 'ba' reng thogs shas/bcus zhwa dang dpa' dam sha 'dzugs byas bzhugs sgar la lta ba rnams spyan gyis gzigs pas/rang re'i khro phu ba rnams spyod lam legs po mdzad dgos pa 'dug/khyim tshas zhed po yin snang gsung ma 'ongs lung bstan bsha' stsal/de nas spel dmar du sde rgyas nas kyis spyan drangs/ der bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi chab shog dang / gtsang pas thab 'degs rgyas pa dang bcas/stod kyi rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal dang nged gnyis kyi legs sbyor la khyed dpon slob skabs su bab pa 'dug pas/stod la mi sna drag pa zhig gnang dgos zhu ba

byung / rje'i bka' las/ dus zing 'khrag long skabs de 'dra la ni/ blos mi bzod par gang drag ci drag byed dgos pa yong gi 'dug /gzhan 'di rigs byed gtad ceng slar mthong phyogs byed pa las mi yo/ yang / stod du grub thob rin po cher brtan bzhugs 'bul ba dang bcas mi drag pa zhig gtong dgos pa yod pa de dang zur rdo nyes chod byas chog pa 'dug pas/ de ka zhus chog pa'i khas len gyis gsung rgyal po rin yo cher bslab ston gnang / de nas gru kha spel/ nor gling / rgya phibs/ yar gdong / 'brong rtsernams su rnam dashar gyi sa bon grung po rgyud la btab nas rgyal byed du phebs/ chos don gnyer mang por dbang lung khrid kyi rim pa mang ngo dang / lhag par zhwa lu ri sngag nas rin po che byang gling nas/ rin sdings grwa tshang gi bla ma/ za dam dbu mdzad sogs la phyag chen gyi nyams khrid shin tu smin pa

ra༅༅/ /dang / byang gling nas kyis gsol ba btab ngor brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dpa' bo o rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyi khyad chos bsnyen sgrub kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa dang / rje rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /pha mtshan ldan bla mar gas pas 'dud/ /spang gnyen dbyer med kyi nyams len 'di/ /khas len dang bral ba'i lta ba yin/ /ched du mi sgom pa'i rang babs 'di/ /sgom med yengs med ces sgom pa'i mchog /gnyis 'dzin dang bral ba'i rang grol 'di/ /a wa dhū ti pa'i spyod par gsungs/ /gzhan phan gyi sems bskyed rgya chen po/ /sdig spong dge sgrub kyi las 'bras rtsi/ /dge tshogs sems can gyi don du bsngo/ /de dkar brgyad gong ma'i gdams pa lags/ /zhes pa'i zhal gdams dang ska chos ska gzan dang bcas pa ska la bzhes 'phro gnang / ska gzan de la ska dreg cung zad 'byar bsaca phyis zhwa

thur mchod rten bzhengs 'dug pa'i nang bzhugs su gsol/ phyag chen gyi khrid grol ba'i sang de phyag dbang zhur byon dus/ sgom thag phyag gis spyi bor bzhag nas 'di nged rang gis bya bral gyi bsko 'ja' yin no gsungs/ sang log rgyu'i de ring de 'brong rtse g.yul kha'i bzhugs sgar du gsung mgur mang du gnang / khyed la gzhi len yin/ rje'i snyan la gzan lags kyang / /sprang la snang ba 'di las med/ /gsungs pa ltar yin gsungs dgyes dgyes kyi zhal 'dzum mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba gzhan 'gags/ rten 'brel gyi gnad cig 'dug pas 'di bzhes gsungs gsol ja bzhes 'phro zhal dpon khengs pa gnang / log 'byon khar zhabs dbang zhus dus smon lam bto/ skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du thugs rjes 'ogron pa mkhyen zhus pas/ bka' las/ thugs yid gcig 'dres yin no/ /bu ston rin po che'i bstan

go༅༅/ /pa la gang phan mdzod/ de kha nged kyi zhabs tog kyang yin no gsungs/ yang / rnam g.yeng rang la ma 'byams par res dben par sgom/dben par bde bde mo skyid chos la ma shor ba yang rkyen dang bsre ba sogs thugs dam la brtson po mdzod gsungs zhal ta legs par stsal to/ /bzhugs khri chen mor sde pa 'grong rtse nas kyi brgya 'bul dang / spel ser ba'i yum gyi tsun cha sogs 'bul ba rgya cher bsgrubs/ khrom shin tu che ba la tshe dbang phyag bstar rang gnang na sku ngal bas sku tshab kyis gnang na 'gab zhu bar/ kho bo da lam ma gtogs re zhig 'di phyogs e yong mi shes myang 'di 'brag lung skyog mo zer dad pa che ba yin pas/ dbang lag bstar ma ma byas na 'di rnams blo kha mi rdzogs gsungs/ 'du khang rdo skas pad sngangs ma'i steng du phebs/ dosam ska mdun la bshar nas tshe rta'i dbang rgyas pa gnang /

sku mchod chen mo dang stabs mtshungs su 'du khang du dpal dgyes pa rdo rje jog lugs kyi dbang bzhi yang gnang ngo / /de nas ja gnas pa sogs grwa yon rnams kyis gang ser du spyan drangs zla ba tsam bzhugs/ khrid ka dbang lung gi rigs mang po dang / spyi chos su stoni pa'i skyes rabs brgya pa stsal/ nub mar yig legs pas gdan drangs/ yar lam chos lung du rin sdings pas chibs bskol zhus thog dpal 'khor chos sde'i sngags grwa rags rim gyi slob dpon rnams mjal bar byang / nub mar bzhugs skabs chos rje nor bu rgyal mtshan dang rin po che ral sgang pa gnyis kyis chos skad mgal reng can byas pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ sngar yin na chozlo skad mug mug las rtsel reng byas pa smo spro ba yong gi yod de/ da rgas pas sun yong gi 'dug gsungs/ rin po che ral sgang nas kyis de tsam gyi bgres pa ci yin lags zhu bar/ da

ra༅༅/ /'chi ba la thag ring po med pas rgas pa rang los yin gsungs/ slar gang ser du sku grib la rten sku khams cung zad myog pa'i tshul gyis sku mtshams rgyang tsam gnang / grol nas chos 'phro rnams rdzogs par gnang rjes rgyal byed du phebs/ rin po che skyabs mchog pa stod la bsko 'ja' dang bcas rdzong bda' mdzad tshe/ bka' las/ da lam gtsang sa nas mi sna rdzong dgos tshul byung ba dang khyed brdzangs pa yin te/ don gyi gtso bo grub thob rin po che sku na yang smin pa tsam yin pas phyag g.yog tu gang 'gyur dang / stod du bstan pa ris med par phan 'doms slebs gang che'i ngos mchod yon gnyis kyi dbongs pa gang zin mdzod gsung bslab ston gnang / de mtshams gzims chung du dud sol lha mor sger bskang brgya tshar zhig ljags thog nas gnang skabs/ 'bras spangs nas thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i bskakha

tho/ sde pa phyag mdzod drung gi zhu yig rten ldan/ chibs drel/ spel ser ba la'ang sne sbyor zhu dgos pa'i bsha' shog rten gnang bar/ dge bzhes dus zhabs pa/ spyir gang sar yon to che ba dang lhag par sgra rig la shin tu 'dris pa yod zer snyan pa 'dug pa/ deng sang 'dir sgra'i dogs gcod 'dra byed bsam pa nas/ da lam rta dre'u dang bcas 'bod par btang ba/ dpon slob nas 'phral du rdzong bda' gnang dgos tshul mdzad 'dug pa/ rgyal dbang dam par ba/kha tho gnas tshul dang bcas pa phul/ da lam 'bras snangs kyi sku don 'di gnang thub na bstan par bda' drin che ba yin 'dug zhus pas/ zhu shog rnams la gzigs/ khyed bsam pa che zhing 'phral phugs lhas things pas yan 'dug ste/ nged rang gi khro phu ba rnams zhus pas gsan pa zhig med/ khong tshos kun rne rkan nee ma byas na/ dge bshes rang yang yoni to

ra༅༅/ /bslab pa'i dgos pa yin 'dug cing skyes bu dam pa la 'bul ba 'di skal ba yang bzang ba yin/ lhag par nged rang gi bstan pa la stod smad thams cad du phan pa zhig yong 'dug ste thog khel zhig dasha'/ gang ltar phyag mdzod du chas gzan bdag rkyen gang drag yong ba gyis/ gnangs nyin mi sna dang bcas rdzong ba yin gsungs/ rgyal po rin po ches kyang / ding sang spyir dge 'brag lugs mi legs pa mi 'dug ste/ 'bras spungs dang nged rang sku nye 'di tsam yin pa'i tshod kyis ha cang 'grul ba zhig mi 'dug pa/ da lam 'dis mtshams sbyadro ba'i thugs 'brel zab pa zhig byung na bstan par phan pa 'dug gsungs thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad/ de'i gnangs mi sna dang bcas pa gnang ba'i bka' shog phebs byung / grwa pa rnams kyis 'chad nyan chag 'gro bas stoni chags kyi skabs la ma gtogs byon na mi

yong zer u tshugs bskyed pas blo 'dzangs de thog tu yong ma thub/ slar yong tshul gyis rgyu mtshan phul bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ da lam gyi don dag 'di rigs la kun ni kon ne byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang ma byung ste/ bar chad kyi mtshan ma la/ grwa pas bla ma la mi nyan/ g.yog gis dpon la mi nyan pa'i zang nge zing nge 'di yong ba yin/ sgar 'di rang la'ang / kha sing khro phu nas skurdzong skabs chang khrims bca' yig de tsam byas pa yin te nyan mkhan su 'dug /lar gyis mkhar chu rang du mtshams la sdod ran pa'i rtags yin gsungs ma mnyes pa chen po byung / da lam 'bras spungs su dpon slob rnams thugs khrel 'gro ste/ slar dge bshes sku gzhogs su rdzong thub pa zhig cis kyang byed dgos gsungs/ de sha'i zhu lan rnams gnang / de nas mkhar chur mi 'gyang bar phebs pa'i dasongs gtad kyis dbu mdzad gan rtsa ras chen stod

ra༅༅/ /du gsang spyod la brdzangs/ dus snyigs ma'i thugs dam rang tsho thub nges yin 'dug kyang / slar bar chad cig byung dogs 'dug pas de la gzobs gsungs pa sogs zhal ta rnams gnang / dgos 'phel dbang po rgyal byed sgrib sder lo gsum la bcug /ras rkyang pa gzhan rnams kyang byin rlabs bslab ston dang bcas pa gnang nas so sor bam chos dang mthun cing rang la rang ma khrel rbe zhig gyis gsungs zhabs dbang re gnang ngo / /de nas 'brong rtse'i g.yul khar bzhugs sgar cag zhag mdzad de shar phyogs su chibs kha bsgrur/ gdan sa chen po ra lung thel gyi gangs ri rnams gzigs pa dang chibs thog tu dbu zhwa phud/ b.lakha las/ da lam gyi gdan sa'i gnas mjal 'di tsam gyis go gagacod dgos pa 'dug /gdan sa 'di la zhabs tog tu gang 'gyur byed bsam pa zhig yod kyang nang khul gyi

dge skyon 'dis byed thabs yod pa zhig ma byung / sems kyi lhagam zhig 'di na lus yod/ gzhan de tsam yin gsungs/ de nas 'brog brgyud ba chos su bzhugs sgar phebs skabs lhun po rdzong rdzong dpon nang gzan sogs mi sde mang po blo 'bul du slebs/ rdzong rtsis bzhes dgos pa sogs rgyu mtshan phul 'dug kyang rje 'di de rigs kyi gzhan srid ham pa la ches mi dgyis pas sna dkar rtser mi sna gnang / lugs legs kyi bka' 'doms mtha' btsan gnang bas dpon g.yog gnyis kur bapokha drin che ba byung ngo / /de nas rim gyis/ 'grong rgyas su/ ri bo bde chen pa/ 'du khang pa/ spyan g.yas/ thang po che pa sogs chos sde khag dgon phran dang bcas pa so sos bsu ba ser sbrengs rdzong dpon sogs dpon smya rnams kyi chibs bsu dang bcas bkur snyi zhus/ lus yo de thams cad kyi rgyad la rnam dkar gyi sa bon bskyon/ de nas lha

ra༅༅/ /gzigs chos kyi rgyal pos bsu ba'i bkod pa dpe bral du gams te pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtse'i mdun/mtho ris kyi dko tshal nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan du bkod pa lta bu'i skyed tshal gzhal med khang bkod pa phun sum tshogs par phebs/chos don gnyer mang po la/phyag rgya i po lhan cig skyes sbyor/nā ro'i chos drug /bla ma sgrub pa/'byung ba ro sgoms/ rten 'brel kho so lugs sogs zab khrid mang po dang /rgyab chos su bka' gdams glegs bam sogs gnang /gong ma chen por/tsha rta/sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/lha mgon gyi rjes gnang sogs zab rgyas kyi chos 'bor ci yang bskor/'di skabs rgyal dbang /mi pa chos dbyengs rdo rjes ska rnam sbyor dang 'gan sbyor sogs na bza' skor/chibs chen gyis gtsos rta bzang ba bcu gnyis kyis byang drangs pa'i 'bul stes brtan

bzhugs kyi tshul du dus tshes nges can bsgrigs nas rdzong gru gnang ba 'byor/ de res kyang shel brag gi gnas gzigs la phebs/ der za dam dbu mdzad la zhal gdams kyang stsal/ chos rgyal pho brang du phyogs zhag tsam bteg /bkur snyi dang 'bul ba dpangs bstod 'dug /grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe bapokha brgya rtsa sogs dbang cos mang po dang / yar shar nub kyi mi 'du tshogs che ba'i khrom la dbang sbyin mdzad/ khra 'brug tu phebs pa'i rten brten par rab tu gnas pa smon lam dang bcas pa gnang / slar sne'u sdong klu sdings su phebs/ chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas gong ma chen po'i bzhed pa bskang rjes/ bya yul phyogs chibs kha bsgyur bar mngon du phyogs tshe/ rtse zhabs drung nas/ legs byas kyi chu gter rgya cher spel ba'i phyir thub dbang grong bzhud dge slong dpal mo'i thugs dam rten khyad can dang / sngags thang chen

ra༅༅/ /mos gtsos/ sku gsung thugs rten khyad mtshar mang pos byang drangs zang zing gi nor la 'dzin pa lhod pa'i brgya 'bul rgya cher bsgrabs/mkhar thog tshun chibs skyel la phebs dus ska ngos kyis gong ma chen por chab srid kyis skyong bran sogs lugs gnyis ma'i blang dor gyi gnas la de res bslab storno sngar bas zhib rgyas che ba stsal/ thang po cher yang snga grwa tshang dang / srong btsan du zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i cog grwa bas chibs ba'ol 'bul lam thog dge 'dun la bla ma'i rnal 'gror dang / glang bu gzhongs su cog grwa bla ma zhabs phyi stegs nas byung bar tshe rta dang phyag rdor gyi rjes gnang stsal/ lā ma brgyud gri gur phebs/ de dus rgan rabs kyis ma dran pa'i kha ba shin tu che ba nyin zhag mang po sbrel nas babs/ sgar rnams gri gu nas dgu bsngas bar kha ba pus nub tsam la bgrod/ ri ror mdo mkhar grwa

tshang ba rnams la chos 'brel mang 'gyed/ dar ma lha khang du sngags grwa bas zhabs tog bgyis te zhag lnga tsam bzhugs thoganas phud kyang bzhes/ der brag khagashegs pa'i bsngo zhus 'gror ba zag med du bsngo ba'i rjes 'dzin mdzad/ dang bskyal du cog sgar rnying pa dpon slob dbus phyogs la phebs pa dang 'grigs/pa'i sku la tshe rta dang mdo phran 'ga' re'i ljags lung gnang / sprul pa'i sku'i gsung nas/ de skabs zhag kha shas kyi bar nyin mo lta ci mtshan mo'ing sku gzhogakyi padmo la spyi bos btud de 'dug pa'i skal ba bzang po thob cing / blang dor gyi gnas mtha' dag la'ang mtshan thog thag 'khyongs pa'i bka' mchid zhib sabaka' drin mdzad pas rang re'i legs byas la'ang mgu bar byung gsungs/ skya log dgyes bro nas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug 'byug pa kun dgazha legs pa'i spre

ra༅༅/ /dpon slob kyis bsu ba'i bkod pas rdo rje gdan du spyan drangs/ krol yangs pa can gyi grong khyer chen po'i skye bo so so'i dpal 'gror dang bstan pa'i dngos po thams cad/ dge ba'i rtsa bar yongs su bsngo ba dang khrom dbang sogs stsal/ bya rigs chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang yang rtser yon gyi bdag mos rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i 'gror pa la 'gran pa lta bus bkur snyi bsgrubs/ dbang chos kyang gnang / mchod khang rnying par phebs bskang gso dang 'phrin bcol rgyas pa mdzad/ sab mo bung nas bya pa zhabs drung 'gyur med lhun grub dpon g.yog dang / pad dkar grwa tshang pa'i bsu ba'i bkur sti dang bcas mi pham rgyal ba'i bsti gnas gang du phebs/ mchod yon so so nas phebs spro'i dgazha ston rgya cher zhus/ ska 'khyos kyi gnang cha'ang gzab ma stsal to// //legs byas bsod nams mthu yis

brgya lam na'ang / /rnyed da/'a lha mi'i mchod sdong yongs 'du'i gter/ /dad gsum shing rtas drangs tshe 'bad pa'i las/ /don ldan 'bras bu'i dpal la cis mi sbyor/ /ye shes 'od kyi klong du ro gcig kyang / /mkhyen brtse mos ngor snang ba nyi zla'i 'gros/ /'char nub mi rtag tshul la yid 'byung ba'i/ /nges 'byung skyo shas drag pos mchi ma bku/ /sngon las byed po'i por gyis bris pa'i tshon/ /dashar nag las kyi ri mo rnam bkra ba/ /ma 'dres gsal gzigs gsung gi nor bu yang / /rmongs pas bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin gyi nar bor/ /las ngan ljan ljin 'dus pa rnyog ma'i rdzing / /blo ngan srin bu'i tshogs kyis gang ba la/ /'dab chags rgyal po yid phebs ma gyur pas/ /rab zhi'i mkha' la rgyu ba'i bskyol zhugs blangs/ /ring nas bordzoms pa'i bag chags mthu brtas pas/ /dbang med mi dge'i las la rab tu 'jug /ma

ra༅༅/ /rungs blo can dman pa'i 'gro ba la/ /khyed kyi brtse ba'i chu rgyun ngang gis lhang / /thabs mkhas thugs rjer ldan pa'i rten 'byang gis/ /sna tshogs mos pa'i 'jug ldog ji bzhin du/ /gcig pu du mar snang ba chu zla'i gar/ /tshur rol mthong ba'i blo yis dpag bya min/ /zhes dpal 'brug peṃ rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gyi 'phros gleng ba las/ thog mar dge ba'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rin po cher byams chen gyi phyag mdzod steng shod rnams rtsis sprod gnang / b.lakha las/ rten li ma'i rigs gzims chung rten gsum rags rim ma gtogs 'di dag phal cher bkra shis mthong spyod gyi sgo khang stong du/ li ma lha khang zhig bsgrigs

nas/ de tsam gyis mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i khungs su byed dgos gsungs/ li ma rnams gdan drangs te bkra shis mthong smon du phebs/ sgo khang steng du rje nyid rang gi sku thog la phyag tu 'byor ba'i rten li ma'i rigs rgya gar dbus 'gyur shar lho nub byang gi yul gru spyi dang bye brag las byung zhing / khyad par ba ri lo tsā bas dbus 'gyur 'chang nas gdan drangs pa'i thub dbang gi skru dzhai khrim las grub pa'i me thub ma byin rlabs shin tu che ba sku tshad rkang gang pa/ yul gru dang ska rgyu de bzhin gyi thub dbang bdud 'dul ma spus lhag par gtsang ba ༷/ tshad gang bzhin/ yang thub pa gser 'dra ma khyad mtshar khru gang pa/ sku tshad de mtshungs kyi thub pa'i sku mtho lding ma sne sngerdzong rtse nas phul ba'i phyag rdor 'gying log slab dpon a byu ya'i thugs dam rten li ma sogs rgya hor sod kyi li ma khyad thon 'ba' zhig phyed nyis brgya lhag tsamadang / gzhan

ra༅༅/ /yang / tsandan dkar dmar/ klu 'jim/ ka ma ru/ bsil tshal gyi sdo nag sogs las grub pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku brnyan lhag par mang ba/ g.yon phyogs su rigs gsum mgon po/ bde kye gsang gsum sogs sngags sku shas che ba'i rgya nag thugs dam ma spus gtsang 'ba' zhig /mchod rdzas su/ ma na ho/ g.yang tre'u/ gi gu shan/ krol dzing dang bzhu shel gyi yol go dkar spyad sogs rgya hor gyi spyad pa bla na ma mchis shing grangs mang bas legs par bstar te phyir lcags drwa sogs sgrub pa'i ljags bkod dang / bla brang gsar bzos la phyag nas gnang / de nas bla ma rnam gnyis kyi sku mchod dus gtor dang 'grigs pas tshogs dbur phebs/ snga dro bla mchod dang bde mchog nā ro bcu gsum ma'i sgrab mchod/ dgong mo mgon po lha mangs sogs/ chos skyong gi bskang ba rgyas pa nyer

gsum nas gnam gang gi bar btsugs pa'i zhabs tog tshang ma phyag mdzod nas zhus/ mgon khang gsar rnying du snyan dar dang mchod rdzas rgya chen po gnang / chos skyong ba'i srung mar sngar bcol ba'i gtang rag dang da bcol gyi 'phrin gsol rgyas pa mdzad/ de nas cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar ska mtshams bcad rgya zla brang du gnang / grol nas rgyal po phyag mdzod pa sogs sku 'khor ba rnams kyis phyag 'bul dang stun dri la byon dus/ bsha' las/ da lam sgya mtshams thog 'dir brtag pa legs rgyu rang ma byung bas/ gang rtsol gyis mkhar chu phyogs 'gro dgos pa 'dug gnang ba dang / bla brang gzims chung gi nag yug khar bzhugs gdan gnang ba'i ska gzhogs pa'ang phal cher yod skabs/ be'i lo 'dab so ma zhig ska mdun du babs pa lhani kha'i bsu bar 'dug gsungs/ ska gzhogs yongs 'du grwa tshang pa

go༅༅/ /rnams la'ang 'dul khrims gtsang ba'i ngos thos bsam gyi bgyi bar rtag 'grus dgos tshul sogs kyi bka'i bslab ston 'ib par gnang / lha khang steng shod/ mgon khang yas mas thams cad du phebs/ smon lam dang 'phrin bcol rgyas pa mdzad mchod rdzas sogs kyang gang 'os stsal/ sgro lcang gi nas phud bzhes te byams chen du phebs/ rten gsum khyad 'phags/ phyag dpe dbang chas sogs bapokha tham gyis gnon 'os rnams dang / dgongs pa can gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag grub rjes/ lho brag la chibs kha bsgyur/ byams chen mchod yon rnams la bgazhi phebs sgor/ nged lho brag la 'gro rgyu yin pas/ khyed grwa tshang rnams thos bsam la rtsol 'don yong ba dang / ska mdun zhal ngo yang rnam dkar la brtson pa dang 'di phyogs kyi bstan pa spyi bye brag la phan shes yang dag dgos pa sogs bslab ston zhib

rgyas gnang / de nas yang rtse brgyud g.yul rgyal lhun rtser 'breng khud pas li ma 'dra cog gi stoni pa grong bzhud kyi sku 'dra sogs rten gsar bzhengs mang po la phyag nas gsor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas mdzad cing 'dod chos kyang 'ga' re gnang / rdo rje gdan du grub dbang rin po cher tshe rta'i badzi' dbang gnang ste/ bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum la snying stobs ma chung ba dang thugs bsam gang che gnang dgos shing / nged kyang na tshod yar lon pa'i gzhis nas yun ring e sdod mi shes gsungs/ rdo rje gdan dge 'dun spyi sor yang / 'di phyogs rmi ltas bzang rgyu rang mi 'dug pas khyed rnams chos mthun sgoms chung gi sgo nas/ grub dbang rin po che'i bka' la 'khri ba gal che gsungs/ de nas sa tshigs so sor 'khos su bab pa'i bkur sti dang / dad 'dus kyi skye bo bgrang bar mi pung

ra༅༅/ /pa'i rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad/ klung rol kha nas sde pa lha khang pa/ cog grwa bla ma sogs mchod yon gyi chibs bsu dang thab bsu'i bkod gzhom bcas/ grwatshang gnyis/ rdo rje gdan pa/ tshe lam dpal ri ba/ lha khang las tshan bcu gsum sogs kyi ser sbrengs kyang rgyas pa dang / lha khang du zhal ngo so so nas bkur snyi ci yang zhus/ tshe rta sgrol dkar phyag rdor sogs lhag pa'i lha mang po'i rjes gnang stsal/ de nas gdod nas grub pa'i gnas chen de wī ko ṭa zhes dpal gsor lo'i mgon po yum bcas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig dgyes par rol pa'i yul mchog gang der phebs/ mkhar chu grwa tshang pas brtan bzhugs thog 'bul zhabs dpangs mtho ba 'dug /dgu gtor sogs kyi thugs brel bcad mtshams/ phyag mdzod rgyal po rin po che sogs las tshan zhabs 'bring sgar

dmangs/ grwa tshang dang bcas pa la/ 'brug lo'i nang 'dir nged rang 'brag pa rnams la 'dzer ba zhig yong 'dug pas/ nged kyang nyung shas kyis lo mtshams dam po la sdod rgyu yin/ rgyal po rin po che 'di phyag mdzod tsam du ma zad/ chos phyorgos nas kyang nged kyi rgyal tshab 'pher ba yod pas/ lugs gnyes kyi sgo nas khyed tshos gus shing zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba gyis shig ces dgongs pa ma 'ongs can ji snyed cig gsungs/ lhag par rgyal po rin po che la sgar sogs bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong gi bslab ston mtha' yas pa gnang ste/ gnam gang gi dgong mo nas sku mtshams nges pa can la bzhugs/ zhabs togo ni mkhar chu grwa tshang dang / sde pa lha khang pa/ lha bro ba/ kun gling pa sogs kyis phul/ sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal bzang bstan 'gro'i don du yang srid bzung ba'i sngal pa'i ska ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang

ra༅༅/ /pos/ yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma'i li skru khyad mtshar/ tshe mdo'i glegs bam rgya par ma/ rnam rgyal mchod rten sogs 'bul lam dpangs mtho ba dang bcas pa'i brtan bzhugs thog mar 'byor/ phyogs kya mjal mi gal che ba rnams la zla re'i nang du bug mjal thengs re tsam gnang dus/ gsung cos ljags bsngo sogs kyang gang 'os su stsol bar mdzad/ sne'u sdong rtse nas mi dbang chen po'i brtan bzhugs 'bul mi'ang slebs/ 'di lo'i 'go nas nyi mar drod mi 'byung zhing mdangs mi gsal ba dang / gnas chen tsa ri tra cig car rgod spang chen gyi gdong 'phan 'gyel ba/ phag mo lha khang gi gser thog rlung gis khyer ba sogs mi dge ba'i mtshan ma mang du byung ba nas/ bya yul phyogs kyi sbyin bdag drag zhan/ bla slob dpon/ grwa ris so sos kyang 'gror pa dang bstan pa'i brtan bzhugs mang po

'gror tshe/ bku' las/ so so'i tshogs rdzogs thabs dang rten 'brel tsam du ni 'dug /da ni lo tshogs kyang dga' rab sleb 'dug cing / lhag par dus snyigs ma'i snang tshul mang ba dang bcas tshe'i 'phen pa'ang de tsam yin pa 'dra gsung ba sogs bapokha mchid thung ngur stsal ba la/ mgar ba'i bu tsundas ston pa la gsol ba btab pa ltar/ lha ga'i phyag mdzod pa sogs ska'akhor ba drag pa 'gazha res/ bstan 'gror dgongs pa'i zhabs pad ji srid du brtan pa'i dgongs pa gtad dgos zhus par/ de ka byed do gsungs 'brag lo'i ring 'tsho ba'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs so/ /rgyal ba dam pa'i sku rim la dmigs phyag mdzod nas/ lho brag gi chos sde so sor mang 'gyed yang yang gnang ༄/ mkhar chu grwa tshang bar/ mdo sgrol/ tshe gzungs/ rkang brgyad til mar ma rnams kyi 'bum gto btsugs/ ska gzhogs rin chen 'phreng ba

ra༅༅/ /rnams kyis phyag mdzod nor bu spungs par tshe dpag med zhi ba lha mangs brgya rtsa tshar mang ba sogs bto / sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang po'ang rgyal ba dam pa nyid mjal 'dod kyis thugs dungs pas/ dpon slob nyung bsdus shig shad rtsol gyis mkhar chur phebs/ de 'phral rang la phyag ja zhig gzims bug nas gsol dpon brgyud nas gnang ba dang stabs gcig par/ me tog shin tu mtshar ba zhig gi ge sar la 'chi med grub pa'i slob dpon padma 'byang gnas kyi sku brnyan chung ngu zhig bkod nas gnang byung ba rang re la tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa gnang ba 'dra/ me tog de'ang zhag shas ma rnyid pa'i ngo mtshar ba zhig byang gsungs/de nas zhabs drang du mjal te thugs mnyes mnyes kyi phebs sgo ci yang stsal/ sngal pa'i skas 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa'i ska tshigs bdun par phebs pa'i sbyad 'phags

ren po che 'di snga sor dngul dkar lhad bral lta bu'i sku mdangs shin tu bzang ba zhig yong yod kyang / da lo nam mkha'i mdog rang du ston pa zhig 'dug cing / lhag par rje gong ma'i sku 'dra rin po che phyag bzo ma des kyang spyan chab byung 'dug pa dang byas/ blo shin tu ma bde bas/ da lam rkang gtad mjal bar yong pa lags pas/ lo 'brag sprul gnyis po ma rdzogs ring 'di kha rang du sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs pa gnang dbothos pa skusgogs rgyu mtshan 'bul ba mdzad tshe/ bskakha las/ nged rang gi 'chad thog tu song na de bzhin cis kyang byed rtsis yin/ 'on kyang gnas dus kyi 'gyur ba 'dis tshe ring khyad rang cher mi 'dug bsam pa dang / khyad par seng ge ri'i sgrub gnas phyogs yin bsam pa'i shar phyogs kyi ri mthon po'i rtsenas bud med rgyan can mang pos dar gyis g.yab mo byed pa'ang rgyan ldan du 'ong ba zhig 'dug sogs gsungs

ra༅༅/ /pa'ang phebs/zhag lnga bzhugs/nyin re bzhin bug mjal yun ring ba gnang / dam pa'i chos kyi ba/'a mchid mol zhib/nyams bzhes kyi nges gnad la dri ba'ang thugs kha rdzogs pa phul bas/sad tho 'dril zhing rdo rje'igasung re res kyang the tshom gyi drwa ba gcod pa'i bslab ston kyang lhug par stsal to/ /rteng la phebs sgor/ sprul pa'i sku sngon sbyangs song ba yin pas/ de ka tsam gyi re ba yod kyang yod/ re ba rpā ldan byung 'dug gsungs/phyir phebs gdong sku la bzhes 'phro'i na bza' 'gan sbyar sogs gnang cha rgyas pa brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'byung du gnang ste/bstan pa spyi bye brag gi 'dzin skyong spel ba la thugs bsam gang che sngar bzhin zhu/slar rim par mjal yong gsungs dpon slob gnyis ka thugs shin tu 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ de nas ska mtshams bcad rgya dam du gnang ba'i bar

zhigasprul pa'i sku ngag dbang kun dgazha lhun grub thub bstan dpal bzang po dpon slob rnams/ bal yul mthil gyi gnas gzigs sogs grub pa'i bde chen chos 'khor du phebs thog /rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs drung du zhabs pad rtag brtan gyi rten byung du/ stan dkar/ gser dngul/ pa ri sogs 'bul ba rgya chen po dang rjes 'brel nang so chos rgyal mtshan pas kyang brtan bzhugs 'gror/ rin po che rta ra mdo nas sku skye dpon slob sog yul nas 'khor/ sbug sil/ ja gos dar sogs 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ bku' las/ byon skabs shin tu zos pa byung bas cis kyang legs/ khyed sog yul nas byon nas khri 'bul stong 'bul byung ba las/ bla tshugs ma dor ba btsun pa gtsang ming byas byon pa 'di dga'/ rjes su yi rang / da rung yang bstan pa'i sar thugs bsam gang che mdzod/ rin po che chos ldan pad dkar de dbu che

ra༅༅/ /bgres kha cig la de las bstan pa la bsam pa med gsung bslab ston stsal/ de nas 'brabasmu / skyes bu dam pa 'di rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di lta bu la rtag par bzhugs na/ glags rnyed par mi 'dug /tijo snyam/gzugs mi snang ba'i rang sgra zhig gis/ rgyal dbang dam pa nyid lo gcig gi sku mtshams bcad rgya ni myur du 'gro yang 'chug cing / dad can rnams kyis kyang mjal mi thub pa zhig 'dug pas/sku mtshams kyi bcad rgya 'grol dgos thams cad du dril bsgrags pas/la la ni de ltar legs so zhes zer/la la ni som nyir dgrod/ kha gnyig ni na ning rna

sku dog chen po yod gsungs pa dang / bsha' bkod kyang bag dro rgyu med tsam gnang ba zhig rang 'dug pas/ gtsang pa rgya ras dang rgyal dbang rje'i dgung sgeg ma grol bar sku mtshams la bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs par rigs so zhes 'dun kyang / dbang byed kyi bdag po'i bsam pa rdzogs phyir dang / rin po che shes rab sku skyes mon chos rje brag nas/ sgo chu'i rten rab la zla ba gsum pa'i 'gor phebs dgos pa'i zhu yig yang yang byung ba dang bstun/ so so nas bskul bar rten nan chen pos sku mtshams 'grol bar zhus te/ ji skad du/ thugs rjes gzhan don rab goms pas/ /nyid kyi sku srog gtong ba la/ /'gum pa gsos ltar rab dges pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes bu dam pa rnams ni gzhan don du ska srog kyang gtong ba la dgyes pa bzhin/ rgyal ba 'di nyid kyang sems can gyi blo ngo dang bstan pa ma gtogs

go༅༅/ /thag chod kyi 'then khyer ye mi gnang ba'i gshis nas zhal 'ches kyang gnang / de'i tshe gter bdag rgyan kha ma mnyes pa'i mtshan mas gzims chung mdo'i thog la spang dang rba skyog yod pa rgyu rkyen med par drag shul chen pos g.yam chal mthil du lhung ba sogs mang du bstan kyang / blang dor gyi mig bar du gcod pa'i rab rib 'thug pos bsgribs pas phal cher gyis ma gzigs/ de skabs phebs sgor dge bsnyen smyon kha 'dis kho bo'i 'phrin las mang du bsgrubs pa yin pas gtang rag tu smyon kha'i sku brnyan zhig bzhengs dgose pa 'dug gsungs/ sprul sku tshe ring rgyal pos rags pa bzhengs/ tshon rtsi/ gzungs gzhug sags zhib tshags tshang ma rgyal ba nyid rang gis phyag bstar gnang / rab tu gnas te/ snyan dar/ mchod rdzas/ rten rdzas rgya chen po 'phrin bcol phyag bris ma dang bcas gzims spyil gtor

/ gnon pa'ang gnang / rgyal po phyag mdzod rin po che bya yul nas phebs pa'i gtsang la skor cig thegs dgos shar she klu sdings chung ngur rgyal ba nyid bzhugs khrir phebs tshe phyag 'bul stun dri zhus par/ bka' las/ da lam gyi gsungs pa sogs phebs sgo 'ga' gnang rjes/ gtsang gi don 'bras rnams bslab stoni stsal/ phyag mdzod kyi gzhis lhag bsam bzhag /khong gis zhus ngor smone lam 'di stsal/ bdag gis rnam dkar dge tshogs ma lus pa/ /ba brgyad bstan dang de 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /yangs pa'i sa phyogs kun tu dar gyur cig /bdag kyang skye bar dal

ra༅༅/ /'gror lus thob cing / /mtshan ldan bla mas rjes bzung dam chos mjal/ /chos brgyad la sogs skyon gyis ma gos par/ /sems kyi gnas zugs rang ngo shes gyur cig /mdor na phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i/ /lus can theg pa wo tsho sgor bcug ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god nus pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam par bdag gyur cig /ces gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i gsung thog mtha' bar du bzhugs pa ches mang yang 13 lam zhal gdams gnang ba'i rjes mar 'dug pas 'dir bkod pa yin/ de nas yongs 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma rnam gnyis kyi sku mchod dang / lo dus kyi sku rim la 'du khang du dge 'dun tshogs che bas/ nyer gsum nas gnam gang bar bde mgon bla mchod rnams tshugs pa'i rgyan gyi zhabs tog phyag mdzod nas btang / mkhar chu mchod yon gyis kyang tshogs kyi

mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ gnam gang gi nyin sku gzhogs su'ang kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshogs kyi gsor lo'i mchod pa phul zhing / sgar grwa'i tshogs chen po 'du khang du ma shong bar rdo chal mthil gang ba la'ang tshogs kyi dga' ston rgya cher spel to// //mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su lhun chags pa'i/ /lha yi ri bor rgyal dang de sras rdzi /sku brnyan rin chen las grub kun bzang gi/ /mchod sprin gyis 'byud bsod nams zhing du bskrun/ /kye ma sdigs ma lnga bdo'i nags tshal 'di/ /mi bsrun dug gi sdong pos gang ba'i khrod/ /skye 'gro'i legs byas lhag mas bskrun pa'i shing / /phan bde'i yal 'dab rab tu rgyas pa de/ /yid srubs yid kyi ra bar ma shong bas/ /sor mo'i grangs ma lhag kyang dge ba'i rgyun/ /gcod byed sta re lag thogs gzugs yo bgegs/ /bzang min smon pa grub pa'i mtshon cha rno/ /zhes dpal 'byug pa

go༅༅/ /rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i chos gar gyi 'phros gleng ba las/ bar du dge ba'i rab tu byed pa ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas sprul lo nag zla'i tshes gnyis la nang mtshams grol nas sku gzhogs pa rags rim la mjal kha/ gsum nas phyi mtshams groli te zhal mjal byin rlabs ci 'dod du stsal/ lnga nas 'du khang gi chos khrir phebs/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku drang por bsrangs chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcing ba sngon du 'gro bas/ yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyis zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa don gnyer gyi gdul bya'i tshogs la 'doms par mdzad pa ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid

dmigs zhib rgyas dang / rgyab chos su/ bsre ba 'bum darkan/ bla sgrub/ rten 'brel/ ro snyoms/ chos drug /thugs dam dge sbyor bdun pa / thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid sogs ljags lung / grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dpag med zhi ba lha mangs kyi dbang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas gnang / de nas lha lung grwa tshang / sras grwa tshang / bkra shis dge 'phel/ nyi lde dgon sogs rkan lugs kyi chos sde rnams nas dge 'dun grangs mang ba dad pa gsum gyis yid brlan te spyan sngar lhags pa la/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po cher 'jug pa'i sgo dang por gyur pa so so thar pa'i sdom pa las brtsams te/ chos tshul ji snyed pa'i char rgyun ci yang phab pas dge ba'i lo tog lhag par 'phel bar mdzad/ de'i tshe rin po che shes rab ska skye mon nas o pa'i phyag 'bul la byung thog /sa ga'i yar ngo la sgo chu'i rab gnas la phebs

ra༅༅/ /dgos par gsol ba bto/lha khang du phebs pa'i snga dro gnas chen gyi mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams 'khren pa'i 'tshub 'gyur gyis gangs shin tya che ba zhig kyang babs/lha khang gzhis khar zhag brgyad tsam bzhugs ring /rnam snang chen por zhal gser dang spyan dbye phyagabastar gnang /lha khang ba'i yum grongs pa'i gshegs rdzong 'bul zhabs rgya cher mdzad/sde pas gsol ba bto/khrom chen por dbang bka' gnang /lha khang du bzhugs skabs khyim bya de pho rnyas kyis srod la skad so len mang po'i bar bsgrags pa byung ba snyan du gsol bas ltas legs po min gsungs/byar stag rtse grwa tshang gi mkhan po lhas rtse zhabs drung thugs kyi tshor ba 'dras mi phyed pa'i dad shugs kyis bskal nas/rgyal ba'i zhabs drung du mjal bar byon/ tsa ri sogs su ltas mtshan legs po ma 'dug ces rgya mtshan phul bar/

sakha las/ de ka yong shas che/ mi 'gyangs par skad cha yong gsung ba phebs song zer/ de nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus gzigs te/ gyad yul rtsa mchog gnyis pa sgo chur phebs/ gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa grub 'dug par sa gzhi tshes bcu bzhi la rab gnas sta goni tshugs/ bco lnga'i nyin mi tshogs shin tu che bas te logs kyi ri ldebs thams cad khengs 'dug pa la sgo mangs nas gzigs nan chen po dang bcas thams cad kyi rgyad byin gyis brlabs/ khrom la tshe bka' zhig stsal/ bcu bdun tshun rab gnas rgyas pa 'khor 'ordzo sdom pa'i sgo nas gnang / gtsang khang mgon khang sogs skyo sku brnyan la snyan dar mchod rdzas kyang rgya cher bstabs/ de'i tshe snang tshul 'ga' zhig la rten 'brel legs po min pa 'dug ces gleng ba rgyal ba'i snyan du lhon tshe/ bka' las/ da ni rten 'brel la ltos ma byung

ra༅༅/ /gsung ba'ang phebs/ sras gro bo lung rnams su snga sor phebs pa ma shar ba'i 'di res kur 'brag thugs snang dag pa'i gnas gzigs la phebs dgos tshul gyi zhu ba nan can byung bar/ thog mar rten 'brel gyi sgo nas zhal 'ches tsam gnang / slar skyar chags kyi snyun 'dren byung bar/ bga' las/ da lam yong thub pa zhig mi 'dug cing / nged sleb kyang gzhis skyengs mgron skyengs kyis nyid dpon slob la'ang mdzad dasha' yong 'dra bas da res 'then/ ting ma yong ba'i smon lam byed gsungs/ rje mar pa'i sku brnyan rtsa ris ma la zhal gser zhu rgyu dang / snyan dar kha btags 'dom 'khor can la phyag bris kyi 'dod gsol smon lam yod pa / sgar grwa tshang la mang ja dang bcas rdzong bda' gnang / tshes bco labargyad la chos mdzad seng ge mjal bar byung ba de nyin ma gnang / sang snga char mjal kha

gnang / sku ngos kyis dri rmed sogs dgyes dgyes mdzad/ khong gi chibs sngon po zhig dang dmar po zhig dgongs par gang bde ba 'bul zhu ba la/ dpon tshang drang nas/ da lo dgung skeg la rta dmar po bzhes sa mi 'dug pas sngon po bzhes dgos pa e yin zhu ba la/ nga rang dgung sgeg gi tig tig mi yong / de snga yin na/ jod rang rta la shin tu rtsi ba zhig yin te/ da rang ni rta'i dgos pa yang chung 'dug pas/ khong rang gang 'jog 'dod pa zhig long gsungs/ de mtshams mgron gnyer dang drung yig pa sku gzhogs na yod pa la/ bka' las/ rgyal po rin po che 'di la thugs sun po rang zhig yong ba 'dug /gsung ba thengs gsum gyi bar du gnang byang zer/ de rjes phyag mdzod ska gzhogs su byon pa la phyogs la zur bstan gyi bka' tshig tha ma mang po gnang ba dang lhan cig spyan yang gzigs nan shin tu shlau ba

go༅༅/ /gnang / skabs 'dir ma zad lo snga res gtsang phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur ba nas bzung zhing gzhan du dgongs pa'i phebs sgo rgyud mar byung 'dug pa dang / bya yul phyogs phebs nas gdan sa gong 'og tu rten mchod sgrigs tshoms/ bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong chos mthun bgyid dgos pa sogs 'phen las kyi mjug skyong gnang tshul dang / khyad par lho brag tu sku mtshams rgyun ring ba gnang rgyu yin phebs pa'i b.lakha stsal sogs sku 'khor ba rnams rang bdud kyi khebs pas ma go ba ma gtogs gzhan don du gshegs pa'i dgongs ther 'dug cing / lho brag tu rgyun ring ba bzhugs rgyu yin phebs pa'ang phyis bsams tshe lha khang du yang srid bzung ba'i dgongs par nges so/ /de nas tshes bcu dgu'i nyin tshe bdag gi dus gtor gnang ba'i gsung chog tshogs dbur bzhugs te/ ska dngos kyi gdul bya'i mtha' ma der

'dus rnams phyogs phyogs su rdzong ba dang so sor zhal ta zhib rgyas re gnang / gsung chog grol nas sgo chu grwa tshang gi bla mar nang so mi pham chos dpal la 'os babs kyis bka' phebs gnang yang bya btang kho nar blo gzhol ba dang / rin po che shes rab sku skye grol cha nan cher zhu ba sogs kyi skabs su dam tshig gi mthu dang tsa ri gsar ma yang mdzod du bka' ji ltar bstsal ba bzhin zhing 'dir sprul pa sku'i mdzad pa'ang re zhig de tsam gyis rdzogs par dgongs/ khyu mchog ste lcags sprul sa ga can gyi tshes bcu dgazhi rgyu skar rnams ma shar tsam der mtha' ma'i gzims khri la/ sku drang por bsrangs/ spyan bar snang la lta stangs su gzigs te/ stun gyi dri tsam yang mi mnga' bar skad cig de la/ 'jig rten thams cad kyiphan bde'i rtsa lag gcig bur grub pa'i gzugs ska'i nyin byed mtshan dpe'i 'od zer 'phro ba de/ chos dbyengs kun gsal

ra༅༅/ /gyi dbyings su nub ste/ mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pas/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di mun pas lan brgyar byags pa bzhin gyur to// //de yang kun mkhyen chen pos/ kun nyon skye 'chi'i sgra gcan khas btang yang / /mos pa shar nub rtse mo de dang der/ /yang yang 'char smar 'phags mchog nyi ma yi/ /ngang tshul yin mod de mtha' su yis bgrang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skye 'chi'i 'ching ba las yongs su grol ba'i bdag nyid chen po 'di ni gdul bya las snang mtha' dag gi ngor/ ji skad du/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /chos kyi gsor lo bskor ba dang / /rigs dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin du ni lhar gshegs dang / /khyim nas 'byung bar byed pa dang / /rab tu byung ba 'dzin pa dang / skye ba sku1ngas su len pa dang / /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa stoni/ /zhes bshad pa

bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgyu'aphral gyi rol rtsed las/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi mdzad pa mtha' ma ni mya ngan las 'das tshul ston pa 'di yin la/ de yang / rtag 'dzin can gyi gdule bya rāga' zhig la mi rtag pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya ba'i phyir dang / le lo can rnams yang dag pa'i brtson 'grus la bskal ba dang / zhing 'di'i mdzad pa mthar phyin te zhing gzhan gyi gdul bya don che bar dgongs pa dang / yid srubs kyi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sogs pa gzigs pa du mas chos kyi dbyings su mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten 'di'i phan bde'i gzhir gyur pa'i legs byas thams cad ni na bun bzhin du yal/ skye 'gro rnams mi bzad pa'i duḥ kha nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i ltas dang mtshan ma sna tshogs ni mngon du gyur/ bya gcan ri dwags kyi tshogs rnams kyang bag ma phebs par phyogs phyogs

ra༅༅/ /su 'thor nas ku co'i sgra sna tshogs pa 'byin na blo dang ldan pa rnams lta ci smos/ gzhan yang sa gzhi 'dar ba dang g.yo ba dang / sgra sgrog pa dang / phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'ja' tshon sna lngas bdab pa'i bar bar nas me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs dpag par dalakha ba'i ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phral sna tshogs pa yang bstan cing / zla ba 'di'i tshes bcu dgazhi srod la khro phu dga' ldan du yang / gnam sa grum pa'am ri chen po nyil ba lta bu'i 'ur sgra 'jigs su rung dro shar nas brtsams te nub phyogs su song ba'ang byung / de ltar gzhan snang du ltas dang cho 'phral sna tshogs dad lhan cig gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan la/ rang don mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po 'od gsal rnam pa kun ldan dang dbyer mi phyirdo pa'i zung 'jug kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa ste/ de yang slob

dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med/ /yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas 'di dag ni/ /bdag 'dod tshad ma yongs sgom blo chen rnams kyang 'dod/ /ces bshad pa ltar ro/ /de la rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag bzhi/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag gsum las/ dang po ni/ /bhogs/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag ste/ ye shes dang / 'khor dang / chos dang / spya tshe bzhi la longs spyod pa'o/ /sambha/ji ni/ kun tu kha sbyor gyi yan lag ste/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /mahāmukhāṅgi ni/ bde chen gya yan lag ste/ zag med kyi bde ba'ob/ /nidzis:lha ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag ste/ gzung 'dzin gyis ma bslad pas so/ /bzhi po

ra༅༅/ /des rang don phun sum tshogs pa bstan ro/ /gnyis pa ni/sam tshildogaṭwāṃ sna/snying rjes nges par gang ba'i yan lag ste/gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa med bzhin du gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung bas dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po dang ldan /'o/ /nijirantarā: (anānās)/ni/ rgyun chad med pa'i yan smug ste/gzugs sku snyas po rgyun mi chad par spro bas thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'o/ /nikṣiswārghaṃ (aniXs)/ni/ 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag ste/zhi ba phyogs gcig pa ma yin par/srid pa ji srid du gzhan snang dbang po'i gzhu ltar ston par mdzad pa'/ /gsum pa das gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa bstan te/de ltar yan lag bdun ldan gyi kha spyor mngon du mdzad de 'od gsal las zung 'jug gi skar bzhengs nas/dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bsus te mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing

du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to// //de nas re zhig gsang ba'i ba/'a gros shar/ sprul pa'i sku rnam gsum sogs 'gangs che sar gsang tshig gi sgo nas snyan lagyal zhus/ de yang / dgongs rdzogs chen mo sgrub pa la lho brag 'di sa khul dog pa dang bcas gang sa nas ska gdung yid bzhin nor bu bya yul du spyan 'dren 'os par dgongs/ lha btsun phyag mdzod pas thugs khur bzhes/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ ga bur/ gur kum sogs dri bzang pos sbags pa'i lha rdzas sku la gsol te gsang khog nas gdan drangs pas/ gar phebs su 'ja' gur dang dri bzang gis khyab pa sogs byung bas/ skye bo thams cad kyang yid kyis tshor ba myong ba'i mya ngan gyis sgra dang lhan cig /phyag 'tshal ba dang skor ba byed/ se khun du sngal pa'i ska rnam gnyis dbus nas phebs pa dang rtse mthun/ sa gzhi gnam gang la byams chen chos gling du

ra༅༅/ /phebs/lkol med khang par bkod pa phul du phyin pa'i rin po che'i khri la/gdung yid bzhin nor bu longs sku'i cha byad du bzhugs su gsol/mchod sprin gyi 'phreng ba thub pa gangs ༅ mtsho'i mdun sa bzhin bshams/sprul pa'i skru rnam gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma dbu che sku gzhogs pa rnams kyis sku gdung ren po che'i spyan sngar/bla ma rdo rje 'chang rigs drug pa'i dkyil 'khor dang /'khor la sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i dmir 'khor dang 'brel ba'i gdung chog/skyu gzhogs yongs 'du grwa tshang pa/sngags grwa ba/rdo rje gdan pa/stag rtse grwa tshang pa rnams kyis theg 'a chos gling du gong gi mtho dkyil rnam tshwas kyi sgo nas sgrub cang mchod pa / rgya mtsho grwa tshang pas gzims chung shod du/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo thugs gsung sko'i dkyil gsor yongs rdzogs kyi sgo nas mchod 'bul/pad darkan grwa tshang ba

sogs dge 'dun stobs che ba'i tshogs dbur grub dbang sprul pa'i sku phebs nas/ 'du khang chen mor bla spyo bcu nas 'dus pa'i sgrub pa pho mo grangs mang bas/ gzims spyil mdun gyi chos ra chen mo1/ lam zaḥ'athul yang dag bsgrubs/ mdor na klog spong gi sde so so nas dge 'dun stongaphrag gnyis tsam 'dus/ zudang / gzhan dge 'dun stong lhag tsam gyis bdun gsum gyi ring mchod chog btsugs pa'i rgyun gyi phogs dang bcas pa phyag mdzod nas star chags su zhus/ chog yoni kyang so sor bsgrabs/ rgyal ba rkadze pa/ spre

ra༅༅/ /po pa/ bya pa zhabs drung / lho rgyud kyi lha sde mi sde/ gzhan yang / kong po/ lho mon/ dbus gtsang sogs yul gru thams cad nas/gdung 'bul/ snyan dar gdung bsor sogs rgya chen po byung deb chen mor gsal ba ltar dang / gzhan ma 'di skabs byang nas o lod gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i dpung gis gtsang du sdigs/ bod ru bzhi'i phyogs su dus 'brug bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bas phal cher gyis lam ma bgrod kyang / rang gnas su mchod 'bul dang gsol 'debs kyi rim pa la brtson par mdzad do/ /dgung zhag gsol 'debs ma grol ring dang sku mchod kyi dus thams cad du nam mkha' beeḍarla ltar dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i gur khyim dang / mchod pa'i bye brag dbang po'i gzhus bris pa lta bu 'khor mor snang zhing me tog gi char yang dus dus su babs se'u/ /de nas ska gdung

yid bzhin nor bu 'bar byed kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su mchod pa'i phyag len 'chug med/ rgyud sde las byung ba bzhin yongs 'dzin mchog gi sprul ༷spyos mdzad pa'i de nyin yang / phyogs kyi gsor lo 'ja' 'od sna lngas bkab cing / ji ltar pra phab pa'i mig ngor gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba ltar/ so so'i mos bla dang mthun pa'i mthong snang ngo mtshar chen por bgrang bar 'os pa yang mang du byung ba re re nas bri bar ma nus so/ /gzhan yang de yan sos char shin tu dkon pa la/ de nub nas sku khras kyi tshul du char rgyun dal bur babs pas skye bo phal cher yid tshim/ de nas gdung khang la sprul pa'i sku rnam gsum dang phyag mdzod kyi phyag rgyas btab ste bdun phragagasag gi bar du legs par mchod nas zhal phye tshe/ ska gdung gi gdul byar dgongs/ gtso bor thugs ljags spyan gsum/ dbu thod ril po/ zhal lko ma nyams pa/ gzhan yang

ra༅༅/ lha sku yig 'bru ring bsrel sogs mos pa'i rten gnas skabs de dang phyis gdung skal la phebs pa sogs mang du byung ba snang /gtsug phud le rpā gcig gis me ma bzhes par byon/gdung rus phal cher shā ri ram du gyur to//de nas spur thal dang gdung phag rin po che dang dar zab sogs las grub pa'i rje'i sku brnyan sku tshad dang mnyamapa/sprulag sa tsha ring rgyal pos phyag phyi zhus/yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i skus phyag bstar du bzhengs par mdzad pa'i thugs shar thugs ljags spyan gsum/dbu gtsug tu de bzhin gas pa'i 'phel gdung / gzhan yang tilli nā ro'i dbu lo nas bzung rje 'di yan gyi dkar brgyud bla ma'i sku bal dang gdung ring bsrel/chos ska'i ring bsrel sogs til gyi gang bu lta bur bzhugs pa la/rab tu gnas pa ni bla ma rnam gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bas mdzad pas

byin rlabs kyi zil mtshungs pa med pa'i sku 'dra rin po che mthong ba don ldan du gyur/ de skabs dgung bdun gsum pa'i srod 'khor gyi dus/ sa g.yo ba dang / nam mkha' la sgra 'byin pa dang / lhan cig gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu las chab ser cung zad babs pas gdung gdan gyi bye ma ring bsrel du gyur pa'ang byung ngo / /sprul pa'i sku rnam gsum sogs skyes chen dam pa rnams la lhums su zhugs pa'i mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung snang bas/ thams cad sems kyi ngal gse chob par gyur to/ /de nas dgongs rdzogs chen mo'i gral dbur/ dkar brgyud kun gyi cod pan sgam po pa spyan snga ratna badzra gdan drangs/ spyan snga rin po che nas/ gzims mal sku 'dra grub pa'i rten 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ grub dbang sngal pa'i ska yang bar der gnyal du rib tsam phebs pa las phyir phebs/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i nyin/ sgar grwa

mi sde rnams dang bcas pa'i skya ser gyi tshogs shin tu stobs che ba tshogs pa'i dbur/bor sgam po zhabs drung /sprus pa'i sku rnam gsum/bla ma dbu che rnams bzhugs pa / rin po cher dgu tshan bcu gnyas so sor bkra shis kha btags 'dom 'khor dang zung skyu ber/byi ru spos shel/ ja gos dar/chibs chen gser chas dang bcas smu pa' ska rnam pa gsum la/bkras btanas/sngag sil/ja gose dar/chibs

mgo sbrel/ chibs chas dang bcas pa sogs dgu tshan bzhi re/ bya pa zhabs drung 'gyur med lhun grub/ lhun rtsezhabs drung / skumadun zhabs drung / 'brong rtse nas sde pa chos rje/ lhun sdings nas sde pa chos rje/ pad dkar grwa tshang dang yongs 'du grwa tshang gi mkhan po rnams la dgu tshan re/ gzhan yang / dbus gtsang / lho brag /rdzo rgyud/ dwags kong sogs bshad sgrub kyi sde so so'i bla ma grangs mang bar/ dgu tshan nas gsum tshan gyi bar gang 'os dang / grwa tshang 'gangs che ba thams cad la rgya hor gyi sbug sil lam bla bre spus gtsang ba lta bu spyi rdzas su 'gro nges res gtsos spyi 'gyed mang ja dang bcas pa/ sgar rang gi dbu che drung 'khor las tshan so sor rnam gzhag babs 'brel/ dge 'dun rnams la sgyi 'gyed dpangs mtho ba dang / phyag 'gyed ja dngul phor re/ sman rtse kha re/ spen tog re rnams bkye/ lho rgyud ral

ra༅༅/ /gsum gyi mi sde stobs che ba la dud rer khal gsum ma'i rtsis kyi 'gyed chas/ gzhanatshab pa/ 'bri stag /sa skya bdag chen/ 'bras spungs rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa/ bkra shis lhun por paṇa chemachod 'bul bsngo rten/ ngam ring / dpal 'khor chos sde/ se 'bras sogs chos sde che ba'i gras thams cadadagongs rdzogs deb chen du gsal ba ltar yin pas re re nas brjod ci nus te mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar za pa'i bya ba rnams grub rjes/ sgam po zhabs drung dpon slob phyir phebs pa'i chibs skyel sogs bkur ste'ang ba:

bzhengs chen mo sgrub par mngon du phyogs/ sa yul gang du mdzad la bgros sgo rnam grangs maḥgato gzhig yin pa'i khar/ rgyal dbang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyi mdzad 'phrin rnam pashākhang g.yas phyogs 'dir bstan 'gro spyi'i phan bde'i rtsa lag la dmigs pa'i 'phags pa thugasatshul du stsal ba'i dgongs pa khyad par ༅ sgrub phyir/ chos rje 'brug pa'i 'phrin las par smon 'basam bstan 'dzin bzang pos grogo thag bcad lhag pa'i thugs bsam rgya chen pos/ lcags spre

ra༅༅/ /sprul sku dpag bsam nor bus byas/ bal po klu shing dang / rne gan dzā ti sogs mkhas pa bcu gcig gis/'phags pa thugs rje chen po zhal tsog phyag bzhi pa'i sku brnyan tsam la/byang phyogs bod yul gyi ljongs 'dir che ba/lta bas ngoms pa med pa'i ma' dpe'i gzi 'od can zla ba bskru kyi khongs su spegs par grub pa'i sku rgyun/rtses sung gi zangs khal lnga brgya/tsha gser la gser zho dgu brgya lhag tsam/zhal gser/sems dpa' gnyis/thugs rten rnams la grang gser bas ma zho brgya dang bcu bdun/sku'i yo bkod rin po che'i srog zhu dbus ma'i rtse 'dzoms su khyad g.yu rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas rang smo gyi tshul du bzhugs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i nor bu'i phra rgyan dpag par dpokha ba du ma dang /nang bzhugs la / dbu gtsug tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung sogs/thugs

gar rgyal ba nyid kyi dbu thod ril por phebs pa bzhugs khang dang bcas/ gzhan yang / rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku brnyan li ma'i rigs mang po/ bka' phyag brgyud pa sogs bla ma gong ma'i phyag nas bzhugs pa'i sku 'dra sna tshogs grangs mang ba/ rje rang gi phyag sor gyis bskrun pa'i rten bris 'bur byin rlabs can 'ga'/ sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs bka' bstan gyi glegs bam grangs mang ba/ dzhai khrim las grub pa'i mchod rten rgya gar shar phyogs ma sogs gdung rten byin rlabs can kha shas/ lhag par rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas gsungs pa'i gsung chos sku'i ring bsrel gtos che ba/ rgya bod kyi paṇa grub skyes chen rnams kyi dbu lo phyag sen na bza' sogs ska bal gyi ring bsrel/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs yungs 'byu lta bu'i ring bsrel/ rje'i dbu thod ril por phebs pa sogs ska gdung gi ring

ra༅༅/ /bsrel te/ ring bsrel rnam bzhis gaspyos pa'i bar bar du/ lha rdzas kyi dar zab/ rin po che/ sman sna/ 'bru sna sogs gnod sbyin 'bor mo'i bar ma tshang ba med pa/ kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i phyag bzhes las ji ltar byung ba bzhin gzungs 'bul phyagabastar du gnang ba po/ sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang po'i zhabs phyir/ chos rje rdo rje gling nas/ rin po che thub bstan ye shes/ mkhyen myong can nang so chos rgyal mtshan rnams skyas legs par mdzad/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal ba nyid kyigadung thal las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs dang phyag na rdo rje'i sku rgya nag ma lugs dang / gdung phag las grub pa'i mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs che ba/ bum nang du rgyal ba mchog gi ska brnyan dang bcas pa byin rlabs can/ gsum ka bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa la gser zhun 'thug por gsol ba/ rten chen gyi

sku rgyab la khri drug 'grogs badzra khyad kyis thon pa dang / shing rtsi ldebs bris kyang legs dper 'os pa bsgrubs/ gzhan yang 'jang rgyal pos phul ba'i bka' 'gyur mtshal par ma sogs bzhugs su gsol te/ rten gsum de dag gi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin phung mngon par mtho ba thub pa gangs can mtsho'i 'dun sa bzhin legs par bstar ba la/ rab tu gnas pa'i byin rlabs kyi char rgyun 'bebs pa po/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnam gnyis/ bla ma dbu che sgar grwa tshang dang bcas pa'i gsung chog pa lnga brgya tsam gyis bde mchog 'khor lo'i las rim rgyas pa'i sgo nas lhag par gnas pa zhag mang po sbrel nas gnang bas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar gyur to/ /rten 'bul snyan dar sogs kyang phyogs phyogs nas stobs che ba byung / bzo bo rnams la yon rdzong / 'phral gyi zhabs tog /ston mo stoni rgyab dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang

ra༅༅/ /sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis la yon 'bul/ bla ma dbu che las tshan rnams la rnam gzhag /dge 'dun dmangs la chog yon dang bcas pa rgyas pa chen po bsgrabs so// //'jigs rung mi bzad srid pa dug gi mtsho/ /sdug bsngal rlabs 'phreng gnyer ba'i chu gter las/ /lus can thams cad sgrol ba'i ded dpon 'di'i/ /snying stobs rgyal sras gzhan gyis spyod yul min/ /kun nyon rlung shugs khyim gyi 'khor lo yis/ /mtho dman kun tu drangs pa ma yin kyang / /sna tshogs mos pa'i sa gzhi de dang der/ /'char nub byed pa thugs rje nyi zla'i 'gros/ /de lta mod kyi byang phyogs mun pa'i gling / /'phrin las snang ba'i dpal la spyod pa'i tshe/ /las ngan dmod pas bsgrabs pa'i sprin 'thug po/ /dus min mkha' la chags pas ring du bsgribs/ /zag med nyer zhi'i dbyengs la gzhol ba'i tshe/ /me tog

char dang 'ja' 'od sgra dbyangs sogs/ /ngo mtshar mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' yas pa/ /bstan la rab dga' dashar phyogs lha yis sprul/ /zab dgongs chos dbyengs kun gsal dag pa'i klong / /yongs su 'gengs pa'i legs byas ji snyed pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par smon lam mthu/ /yongs su grub pa'i skyes chen mchog des bskran/ /zhes dpal 'brug pa rin po che rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i rnam par thar pa skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gyi 'phros gleng ba las/ mtha' mar dge ba'i rab tu byed pa ste nyer gcig pa'o// //thun mong mdzad pa'i spyod tshul bu ram shing gang gi/ /rang bzhin dngar ba'i yon to cha shas re re yi/ /zegs ma phra mo la yang mchog gi ro bro ba'i/ /rtogs brjod rkang 'thung 'di ko mos ldan gsos su bskan/ /de na'ang

ra༅༅/ min gsal bu mor phyogs gos dbyar gyi ma mas byin pa'i chu 'dzin thig le rol pa ni/ /gtsug phud can gyi 'dren byed lta ba'i skal ba tsam las rang bzhin pha mtha' mthong ba ga la zhig /de bzhin grangs med yon to phung pos mtho ba'i rgyal ba mchog gi rnam thar 'di yang rang nyid kyis/ /mi phyed dad pa'i blo yi 'drug paspel phyir spros kyi ngang tshul mtha' dag brjod nus min no lge /'on kyang ngag gribarjod pa thams cad las/ /dam pa'i yon to gleng ba dge legs rdzi /'bras gya che bar gsungs bzhin rje bla mas/ /skye ba kun tu rjes 'dzin rgyur gyur cig /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang / /skye dgu'i phun tshogs yar ngo'icazla tshes ltar/ /gong du 'phel bas lus can thams cad kyi/ /sngag bsngal tshad gdung ma lus zhi bar shog /'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /kun mkhyen

'brug pa'i bstan la rab zhugs te/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin nas/ /dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro ce 'grub par shog /dam pa'i rnam thar gting mtha' mi mngon dge legs rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mtha' gnyis rnyog pas nam yang ma brdzis rang bzhin brjod pa'i gzugs brnyan gsal/ /gzur gnas klu dbang dgis pa'i mtsho chen ya mtshan dbu ba'i do shal dkar/ /skal ldan snying gi gdung ba sel byed srid 'dir gnyis pa yod ma yin/ /'on kyang bdag blo gti mug shas che bas/ /ma rtogs log rtogasom nyi'i nyes pa kun/ /chos kyi spyan ldan la bshags dge ba'i dngos/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'phel gyur cig /rab yangs mdzad pa'i pha mtha' mi mngon brtan g.yo kun gyi bla na brjid/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul nam yang 'gyur med ngo mtshar gza' skar snang brnyan bkra/ /brjod don rab

ra༅༅/ /gsal nyi zla'i rol pas dad ldan snying gi mun pa sel/ /legs pa'i go 'byed rnam thar mchog 'di nam mkha' ji srid gnas gyur cig /'dir 'bad dge ba chu shel ltar dkar bas/ /thub bstan bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'phyur byed cing / /mar gyur 'gro ba'i tshad gdung kun bcil nas/ /phun tshogs ku mud rtag tu bzhad gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs/ /bkra shis gang zhig gdan gsum lha yis dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs/ /bkra shis gang zhig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs rnams zhi /bkra shis gang zhig phan bde'i dpal gyis 'jig rten ma lus skyong gyur cig/ //de ltar grangs med rigs kyi khyab bdag /rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag

rnyed/ rje btsun kun mkhyen 'brug pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde zhes/ dzam gling mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan dpal nā ro paṇḍi ta'i 'khrungs rabs bcu gnyis pa'i mdzad pa/ gang zag tshur mthong rmongs brtul dang bstun cha tsam brjod pa 'di ni/ dang por rgyal gamachog gi bkas rjes su gnang ba thob ceng / bar du rnam dgrod kyi blo gros gsal ba chos rje thub bstan rdo rje dang / mtha' mar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid mi pham ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum pa kun mkhyen chen po bu stoni rin chen grub kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa lhag par 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen byang gling chos rje rin chen bsod nams chos grub la sogs pa'i skyes chen du mas bskal ba'i bsha' spyi bor nod de/ gong du smos pa ltar/ zab cing rgya che ba'i

ra༅༅/ /gaspyo phul du byung gso skye'i spyod yul las 'das pa du ma zhinamathong thos yid ches kyi lam du mtho sum snang yang /rgyal ba 'di ni yon to thams cad gzhan ngor ston pa'i chos brgyad kyi ra ba las brgal/gyi na'i ngang tshul sgo nas bdag pas gzhan brtes kyi blang dor la gcig tu gzhol bas/zab mo'i rnam thar yongs su rdzogs pa ni bkas bcad de bri bar ma gnang la/phal cher zhig dang /rdo rje'i gsung mtha' las 'das pa rnams kyang /spyir snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dam pa'i chos las zang zing gi nor gces par 'dzin pa'i skabs su song ba dang / khya na par zhabs 'bring du gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis kyang do gal cher ma mdzad pas/rnam thar sa bon du yang de 'dra'i 'phros gzhi mi snang zhing 'ga' re yang phyogs su 'thor ba gang rnyed las/ brjod rpā phyi mo bzhin phyogs lhang gi sgro skar spangs

te/ rgyal dbang mchog gi bskakha 'bangs thams cad kyi tha shal dus zhabs pa dpal rgyas dbang pos khro phu dganya ldan byams pa'i gling du sbyar ba las/ thog ma'i skabs su sgrig dus kyi dbang las rnam thar stod smad so sor bzhugs mod kyang / slad kyis sems dpa' chen po'i skyes mchog gang gis/ chos sbyin grangs med spel phyir par du 'god skabs/ 'khyer bde ba zhig skabs su babs pas phyogs gcig tu bsdeb par gyis shig ces bsha' bstsal ba spyi bor blangs te/ phyis su zin bris khungs btsun rnyed pa rnams bsnan/ zlos pa dang ma 'brel ba kha cig dbri ste chabs cig par/ gser 'phyang gi lo la chos grwa de nyid du yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i 'bras bus/phyogs dus thams cad du bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal chen pos khyab par gyur cig/ //
