si༅༅/ /rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod phul byung dad pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 7/ //phul byung mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i klong yangs las//ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i snang ba 'byams klas pas/ /srid zhi'i mun pa mthar byed 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dpagabasam dbang por 'dud/ /wegs byas yangs pa'i bgoskal gyis thob pas//phan bde'i bsam rdzogs byed la zla bral ba/ /gang gi rtogs brjod rgya mtsho chen po las//mos pa kusha'i rtser bzung dang bas spro/2/khyab brdal gdod ma'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin//'gro la brtse ba'i spyan ras rjes chags pas/ /gzigs pa mi g.yel sgyu 'phrul zlos pa'i gan//mngon par bskyar mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs/3/sum rtsen dbus 'gyur legs bris tshal nang du/ /za hor rigs mchog thig le la gzigs te//

bsam bzhin srid pa bzung ba sprul pa'i gan/ /dpag bsam ljoni pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ 4 /de tshe lha bcas skye rgu'i bsod nams yoni/ /gnyis pa med mno kun bzod khyon 'di yang / /rnam par g.yo zhing 'bigs byed dga' ma'i dbyangs/ /snyan pa'i me tog 'thor der gsol ba 'debs/ 5 /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i cha shas yongs gang ba/ /ring nas goms pas byed pos bsgrubs pa bzhin/ /skye rgu'i mig la kun dgazhi skyes gsar pas/ /mi g.yo'i brtul zhugs sbyin la gsol ba 'debs/ snyo /don kun grub pa'i gtsug lag khang nang du/ /ngur sgrig rgyal mtshan legs bzung dregs ldan thod/ /zhabs rdul nor bu'i cod pan gyis bcings pas/ /legs byas zhing du 'phags la gsol ba 'debs/ 7 /sngoni goms dam pa'i ngang tshul gyis phyug kyang / /mos ngor chos tshul rgya mtsho slar yang

ra༅༅/ /ni//rnam dgrod khyor bas drangs tsha chos smra ba//gdengs ༅ dbang pos ba'i la gsol ba 'debs/ /log smra tshar sarna sgra rdzo rig pa'i gzhung / /bzo dang tshe rig don gnyer gzhan rjes 'dzin/ /gang gi spobs pas sngon rabs mkhas rnams la/ /ngal gso'i dka' thub sbyin la gsol ba 'debs/9 /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i klung / /ma lus thugs mtshor yongs smin rang gzhan gyi/ /grub pa'i 'jug ngogs 'di mdun gcig gyur pas/kun mkhyen bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ 0/brtan mkhas sbyangs brtson dgra bcom dul ba'i sde//bcas ldan mdun ngor bslab gzhi'i khrims nod tsha/sgolnga'i bstan la stoni pa gnyis pa che//rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bslab gsum rin chen bdun ldan bcas rang bzhin//kha na ma tho

reng spangs tshangs par spyod/ /bsung zhim mā la yar skyes dri'i bzhon pas/ /rab dang dpal la sbyor der gsol ba 'debs/ 12 /khyab bdag rigs kyi sgya 'phral ngag gi dbang / /grub pa'i dpa' bo bzang po'i 'phrin las can/ /mchog tu bsnyen nas legs gsung gdams pa'i rgyun/ /ma lus thugs mtshor 'khyil la rgoso/ ba 'debs/ 9 /tshogs gsum rgya mtsho'i snying po rin chen dbang / /dge legs dpal yon bzang pos 'khyud pa can/ /khyab bdag gnyis par bsnyen te zab rgyas tshul/ /gsan pa'i snyim pas bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ skrag /gzhan yang mkhas grubasdom brtson rig pa 'dzin/ tagazha las gdams pa'i rgyun bzang bzhes pa dang / /ska bzhi'i go 'phang mchog la dbang bskar ba/ /phan tshun 'gran par mdzad der gsol ba 'debs/ ska /gang khyod don gnyis lhan grub rgyal thabs mchog /

ra༅༅/ /bdag gir mdzad kyang bas mtha'i gnas mal cher/ /'khor gsol ba 'debs/ snyo /bco sbyangs gser ri ji lta rgyal ba'i sku/ /mtho ris rngom pa'abs/ /'byud pari mor mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 7 /phan bde'i sgo 'phar thub ba 'gron du gnyer ba'i 'jug ngogs can/ /rten dang brten pa spel la gsol ba 'debs/ po rtag phab pas/ /byang chub myu gu zung 'jug 'bras bus dud/ /mkha' khyab nye 'tshor bsna

khams/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i grong du bkri ba la/ /bshes gnyen khyod nyid khon la rag ces/ /lha bcas skye rgus btud der gsol ba 'debs/ 20 /mthong na mi mthun med pa rdo rje'i sku/ /zhi dul des par smra bas gzhan rjes 'dzin/ /lhag par rtsub la'ang byams pas dga' bskyed pa'i/ /'gran bral dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ lto /srid zhi'i 'byor pa rgya mchos mdun bdar kyang / /snyems pa ring btang 'phags nor rol mchos 'khyud/ /thub bstan nor 'dzin dbus na lham me ba / khun mkhyen ri dbang lhun por gsol ba 'debs/ lto /srid pa'i nyes brgyas brid kyang ji mi snyam/ /rtag 'dzin 'ching bas bcings rnams bskal bzhed pas/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings tha ma'i khrir/ /ngo mtshar rgya mtshos bsus der gsol ba 'debs/ sa /gang gi mtshan tsam thos sam dran byes kyang / /'khor

si༅༅/ /ba'i duḥkha bcil te thar mchog gi/ /go 'phang myur ba nyid du stsol des na/ /rnam kun khyod nyid kho nar gsol ba 'debs/24/bdag rus longs spyod dngos 'byor yid sprul te/khun bzang mchod sprin dam pa 'bul bar bsgo /nyid kyi thugs rje'i kyo tang gis bzung nas//gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i mchogagyur cig25/mdor na bdag gi dus gsum legs byas kun//mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan pa mchog grub nas//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog/thob pas phan bde'i lam bzang gsal gyur cig26 khegs byas khyung sngon skyes kyis bskul ba'i byin/ /'bar bas srid mtha'i sdug bsngal 'dzin khri ༅//bcomaste phan bde'i dga' tshal chos bzhin du/khun gsal khyon 'di gang bas dger gyur cig/ 27 //ces rgyal dbang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams

༅ mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po'i rnam par thar pa la cha tsam bstod pa phul byung dad pa'i 'jug ngogs 'di yang / zhwa lu kun mkhyen chen po'i chos kyi srid 'dzin pa chos kyi rje rin chen bsod nams chos grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dam pa gang gi bku' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i phyogs bral gyi dge sbyong chos smra ba ngag gi dbang pos gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig tu byas pa maṅga lam̐// //swa sti/ bskal bzang gi zhing 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsagacig gis 'gro ba sgrol bar dam bcas pa'i nangs kyi mtha' ma/ rgyal ba sgrozhe ma mos pa byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa'i ngang tshul las/ kha ba can pa dag gi snang tshul tsam du dpal 'brag pa zhes snyan par grags pa'i 'khrungs rabs ༄ gnyog pa/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rtogs brjod kun dgazhi zlos gar 'di nyid/ grangs med kyi chos sbyin 'gyed phyir/ rjol ba'i sras po byang chub sems dpa' mi

ra༅༅/ /pham ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyis 'phrin las ston zla ltar dashar ba'i 'dzum rlabs spros pa las/rgyal bstan ku mud kyi mong tsho rnam par bzhad pa'i zil dngar gyis ris meda'agro ba'i : ma ra rnams skal ba bzang po'i dpar la sbyor ba'i mdzad pa yid bzhin gyi mtsho wo las zegs ma slo gyi tshul du par du 'god pa'i mthun rkyen ma lus pa dang /phra rags kyi bslab ston thams cad bstsal/par shing gcod 'dren/rig byed pa 'gags pa'i mtshams sbyor bya ma rta/zhabs tog sgrub pa'i do dam/zhus dag sogs mdor na phyogs 'dir 'bad dgos kyi bya ba thams cad rgyal ba yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' 'bangs thams cad kyi ba spu tsam la reg par ma nus shing / sgo gsum mi dge'i ra bas yongs su bskor ba/shākya'i bande phug mo ba thub bstan byams pa dbang po bdag

gis/ rje btsun dam pa'i bka' tshig bdud rtsir ltes mi spyod spre'us byed pa ltar brtson pa bskyed/ par yig mkhas pa dpon dar rgyas dang / rgya mon yab sras kyis bris/ lan grangs du mar tshig zhus bgyis na'ang / rang nyid shes bya dang 'dris chung bas sgra doni ji bzhin gyi brda' la daphyod par ma nus pas 'khral pa 'ga' mchis/sdeb sbyor tshig phrad 'gar 'dems kha ༅ dang / bkas bcad gsar rnying 'dres mar snang bas phyi mo bzhin bzhag pa 'gyur med 'god pa'i bi shwa dro bcu phrag gcig /par shing gzhog gang byed pa lha dbang bstan 'dzin/ bzhugs sgam sogs nyi tshe'i bzo rig pa gnyis/ nang so ngag dbang sogs grwa tshang pa rang gi dge 'dun drug gis sgyu lus bran du bkol/ pad dkar gnyer tshang ba dang / lcam shukya'i drung nas nyer mkho'i phan bzhes bstabs/ sgrab sde padma dkar po nas zla phogs/ thub bstan rgya

ra༅༅/ /mtshos khro chen yon du sbyar ba sogs/dmag sde khul gyi skya ser rags pasabasnyen bkun dang /byams chen gzhis bzhugs khag che che nas thabs 'degs/lding gsum/khabs dang bcas pas thab shing phul zhing / 7/ 'di mtshams nas ma dper shog ldeb gcig gam/gnyis tsam zhig chad 'dug kyang /gong du gsal ba'i spar gyi sri zhu ji ltar mdzad pa'i lo rgyus la dpyad na gsung spar 'di nyid bya yul pad dkar byams pa chos gling gtsug lag khang du bzhugs par snang /da lam rnam thar ma phyi 'di rang gi spar ma shin tu dpe rnying zhig bal yul yam bu dpal ldan 'grug pa'i chos sde go'u tapa sau wi har gyi mkhan po bshad sgrab bstan 'dzin mchog gis dpal ldan lho 'byug kha bzhi'i rgyal khab nas g.yar bzhes kyis 'di gar spar bskyon ched du gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgya dang /nga

tsho'i mam pu ṭar gyi spar yig nang du ra ya btags mi 'dug pas/ ā tsam/ adma/ beeḍarla/ rnams la ming gzhi'i ya nyid ra yig gi 'dogs su sbyor dgos byung / ja yig wa zur can mi 'dug pas/ bsko 'ja' zhes pa'i ja la wa zur chad pa mkhyen ldarno klog pa po rnams nas thugs snang yong ba zhu/ shog ldega'aga' shas kyi spar yig mi gsal ba rnams 'brel yod yig cha gzhan la go bsdur gyis gang shes dpyad zhib zhus/ deng dus kyi 'bri srol dang mi mthun pa'i ming tshig dag cha 'ga' zhigabarda' rnying dang gdam nga can du yin nges pas rang sor bzhag /zhus dag lan mang bgyis te/ 'phags yul rdo rje gling 'brug sgar dpe mdzod khang nas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags sngal/ phyi lo 241 lor spar bstun zhus pa'o// 7 //gong gsal gyi spar gzhi'i thog /mtshungs med a pho chos dpal lags kyi

ra༅༅/ /phyag nas byung ba'i ma dpe bris rnying zhig dang / gzhan yang yongs 'dzin kun dgazha lhun grub mchog gi gsung / kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag bsam dbang po'i rnam thar rtogs brjod/ phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i sge ma zhes bya ba yang dpe mdzod nas g.yar po zhus pa sogs la gzhi bcol te/ grag mtha' ba bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin ming pas slar yang zhu dag lan grangs 'ganya zhig dang bcas/ bal yul 'phags shing mchod rten rin po che'i nye 'dabs shrī gau tam buddha wi ha ra'i gsung rab rgyun spel khang nas/ phyi lo 240 lor spar bskran zhus pa dge'o// lto //skye ba kun tu yang dgablam dang / /bral med chos kyi dpal la longs sprod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon to rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog/ // 132sa 9789937—83 0
